words.en: If you are punctual, you do something or arrive somewhere at the right time and are not late.

words.ex: The purity of the water is checked every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天都会检查水的纯净度。
words.en: The quality or state of being pure, especially in terms of being free from anything that contaminates, pollutes, or dilutes.

words.ex: He went outside regardless of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 他不顾下雨就出去了。
words.en: If you say that someone does something regardless, you mean that they do it without taking account of the possible problems or difficulties.

words.ex: This region has many mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有很多山。
words.en: A region is a large area of land that is different from other areas of land, for example because it is one of the different parts of a country with its own customs and characteristics, or because it has a particular geographical feature.

words.tr:
v. 注册；登记；
n. 登记簿；
words.ex: He will register for the course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会注册这门课程。
words.en: If you register something, you officially record it or list it.

words.tr:
adj. 有规律的；经常的；常见的；
n. 常客；
words.ex: He goes for a run every morning, a regular habit.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑步，这是一个有规律的习惯。
words.en: Something that is regular happens or is done at equal intervals or is consistent in pattern or occurrence.

words.ex: The thermostat helps regulate the room temperature.
words.ex_cn: 恒温器有助于调节室温。
words.en: To regulate something means to control or manage it, especially by means of rules or laws.

words.ex: The government gives a subsidy to farmers.
words.ex_cn: 政府向农民提供补贴。
words.en: A subsidy is money that is paid by a government or other authority in order to help an industry or business, or to pay for a public service.

words.ex: Water is a common substance.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种常见的物质。
words.en: A substance is a particular kind of matter with uniform properties.

words.tr:
n. 代用品；代替物；
v. 替代；
words.ex: Honey is a good substitute for sugar.
words.ex_cn: 蜂蜜是糖的良好代用品。
words.en: A substitute is something or someone that takes the place or function of another.

words.tr: n. 说明或对白的字幕；副标题；
words.ex: The movie has English subtitles for the dialogue.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影为对白提供了英文字幕。
words.en: A subtitle is a secondary or explanatory title, or a translation of the dialogue in a film or television program, displayed at the bottom of the screen.

words.ex: Subtract 5 from 10 to get 5.
words.ex_cn: 从10中减去5得到5。
words.en: If you subtract one number from another, you take the first number away from the second.

words.ex: Honesty is a good trait.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一种好的特性。
words.en: A trait is a particular characteristic, quality, or tendency that someone or something has.

words.ex: He takes the tram to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上乘电车上班。
words.en: A tram is a vehicle that is used for public transportation in cities and towns, running on tracks laid in the streets.

words.ex: Water is vital for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you say that something is vital, you mean that it is necessary or very important.

words.ex: The painter used vivid colors to show the forest.
words.ex_cn: 画家用鲜艳的颜色来描绘森林。
words.en: If you describe memories and descriptions as vivid, you mean that they are very clear and detailed.

words.ex: He is learning vocational skills to become a mechanic.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习职业技能以成为一名机械师。
words.en: Relating to the skills you need to do a particular job.

words.ex: The volcano erupted last year.
words.ex_cn: 这座火山去年喷发了。
words.en: A volcano is a mountain that opens downward to a pool of molten rock below the surface of the earth. When pressure builds up, eruptions occur.

chapters.name: 6分词汇 Word List 29

words.tr: n. 外观；外表；出现；露面；
words.ex: The appearance of the house surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的外观让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The way that someone or something looks or the act of coming into view.

words.ex: He has an appetite for spicy food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢辛辣食物。
words.en: A desire or liking for something, especially food.

words.ex: The city had an economic boom after the new factory opened.
words.ex_cn: 新工厂开业后，这座城市迎来了经济繁荣。
words.en: If there is a boom in the economy, there is an increase in economic activity, for example in the amount of things that are being bought and sold.

words.tr:
v. 促进；使增长；
n. 提高；增强；
words.ex: Exercise can boost your energy.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进你的精力。
words.en: If one thing boosts another, it causes it to increase, improve, or be more successful.

words.ex: He conform to the rules of the school.
words.ex_cn: 他遵守学校的规章制度。
words.en: To conform means to behave in a way that is accepted by most people or to obey a rule, law, or custom.

words.ex: He must confront his fears.
words.ex_cn: 他必须面对自己的恐惧。
words.en: If you confront a difficult situation or issue, you accept the fact that it exists and try to deal with it.

words.ex: The instructions confuse me.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明让我感到困惑。
words.en: If you confuse two things, you mix them up in your mind so that you think one is the other.

words.ex: Don't discourage him from trying.
words.ex_cn: 不要阻止他尝试。
words.en: If someone or something discourages you, they cause you to lose your enthusiasm about your actions.

words.ex: They discriminate against people because of their race.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为种族而歧视他人。
words.en: To discriminate means to recognize a distinction; differentiate. It can also mean to make an unjust or prejudicial distinction in the treatment of different categories of people, especially on the grounds of race, sex, or age.

words.ex: The bird evolved from a small dinosaur.
words.ex_cn: 这种鸟由一种小型恐龙演变而来。
words.en: If something evolves or you evolve it, it gradually develops over a period of time into something different and usually more advanced.

words.ex: The car exceeded the speed limit.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车超过了限速。
words.en: To be greater in quantity, degree, or intensity than something else.

words.tr:
n. 过量；过度；超过；
adj. 多余的；
words.ex: The excess of sugar in his diet caused health problems.
words.ex_cn: 他饮食中糖分过量导致了健康问题。
words.en: An excess of something is a larger amount than is needed, allowed, or usual.

words.tr: v. 繁荣兴旺；茁壮成长；
words.ex: The business flourishes in the new market.
words.ex_cn: 这家企业在新市场中繁荣兴旺。
words.en: If something flourishes, it is successful, active, or common, and developing quickly and strongly.

words.ex: He stayed home because he had the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他因为得了流感待在家里。
words.en: The flu is an infectious disease characterized by fever, aches and pains, and respiratory symptoms.

words.tr: adj. 优雅的；优美的；得体的；
words.ex: The dancer moved in a graceful way.
words.ex_cn: 这位舞者动作优雅。
words.en: If you describe a person or their behavior as graceful, you mean that they move in a smooth, controlled, and attractive way.

words.tr: adj. 亲切的；和蔼的；仁慈的
words.ex: She was gracious and thanked everyone.
words.ex_cn: 她很友善，感谢了每一个人。
words.en: If you describe someone, especially someone you think is superior to you, as gracious, you mean that they are very well-mannered and pleasant.

words.ex: Hopefully, it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 但愿明天会下雨。
words.en: If you say that something will happen hopefully, you mean that you wish it to happen or you think it is likely to happen.

words.tr: n. 地平线；思想等的范围；眼界；
words.ex: The sun set below the horizon.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在地平线以下落山。
words.en: The horizon is the line at which the earth's surface and the sky appear to meet.

words.tr: adj. 不安全的；无保障的；缺乏自信的；无把握的
words.ex: He feels insecure when he is alone at night.
words.ex_cn: 当他晚上一个人时，他感到不安全。
words.en: If you are insecure, you lack confidence because you think that you are not good enough or are not loved.

words.ex: He felt insecurity when he lost his job.
words.ex_cn: 当他失去工作时，他感到不安全感。
words.en: Insecurity is a feeling of uncertainty or anxiety about oneself or one's situation.

words.ex: He inserts a coin into the machine.
words.ex_cn: 他把一枚硬币放进机器里。
words.en: To put or introduce something into something else.

words.ex: The children left litter on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在海滩上留下了垃圾。
words.en: If a place is littered with something, it contains many examples of it that are usually not arranged neatly or properly.

words.ex: The motion of the ball is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 球的运动非常快。
words.en: The action or process of moving or being moved.

words.ex: Good teachers motivate students to learn.
words.ex_cn: 好老师激励学生学习。
words.en: To motivate someone means to provide them with a reason for doing something, especially something that requires effort.

words.ex: The big rock was an obstacle on the road.
words.ex_cn: 那块大石头是路上的障碍。
words.en: An obstacle is something which makes it difficult for you to go forward or to achieve something.

words.ex: The fallen tree obstructs the road.
words.ex_cn: 倒下的树挡住了道路。
words.en: If something obstructs a road or path, it blocks it, stopping people or vehicles from getting past.

words.ex: He wants to pursue his dream of becoming a writer.
words.ex_cn: 他想追求成为作家的梦想。
words.en: If you pursue an activity, interest, or plan, you carry it out or follow it.

words.ex: His pursuit of happiness made him work hard every day.
words.ex_cn: 他对幸福的追求让他每天努力工作。
words.en: The act of pursuing something or someone, especially in order to catch or achieve them.

words.ex: The actors had a rehearsal before the play.
words.ex_cn: 演出前，演员们进行了一次排练。
words.en: A rehearsal of a play, dance, or piece of music is a practice of it in preparation for a performance.

words.ex: Exercise can reinforce your muscles.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以增强你的肌肉。
words.en: To reinforce something means to make it stronger or more effective.

words.ex: He reject the job offer.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝了这份工作邀请。
words.en: If you reject something such as a proposal, a request, or an offer, you do not accept it or you do not agree to it.

words.ex: They live in a quiet suburb outside the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在城市外一个安静的市郊。
words.en: A suburb is a residential district located on the outskirts of a city.

words.ex: The young manager is the successor to the CEO.
words.ex_cn: 这位年轻经理是首席执行官的接班人。
words.en: A successor is a person who takes a job or position previously held by someone else.

words.ex: The baby suck milk from the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿从奶瓶里吮吸牛奶。
words.en: To draw something into the mouth by creating a partial vacuum with the lips and tongue; to be very bad or unpleasant.

words.ex: We have sufficient food for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们有足够的食物用于这次旅行。
words.en: If something is sufficient for a particular purpose, there is enough of it for the purpose.

words.ex: He felt so sad that he thought about suicide.
words.ex_cn: 他感到非常难过，以至于想到了自杀。
words.en: Suicide is the act of deliberately killing oneself.

words.ex: The bank recorded the transaction quickly.
words.ex_cn: 银行迅速记录了这笔交易。
words.en: A transaction is an instance of buying or selling something; a business deal.

words.ex: The lab technician transcribes the DNA sequence into RNA.
words.ex_cn: 实验室技术员将DNA序列转录成RNA。
words.en: To transcribe something means to write it down or to copy it from one form of recording to another.

words.ex: I asked the school for a transcript of my grades.
words.ex_cn: 我向学校要了一份成绩单的副本。
words.en: A transcript is a written or printed version of something that has been recorded or spoken, especially in the context of academic records.

words.tr:
v. 转移；转让；调任；
n. 转移；转让；调任；
words.ex: He will transfer the money to his bank account.
words.ex_cn: 他将把钱转到他的银行账户。
words.en: If you transfer something or someone from one place to another, or they transfer from one place to another, they go from the first place to the second.

words.ex: The volume of the box is 10 cubic meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的体积是10立方米。
words.en: A volume is a book, especially one that is part of a series of books. It can also refer to the amount of space that a substance or object occupies, or the level of sound produced by a television, radio, etc.

words.ex: He did voluntary work at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院做志愿工作。
words.en: If something is voluntary, you do it because you choose to, and not because you have to.

chapters.name: 6分词汇 Word List 30

words.ex: The crowd applauded after the performance.
words.ex_cn: 演出结束后，观众鼓掌了。
words.en: To applaud means to show approval or praise by clapping the hands.

words.ex: He submitted his application for the job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周提交了那份工作申请。
words.en: An application is a formal request, often written, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something. It can also refer to the act of putting something to a special use or purpose, or a program or piece of software designed to perform a specific function.

words.ex: He wants to apply for a job at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请银行的工作。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.ex: He bought a hot dog from a food booth.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个小吃亭买了个热狗。
words.en: A booth is a small area separated from a larger public area by screens or thin walls where, for example, people can make a phone call or vote in private.

words.ex: The river forms the border between the two countries.
words.ex_cn: 这条河是两个国家的边界。
words.en: The edge or boundary of something, or the part near it; a dividing line.

words.ex: I congratulate you on your success.
words.ex_cn: 我祝贺你取得成功。
words.en: If you congratulate someone, you express pleasure for something good that has happened to them, or you praise them for something they have achieved.

words.ex: He sent her a card with congratulations.
words.ex_cn: 他给她寄了一张写有祝贺的卡片。
words.en: an expression of pleasure at someone's success or good fortune

words.tr: n. 代表大会；议会；国会；
words.ex: The congress met to discuss new laws.
words.ex_cn: 代表大会召开以讨论新法律。
words.en: A congress is a formal meeting of representatives, as of various nations, to discuss problems or to make decisions.

words.ex: The army conquered the small city after a long battle.
words.ex_cn: 军队经过长期战斗征服了这座小城。
words.en: To conquer means to take control of a country or city and its people by force, or to successfully deal with or control something.

words.ex: He felt dismay when he saw the low grade.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到低分时，感到沮丧。
words.en: Dismay is a feeling of unhappiness and disappointment.

words.ex: He dismissed her advice and walked away.
words.ex_cn: 他不理会她的建议，走开了。
words.en: If you dismiss someone, you send them away or allow them to leave.

words.ex: The rule excludes children under 12.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则排除了12岁以下的孩子。
words.en: To exclude someone or something means to prevent them from entering a place or taking part in an activity.

words.ex: We went on an excursion to the mountains last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去山区进行了短途旅行。
words.en: An excursion is a short journey or trip, especially one taken as a leisure activity.

words.ex: The price of oil fluctuates every day.
words.ex_cn: 油价每天都在波动。
words.en: To fluctuate means to change or vary frequently and unpredictably.

words.ex: He flushes the toilet after using it.
words.ex_cn: 他用完厕所后冲水。
words.en: If you flush, your face goes red because you are hot or ill, or because you are feeling a strong emotion such as embarrassment or anger. To flush a toilet means to cause water to pass through it in order to clean it.

words.ex: The hotel has a five-star grade.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有五星级别的等级。
words.en: A grade is a level of quality, rank, or value, or a mark given in an examination or for school work.

words.tr: adj. 逐渐的；逐步的；渐进的；
words.ex: The change was gradual.
words.ex_cn: 这种变化是逐渐的。
words.en: A gradual change or process happens in small stages over a long period of time, rather than suddenly.

words.ex: The movie was horrible and made me scared.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影很恐怖，让我害怕。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as horrible, you mean they are very unpleasant or bad.

words.ex: His insight helped the team solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他的洞察力帮助团队解决了问题。
words.en: If you gain insight or an insight into a complex situation or problem, you gain an accurate and deep understanding of it.

words.ex: She insists on going home now.
words.ex_cn: 她坚决要求现在回家。
words.en: If you insist on doing something, you keep doing it, even though it is difficult or other people are against it.

words.ex: The teacher will inspect our homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天会检查我们的作业。
words.en: If you inspect something, you look at it very carefully, usually in order to find out something about it.

words.tr: v. 互相作用；互相影响；交流；沟通；
words.ex: The two chemicals interact when mixed.
words.ex_cn: 这两种化学物质混合时会互相作用。
words.en: If people interact with each other, they communicate or work together.

words.tr: adj. 互相依赖的；相倚的；
words.ex: The two countries are interdependent in trade.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家在贸易上互相依赖。
words.en: If two or more things are interdependent, they depend on each other.

words.tr: adj. 充满生机的；活泼的；
words.ex: The market is lively with people and music.
words.ex_cn: 市场里人来人往，音乐欢快，充满生机。
words.en: If you describe someone as lively, you mean they are full of life, energy, or enthusiasm.

words.tr:
n. 负荷；载重；
v. 载入；
words.ex: The bridge can't hold such a heavy load.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥承受不了这么重的负荷。
words.en: A load is a large quantity of something that is carried by a vehicle, person, or animal, or the amount of work that a person or machine has to do.

words.ex: His motive was to help his family.
words.ex_cn: 他的动机是帮助家人。
words.en: Your motive for doing something is your reason for doing it.

words.ex: Her motto is 'Never give up.'
words.ex_cn: 她的座右铭是‘永不放弃’。
words.en: A motto is a short sentence or phrase that expresses a rule for sensible behavior, especially a way of behaving in a particular situation.

words.tr:
n. 山；
v. 逐渐增加；
words.ex: He climbed the mount early in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 他一大早爬了那座山。
words.en: To mount something means to go up it or to get on it. It can also refer to the act of organizing and beginning something, such as an event or an exhibition.

words.ex: It is obvious that he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 很明显他很累。
words.en: If something is obvious, it is easy to see or understand.

words.ex: The cat occupies the sofa all day.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫整天占据着沙发。
words.en: If people or things occupy a place, they are in it or fill it.

words.ex: The accident occurred yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 事故昨天发生了。
words.en: If something occurs, it happens.

words.tr: v. 有关；把…联系起来；认同；叙述；理解；
words.ex: This story relates to your childhood.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事与你的童年有关。
words.en: If you relate a story, you tell it. If two things relate, they are connected in some way.

words.tr:
adj. 相对的；相关联的；
n. 亲戚；
words.ex: His success is relative to his hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他的成功是相对于他的努力而言的。
words.en: A relative is someone who is part of your family. Parents, siblings, uncles, aunts, grandparents, cousins, nieces and nephews — they're all relatives.

words.tr:
n. 释放；发布；
v. 释放；发布；
words.ex: The release of the prisoner made everyone happy.
words.ex_cn: 囚犯的释放让每个人都高兴。
words.en: To release something means to let it go or to allow it to be free, or to make something available to the public.

words.tr:
n. 金额；总数；
v. 概括；
words.ex: The sum of the bill is fifty dollars.
words.ex_cn: 账单的金额是五十美元。
words.en: A sum is an amount of money, or the total amount of two or more amounts of money added together.

words.ex: He gave a summary of the story at the end.
words.ex_cn: 他在结尾对故事做了总结。
words.en: A summary is a brief statement or account of the main points of something.

words.ex: The climbers reached the summit of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 登山者到达了山顶。
words.en: The highest point of a hill or mountain; a meeting between heads of government.

words.ex: His knowledge of history is superficial.
words.ex_cn: 他对历史的了解是表面的。
words.en: If you describe someone as superficial, you disapprove of them because they do not think deeply, and have little understanding of anything serious or important.

words.ex: The new teacher transformed the class into a lively group.
words.ex_cn: 这位新老师把班级变成了一个充满活力的团体。
words.en: To transform something or someone means to change them completely and usually improve their appearance, form, or structure.

words.tr:
n. 志愿者；
v. 自愿做；
words.ex: He is a volunteer at the local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他是当地医院的一名志愿者。
words.en: A volunteer is someone who does work without being paid for it, especially work that involves helping people.

words.ex: They went on a long voyage across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行了一次横跨海洋的长途航行。
words.en: A voyage is a long journey, especially by sea or in space.

words.ex: Children are vulnerable to colds in winter.
words.ex_cn: 儿童在冬天容易感冒。
words.en: If someone or something is vulnerable, they are weak and without protection, with the result that they are easily hurt physically or emotionally.

chapters.name: 6分词汇 Word List 31

words.ex: I have an appointment with my doctor at 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我下午三点有个医生的约会。
words.en: An appointment is a formal arrangement to meet or visit someone at a particular time, especially for a purpose connected with their work or official position.

words.ex: I appreciate the beauty of nature.
words.ex_cn: 我欣赏大自然的美。
words.en: If you appreciate something, you recognize its value and feel grateful for it.

words.tr:
n. 熊；
v. 承受；忍受；带有；生（孩子）；
words.ex: A bear walked near the campsite.
words.ex_cn: 一只熊在露营地附近走动。
words.en: If you bear something, you accept it and are able to deal with it, even though it is unpleasant or painful. A bear is a large, strong wild animal with thick fur and sharp claws.

words.ex: He was conscious after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后他醒了过来。
words.en: If you are conscious of something, you notice it or are aware of it.

words.ex: Lying has serious consequences.
words.ex_cn: 撒谎会有严重的后果。
words.en: A consequence is a result or effect of an action or condition.

words.ex: He is a conservative man who likes old traditions.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢古老传统的保守男子。
words.en: A conservative person or group is one that does not like changes or new ideas, especially in politics or religion.

words.tr:
n. 展示；陈列；
v. 展示；陈列；
words.ex: The store has a big display of new phones.
words.ex_cn: 商店里有一个新手机的展示。
words.en: To display something means to put it in a place where people can see it easily, or to show it to people.

words.ex: The disposal of waste is important for the environment.
words.ex_cn: 废物的处理对环境很重要。
words.en: The act or process of getting rid of something, especially by throwing it away or selling it.

words.ex: The computer will execute the program quickly.
words.ex_cn: 计算机将快速执行该程序。
words.en: To execute means to carry out or put into effect a plan, order, or course of action. It can also refer to the act of legally killing someone as a punishment.

words.ex: He exerted pressure on his team to win.
words.ex_cn: 他给他的团队施加了压力以赢得比赛。
words.en: To exert means to use power, influence, or effort to make something happen.

words.tr:
v. 集中；聚焦；
n. 中心点；焦点；
words.ex: He needs to focus on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you focus on a particular topic or if your attention is focused on it, you concentrate on it and think about it, discuss it, or deal with it, rather than dealing with other topics.

words.tr:
n. 折痕；褶；
v. 折叠；
words.ex: The paper has a deep fold in the middle.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸中间有一道深深的折痕。
words.en: To bend something, especially paper or cloth, so that one part of it lies flat on top of another part; to be able to be bent in this way.

words.tr:
n. 大学毕业生；
v. 毕业；
words.ex: He is a graduate of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的毕业生。
words.en: A graduate is a person who has successfully completed a degree at a university or college and has received a certificate or diploma stating this. To graduate means to successfully complete a degree at a university or college.

words.tr:
adj. 壮丽的；堂皇的；重大的；总的；
n. 大钢琴；
words.ex: The grand castle stood on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 壮丽的城堡矗立在山上。
words.en: If you describe a building or a piece of scenery as grand, you mean that its size or appearance is very impressive.

words.tr:
n. 主人；主持人；
v. 主持；
words.ex: The host welcomed us with tea and cookies.
words.ex_cn: 主人用茶和饼干欢迎了我们。
words.en: A host is a person who receives or entertains guests, especially in their own home. A host is also a person who presents a television or radio program.

words.tr: n. （校外）学生宿舍；旅社；招待所；
words.ex: The students live in a cheap hostel near the university.
words.ex_cn: 学生们住在大学附近的一家便宜的学生宿舍里。
words.en: A hostel is a budget-oriented, shared-room accommodation that attracts a diverse clientele, including backpackers, students, and travelers seeking an economical place to stay.

words.tr: n. 检查；视察；查看；审视；
words.ex: The teacher did an inspection of the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师对教室进行了检查。
words.en: An inspection is an official visit to a building or organization to check that everything is satisfactory and that rules are being obeyed.

words.ex: He will install the new software on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他将在他的电脑上安装新软件。
words.en: To set up or fix in position for use or service.

words.ex: This is a good instance of teamwork.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个团队合作的好例子。
words.en: An instance is a particular example or case of something.

words.ex: The bank gave a loan to the student.
words.ex_cn: 银行向学生提供了一笔贷款。
words.en: A loan is a sum of money that you borrow.

words.ex: The store offers multiple flavors of ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供多种口味的冰淇淋。
words.en: If something is multiple, it consists of or involves many things of the same kind.

words.ex: The bacteria multiply quickly.
words.ex_cn: 细菌迅速增加。
words.en: If you multiply one number by another, you add the first number to itself as many times as is indicated by the second number. For example, 2 multiplied by 3 is equal to 6.

words.tr:
n. 低语声；嘟哝
v. 低语；咕哝；私下抱怨
words.ex: I heard a murmur from the next room.
words.ex_cn: 我听到隔壁房间传来低语声。
words.en: A murmur is a low, indistinct, continuous sound, as of a stream or of voices.

words.tr: adj. 奇怪的；奇数的；余的；
words.ex: He wore an odd hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶奇怪的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as odd, you mean that they are strange or unusual.

words.tr: adj. 爱发号施令的；多管闲事的
words.ex: The officious clerk refused to help unless I filled out another form.
words.ex_cn: 那位爱多管闲事的职员拒绝帮忙，除非我再填一份表格。
words.en: If you describe someone as officious, you are critical of them because they are eager to tell people what to do when you think they should not.

words.ex: The rain offset the heat yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天的雨抵消了炎热。
words.en: If one thing is offset by another, the effect of the first thing is reduced by the second, so that any advantage or disadvantage is cancelled out.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians built pyramids for their kings.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人为他们的国王建造了金字塔。
words.en: A pyramid is a monumental structure with a square or triangular base and sloping sides that meet in a point at the top, especially one built of stone as a royal tomb in ancient Egypt.

words.ex: This information is relevant to our project.
words.ex_cn: 这些信息与我们的项目相关。
words.en: Something that is relevant to a situation or person is important or significant in that situation or to that person.

words.ex: He is a reliable friend who always helps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮忙。
words.en: Able to be trusted to do or provide what is needed or right.

words.ex: He visits a religious temple every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都去一座宗教寺庙。
words.en: Relating to or believing in a religion.

words.ex: This phone is superior to the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机比旧的更好。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as superior, you mean that they are better than other people or things.

words.ex: The teacher supervises the students during the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 老师在实验期间指导学生。
words.en: If you supervise an activity or a person, you make sure that the activity is done correctly or that the person is doing a task or behaving correctly.

words.tr:
v. 补充；
n. 补充物；附加费；
words.ex: He supplements his income by teaching part-time.
words.ex_cn: 他通过兼职教学来补充收入。
words.en: A supplement is something that is added to something else in order to make it complete or better.

words.tr: adj. 增补性的；补充性的；
words.ex: The teacher gave supplementary notes for the lesson.
words.ex_cn: 老师为这节课提供了增补性的笔记。
words.en: Supplementary things are added to something in order to improve it or make it more complete.

words.ex: I suppose he is late because of the traffic.
words.ex_cn: 我认为他因为交通堵塞而迟到了。
words.en: If you suppose that something is true, you believe or imagine that it is true, although you may not have any proof.

words.ex: The transit of goods takes three days.
words.ex_cn: 货物的运输需要三天。
words.en: The act or process of passing through or across; the conveyance of people or goods from one place to another.

words.ex: He can translate words into pictures.
words.ex_cn: 他能把词语转化为图画。
words.en: To translate means to change written or spoken words from one language into another, or to explain something in a way that is easier to understand.

words.ex: The radio transmits music to listeners.
words.ex_cn: 收音机将音乐传递给听众。
words.en: To send or pass something from one person, place, or thing to another.

words.ex: The glass is transparent.
words.ex_cn: 这玻璃是透明的。
words.en: If something is transparent, you can see through it.

words.ex: He likes to wander in the park after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢晚饭后在公园里徘徊。
words.en: If you wander in a place, you walk around there in a casual way, often without intending to go in any particular direction or to any particular place.

words.ex: He put his clothes in the wardrobe.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服放进衣橱里。
words.en: A wardrobe is a tall cupboard or cabinet in which you can hang your clothes.

words.ex: She weaves a basket from reeds.
words.ex_cn: 她用芦苇编织一个篮子。
words.en: If you weave cloth or a carpet, you make it by crossing threads over and under each other using a machine or a frame called a loom.

chapters.name: 6分词汇 Word List 32

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.tr: adj. 适当的；合适的；恰当的；
words.ex: This dress is appropriate for a wedding.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子适合参加婚礼。
words.en: Something that is appropriate is suitable or acceptable for a particular situation.

words.ex: Don't bother to clean the room, I'll do it later.
words.ex_cn: 别麻烦去打扫房间了，我稍后会做。
words.en: To bother someone means to cause them trouble or to annoy them.

words.ex: He has a considerable amount of money.
words.ex_cn: 他有相当多的钱。
words.en: Considerable means large in size, amount, or extent.

words.ex: The team consists of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: If something consists of particular things or people, it is made up of them.

words.tr: adj. 恒定的；不变的；持续的；
words.ex: The temperature is constant in this room.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的温度是恒定的。
words.en: Something that is constant happens all the time or is always there.

words.ex: Five apples constitute a basket.
words.ex_cn: 五个苹果构成一篮子。
words.en: If something constitutes a particular thing, it can be regarded as being that thing.

words.tr:
n. 纠纷；争端；
v. 对（某事）有异议；
words.ex: The dispute between the two neighbors was about the fence.
words.ex_cn: 两个邻居之间的纠纷是关于篱笆的。
words.en: A dispute is a disagreement or argument about something important.

words.tr:
n. 漠视；忽视；
v. 漠视；不理会；不顾；
words.ex: His advice was met with disregard.
words.ex_cn: 他的建议遭到了漠视。
words.en: If you disregard something, you ignore it or do not take account of it.

words.ex: He wrote his dissertation on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的学位论文。
words.en: A dissertation is a long piece of writing on a particular subject, especially one written for a university degree.

words.ex: He exhale slowly after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后慢慢呼出气。
words.en: To exhale means to breathe out air from your lungs.

words.tr:
v. 耗尽；用完；使筋疲力尽
n. 排气管；废气
words.ex: The long hike exhausted him.
words.ex_cn: 这次漫长的徒步旅行让他筋疲力尽。
words.en: If something exhausts you, it makes you so tired, either physically or mentally, that you have no energy left.

words.tr:
n. 预测；预报；
v. 预测；预报；
words.ex: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 天气预测说明天会下雨。
words.en: If you forecast future events, you say what you think is going to happen in the future.

words.ex: The school forbids students to use phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: To forbid something means to order that it must not be done.

words.ex: I forgive you for being late.
words.ex_cn: 我原谅你迟到了。
words.en: If you forgive someone who has done something bad or wrong, you stop being angry with them and stop blaming them.

words.ex: The story had a graphic description of the battle.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事对战斗的描述非常生动。
words.en: A graphic is a visual representation of data or information, such as a chart, diagram, or picture.

words.ex: The hostile neighbor shouted at us every morning.
words.ex_cn: 那个敌意的邻居每天早上都对我们大喊大叫。
words.en: If you are hostile to another person or an idea, you disagree with them or disapprove of them, often showing this in your behavior.

words.ex: Birds fly south by instinct.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类凭本能飞向南方。
words.en: An instinct is the natural tendency that a person or animal has to behave or react in a particular way.

words.tr:
n. 研究所；学院；协会；
v. 建立；制定；
words.ex: He works at a research institute.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家研究所工作。
words.en: An institute is an organization set up to do a particular type of work, especially research or teaching. It can also refer to the act of starting something such as a system or an official process.

words.ex: The teacher instructed the students to open their books.
words.ex_cn: 老师指示学生打开书。
words.en: To instruct someone means to tell or teach them to do something, especially in a formal or official way.

words.ex: The locality has many small shops and cafes.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有许多小商店和咖啡馆。
words.en: A locality is a particular place or area, especially in relation to its geographical position or features.

words.tr: v. 确定…的位置；使坐落于；查找…的地点；
words.ex: Can you locate the hotel on the map?
words.ex_cn: 你能在地图上找到酒店的位置吗？
words.en: To locate something means to find out exactly where it is, or to establish something in a particular place.

words.ex: He picked a wild mushroom in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他在森林里摘了一朵野生蘑菇。
words.en: A mushroom is a fungus that grows in damp, dark places and has a stem with a rounded top.

words.tr:
adj. 无数的；
n. 无数；
words.ex: There are myriad stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中有无数的星星。
words.en: A myriad of things or people is a very large number of them.

words.ex: The dogs had three offspring last spring.
words.ex_cn: 这些狗去年春天生了三只幼崽。
words.en: Someone's offspring are their children.

words.ex: He omitted the last word in the sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他省略了句子中的最后一个词。
words.en: If you omit something, you do not include it in an activity or piece of work, deliberately or accidentally.

words.ex: The project is ongoing.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目正在进行中。
words.en: An ongoing situation has been happening for quite a long time and seems likely to continue for some time in the future.

words.tr: n. 减缓；宽慰；解脱；救济；
words.ex: The medicine brought relief to his pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药缓解了他的疼痛。
words.en: Relief is a feeling of reassurance and relaxation following release from anxiety or distress.

words.ex: He was reluctant to leave his home.
words.ex_cn: 他不愿意离开家。
words.en: If you are reluctant to do something, you are unwilling to do it and hesitate before doing it, or do it slowly and without enthusiasm.

words.tr:
n. 袋子；
v. 劫掠；
words.ex: He carried the apples in a burlap sack.
words.ex_cn: 他把苹果装在一个麻布袋里。
words.en: A sack is a large bag made of rough woven material, used for storing or carrying goods. It can also refer to the act of dismissing someone from employment or the act of looting a place.

words.ex: The temple is a sacred place for believers.
words.ex_cn: 这座寺庙对信徒来说是神圣的地方。
words.en: Something that is sacred is considered to be holy or connected with God or a god.

words.tr:
v. 牺牲；
n. 牺牲（品）；
words.ex: He sacrificed his time to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他牺牲了自己的时间来帮助朋友。
words.en: If you sacrifice something that is valuable or important, you give it up, usually to obtain something else for yourself or for other people.

words.ex: The fence safeguards the garden from animals.
words.ex_cn: 围栏保护花园免受动物侵扰。
words.en: A safeguard is a measure taken to protect someone or something from potential harm or danger.

words.ex: The soup is too salty.
words.ex_cn: 这汤太咸了。
words.en: Something that is salty contains salt or tastes of salt.

words.ex: The supreme leader makes the final decision.
words.ex_cn: 至上的领导人做出最终决定。
words.en: If you say that something is supreme, you mean that it is the most important or the best of its kind.

words.ex: There was a surge in sales during the holiday season.
words.ex_cn: 假期期间销量激增。
words.en: If something surges, it increases suddenly and greatly, after having been steady or only small in size or amount.

words.ex: He needs surgery for his broken arm.
words.ex_cn: 他需要做手术来治疗断掉的胳膊。
words.en: Surgery is the medical specialty that uses operative manual and instrumental techniques on a patient to investigate or treat a pathological condition such as a disease or injury, to help improve bodily function or appearance, or to repair unwanted ruptured areas.

words.ex: He surpassed his brother in math scores.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学成绩上超过了他弟弟。
words.en: If one person or thing surpasses another, the first is better than, or has more of a particular quality than, the second.

words.tr:
v. 移栽；移植；
n. 移植；
words.ex: He will transplant the flowers to the garden tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天要把这些花移栽到花园里。
words.en: To transplant something means to move it from one place to another. In medicine, to transplant an organ, piece of skin, etc. means to use it to replace a damaged part in someone's body.

words.tr:
n. 运输；
v. 运输；
words.ex: He uses public transport to go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐公共交通去上班。
words.en: To transport something or someone is to move them from one place to another, especially over long distances.

words.tr:
v. 陷入（困境）；设圈套；
n. 圈套；陷阱；困境；
words.ex: He trapped himself in debt by spending too much.
words.ex_cn: 他因花钱太多而陷入债务困境。
words.en: A trap is a device or enclosure designed to catch and retain animals, typically by allowing entry but not exit or by catching hold of a part of the body.

words.tr:
n. 珍宝；宝物；财富；
v. 珍惜；
words.ex: The old map showed where the treasure was buried.
words.ex_cn: 那张旧地图显示了珍宝埋藏的地方。
words.en: If you treasure something that you have, you keep it or care for it carefully because it gives you great pleasure and you think it is very special.

chapters.name: 6分词汇 Word List 33

words.tr: v. 批准；认可；通过；赞成(连of)
words.ex: My mom will approve my new phone.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈会同意我买新手机。
words.en: If you approve of an action, event, or suggestion, you like it or are pleased about it.

words.tr:
adj. 近似的；大约的；
v. 接近；
words.ex: The approximate cost is $50.
words.ex_cn: 费用大约是50美元。
words.en: An approximate number, time, or position is close to the correct number, time, or position, but is not exact.

words.ex: He loves archaeology and digs old artifacts.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱考古学，挖掘古代文物。
words.en: Archaeology is the study of the societies and peoples of the past by examining the remains of their buildings, tools, and other objects.

words.ex: The fence marks the boundary between the two gardens.
words.ex_cn: 这道围栏标志着两个花园的分界线。
words.en: A boundary is a real or imagined line that marks the edge or limit of something.

words.ex: The law constrains companies from polluting rivers.
words.ex_cn: 法律约束公司不得污染河流。
words.en: To constrain someone or something means to limit their development or force them to behave in a particular way.

words.tr:
v. 建造；构造；
n. 概念；
words.ex: They construct houses with bricks.
words.ex_cn: 他们用砖块建造房屋。
words.en: To construct something means to build or create it, usually something large such as a building, road, or machine.

words.ex: He will consult a doctor for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他将咨询医生治疗他的头痛。
words.en: to seek information or advice from someone, especially someone who is an expert in a particular field

words.ex: The car consumes a lot of gas.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车消耗很多汽油。
words.en: To consume something means to eat or drink it, or to use it up in some way.

words.ex: Sugar dissolves in water.
words.ex_cn: 糖在水中溶解。
words.en: If a substance dissolves in liquid or if you dissolve a substance, it becomes mixed with the liquid and disappears.

words.ex: The two colors are distinct.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色有区别。
words.en: If something is distinct, it is easily seen, heard, or understood.

words.ex: The museum will exhibit ancient coins next month.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆下个月将展览古钱币。
words.en: To exhibit something means to show it in a public place so that people can go to see it. It can also mean to show a particular quality, ability, or type of behavior.

words.ex: The museum held an exhibition of ancient art.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆举办了一场古代艺术展览。
words.en: An exhibition is a public display of works of art or items of interest, often held in a museum or art gallery.

words.tr:
n. 格式；
v. 格式化；
words.ex: The file is in PDF format.
words.ex_cn: 这个文件是PDF格式。
words.en: The way in which something is arranged or set out.

words.tr:
n. 补助金；授予物；
v. 承认；授予；允许；
words.ex: The university received a grant for scientific research.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学收到了一笔用于科学研究的补助金。
words.en: If someone in authority grants you something, or if something is granted to you, you are allowed to have it or do it.

words.ex: A hammer is a useful instrument for building.
words.ex_cn: 锤子是建造时有用的工具。
words.en: An instrument is a tool or device used for a particular task, especially for scientific, medical, or technical work. It can also refer to a musical instrument.

words.ex: The water supply is insufficient for the whole village.
words.ex_cn: 供水对整个村庄来说是不充分的。
words.en: If something is insufficient, it is not enough for a particular purpose.

words.tr: v. 隔离；使隔热；使隔音；使绝缘
words.ex: The walls insulate the house from cold air.
words.ex_cn: 墙壁将房子与冷空气隔离开。
words.en: To insulate something means to protect it from heat, cold, noise, or electricity by covering it in a material that prevents it from passing through.

words.ex: Don't interfere when I am working.
words.ex_cn: 我工作时不要打扰。
words.en: To interfere means to involve oneself in a situation where one is not wanted or needed, often causing problems or hindering progress.

words.tr:
n. 内部；
adj. 内部的；
words.ex: The interior of the house is very cozy.
words.ex_cn: 房子的内部非常舒适。
words.en: The interior of something is the inside part of it.

words.ex: He ate a lump of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块糖。
words.en: A lump is a solid piece of something, often with no particular shape. If you lump things together, you put them together in a group or treat them as the same.

words.ex: She stayed in a luxurious hotel with gold faucets.
words.ex_cn: 她住进了一家有金色水龙头的奢侈酒店。
words.en: Something that is luxurious is very comfortable and expensive, and often involves great pleasure or indulgence.

words.ex: The mysterious box appeared on his doorstep.
words.ex_cn: 那个神秘的盒子出现在他的门口。
words.en: If someone or something is mysterious, it is not fully understood or explained and seems interesting or puzzling.

words.ex: It's a myth that eating late at night causes weight gain.
words.ex_cn: 晚上吃东西会导致发胖，这是一种错误观念。
words.en: A myth is a traditional story, especially one concerning the early history of a people or explaining some natural or social phenomenon, and typically involving supernatural beings or events.

words.tr: n. 神话；神话学；神话集；
words.ex: He loves reading Greek mythology.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读希腊神话。
words.en: Mythology is a collection of myths, especially one belonging to a particular religious or cultural tradition.

words.tr: v. 运转；操作；施行手术；
words.ex: The machine operates smoothly.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器运转顺畅。
words.en: If you operate a business or organization, you work to keep it running properly. If a business or organization operates, it carries out its work.

words.ex: The operation of the machine is very smooth.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的运行非常顺畅。
words.en: An operation is a planned activity involving many people performing various tasks.

words.ex: He defeated his opponent in the chess game.
words.ex_cn: 他在国际象棋比赛中击败了对手。
words.en: An opponent is someone who is competing against you in a contest, game, or argument, or someone who is opposed to an idea or plan.

words.ex: Children rely on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们依靠父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: If you rely on someone or something, you need them and depend on them in order to live or work properly.

words.tr: adj. 不同寻常的；非凡的；显著的；值得注意的；
words.ex: She made a remarkable improvement in just one month.
words.ex_cn: 她在短短一个月内取得了不同寻常的进步。
words.en: Unusual or striking in a way that attracts attention.

words.ex: The doctor suggested a natural remedy for the cold.
words.ex_cn: 医生建议了一种治疗感冒的天然疗法。
words.en: A remedy is a cure or a way of making something better.

words.tr:
n. 样品；样本；
v. 抽样；
words.ex: The scientist tested the sample from the river.
words.ex_cn: 科学家测试了来自河流的样品。
words.en: A sample is a small quantity of a product, especially food, given to customers so that they can try it before buying it.

words.tr:
n. 批准；允许；认可；制裁；处罚
v. 批准；认可；制裁；处罚
words.ex: The company got official sanction to open a new branch.
words.ex_cn: 该公司获得了开设新分公司的正式批准。
words.en: A sanction is a penalty for disobeying a law or rule, or an official permission or approval for an action.

words.ex: The kitchen must be sanitary to prevent illness.
words.ex_cn: 厨房必须保持清洁以防止疾病。
words.en: relating to the conditions that affect hygiene and health, especially the supply of sewage facilities and clean drinking water

words.tr:
n. 规模；等级；比例（尺）；刻度；秤；
v. 改变…大小；
words.ex: The scale of the project surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的规模让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: A scale is a set of levels or numbers which are used in a particular system of measuring things or are used when comparing things.

words.ex: He scan the QR code with his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他用手机扫描了二维码。
words.en: To look at something carefully or quickly in order to find out specific information or to examine something thoroughly.

words.ex: He has a scar on his arm from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他手臂上有一道事故留下的伤疤。
words.en: A mark left on the skin after a wound or injury has healed, or the act of causing such a mark.

words.ex: The farm has a surplus of apples this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年农场苹果过剩。
words.en: A surplus is an amount of something that is extra or more than what is needed.

words.ex: He will surrender when he sees the police.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到警察时，他会投降。
words.en: If you surrender, you stop fighting or resisting someone and agree that you have been beaten.

words.tr:
n. 调查；勘测；
v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did a survey about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了一项关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: A survey is a detailed study or inspection, especially as a means of collecting information about people's opinions or behavior.

words.ex: The doctor gave him proper treatment for the infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他提供了针对感染的适当治疗。
words.en: The act or manner of treating someone or something, especially in a medical context.

words.ex: Two countries signed a treaty to stop the war.
words.ex_cn: 两个国家签署了一项条约以停止战争。
words.en: A treaty is a formal agreement between two or more countries or groups, especially one that is written down and signed by their leaders.

words.tr:
v. 发抖；打颤；战栗；焦虑
n. 震颤；发抖；战栗
words.ex: The old man tremble in the cold wind.
words.ex_cn: 老人在寒风中发抖。
words.en: If you tremble, you shake slightly because you are frightened or cold.

chapters.name: 6分词汇 Word List 34

words.ex: A problem arose during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议中出现了一个问题。
words.en: If a situation or problem arises, it begins to exist or people start to become aware of it.

words.ex: The movie aroused his curiosity.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影激起了他的好奇心。
words.en: If something arouses a particular reaction or attitude in people, it causes them to have that reaction or attitude.

words.ex: The archer drew the bow and shot the arrow.
words.ex_cn: 弓箭手拉弓射出了箭。
words.en: A bow is a knot with two loops and two loose ends that is used in tying shoelaces and decorative ribbons. It is also the front part of a ship or boat.

words.ex: The consumer buys food at the store.
words.ex_cn: 消费者在商店购买食物。
words.en: A consumer is a person who buys goods or uses services.

words.ex: The consumption of water has increased this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年水的消耗量增加了。
words.en: Consumption is the act of buying and using products.

words.tr:
n. 接触；联系；
v. 接触；联系；
words.ex: The two balls made contact when they collided.
words.ex_cn: 两个球在碰撞时发生了接触。
words.en: Contact refers to the act of communicating with someone, especially regularly, or the state of touching something.

words.ex: The box contains five apples.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子包含五个苹果。
words.en: If something such as a box, bag, room, or place contains things, those things are inside it.

words.ex: The two colors distinguish the two teams.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色使两个队伍有所不同。
words.en: If you can distinguish one thing from another, you can see or understand how they are different.

words.ex: The mirror distorts my face.
words.ex_cn: 这面镜子扭曲了我的脸。
words.en: If you distort a statement, fact, or idea, you report or represent it in an untrue way.

words.ex: The existence of life on other planets is still unknown.
words.ex_cn: 其他星球上是否存在生命仍不清楚。
words.en: The state or fact of existing; being.

words.ex: The exit is near the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 出口在楼梯附近。
words.en: To exit means to go out of or leave a place.

words.ex: The company used a new formula to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 公司使用了一个新方案来解决问题。
words.en: A formula is a plan or method that is used to achieve a particular goal, especially in science or mathematics.

words.tr:
v. 领会；抓紧；
n. 领会；
words.ex: I couldn't grasp the meaning of the poem.
words.ex_cn: 我没能领会这首诗的含义。
words.en: To grasp something means to take it in your hand and hold it firmly.

words.ex: I am grateful for your help.
words.ex_cn: 我感激你的帮助。
words.en: If you are grateful for something that someone has given you or done for you, you have warm, friendly feelings towards them and wish to thank them.

words.tr:
v. 拥抱；紧抱；抱有；挨着
n. 拥抱；搂抱
words.ex: She gave him a big hug when he arrived.
words.ex_cn: 他到达时，她给了他一个大大的拥抱。
words.en: To hug someone means to put your arms around them and hold them tightly, for example because you like them or are pleased to see them.

words.ex: He bought insurance for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车买了保险。
words.en: Insurance is an arrangement in which you pay money to a company, and they pay money to you if something unpleasant happens to you, for example if your property is stolen or damaged, or if you get a serious illness.

words.ex: The doctor checked his daily intake of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他每天的糖摄入量。
words.en: The process of taking something in, especially food, air, or information.

words.ex: Honesty is an integral part of a good relationship.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是良好关系中不可或缺的一部分。
words.en: Something that is integral is very important or necessary. If something is an integral part of a whole, it is an essential part of that whole.

words.ex: The location of the store is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店的位置在公园附近。
words.en: A location is the place where something happens or is situated.

words.ex: He opted to stay home instead of going out.
words.ex_cn: 他选择待在家里而不是出去。
words.en: If you opt for something, or opt to do something, you choose it or decide to do it in preference to anything else.

words.ex: He is optimistic about the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来持乐观态度。
words.en: Someone who is optimistic is hopeful about the future or the success of something in particular.

words.ex: He changed his pace to match the group.
words.ex_cn: 他调整了步伐以跟上队伍。
words.en: The speed at which someone or something moves, or with which something happens or changes.

words.ex: The two countries signed a pacific agreement.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了一项和平协议。
words.en: A pacific person, country, or policy is peaceful and seeks to avoid conflict.

words.tr: adj. 充满...的；挤满人的；拥挤的； v. 包装；“pack”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The bus was packed with people.
words.ex_cn: 公交车上挤满了人。
words.en: Filled with a large number of people or things.

words.ex: Please remind me to call my mom tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 请提醒我明天给我妈妈打电话。
words.en: If someone reminds you of a fact or event that you already know about, they say something which makes you think about it.

words.tr:
adj. 偏远的；久远的；
n. 遥控器；
words.ex: The village is in a remote area far from the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄位于远离城市的偏远地区。
words.en: Remote areas are far away from cities and places where most people live, and are therefore difficult to get to.

words.ex: Please remove the trash from the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 请把厨房的垃圾去掉。
words.en: To take something or someone away from a place or off a surface.

words.ex: The rain rendered the road slippery.
words.ex_cn: 雨水使道路变得滑溜。
words.en: To render something means to cause it to become or to provide it. It can also mean to express or translate something.

words.tr: adj. 缺乏的；不足的；稀有的；
words.ex: Water is scarce in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠里水很缺乏。
words.en: If something is scarce, there is not enough of it.

words.ex: He scarcely ate anything at dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐几乎没吃任何东西。
words.en: You use scarcely to emphasize that something is only just true or only just the case.

words.ex: The wind scatter the leaves everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 风把树叶吹得四处分散。
words.en: To scatter means to throw or drop things over a wide area in an irregular way, or to cause a group of people or animals to move apart in different directions.

words.tr: n. 可能发生的情况；设想；
words.ex: It's a possible scenario that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天会下雨是一个可能发生的情况。
words.en: A scenario is a description of a possible course of action or events.

words.ex: The scene at the park was peaceful.
words.ex_cn: 公园里的场景很宁静。
words.en: A scene is a part of a play or film in which the action stays in one place for a continuous period of time.

words.ex: The survival of the animals depends on the weather.
words.ex_cn: 这些动物的生存取决于天气。
words.en: The state or fact of continuing to live or exist, typically in spite of an accident, ordeal, or difficult circumstances.

words.tr: v. 幸存；生存；存活；艰难挺过；
words.ex: He survived the accident with minor injuries.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故中幸存下来，只有轻微受伤。
words.en: If you survive in a dangerous situation, you continue to live or exist in spite of it.

words.ex: I suspect it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我猜想明天会下雨。
words.en: If you suspect someone of doing something wrong or dishonest, you believe that they have done it, although you have no proof.

words.tr: v. 暂停；中止；延期； suspending
words.ex: The school will suspend the class due to snow.
words.ex_cn: 由于下雪，学校将暂停课程。
words.en: If you suspend something, you delay it or stop it from happening for a while or until a decision is made about it.

words.ex: The earthquake caused tremendous damage.
words.ex_cn: 地震造成了巨大的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as tremendous, you mean that they are very great in amount, extent, or intensity.

words.ex: The trend shows more people are using electric cars.
words.ex_cn: 这个趋势表明越来越多的人在使用电动汽车。
words.en: A trend is a general development or change in a situation or in the way that people are behaving.

words.ex: The doctor ran a trial to test the new medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生进行了试验来测试这种新药。
words.en: A trial is a formal meeting in a law court, at which a judge and jury listen to evidence and decide whether a person is guilty of a crime.

words.tr: n. 重量；重物；重要性；负担；
words.ex: The weight of the box is 10 kilograms.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子的重量是10公斤。
words.en: Weight is the force with which a body is attracted toward the earth or a celestial body by gravitation and which is equal to the product of the mass and the local gravitational acceleration.

words.ex: The government provides welfare to poor families.
words.ex_cn: 政府向贫困家庭提供福利。
words.en: The welfare of a person or group is their health, comfort, and happiness.

chapters.name: 6分词汇 Word List 35

words.ex: The flowers in the garden are artificial.
words.ex_cn: 花园里的花是人造的。
words.en: Made or produced by human beings rather than occurring naturally, especially as a copy of something natural.

words.ex: One aspect of learning English is practicing speaking.
words.ex_cn: 学习英语的一个方面是练习口语。
words.en: An aspect of something is one of the parts of its character or nature.

words.tr:
v. 吹嘘；自吹自擂
adj. 一流的；极好的
words.ex: He brags about his new car.
words.ex_cn: 他炫耀自己的新车。
words.en: If you brag, you say in a very proud way that you have something or have done something.

words.tr: adj. 现代的；当代的；同时代的；
words.ex: This museum displays contemporary art.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆展示现代艺术。
words.en: Belonging to or occurring in the present; or a person or thing living or existing at the same time as another.

words.ex: He won the spelling contest.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了拼写比赛。
words.en: A contest is a competition or a struggle for victory between individuals or groups.

words.ex: The word means different things in different context.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在不同的上下文中意思不同。
words.en: The context of an idea or event is the general situation that relates to it, and which helps it to be understood.

words.tr:
n. 合同；契约；
v. 收缩；
words.ex: They signed a contract to buy the house.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份购买房子的合同。
words.en: A contract is a legal agreement between two or more parties. It can also mean to become smaller or tighter, or to catch a disease.

words.ex: The loud music distract me from my homework.
words.ex_cn: 嘈杂的音乐让我无法专心做作业。
words.en: If something distracts you or your attention, it makes you stop concentrating on what you are doing.

words.ex: He felt great distress when he lost his job.
words.ex_cn: 当他失去工作时，他感到非常忧虑。
words.en: Distress is a feeling of extreme worry, sadness, or pain.

words.ex: The teacher will distribute the books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把书分发给学生。
words.en: If you distribute things, you hand them or deliver them to a number of people.

words.tr: v. 扩大；膨胀；更充分地阐述；
words.ex: The company plans to expand its business to other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划将其业务扩大到其他国家。
words.en: To increase in size, number, or importance, or to make something increase in this way.

words.ex: The city's expansion caused more traffic.
words.ex_cn: 城市的扩张导致了更多的交通拥堵。
words.en: Expansion refers to the process of becoming larger or more extensive.

words.tr:
n. 专家；行家；
adj. 内行的；老练的；专门的；
words.ex: He is an expert in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他是计算机科学方面的专家。
words.en: A person who is very knowledgeable about or skillful in a particular area.

words.ex: The teacher will formulate a new rule for class.
words.ex_cn: 老师将制定一条新的课堂规则。
words.en: If you formulate something such as a plan or proposal, you invent it, thinking about the details carefully.

words.tr: adj. 即将发生（或出版等）的；准备好的；
words.ex: The forthcoming book will be released next month.
words.ex_cn: 即将出版的这本书将在下个月发布。
words.en: If something is forthcoming, it is happening or coming soon.

words.ex: He showed gratitude for the help.
words.ex_cn: 他表达了对帮助的感激。
words.en: Gratitude is the feeling of being thankful and appreciative.

words.tr: n. 人性；人类；人道；仁慈；
words.ex: Kindness shows the best of humanity.
words.ex_cn: 善良展现了人性中最美好的一面。
words.en: Humanity refers to all human beings collectively or the qualities that make us human, such as kindness, compassion, and the ability to reason.

words.ex: He tried to integrate into the new school community.
words.ex_cn: 他试图融入新的学校群体。
words.en: If someone integrates into a social group, or is integrated into it, they behave in such a way that they become part of the group or are accepted into it.

words.tr:
adj. 智力的；
n. 知识分子；
words.ex: He is an intellectual person who loves solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个热爱解决数学问题的智力型人。
words.en: An intellectual is someone who spends a lot of time studying and thinking about complicated ideas.

words.ex: He shows high intelligence in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题时表现出很高的智力。
words.en: The ability to acquire and apply knowledge and skills.

words.ex: He uses logic to solve the puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 他用逻辑来解决这个谜题。
words.en: Logic is a method of reasoning that involves a series of statements, each of which must be true if the statement before it is true.

words.ex: You have three options to choose from.
words.ex_cn: 你有三个选项可以选择。
words.en: An option is something that you can choose to do in preference to one or more alternatives.

words.tr:
n. 轨道；
v. 绕...轨道而行；
words.ex: The moon moves around the Earth in an orbit.
words.ex_cn: 月亮围绕地球在轨道上运行。
words.en: An orbit is the curved path, usually elliptical, described by a planet, satellite, spaceship, etc., around a celestial body, as the sun.

words.ex: The heart is an important organ in the body.
words.ex_cn: 心脏是身体中重要的器官。
words.en: An organ is a part of an organism that is typically self-contained and has a specific vital function, such as the heart or liver in humans.

words.tr: n. 生物体；有机体；有机组织；
words.ex: A bacterium is a simple organism.
words.ex_cn: 细菌是一种简单的生物体。
words.en: An organism is a living thing that has an organized structure, can react to stimuli, reproduce, grow, adapt, and maintain homeostasis.

words.tr: n. 专家咨询组；嵌板；仪器板；
words.ex: The government formed a panel to advise on health policy.
words.ex_cn: 政府组建了一个专家咨询组来就卫生政策提供建议。
words.en: A panel is a small group of people who are chosen to do something, for example to discuss something in public or to make a decision.

words.tr:
n. 恐慌；
v. 感到恐慌；
words.ex: A panic spread through the crowd when the fire alarm rang.
words.ex_cn: 当火警响起时，人群陷入了恐慌。
words.en: Panic is a very strong feeling of anxiety or fear, which makes you act without thinking carefully.

words.ex: He saw a beautiful panorama from the mountain top.
words.ex_cn: 他从山顶看到了美丽的全景。
words.en: A panorama is a view of a wide area, or a description or study that presents all the different parts or aspects of a particular subject.

words.ex: He will renew his passport next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会更新他的护照。
words.en: To renew something means to begin it again or to make it new again.

words.ex: He is a renowned scientist.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有名的科学家。
words.en: Known or talked about by many people; famous.

words.ex: The rental of the apartment costs $800 per month.
words.ex_cn: 这套公寓的租赁费用是每月800美元。
words.en: The act of paying for the use of something, such as property, a vehicle, or equipment, or the amount paid for such use.

words.tr: n. 香味；香水；气息；察觉；
words.ex: The flower has a sweet scent.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花有甜美的香味。
words.en: A scent is a pleasant smell, especially one that is characteristic of a particular thing. It can also refer to the ability to detect smells or a clue or indication of something.

words.ex: I checked the class schedule for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我查看了明天的课程时间表。
words.en: A schedule is a plan that gives a list of events or tasks and the times at which each one should happen or be done.

words.ex: He won a scholarship to study at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了一项去哈佛学习的奖学金。
words.en: A scholarship is a grant or payment made to support a student's education, awarded on the basis of academic or other achievement.

words.ex: He uses scientific methods to test his idea.
words.ex_cn: 他用科学方法来测试他的想法。
words.en: Scientific means relating to science or using the methods of science.

words.tr: adj. 怀疑的；令人怀疑的；
words.ex: The police felt suspicious about the man's behavior.
words.ex_cn: 警察对这个人的行为感到怀疑。
words.en: If you are suspicious of someone or something, you do not trust them, and are careful when dealing with them.

words.ex: The farmer works hard to sustain his crops.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民努力维持他的庄稼。
words.en: To sustain something means to continue it or maintain it for a period of time.

words.ex: This puzzle is tricky for kids.
words.ex_cn: 这个谜题对孩子来说很棘手。
words.en: If you describe a task or problem as tricky, you mean that it is difficult to deal with and requires careful thinking or skill.

words.tr:
n. 琐事；少量
v. 玩弄；轻视
words.ex: He threw away a trifle of money on candy.
words.ex_cn: 他花了一点钱买糖果。
words.en: A trifle is something that is considered to have little importance, value, or significance. It can also refer to a small amount of something. As a verb, to trifle means to treat someone or something without seriousness or respect.

words.tr:
v. 触发；引起；发动；
n. 诱因；触发；
words.ex: The loud noise triggered the alarm.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音触发了警报。
words.en: A trigger is a device that activates a mechanism when it is pulled or pressed. It can also refer to something that causes a particular reaction or development.

words.ex: He likes coffee, whereas she prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，然而她更喜欢茶。
words.en: You use whereas to introduce a comment which contrasts with what is said in the main clause.

words.ex: He found a way whereby he could save money.
words.ex_cn: 他找到了一种借以省钱的方法。
words.en: You use whereby to introduce a clause in which you mention the means by which something happens.

chapters.name: 6分词汇 Word List 36

words.ex: He will assemble the toy for his son.
words.ex_cn: 他将为儿子组装玩具。
words.en: If people assemble or if someone assembles them, they come together in a group, usually for a particular purpose such as a meeting.

words.ex: The teacher will assess your homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天会评估你的作业。
words.en: to judge or decide the amount, value, quality, or importance of something

words.ex: The tree has many branches.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树有许多分支。
words.en: A branch of a tree is one of its parts that grows out from its trunk. A branch of a business or organization is one of its offices or shops that are in different places.

words.ex: Nike is a famous brand.
words.ex_cn: 耐克是一个著名品牌。
words.en: A brand is a name, term, design, symbol, or any other feature that identifies one seller's good or service as distinct from those of other sellers.

words.tr:
n. 合同；契约；
v. 收缩；
words.ex: They signed a contract to buy the house.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份购买房子的合同。
words.en: A contract is a legal agreement between two or more parties. It can also mean to become smaller or tighter, or to catch a disease.

words.tr:
n. 相反；
adj. 相反的；
words.ex: The contrary of hot is cold.
words.ex_cn: 热的相反是冷。
words.en: If you say that something is true contrary to other people's beliefs or opinions, you are emphasizing that it is true and that they are wrong.

words.tr:
n. 对照；反差；对立；
v. 对比；和...形成对照；
words.ex: The contrast between light and dark is clear in the photo.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片中明暗的对照很明显。
words.en: A contrast is a great difference between two or more things which is clear when you compare them.

words.tr: v. 贡献；促成；捐献；投稿；
words.ex: He contributes money to the charity.
words.ex_cn: 他向慈善机构捐款。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.ex: This district has many parks and schools.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有许多公园和学校。
words.en: A district is a part of a city, country, or other area that has been officially designated for a particular purpose, such as administration or business.

words.ex: Please don't disturb me while I'm reading.
words.ex_cn: 我读书时请不要打扰我。
words.en: To disturb someone means to interrupt what they are doing and cause them inconvenience or annoyance.

words.ex: My passport will expire next month.
words.ex_cn: 我的护照下个月到期。
words.en: If something such as a contract or a visa expires, it comes to an end or is no longer valid.

words.ex: The bomb will explode at noon.
words.ex_cn: 炸弹将在中午爆炸。
words.en: If an object explodes, it bursts loudly and with great force, often causing damage or injury.

words.ex: He gave an explicit answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了明确的答案。
words.en: Something that is explicit is expressed or shown clearly and openly, without any attempt to hide anything.

words.ex: He visits his grandparents every fortnight.
words.ex_cn: 他每两周拜访一次祖父母。
words.en: A fortnight is a period of two weeks.

words.ex: People discuss politics on this forum.
words.ex_cn: 人们在这个论坛上讨论政治。
words.en: A forum is a place, situation, or group in which people exchange ideas and discuss issues, especially important public issues.

words.tr:
n. 坟墓；
adj. 严重的；
words.ex: They visited the grave of their grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他们参观了祖父的坟墓。
words.en: A grave is a place where a dead person is buried. When used as an adjective, grave means serious or solemn.

words.ex: The gravity of Earth pulls objects down.
words.ex_cn: 地球的重力把物体往下拉。
words.en: Gravity is the force that causes things to fall towards the Earth or towards any other physical body having mass.

words.tr: adj. 卑微的；谦逊的；虚心的；
words.ex: He lived in a humble house near the river.
words.ex_cn: 他住在河边一座简陋的房子里。
words.en: If you describe someone as humble, you mean that they do not think they are better or more important than other people.

words.ex: The humidity in the room made the air feel heavy.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的湿度让空气感觉很闷。
words.en: Humidity is the amount of water vapor in the air. High humidity makes the air feel wet and sticky.

words.ex: I intend to go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我打算明天去公园。
words.en: If you intend to do something, you have decided or planned to do it.

words.ex: He felt intense pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到剧烈的疼痛。
words.en: If you describe an activity as intense, you mean that it is very serious and concentrated, and often involves doing a great deal in a short time.

words.ex: His intention was to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他的意图是帮助他的朋友。
words.en: An intention is an idea or plan of what you are going to do.

words.ex: The company has a simple logo on its products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的产品上有一个简单的标志。
words.en: A logo is a design or symbol used by a company to identify its products, services, or itself.

words.ex: The ship's longitude is 45 degrees west.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船的经度是西经45度。
words.en: Longitude is the distance of a place east or west of the Greenwich meridian, measured in degrees.

words.ex: He used the sun to orient himself.
words.ex_cn: 他用太阳来确定方向。
words.en: To orient means to align or position something in relation to the points of a compass or other specified positions, or to familiarize someone with a new situation or environment.

words.tr: n. 入学介绍；岗前训练；方向；取向；
words.ex: The school held an orientation for new students on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 学校在周一为新生举行了入学介绍。
words.en: The act of orienting or the state of being oriented; the determination of the relative position of something or someone (especially oneself).

words.ex: This tradition originates from ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统起源于古代。
words.en: To originate means to have a specific beginning or to start something.

words.ex: They found paradise on a small island.
words.ex_cn: 他们在一个小岛上找到了天堂。
words.en: Paradise is a place of ideal beauty or loveliness, or a state of supreme happiness.

words.ex: It's a paradox that he is rich but unhappy.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个悖论，他很富有却不快乐。
words.en: A paradox is a statement that seems to contradict itself but may nonetheless be true, or a situation that defies intuition.

words.tr:
adj. 平行的；
n. 类似的事物；
words.ex: The two lines are parallel and never meet.
words.ex_cn: 这两条线是平行的，永远不会相交。
words.en: Something that is parallel to something else is similar to it in many ways, or happens at the same time as it.

words.ex: The repeal of the old law took effect last month.
words.ex_cn: 这项旧法律的废止上个月生效了。
words.en: If the government repeals a law, it officially ends it, so that it is no longer valid.

words.ex: He will replace the broken chair.
words.ex_cn: 他将代替这把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: If one thing or person replaces another, the first is used or acts instead of the second.

words.ex: The scientist tried to replicate the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家试图复制这个实验。
words.en: To replicate something means to do or make something again in exactly the same way.

words.tr: v. 代表；表现；体现；相当于；
words.ex: He represents his country in the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中代表他的国家。
words.en: If someone represents a person or group of people, they act on behalf of that person or group.

words.ex: The scope of this project includes three cities.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的范围包括三个城市。
words.en: The range of one's perceptions, thoughts, or actions.

words.tr:
n. 分数；得分；总谱；乐谱；
v. 得分；
words.ex: He got a high score on the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了高分。
words.en: If you score a particular amount or number in a game or test, you achieve that amount or number.

words.ex: There was a scramble for the last ticket.
words.ex_cn: 大家争相抢购最后一张票。
words.en: If you scramble over rocks or up a hill, you move quickly over them or up it using your hands to help you. Scramble can also mean to compete or struggle with others for something that is in short supply.

words.ex: He swore he didn't steal the money.
words.ex_cn: 他发誓他没有偷钱。
words.en: If someone swears, they use language that is considered to be rude or offensive, usually because they are angry.

words.ex: She sweeps the floor every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上扫地。
words.en: To clean an area by brushing away dirt or litter.

words.tr:
v. 成为三倍；使增至三倍；
n. 三倍的数；三个一组；
adj. 三部分的；
words.ex: The company's profits tripled last year.
words.ex_cn: 该公司去年的利润增长了三倍。
words.en: To triple something means to make it three times as much in size or number.

words.ex: The team celebrated their triumph after winning the match.
words.ex_cn: 球队在赢得比赛后庆祝了他们的胜利。
words.en: A triumph is a great success or achievement, often one that has been gained with a lot of skill or effort.

words.ex: The mistake was trivial and didn't affect the result.
words.ex_cn: 这个错误不重要，没有影响结果。
words.en: If you describe something as trivial, you mean that it is not important or significant, or is not worth serious consideration.

chapters.name: 6分词汇 Word List 37

words.ex: The teacher gave us a math assignment.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一份数学作业。
words.en: An assignment is a task or piece of work that you are given to do, especially as part of your job or studies.

words.ex: He assists his brother with homework.
words.ex_cn: 他帮助弟弟做作业。
words.en: If you assist someone, you help them to do a job or task by doing part of the work for them.

words.tr:
v. 把…联系在一起；
adj. 副的；
n. 同事；伙伴；
words.ex: He associates happiness with family time.
words.ex_cn: 他把幸福与家庭时光联系在一起。
words.en: If you associate someone or something with a particular quality or idea, or if they are associated with it, you connect them in your mind with that quality or idea.

words.ex: He joined a local book association.
words.ex_cn: 他加入了一个本地的图书协会。
words.en: An association is an official group of people who have the same job, aim, or interest.

words.tr:
v. 交配繁殖；饲养；
n. 品种；
words.ex: The farmers breed cows to get more milk.
words.ex_cn: 农民让奶牛交配繁殖以获得更多牛奶。
words.en: If you breed animals or plants, you keep them for the purpose of producing more animals or plants with particular qualities, in a controlled way.

words.tr:
adj. 简短的；简明的；短暂的；
v. 为…提供信息；
n. 摘要；概要；
words.ex: He gave a brief answer.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了一个简短的答案。
words.en: If something is brief, it lasts only for a short time.

words.ex: This store is convenient for buying groceries.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店买杂货很方便。
words.en: If something is convenient, it is easy to use or do, or it is useful and suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: It is a convention to shake hands when you meet someone.
words.ex_cn: 见面时握手是一种习俗。
words.en: A convention is a large meeting of an organization or political group, or a way of behaving that is considered to be correct or polite by most people in a society.

words.ex: His converse was the opposite of what he said earlier.
words.ex_cn: 他的相反言论与他之前说的话相反。
words.en: To engage in conversation; to talk informally with someone.

words.ex: He converts old paper into new notebooks.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧纸张转换成新笔记本。
words.en: To change something into a different form or to change someone's beliefs, especially their religious beliefs.

words.tr: adj. 不同的；多种多样的；
words.ex: The class has diverse students from many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级有来自许多国家的不同学生。
words.en: If a group or range of things is diverse, it is made up of a wide variety of things.

words.tr:
n. 离婚；
v. 和…离婚；
words.ex: They filed for divorce after ten years of marriage.
words.ex_cn: 他们结婚十年后申请了离婚。
words.en: Divorce is the formal ending of a marriage by law.

words.tr:
n. 文件；公文；文献；
v. 记录；为…提供证明；
words.ex: He submitted the document to the office.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件提交给了办公室。
words.en: A document is a piece of text or graphics, for example a letter, that is stored as a file on a computer and that you can access in order to read it or change it.

words.tr: adj. 家庭的；国内的；驯养的；
words.ex: She prefers domestic chores over going out.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜欢做家务而不是外出。
words.en: Domestic means relating to the home, family, or household affairs. It can also refer to something that is made or produced within a country and not imported.

words.ex: He exploited the situation to get more money.
words.ex_cn: 他利用这个情况赚了更多钱。
words.en: To exploit someone or something means to use them in a way that benefits you, often unfairly or without considering their rights or feelings. It can also refer to the act of making full use of and deriving benefit from a resource.

words.ex: The boy found a fossil in the rock.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在岩石中发现了一块化石。
words.en: A fossil is the remains or impression of a prehistoric organism preserved in petrified form or as a mold or cast in rock.

words.ex: Parents should foster good habits in children.
words.ex_cn: 父母应该培养孩子的好习惯。
words.en: To foster something means to encourage and promote its development.

words.tr: v. 发现；找到；建立；认为；“find”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He found a strange stone on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他在海滩上发现了一块奇怪的石头。
words.en: To establish or set up (an organization, institution, or place) on a firm or permanent basis.

words.ex: The foundation gives money to poor students.
words.ex_cn: 这个基金会向贫困学生提供资金。
words.en: The foundation of something such as a belief or way of life is the things on which it is based.

words.ex: A fraction of the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 只有一小部分学生通过了考试。
words.en: A fraction is a small part or amount of something.

words.ex: He is greedy and always wants more candy.
words.ex_cn: 他很贪婪，总是想要更多的糖果。
words.en: If you describe someone as greedy, you mean that they want to have more of something such as food or money than is necessary or fair.

words.ex: He greet his friend with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着向朋友问好。
words.en: To greet someone means to say hello to them or to welcome them.

words.ex: Good hygiene helps prevent sickness.
words.ex_cn: 良好的卫生有助于预防疾病。
words.en: Hygiene refers to conditions and practices that help to maintain health and prevent the spread of diseases.

words.ex: He made a hypothesis that plants grow faster in light.
words.ex_cn: 他提出一个假设，认为植物在光照下长得更快。
words.en: A hypothesis is an idea which is suggested as a possible explanation for a particular situation or condition, but which has not yet been proved to be correct.

words.tr: n. 交叉；相交；十字路口；交叉路口；
words.ex: The intersection of two roads is busy.
words.ex_cn: 两条路的交叉口很繁忙。
words.en: An intersection is a place where roads or other lines meet or cross.

words.tr:
n. 面试；访谈；
v. 面试；接见；
words.ex: He has an interview tomorrow for a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他明天有一场新工作的面试。
words.en: An interview is a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out if they are suitable for a job or a course of study.

words.ex: They have an intimate friendship.
words.ex_cn: 他们有着亲密的友谊。
words.en: having a close, friendly, or personal relationship with someone; private and personal

words.tr: adv. 否则；在其他方面；除此之外；
words.ex: Hurry up, otherwise you'll be late.
words.ex_cn: 快点，否则你会迟到的。
words.en: in circumstances different from those present or considered; or else

words.ex: The outcome of the game was a tie.
words.ex_cn: 比赛的结果是平局。
words.en: The outcome of an activity, process, or situation is the situation that exists at the end of it.

words.tr: v. 使麻痹；使瘫痪；使无效；使停止活动
words.ex: The accident paralyzed his leg.
words.ex_cn: 这场事故使他的腿瘫痪了。
words.en: If someone is paralyzed by an accident or an illness, they have no feeling in their body, or in part of their body, and are unable to move.

words.ex: He paraphrased the poem in simple words.
words.ex_cn: 他用简单的语言意译了这首诗。
words.en: To paraphrase means to express the meaning of something written or spoken using different words, especially to achieve greater clarity.

words.ex: He will participate in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参与学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To take part in an activity or event.

words.ex: Dust particles float in the air.
