words.en: Sports administration refers to the management of sports organizations, teams, and events, involving planning, organizing, staffing, leading, and controlling.

words.tr: phrase. 运动心理学家：专门研究运动员心理状态、行为及表现的心理学专家
words.ex: The sports psychologist helps athletes stay focused.
words.ex_cn: 运动心理学家帮助运动员保持专注。
words.en: A sports psychologist is a professional who applies psychology to understand and improve the performance of athletes and sports participants.

words.tr: phrase. 压力管理；应对压力的技巧与方法
words.ex: He practices yoga for stress management.
words.ex_cn: 他练习瑜伽来管理压力。
words.en: Stress management refers to the wide spectrum of techniques and psychotherapies aimed at controlling a person's levels of stress, especially chronic stress, usually for the purpose of improving everyday functioning.

words.tr: phrase. 培训计划：一系列有组织的活动和课程，旨在提高个人或团体的技能、知识和能力。
words.ex: He joined a training programme last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月参加了一个培训项目。
words.en: A series of activities designed to teach skills or knowledge to employees or students.

words.tr: phrase. 职业训练；职业培训
words.ex: He is doing vocational training to become a mechanic.
words.ex_cn: 他正在接受职业培训，以成为一名机械师。
words.en: Vocational training refers to instructional programs or courses that focus on the skills required for a particular job function or trade.

words.tr: phrase. 入学要求；准入条件
words.ex: The entry requirement for this school is a high school diploma.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校的入学要求是高中文凭。
words.en: The conditions that must be met in order to be admitted into a school, program, or event.

words.ex: The elite of the city often meet at private clubs.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的精英经常在私人俱乐部会面。
words.en: You can refer to the most powerful, rich, or talented people within a particular group, place, or society as the elite.

words.ex: The teacher gave me guidance on how to write the essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我写论文的指导。
words.en: Guidance is help and advice that is given to someone about their work, education, or personal life.

words.ex: The faculty of engineering has many labs.
words.ex_cn: 工程学院有许多实验室。
words.en: A faculty is a group of departments in a university or college that specialize in a particular subject or group of subjects, or the teachers in such a group.

words.ex: He got a teaching qualification last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了教师资格。
words.en: A qualification is a skill or type of experience that you need in order to do a particular job or activity.

words.ex: A car has many components, like wheels and engines.
words.ex_cn: 汽车有许多部分，比如轮子和发动机。
words.en: A component is a part of a larger whole, especially a part that can be separated from or attached to a system.

words.tr: phrase. 大范围的；范围广泛的
words.ex: The store has a wide range of toys for children.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店有各种各样的儿童玩具。
words.en: A wide range of means there is a large variety or a great number of different things within a particular category.

words.tr:
n. 常规；例行公事；
adj. 常规的；例行公事的；
words.ex: He follows a morning routine every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都遵循固定的惯例。
words.en: A routine is a sequence of actions regularly followed; a fixed program.

words.ex: Good coordination between teams improves work efficiency.
words.ex_cn: 团队之间的良好协调能提高工作效率。
words.en: The organization of the different elements of a complex body or activity so as to enable them to work together effectively.

words.tr:
n. 平衡；天平；秤；
v. （使）相抵；（使）平衡；
words.ex: She maintains a good balance between work and rest.
words.ex_cn: 她在工作和休息之间保持良好的平衡。
words.en: Balance is the ability to remain steady when you are standing up. Also, it refers to the state of having your weight spread equally so that you do not fall. In finance, it refers to the amount of money you have in a bank account.

words.ex: He sat with good posture at the desk.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在书桌前，姿势端正。
words.en: Your posture is the way in which you hold your body when you are standing or sitting.

words.ex: The company values flexibility in work hours.
words.ex_cn: 公司重视工作时间的灵活性。
words.en: Flexibility refers to the quality of bending easily without breaking, or the ability to be easily modified to respond to altered circumstances or conditions.

chapters.name: 真题解析2 T2 S1 家具和个人财物投保咨询

words.tr: n. 单元住宅；公寓住宅；
words.ex: He lives in a small apartment near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一间小公寓里。
words.en: An apartment is a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a large building.

words.tr: n. 非法闯入；入室行窃
words.ex: The police investigated a break-in at the store last night.
words.ex_cn: 警方调查了昨晚商店的非法闯入事件。
words.en: An act of illegally entering a building, especially by force, in order to steal something.

words.tr: phrase. 某人家里所包含的物品；家庭财产；住宅内的所有物品
words.ex: The contents of one's home include furniture, clothes, and books.
words.ex_cn: 一个人家里的物品包括家具、衣服和书籍。
words.en: The items or belongings that are inside someone's house or apartment.

words.tr: phrase. 一楼；底层；有利地位
words.ex: The shop is on the ground floor.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店在底层。
words.en: The ground floor of a building is the floor that is level or almost level with the ground outside.

words.ex: He bought insurance for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车买了保险。
words.en: Insurance is an arrangement in which you pay money to a company, and they pay money to you if something unpleasant happens to you, for example if your property is stolen or damaged, or if you get a serious illness.

words.tr: phrase. 保险申请表；投保单
words.ex: He filled out the insurance application form yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天填了保险申请表。
words.en: A document used to apply for insurance, containing personal and policy details.

words.ex: The insurance cost is high for new drivers.
words.ex_cn: 新手司机的保险费用很高。
words.en: The amount of money that is required to be paid for an insurance policy.

words.tr: phrase. 个人财物；私人财产；随身物品
words.ex: He lost his personal possessions in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他在火灾中丢失了个人物品。
words.en: Personal possessions are things that belong to a particular person and are considered as their own property.

words.tr: phrase. 私人财物保险；个人物品保险
words.ex: He bought private contents insurance for his apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的公寓购买了私人财产保险。
words.en: Insurance that covers personal belongings against loss, theft, or damage.

words.ex: The government changed its education policy.
words.ex_cn: 政府改变了它的教育政策。
words.en: A policy is a set of ideas or plans that is used as a basis for making decisions, especially in politics, economics, or business.

words.ex: I recommend this book to you.
words.ex_cn: 我向你推荐这本书。
words.en: If someone recommends a person or thing to you, they suggest that you would find them good or useful.

words.ex: He bought a new stereo system for his living room.
words.ex_cn: 他为客厅买了一个新的音响系统。
words.en: A stereo system is a set of equipment for playing recorded sound, which uses two or more separate speakers to produce a more natural and realistic sound.

words.tr: phrase. 年度总成本；全年费用总额
words.ex: The total annual cost of the car is $5,000.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的全年总成本是5000美元。
words.en: The complete amount of money spent over the course of a year for a particular purpose or operation.

words.ex: They live in a two-bedroom apartment near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一间两居室公寓里。
words.en: A two-bedroom apartment is a flat that has two bedrooms, typically used for living purposes.

words.tr: v. 租借；出租；“rend”的过去式和过去分词； n. 租金；
words.ex: They rent a small apartment in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们租了一间城市里的小公寓。
words.en: Rent refers to the payment made periodically by a tenant to a landlord for the use of property or land.

words.ex: We divide 10 by 2 to get 5.
words.ex_cn: 我们用10除以2得到5。
words.en: To perform the operation of division on a number by another number.

words.ex: Please give me your contact number.
words.ex_cn: 请给我你的联系电话。
words.en: A contact number is a telephone number at which a person or organization can be reached.

chapters.name: 真题解析2 T2 S2 校园住宿介绍

words.ex: He converts old paper into new notebooks.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧纸张转换成新笔记本。
words.en: To change something into a different form or to change someone's beliefs, especially their religious beliefs.

words.tr: phrase. 紧急消防门；在火灾或其他紧急情况下供人员迅速疏散的安全出口门
words.ex: The emergency fire door is always closed.
words.ex_cn: 紧急消防门总是关闭的。
words.en: A door designed to provide a safe exit in the event of a fire, often equipped with mechanisms to prevent the spread of fire and smoke.

words.tr: phrase. 家庭住宅；供一家人居住的房子
words.ex: They live in a small family house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一栋小家庭房子里。
words.en: A house that is designed to accommodate a family.

words.ex: He paid the laundry fee for his clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的衣服支付了洗衣费。
words.en: A charge for washing clothes, linens, etc., often applied by hotels or laundromats.

words.ex: They are sitting in the main lounge.
words.ex_cn: 他们正坐在主休息室里。
words.en: The main lounge is a large room in a public building, especially a hotel, where people can sit and relax.

words.tr: phrase. 建筑物的北翼；大楼北侧的侧翼部分
words.ex: The north wing of building is where the library is.
words.ex_cn: 北翼是图书馆所在的地方。
words.en: The section of a building located on the northern side, often used for offices, classrooms, or specific functions.

words.tr: phrase. 办公大楼；办公楼群
words.ex: He works in a tall office block near the station.
words.ex_cn: 他在车站附近的一栋高楼里上班。
words.en: A large building containing many offices.

words.tr: phrase. 娱乐室；康乐室；休闲活动室
words.ex: The children play games in the recreation room.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在娱乐室里玩游戏。
words.en: A room used for relaxation and leisure activities.

words.ex: He lives in a residential college near the campus.
words.ex_cn: 他住在校园附近的一所住宿学院里。
words.en: A residential college is a college that provides accommodation for students, typically on or near the campus of a university.

words.tr: phrase. 房间分配；房间配置
words.ex: The school handles room allocation for new students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为新生安排房间。
words.en: The process of assigning rooms to guests or users, often in a hotel or conference setting.

words.ex: We eat dinner in the dining room.
words.ex_cn: 我们在餐厅吃晚饭。
words.en: A dining room is a room in a house where people eat their meals.

words.ex: He will add on extra hours to his work schedule.
words.ex_cn: 他将在工作时间表上增加额外的工时。
words.en: To add something extra or additional to something else.

words.ex: The city plans to modernize its old subway system.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市计划现代化其老旧的地铁系统。
words.en: To modernize something means to change it so that it is more modern, for example by using more recent technology or methods.

words.ex: The dark clouds indicate rain.
words.ex_cn: 乌云表明要下雨了。
words.en: If one thing indicates another, the first thing shows that the second is true or exists.

words.tr: phrase. 独立房间号；个人房间号码
words.ex: Each guest has an individual room number on the key card.
words.ex_cn: 每位客人的钥匙卡上都有一个独立房间号。
words.en: The unique identifier assigned to a single room within a larger building or complex.

words.tr: phrase. 新生/新员工资料包；入职指南包；迎新资料袋
words.ex: He got an orientation pack on his first day.
words.ex_cn: 他在第一天拿到了一份入门指南包。
words.en: A set of materials provided to new students or employees to help them acclimate to their new environment.

words.ex: He left his keys at the front door.
words.ex_cn: 他把钥匙落在前门了。
words.en: The main entrance door of a building or house, typically facing the street.

words.ex: The boy walked down the long corridor.
words.ex_cn: 男孩走过了长长的走廊。
words.en: A corridor is a long passage in a building, with doors and rooms on one or both sides.

words.tr: v. 加浮雕花纹于；饰以浮饰；使凸出
words.ex: He embosses the card with his name.
words.ex_cn: 他把名字压印在卡片上。
words.en: To decorate a surface by making raised designs or patterns on it.

words.tr: adj. 可识别的；可辨认的；
words.ex: The stolen bike is identifiable by its red handlebar.
words.ex_cn: 这辆被盗的自行车可以通过它的红色车把识别出来。
words.en: If something or someone is identifiable, they are able to be recognized.

words.tr: phrase. 资深员工（通常指在某个楼层或部门工作时间最长的高级职员）
words.ex: The floor senior helped the new staff with the office rules.
words.ex_cn: 资深员工帮助新员工了解办公室规定。
words.en: A student who is responsible for the management and well-being of students on a particular floor in a school or dormitory.

words.ex: He had to pay an extra fee for late submission.
words.ex_cn: 他因为迟交而支付了额外费用。
words.en: An additional charge for services beyond what is included in the standard rate or package.

chapters.name: 真题解析2 T2 S3 教学媒体的种类和作用

words.ex: The audio signal was clear and loud.
words.ex_cn: 音频信号清晰响亮。
words.en: Audio refers to sound, especially when recorded, transmitted, or reproduced.

words.tr: adj. 视听的；视听教学的
words.ex: The school uses audio-visual tools to teach students.
words.ex_cn: 学校使用视听工具来教学。
words.en: Relating to both hearing and sight, or to equipment and materials used to provide such experiences, especially in education or entertainment.

words.ex: The bar chart shows the number of students in each class.
words.ex_cn: 条形图显示了每个班级的学生人数。
words.en: A bar chart is a type of chart that presents categorical data with rectangular bars with heights or lengths proportional to the values that they represent.

words.tr: phrase. 饼形图；圆形分格统计图表
words.ex: The pie chart shows the percentage of students who like different fruits.
words.ex_cn: 饼状图显示了喜欢不同水果的学生的百分比。
words.en: A pie chart is a circular statistical graphic which is divided into slices to illustrate numerical proportion.

words.tr: phrase. 最适合……的；最符合……要求的
words.ex: This job is best suited to someone who loves quiet work.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作最适合喜欢安静工作的人。
words.en: Most appropriate or perfectly matched for a particular purpose, person, or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 电子媒体；指通过电子手段传播信息的媒介，如电视、广播、互联网和电子游戏等
words.ex: Children spend time on electronic media every day.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们每天都在电子媒体上消磨时间。
words.en: Electronic media refers to media that use electronics or electromechanical energy for the end user to access the content. This is in contrast to static media (mainly print media), which today are most often created electronically, but do not require electronics to be accessed by the end user in the printed form.

words.tr: phrase. 将注意力集中于；专心于
words.ex: He tries to focus his mind on the book.
words.ex_cn: 他努力把注意力集中在书上。
words.en: To direct one's attention or effort towards a particular activity or subject.

words.tr: phrase. 让想象力自由驰骋；尽情发挥想象力；放飞想象
words.ex: When you read fairy tales, let imagination run wild.
words.ex_cn: 当你读童话故事时，让想象力尽情驰骋。
words.en: To allow one's imagination to roam freely and creatively, without restrictions or limitations.

words.tr: phrase. 规划小组作业；安排团队工作
words.ex: The teacher will plan group work for tomorrow's class.
words.ex_cn: 老师将为明天的课规划小组作业。
words.en: To organize and coordinate the tasks and responsibilities of a team for a collaborative project.

words.tr: phrase. 印刷媒体；平面媒体（指报纸、杂志等传统纸质媒介）
words.ex: The news is often shared in print media.
words.ex_cn: 新闻经常通过纸质媒体传播。
words.en: Print media refers to the means of mass communication in the form of printed publications, such as newspapers and magazines.

words.tr:
n. 视频；录像；
adj. 视频的；录像的；
words.ex: I watched a short video on YouTube.
words.ex_cn: 我看了一个YouTube上的短视频。
words.en: A recording of moving visual images made digitally or on videotape.

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.tr: 短语动词. 拟定或制作一张表格
words.ex: He draws up a table to show the numbers.
words.ex_cn: 他画一个表格来显示这些数字。
words.en: To create or draft a structured grid of rows and columns to organize information or data.

words.tr: phrase. 图像形式；图画形式；以图表示的形式
words.ex: The map shows the data in pictorial form.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图以图示形式显示数据。
words.en: A pictorial form refers to a way of representing something using pictures or images, often to convey information or emotions visually.

words.ex: This book belongs to the science category.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于科学类别。
words.en: A category is a class or group of things that have similar characteristics.

words.ex: He is a so-called expert, but he knows little.
words.ex_cn: 他是个所谓的专家，但懂得很少。
words.en: used to show that something or someone is commonly designated by the name or term specified, often to suggest that the name or term is not appropriate or accurate

words.tr: adj. 偏远的；隔离的；孤独的； v. 使隔离；“isolate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The village is isolated, far from any city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄很偏远，远离任何城市。
words.en: If something is isolated, it is far away from other places, buildings, or people.

words.tr: v. 互相作用；互相影响；交流；沟通；
words.ex: The two chemicals interact when mixed.
words.ex_cn: 这两种化学物质混合时会互相作用。
words.en: If people interact with each other, they communicate or work together.

words.ex: They share ideas in class every day.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天在课堂上分享想法。
words.en: To exchange thoughts, opinions, or creative concepts with others in a group setting.

chapters.name: 真题解析2 T2 S4 英国农业介绍

words.tr: phrase. 是…的原因；解释；负责；（数量或比例上）占
words.ex: The rain can account for the delay.
words.ex_cn: 下雨是延误的原因。
words.en: If a particular thing accounts for a part or proportion of something, that part or proportion consists of that thing, or is used or produced by it.

words.ex: He works at an agricultural training college.
words.ex_cn: 他在一所农业培训学院工作。
words.en: An educational institution that provides training in agriculture and related fields.

words.ex: The agricultural workforce works hard in the fields every day.
words.ex_cn: 农业劳动力每天在田里辛勤工作。
words.en: The agricultural workforce refers to the segment of the population engaged in agricultural activities, including farming, fishing, and forestry, contributing to the production of food and other agricultural products.

words.ex: British agriculture grows wheat and sheep.
words.ex_cn: 英国农业种植小麦和饲养绵羊。
words.en: The sector of the economy in the United Kingdom involved in the production of crops and livestock.

words.ex: This is a cereal-producing region with many wheat fields.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个生产谷物的地区，有许多小麦田。
words.en: An area or district where the primary agricultural activity is the cultivation of grains like wheat, corn, or oats.

words.tr: phrase. 紧密的合作；密切的协作
words.ex: They have close cooperation on the project.
words.ex_cn: 他们在项目上密切合作。
words.en: Close cooperation refers to a situation where two or more parties work together in a very coordinated and effective manner to achieve a common goal.

words.tr: phrase. 商业化农场；以盈利为目的的大型农业经营场所
words.ex: He owns a commercial farm that grows wheat and corn.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有一家商业农场，种植小麦和玉米。
words.en: A commercial farm is a large-scale farm that operates as a business, focusing on the production of crops or livestock for sale.

words.tr: v. 贡献；促成；捐献；投稿；
words.ex: He contributes money to the charity.
words.ex_cn: 他向慈善机构捐款。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.tr: phrase. 国家的经济；一个国家的经济体系或经济状况
words.ex: The country's economy is growing slowly.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的经济正在缓慢增长。
words.en: The economic system of a country, including the production, distribution, and consumption of goods and services.

words.tr: phrase. 极好的牧场；优质的草场
words.ex: The sheep graze on excellent pasture near the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 羊在山边极好的牧场上吃草。
words.en: An excellent pasture refers to land covered with grass or other plants suitable for grazing animals, which is of high quality and supports the healthy growth of livestock.

words.tr: adj.家族流传的; 家庭经营的
words.ex: This small restaurant is family-run and has been open for 50 years.
words.ex_cn: 这家小餐馆是家族传承的，已经开了50年。
words.en: Managed or operated by members of a family.

words.tr: phrase. 农民协会；农会（由农民组成的团体，旨在维护农民利益）
words.ex: The farmers' union is asking for higher prices.
words.ex_cn: 农民工会要求提高价格。
words.en: An organization that represents the interests of farmers, often involved in negotiating better conditions and prices for agricultural products.

words.tr: phrase. 农业社区； farming 社区，指从事农业生产的群体或地区
words.ex: The farming community grows wheat and corn.
words.ex_cn: 这个农业社区种植小麦和玉米。
words.en: A farming community is a group of people living in a rural area who are primarily engaged in agricultural activities.

words.tr:
n. 公寓；
adj. 平坦的；扁平的；(轮胎)瘪了的；平淡无味的；
adv. 直接地；
words.ex: He lives in a small flat in London.
words.ex_cn: 他住在伦敦的一间小公寓里。
words.en: Something that is flat is level and smooth, with no curved, high, or hollow parts.

words.tr: 名词短语，地质学与气候：研究地球的结构、组成及其历史过程，以及某一地区长期的天气模式和条件
words.ex: Geology and climate affect the shape of mountains.
words.ex_cn: 地质和气候影响山脉的形状。
words.en: The study of the Earth's physical structure and the long-term weather patterns of a region.

words.ex: The country's gross national product increased last year.
words.ex_cn: 该国的国民生产总值去年增加了。
words.en: The total value of goods produced and services provided by a country during one year, equal to the gross domestic product plus the net income from foreign investments.

words.tr: abbr. 国民生产总值；“gross national product”的缩写
words.ex: The country's GNP increased last year.
words.ex_cn: 该国的国民生产总值去年有所增长。
words.en: The total value of goods produced and services provided by a country during one year, equal to the gross domestic product plus the net income from foreign investments.

words.tr: phrase. 多山的土地；丘陵地带
words.ex: The cows graze on hilly land near the village.
words.ex_cn: 牛群在村庄附近的丘陵地上吃草。
words.en: Land that is characterized by many hills.

words.tr: phrase. 重要部分；关键份额
words.ex: This is an important portion of the test.
words.ex_cn: 这是考试的重要部分。
words.en: A significant or essential part of something.

words.tr: phrase. 令人印象深刻的人物；给人深刻印象的形象
words.ex: He is an impressive figure in the world of science.
words.ex_cn: 他是科学界一位令人印象深刻的人物。
words.en: An impressive figure is someone or something that is notable or remarkable, often because of their achievements, appearance, or the impact they have.

words.tr: phrase. 对国家的智能支持；对国家的智慧支持
words.ex: The government uses AI for intelligent support of the state.
words.ex_cn: 政府利用人工智能对国家提供智能支持。
words.en: The provision of wise and effective assistance by a government or ruling authority.

words.tr: phrase. 世纪中叶；本世纪中期
words.ex: The house was built in the middle of the century.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子建于本世纪中叶。
words.en: The middle of the century refers to the period around the 50th year of a century, often used to denote a significant time of change or development.

words.tr: phrase. 提前计划；预先筹划
words.ex: He plans ahead for his exams.
words.ex_cn: 他提前为考试做计划。
words.en: To think about and decide what you are going to do or how you are going to do something before you do it.

words.ex: The city became post-industrial after the factories closed.
words.ex_cn: 工厂关闭后，这座城市进入了后工业时代。
words.en: relating to or denoting a period or society characterized by an economy that is no longer based on heavy industry and manufacturing, but on services and information

words.tr: phrase. 团结意识； solidarity 指团结一致，sense of solidarity 即对群体团结的感知或认同感
words.ex: The team showed a strong sense of solidarity during the crisis.
words.ex_cn: 在危机期间，团队表现出强烈团结感。
words.en: A feeling of unity among people with common interests, goals, or sympathies.

words.tr: phrase. 配套产业；辅助产业
words.ex: The car factory needs a strong supporting industry to make parts.
words.ex_cn: 汽车工厂需要强大的配套产业来制造零件。
words.en: An industry that provides necessary goods or services to another industry, helping it to function or grow.

words.tr: phrase. 典型的农场；具有代表性的农庄
words.ex: This is a typical farm with cows and a red barn.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个有着奶牛和红色谷仓的典型农场。
words.en: A typical farm refers to a farm that represents the usual characteristics or features of farms in a specific area or context.

words.ex: She knits a sweater from wool.
words.ex_cn: 她用羊毛织毛衣。
words.en: Wool is the hair that grows on sheep and some other animals, which is used to make clothes, blankets, etc.

words.ex: He bought timber to build a fence.
words.ex_cn: 他买了木材来建篱笆。
words.en: Wood prepared for use in building and carpentry.

words.ex: He emphasizes the importance of homework.
words.ex_cn: 他强调作业的重要性。
words.en: To give special importance or prominence to (something) in speaking or writing.

words.ex: Bear in mind that the bus leaves at 6 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 请记住，公交车晚上6点发车。
words.en: If you tell someone to bear something in mind, you are reminding or warning them about something important which they should remember.

words.ex: The percentage of students who passed the test was 85.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试的学生百分比是85。
words.en: A percentage is a proportion or ratio expressed as a fraction of 100.

words.ex: The majority of students like pizza.
words.ex_cn: 大多数学生喜欢披萨。
words.en: The majority is the greater number or part of something.

words.tr: phrase. 归因于；归功于；由于
words.ex: He owes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把成功归功于努力工作。
words.en: If you owe something to someone or something, it is because of them that you have it or experience it.

words.ex: He bought a good deal of books.
words.ex_cn: 他买了很多书。
words.en: A large amount or quantity of something.

words.tr: phrase. 肥沃的土壤；能生育的土壤
words.ex: The farmers planted crops in fertile soil.
words.ex_cn: 农民们在肥沃的土壤里种植庄稼。
words.en: Soil that is rich in nutrients and ideal for plant growth.

words.ex: People are increasingly using smartphones.
words.ex_cn: 人们日益使用智能手机。
words.en: More and more; gradually becoming greater in amount or degree.

words.tr: adj. 重大的；重要的；影响明显的；
words.ex: This discovery is a significant step forward.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现是一个重大的进步。
words.en: Something that is significant is important or large enough to be noticed or to have an effect.

words.tr: phrase. 利益集团；游说团体
words.ex: The interest group wants better schools.
words.ex_cn: 这个利益团体想要更好的学校。
words.en: An interest group is a group of people who try to influence politicians or officials in order to get laws or policies that will help them.

words.ex: He is virtually always on time.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎总是准时。
words.en: In effect though not formally recognized; practically.

chapters.name: 真题解析2 T3 S1 新开电视频道问卷调查

words.tr: phrase. 喜剧表演；喜剧节目
words.ex: He watches a comedy show every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看喜剧节目。
words.en: A comedy show is a performance intended to make an audience laugh, typically consisting of stand-up comedy, sketches, or improvisational acts.

words.tr: phrase. 商业频道；商业渠道
words.ex: The commercial channel shows ads between TV shows.
words.ex_cn: 这个商业频道在电视节目之间播放广告。
words.en: A commercial channel is a television or radio station that broadcasts advertisements as a primary source of revenue.

words.ex: He complains about the loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 他抱怨那噪音太大。
words.en: If you complain about a situation, you say that you are not satisfied with it.

words.ex: The director of the school gave a speech.
words.ex_cn: 学校的主任发表了一次演讲。
words.en: A director is a person who is in charge of something, especially a film, play, or organization.

words.tr:
n. 纪录片；
adj. 文书的；
words.ex: We watched a documentary about pandas last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚看了一部关于熊猫的纪录片。
words.en: A documentary is a film or television or radio programme that gives factual information about a particular subject.

words.tr: phrase. 纪实节目；事实性节目（通常指非虚构的电视或广播节目，如纪录片、新闻报道等）
words.ex: He watches a factual programme about animals every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看一个关于动物的纪实节目。
words.en: A factual programme is a television or radio broadcast that presents information based on facts and reality, often including documentaries, news reports, and educational content.

words.tr: phrase. 高质量的东西；品质优良的物品
words.ex: He bought good quality stuff for his new room.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的新房间买了质量好的东西。
words.en: Items or materials that are of high standard and durability.

words.tr: phrase. 帮助放松和缓解压力
words.ex: Listening to music can help relax and unwind after a long day.
words.ex_cn: 听音乐可以帮助在漫长的一天后放松和解压。
words.en: To cause someone to feel less stressed or anxious and more at ease.

words.tr: phrase. 本地信息；当地资讯
words.ex: The shop gives local information to tourists.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店向游客提供当地信息。
words.en: Information that is specific to a particular area or community, often useful for residents or visitors.

words.ex: He joined the mailing list for news updates.
words.ex_cn: 他加入了获取新闻更新的邮件列表。
words.en: A mailing list is a collection of names and addresses used by an individual or an organization to send material to multiple recipients.

words.ex: Make a note of the meeting time.
words.ex_cn: 把会议时间记下来。
words.en: To write down something so that you will remember it.

words.tr: phrase. 新闻简报；新闻快讯
words.ex: The news bulletin aired at 6 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 新闻简报在晚上6点播出。
words.en: A news bulletin is a brief report or statement about recent events, often broadcast on radio or television.

words.ex: The occupation of the city by foreign troops lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 外国军队对这座城市的占领持续了多年。
words.en: An occupation is a job or profession, or a way of spending your time.

words.tr: phrase. 潜在客户；可能购买商品或服务的人群
words.ex: The store is trying to attract potential customers.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店正试图吸引潜在客户。
words.en: Potential customers are individuals or organizations that may be interested in purchasing a product or service but have not yet done so.

words.tr:
adj. 专业的；职业的；
n. 专业人士；
words.ex: He is a professional teacher with many years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有多年经验的专业教师。
words.en: A professional is a person who has a job that requires special training and education, especially one that involves a high level of skill or knowledge.

words.w: provide a service of the community
words.tr: phrase. 为社区提供一项服务；向社区提供公益服务
words.uk: prəˈvaɪd ə ˈsɜːvɪs əv ðə kəˈmjuːnəti
words.us: prəˈvaɪd ə ˈsɜːrvɪs əv ðə kəˈmjuːnəti
words.ex: The library provides a service of the community by offering free books.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆通过提供免费书籍为社区提供一项服务。
words.en: To offer a service that benefits the general public or local inhabitants.

words.ex: The respondent answered all the questions honestly.
words.ex_cn: 这位调查对象诚实地回答了所有问题。
words.en: A respondent is someone who replies to something such as a survey or set of questions.

words.tr: phrase. 设置频道；建立频道
words.ex: He set up the channel last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周建立了这个频道。
words.en: To establish or initiate a communication or distribution pathway.

words.tr: phrase. 音响系统；声音系统
words.ex: The sound system plays music loudly.
words.ex_cn: 音响系统大声播放音乐。
words.en: A sound system is a set of equipment for playing recorded music, or for amplifying a person's voice so that it can be heard at a distance.

words.tr: phrase. 特别促销；特价优惠活动
words.ex: The store has a special promotion this week.
words.ex_cn: 这家店本周有特别促销。
words.en: A special promotion is a marketing strategy where products or services are offered at a reduced price or with added value for a limited period to stimulate sales and attract customers.

words.tr: phrase. 具体的建议；特指的指导
words.ex: He gave me specific advice on how to improve my writing.
words.ex_cn: 他给了我一些关于如何提高写作的具体建议。
words.en: Guidance or recommendations tailored to a particular situation or need.

words.w: start with some personal background information
words.tr: phrase. 从一些个人背景信息开始
words.uk: stɑːt wɪð sʌm ˈpɜːsən(ə)l ˈbækɡraʊnd ˌɪnfəˈmeɪʃ(ə)n
words.us: stɑːrt wɪð sʌm ˈpɜːrsən(ə)l ˈbækɡraʊnd ˌɪnfərˈmeɪʃ(ə)n
words.ex: He starts with some personal background information before the interview.
words.ex_cn: 他在面试前先提供一些个人背景信息。
words.en: To begin by providing details about one's own life or experiences.

words.ex: The weather was tolerable, so we went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 天气还可以忍受，所以我们去散步了。
words.en: If something is tolerable, it is acceptable or bearable, even though it is not very good or pleasant.

words.ex: Reading a book gives me relaxation.
words.ex_cn: 读书让我放松。
words.en: Relaxation is the state or process of becoming less tense, anxious, or stressed.

words.ex: Watching movies is a popular entertainment.
words.ex_cn: 看电影是一种流行的休闲娱乐。
words.en: Entertainment refers to performances or activities that are intended to amuse or interest an audience.

words.tr: phrase. 市场调研；市场研究（指通过调查分析消费者需求、市场趋势等以支持商业决策）
words.ex: The company did market research before launching the new product.
words.ex_cn: 公司在推出新产品之前做了市场调研。
words.en: Market research is the process of gathering, analyzing, and interpreting information about a market, about a product or service to be offered for sale in that market, and about the past, present, and potential customers for the product or service.

words.tr: phrase. 在两年之后；再过两年
words.ex: In two years' time, he will graduate from high school.
words.ex_cn: 两年之后，他将从高中毕业。
words.en: A phrase indicating a period of two years from the present time.

words.tr: phrase. 系统分析师；负责分析、设计和改进计算机系统的专业人员
words.ex: He works as a system analyst at a tech company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家科技公司担任系统分析师。
words.en: A system analyst is a person who analyses and designs the information systems that are used within an organization.

words.ex: On average, children sleep 10 hours a night.
words.ex_cn: 平均而言，儿童每天睡10个小时。
words.en: If you say that something is true on average, you mean that it is generally the case.

words.ex: The new policy is for the promotion of clean energy.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策是为了促进清洁能源。
words.en: A promotion is a move to a more important job or rank in a company or organization.

words.tr: phrase. 只要；长达；和 ... 一样长
words.ex: You can stay out as long as you come home before midnight.
words.ex_cn: 只要你午夜前回家，你就可以在外面待着。
words.en: used to say that one thing is true or will happen only if another thing is true or happens

chapters.name: 真题解析2 T3 S2 校园公共设施及服务介绍

words.tr: phrase. 咨询服务；提供专业建议的服务
words.ex: The school offers an advice service for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供咨询服务。
words.en: A service that provides advice or information on a particular subject.

words.tr: phrase. 一系列有趣的商店
words.ex: There is an interesting range of shops in the town center.
words.ex_cn: 镇中心有一系列有趣的商店。
words.en: A diverse selection of retail outlets offering various goods.

words.tr: phrase. 助理福利官员；协助处理社会福利事务的工作人员
words.ex: The assistant welfare officer helps poor families get food.
words.ex_cn: 辅助福利官员帮助贫困家庭获得食物。
words.en: An assistant welfare officer is a person who works in a supporting role to ensure the well-being and welfare of individuals within an organization or community.

words.ex: The charity helps poor children get food and education.
words.ex_cn: 这个慈善团体帮助贫困儿童获得食物和教育。
words.en: An organization that helps people in need, or the act of giving money, food, or help to those who need it.

words.ex: They took a charter flight to the island.
words.ex_cn: 他们乘坐包机去了那个岛屿。
words.en: A charter flight is a flight that is not part of an airline's regular schedule, but is specially arranged for a particular group of people or for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 拥有六个放映厅的电影院
words.ex: There is a cinema with six screens near the mall.
words.ex_cn: 商场附近有一家有六个放映厅的电影院。
words.en: A movie theater featuring six separate screens for showing films.

words.tr: 短语动词. 得到一笔好交易；获得优惠条件
words.ex: She got a good deal on a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一辆新自行车，价格很划算。
words.en: To obtain something at a favorable price or with advantageous terms.

words.ex: He goes to the hi-tech fitness centre every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都去高科技健身中心。
words.en: A high-tech fitness center equipped with the latest technology and equipment for physical exercise and health improvement.

words.tr: phrase. 滑冰设施；溜冰场地及配套设备
words.ex: The town has new ice-skating facilities.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇有新的滑冰设施。
words.en: Places or buildings equipped for ice-skating.

words.tr: phrase. 室内运动；在室内进行的体育活动
words.ex: He likes indoor sports like basketball and volleyball.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢篮球和排球等室内运动。
words.en: Sports or physical activities that are performed inside a building, as opposed to outdoors.

words.tr: phrase. 法律问题；法律纠纷；法律难题
words.ex: He has legal problems with his landlord.
words.ex_cn: 他和房东有法律问题。
words.en: Issues or disputes that require resolution through the legal system.

words.tr: phrase. 社交生活的主要中心
words.ex: The park is the main centre of social life in the town.
words.ex_cn: 公园是这个城镇社会生活的主要中心。
words.en: The primary location where social activities and interactions occur.

words.ex: The car is in the parking lot.
words.ex_cn: 车在停车场里。
words.en: A parking lot is an area of ground where people can leave their cars.

words.tr: phrase. 流行乐队；流行音乐团体
words.ex: They are in a pop group that sings on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他们是演唱流行歌曲的乐队，会在电视上表演。
words.en: A pop group is a musical ensemble that performs pop music, typically consisting of singers and musicians.

words.ex: They provide catering services for small parties.
words.ex_cn: 他们为小型聚会提供餐饮服务。
words.en: To offer food and drink services for events or groups.

words.ex: They are trying to raise money for the school.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在努力为学校筹钱。
words.en: To collect money for a particular purpose, especially for a charity or for a political campaign.

words.w: social facilities available on the campus
words.tr: phrase. 校园内可使用的社交设施
words.uk: ˈsəʊʃ(ə)l fəˈsɪlɪtɪz əˈveɪləb(ə)l ɒn ðə ˈkæmpəs
words.us: ˈsəʊʃ(ə)l fəˈsɪlətɪz əˈveɪləb(ə)l ɑːn ðə ˈkæmpəs
words.ex: The campus has social facilities like cafés and lounges.
words.ex_cn: 校园里有咖啡馆和休息室等社交设施。
words.en: Amenities like libraries, sports areas, or cafés available at a university.

words.tr:
n. 球类运动（squash）；
v. 压碎；
words.ex: He plays squash every weekend with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末和朋友打壁球。
words.en: To squash something means to press or squeeze it so that it becomes flat, soft, or out of shape. It can also refer to the sport of squash or a type of vegetable.

words.ex: The chair is stationary and does not move.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子是固定的，不会移动。
words.en: not moving or not intended to be moved

words.tr:
n. 味觉；味道；品味；喜好；
v. 品尝；有…味道；
words.ex: My taste can detect sweet and sour flavors.
words.ex_cn: 我的味觉能分辨甜味和酸味。
words.en: The sensation of flavor perceived in the mouth and throat on contact with a substance.

words.tr: phrase. 皇家剧院（英国一些城市的历史悠久的剧院）
words.ex: They saw a play at the theatre royal last night.
words.ex_cn: 他们昨晚在皇家剧院看了一出戏。
words.en: A Theatre Royal is a name given to theatres in the United Kingdom that have been granted a royal patent or charter. These theatres are often historic and have a prestigious status in the performing arts community.

words.ex: He bought a ticket at the ticket shop.
words.ex_cn: 他在售票处买了一张票。
words.en: A ticket shop is a place where tickets for events, travel, etc., are sold.

words.ex: The school sends a weekly programme of events to parents.
words.ex_cn: 学校每周向家长发送活动日程。
words.en: A schedule or list of events that are planned to occur each week.

words.tr: phrase. 正当的理由；慈善事业；有益的事业
words.ex: He donated money to a good cause.
words.ex_cn: 他捐钱给一个正当的理由。
words.en: A good cause is a charitable or worthy purpose that people support because they believe it is important or beneficial to society.

words.tr: phrase. 政治竞选活动；政治运动
words.ex: He joined a political campaign last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年参加了一个政治竞选。
words.en: A political campaign is an organized effort which seeks to influence the decision making progress within a specific group. In democracies, political campaigns often refer to electoral campaigns, by which representatives are chosen or referendums are decided.

words.ex: I bought a newspaper from the newsagent.
words.ex_cn: 我从报刊亭买了一份报纸。
words.en: A newsagent is a person or shop that sells newspapers and magazines.

words.tr: n. 住处；膳宿；(交通工具内的)空间；
words.ex: The hotel provided cheap accommodation for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 酒店为旅客提供了便宜的住处。
words.en: Accommodation is a place where someone lives or stays, or the act of providing someone with a place to live or stay.

words.ex: Immigration to this country has increased recently.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的移民数量最近增加了。
words.en: Immigration is the act of coming to live permanently in a country that is not your own.

words.tr:
n. 补助金；授予物；
v. 承认；授予；允许；
words.ex: The university received a grant for scientific research.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学收到了一笔用于科学研究的补助金。
words.en: If someone in authority grants you something, or if something is granted to you, you are allowed to have it or do it.

words.ex: The student union organized a free concert on campus.
words.ex_cn: 学生会在学校组织了一场免费音乐会。
words.en: The student union is an organization found in many colleges, universities, and high schools. In higher education, the student union is often accorded its own building on the campus, dedicated to social, organizational activities, representation, and academic support of the membership.

words.tr: n. 举办地点；（比赛）地点；会场；
words.ex: The concert will be held at a new venue.
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会将在一个新的举办地点举行。
words.en: A place where an event or meeting is held, such as a concert hall or conference center.

words.tr: phrase. 财务问题；经济困难
words.ex: He has a financial problem and needs help.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个财务问题，需要帮助。
words.en: A financial problem refers to an issue related to the management of money, such as debt, lack of funding, or poor financial planning.

words.tr: phrase. 医疗服务；医疗业务
words.ex: He needs good medical service after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他事故后需要良好的医疗服务。
words.en: The provision of medical care and treatment by professionals.

words.tr: phrase. 咨询中心；辅导中心（提供心理、学业或职业等方面咨询与支持的机构）
words.ex: He went to the counseling center for help.
words.ex_cn: 他去咨询中心寻求帮助。
words.en: A counseling center is a place where individuals can receive guidance and support for personal, educational, or psychological issues.

words.ex: The town has a new leisure facility with a pool and gym.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇有一个新的休闲设施，配有游泳池和健身房。
words.en: A leisure facility is a place where people can go to relax and enjoy themselves, such as a gym, swimming pool, or cinema.

words.ex: The park is in the centre of the city.
words.ex_cn: 公园在城市的中心。
words.en: Located at the middle point of something.

words.tr: adj. 奥运会标准尺寸的；符合奥运会规格的
words.ex: The pool is an olympic-size pool.
words.ex_cn: 这个游泳池是一个奥运标准尺寸的泳池。
words.en: Conforming to the standards or size of the Olympic Games.

words.tr: n. 羽毛球运动；羽毛球；
words.ex: He plays badminton every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打羽毛球。
words.en: A game played with rackets and a shuttlecock, which is hit back and forth across a high net.

chapters.name: 真题解析2 T3 S3 课程论文指导

words.tr: 短语动词. 请求延期；要求延长截止时间
words.ex: He will ask for an extension on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他会请求延长作业的截止时间。
words.en: Request additional time to complete a task or assignment.

words.ex: He likes biology because it teaches about animals and plants.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢生物学，因为它教关于动物和植物的知识。
words.en: Biology is the science which is concerned with the study of living things.

words.tr: v. 证实；确认；“confirm”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 证实的；
words.ex: The test confirmed his illness.
words.ex_cn: 检测证实了他生病了。
words.en: If someone is confirmed in a particular position or role, they are formally given that position or role.

words.tr: phrase. 演示的持续时间；陈述的时间长度
words.ex: The duration of presentation is ten minutes.
words.ex_cn: 演示的时长是十分钟。
words.en: The length of time that a presentation lasts.

words.ex: The teacher set a fixed hand-in date for the homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师为作业设定了一个固定的上交日期。
words.en: A predetermined deadline for submitting work.

words.tr: phrase. 教程主题；教学课题
words.ex: The tutorial topics are easy to understand.
words.ex_cn: 辅导课的主题很容易理解。
words.en: Subjects or themes discussed in small-group teaching sessions.

words.tr: phrase. 期刊论文；学术期刊文章
words.ex: He reads journal articles for his research.
words.ex_cn: 他为了研究阅读期刊文章。
words.en: Academic papers published in scholarly periodicals.

words.tr: phrase. 造山运动；山岳形成（地质学中指地壳运动导致山脉隆起的过程）
words.ex: The mountain building took millions of years.
words.ex_cn: 造山运动花了数百万年。
words.en: The geological processes that cause the formation of mountains.

words.ex: He uses a simple research method to collect data.
words.ex_cn: 他使用一种简单的研究方法来收集数据。
words.en: A systematic approach used to collect and analyze data to answer research questions or test hypotheses.

words.ex: He wrote his dissertation on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的学位论文。
words.en: A dissertation is a long piece of writing on a particular subject, especially one written for a university degree.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a questionnaire about our habits.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们一份关于我们习惯的问卷。
words.en: A questionnaire is a written list of questions which are answered by a lot of people in order to provide information for a report or a survey.

words.ex: I look forward to the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我期待着周末。
words.en: If you look forward to something that is going to happen, you want it to happen because you think you will enjoy it.

words.tr: n. 需求；要求；必要条件；
words.ex: The job has a requirement of two years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作的要求是两年经验。
words.en: A requirement is something that is necessary or that must be done.

words.ex: Graduating from high school was a big milestone for him.
words.ex_cn: 从高中毕业对他来说是一个重要的事件。
words.en: A milestone is a significant event or stage in the development of something.

words.ex: She is flexible with her schedule.
words.ex_cn: 她的日程安排很灵活。
words.en: Able to change or be changed easily according to the situation.

words.ex: He finished his homework before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 他在截止日期前完成了作业。
words.en: A deadline is a time or date before which a particular task must be finished or a particular thing must be done.

words.ex: He added the bibliography at the end of his report.
words.ex_cn: 他在报告末尾添加了参考书目。
words.en: A bibliography is a list of the books and articles that have been used by someone when writing a particular book or article.

words.ex: Get a move on, or we will miss the bus.
words.ex_cn: 快点走，不然我们会错过公交车。
words.en: If you tell someone to get a move on, you are telling them to hurry.

words.ex: He wrote a draft plan for the project.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一个项目的初步计划。
words.en: A preliminary version of a plan or document that is subject to revision and refinement.

words.tr: 短语. 非常有益；大有裨益
words.ex: Eating vegetables is of great benefit to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜对你的健康非常有益。
words.en: To be of great benefit means to provide significant advantages or positive effects to someone or something.

words.ex: He bought a secondhand bike for $50.
words.ex_cn: 他花50美元买了一辆二手自行车。
words.en: Something that is secondhand is not new and has been owned by someone else before.

words.tr: phrase. 结束；告终；意外到达
words.ex: He didn't plan to stay, but he ended up sleeping there.
words.ex_cn: 他本没打算留下，但最后在那里睡了。
words.en: If you end up in a particular place or situation, you are in that place or situation after a series of events, even though you did not originally intend to be.

words.ex: To be frank, I don't like this movie.
words.ex_cn: 老实说，我不喜欢这部电影。
words.en: Used to indicate that the speaker is being honest or straightforward in their statement.

words.ex: He will sort out his books tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会整理好他的书。
words.en: To sort something out means to organize or arrange it, or to solve a problem or difficulty.

chapters.name: 真题解析2 T3 S4 关于澳大利亚水资源的讲座

words.tr: phrase. 非常重要的；极为重要的
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: To be very significant or crucial.

words.ex: The dryness of the desert makes it hard for plants to grow.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠的干燥使植物难以生长。
words.en: The state or quality of being dry.

words.tr: phrase. 广泛的地下水资源
words.ex: The desert has extensive underground water resources.
words.ex_cn: 这个沙漠拥有广泛的地下水资源。
words.en: Large amounts of water found beneath the Earth's surface, which are crucial for supporting ecosystems, agriculture, and human consumption.

words.tr: phrase. 家庭用水量；家庭水消耗
words.ex: Our household water consumption dropped last month.
words.ex_cn: 我们家上个月的用水量减少了。
words.en: The amount of water used by a household, typically measured over a certain period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 自然问题；天然难题；与生俱来的困扰
words.ex: Mathematicians study natural problems like prime numbers.
words.ex_cn: 数学家研究像质数这样的自然问题。
words.en: Issues or challenges arising from the natural world.

words.tr: phrase. 宝贵资源；珍贵资源
words.ex: Clean water is a precious resource.
words.ex_cn: 清洁的水是一种宝贵的资源。
words.en: A precious resource is something valuable that is available in limited quantities and is essential for survival or for maintaining a certain quality of life.

words.ex: It was a rainy day, so we stayed inside.
words.ex_cn: 那天是多雨的，所以我们待在室内。
words.en: If the weather is rainy, it is raining a lot.

words.ex: There is a shortage of clean water in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄的清洁用水不足。
words.en: A shortage is a situation in which there is not enough of something that is needed.

words.ex: The stream flows quietly through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 小溪静静地流过森林。
words.en: A stream is a small, narrow river. It can also refer to a continuous flow of liquid, air, or gas, or a continuous flow of data or information.

words.tr: phrase. 地下水；位于地表之下的水体
words.ex: The subterranean water flows slowly under the hill.
words.ex_cn: 地下水在山下缓慢流动。
words.en: Water that exists below the surface of the earth, in the cracks and spaces in soil, sand, and rock.

words.ex: He drinks tap water every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天喝自来水。
words.en: Water that comes out of a tap, especially as opposed to bottled water.

words.ex: The village gets water from underground water.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄的水源来自地下水。
words.en: Water that is found beneath the surface of the earth, often in aquifers, which can be extracted for use in agriculture, industry, and domestic purposes.

words.ex: The village needs more water resource to grow crops.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄需要更多的水资源来种植庄稼。
words.en: A water resource is a source of water that is useful or potentially useful to humans, for example for drinking, irrigation, or industrial processes.

words.tr: phrase. 明智的管理；审慎的经营
words.ex: He showed wise management of the company's money.
words.ex_cn: 他对公司的资金进行了明智的管理。
words.en: The effective and prudent handling or control of resources or affairs.

words.tr: phrase. 蒸发速率；单位时间内液体转化为蒸气的量
words.ex: The evaporation rate is high in summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天的蒸发率很高。
words.en: The speed at which a liquid changes into a gas or vapor.

words.ex: Water can penetrate the soil slowly.
words.ex_cn: 水可以慢慢渗透进土壤。
words.en: To penetrate means to enter or pass through something, especially when this is difficult or when it is not obvious how to do it.

words.ex: He used up all the water.
words.ex_cn: 他把所有的水都用完了。
words.en: To consume or exhaust something completely.

words.tr: phrase. 天然泉；自然涌出的泉水
words.ex: The village has a clean natural spring.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄有一个干净的天然泉。
words.en: A natural spring is a place where water flows naturally from the ground.

words.ex: The farmer feeds his livestock every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂他的家畜。
words.en: Livestock are animals such as cattle and sheep which are kept on a farm.

words.ex: The dam produces hydro-electric power for the town.
words.ex_cn: 大坝为这个城镇提供水力发电。
words.en: Hydro-electric power is electricity that is produced by the force of fast-flowing water, especially from rivers.

words.ex: The aridity of the desert makes it hard for plants to grow.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠的干旱使植物难以生长。
words.en: Aridity is the state of being extremely dry, especially due to lack of rainfall.

words.tr:
v. 估算；估价；
n. 估价；估算；
words.ex: Can you estimate how long it will take?
words.ex_cn: 你能估算一下需要多长时间吗？
words.en: If you estimate a quantity or value, you make an approximate judgment or calculation of it.

words.ex: The trip takes approximately 30 minutes.
words.ex_cn: 这段旅程大约需要30分钟。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is close to the actual, but not completely accurate or exact.

words.ex: He runs fast, in comparison with his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，与他哥哥相比。
words.en: Used to say that something is being considered in relation to something else, especially to show how they are different or similar.

words.ex: The soil has too much moisture.
words.ex_cn: 土壤中有太多湿气。
words.en: Moisture is tiny drops of water in the air, on a surface, or in a substance, that make it feel wet.

words.ex: Farmers use irrigation to water their crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用灌溉来浇灌庄稼。
words.en: Irrigation is the process of supplying water to land or crops to help growth, typically by means of channels.

words.ex: He relies on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠弟弟帮忙。
words.en: To depend on with full trust or confidence.

words.tr: phrase. 地下水库；地下储水层
words.ex: The city gets water from an underground reservoir.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市从地下水库获取水。
words.en: An underground reservoir is a large natural or artificial lake used as a source of water supply, located beneath the ground surface.

words.ex: Water is vital for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you say that something is vital, you mean that it is necessary or very important.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a handout about photosynthesis.
words.ex_cn: 老师发给我们一份关于光合作用的讲义。
words.en: A handout is a document which contains news or information about something and which is given, for example, to journalists or to people attending a talk or lecture.

words.tr: n. 参考；提及；介绍信；引用；
words.ex: Please use this book for reference.
words.ex_cn: 请使用这本书作为参考。
words.en: A reference is a mention of something or someone, or a letter or statement about someone's character or abilities.

words.tr: phrase. 内陆农场；澳大利亚偏远地区的农场
words.ex: He works on an outback farm in Australia.
words.ex_cn: 他在澳大利亚的内陆农场工作。
words.en: A farm located in the remote and usually arid inland regions of Australia.

chapters.name: 真题解析2 T4 S1 咨询住房维修服务

words.tr: phrase. 浴室灯；用于浴室的照明设备
words.ex: He turned on the bathroom light.
words.ex_cn: 他打开了浴室的灯。
words.en: A light fixture in a room for washing and personal hygiene.

words.ex: The candle's flicker lit up the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛的闪现照亮了黑暗的房间。
words.en: If a light or flame flickers, it shines unsteadily.

words.tr: 短语动词. 立即完成……；马上把……做完
words.ex: He got his homework done right away.
words.ex_cn: 他立刻把作业做完了。
words.en: To complete a task immediately without delay.

words.tr: 短语动词. 立刻完成某事；马上把……做完
words.ex: I will get the homework done straight away.
words.ex_cn: 我会马上把作业做完。
words.en: To complete a task immediately without delay.

words.tr: phrase. 房屋中介；房产代理机构
words.ex: We hired a house agency to find our new home.
words.ex_cn: 我们聘请了一家房屋中介来为我们找新家。
words.en: A house agency is a business that acts as an intermediary between sellers and buyers of real estate properties, offering services such as property listing, viewing arrangements, and negotiation assistance.

words.tr:
n. 漏洞；泄露；
v. 漏；泄露；
words.ex: The leak in the roof caused water to drip inside.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶的漏洞导致水滴进屋里。
words.en: If a container or pipe leaks, or if it leaks a substance such as liquid or gas, the substance comes out of it accidentally because there is a hole or crack in it.

words.tr:
n. 租契；
v. 出租；
words.ex: He signed a lease for the apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他签了公寓的租契。
words.en: A lease is a legal agreement by which the owner of a building, a piece of land, or something such as a car allows someone else to use it for a period of time in return for money.

words.ex: He lost all his property in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他在火灾中失去了所有财产。
words.en: Something owned; a possession.

words.tr: n. 单元住宅；公寓住宅；
words.ex: He lives in a small apartment near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一间小公寓里。
words.en: An apartment is a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a large building.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；逐步增长；加强
words.ex: He builds up his strength by running every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天跑步来增强体力。
words.en: To increase or develop something gradually; to accumulate or amass something over time.

words.ex: She uses the washing machine every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 她每星期天都用洗衣机。
words.en: A washing machine is a machine that washes clothes, sheets, and other items.

words.tr:
adj. 琐碎的；费神的；烦扰的
v. 为琐事费心；吹毛求疵；找茬儿；“niggle”的现在分词
words.ex: He has a niggling pain in his back.
words.ex_cn: 他背部有一种持续的小疼痛。
words.en: A niggling problem or worry is small but bothers you over a period of time.

words.tr: adj. 讨厌的； v. “annoy”的现在分词；
words.ex: The loud noise is annoying.
words.ex_cn: 这噪音很讨厌。
words.en: Something that is annoying makes you feel fairly angry and impatient.

words.ex: He left right away when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 他一听到消息就离开了。
words.en: If you do something right away, you do it immediately.

chapters.name: 真题解析2 T4 S2 旅游观光地介绍

words.ex: They stayed in a small lodge near the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在森林附近的一座小屋里。
words.en: A lodge is a small house in the country, especially one that is used by people on holiday or by people taking part in a sport such as skiing or hunting. As a verb, to lodge means to stay somewhere, especially temporarily, or to formally submit something, such as a complaint or an application.

words.tr: phrase. 康乐干事；文娱活动负责人
words.ex: The recreation officer organizes games for children.
words.ex_cn: 休闲官员为孩子们组织游戏。
words.en: A recreation officer is a professional responsible for planning, organizing, and overseeing recreational activities and programs within a community or organization.

words.ex: We hope you have a great stay at our hotel.
words.ex_cn: 我们希望你在我们酒店住得愉快。
words.en: Wish someone a pleasant and enjoyable time during their stay.

words.ex: I appreciate the beauty of nature.
words.ex_cn: 我欣赏大自然的美。
words.en: If you appreciate something, you recognize its value and feel grateful for it.

words.ex: He drinks coffee on the balcony every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在阳台上喝咖啡。
words.en: A balcony is a platform on the outside of a building, enclosed by walls or balustrades, supported by columns or console brackets. The platform is projected from the wall of a building, usually above the ground floor.

words.tr: adj. 惊吓的；受惊的；害怕的； v. “frighten”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The child was frightened by the loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 孩子被巨大的噪音吓到了。
words.en: If you are frightened, you are anxious or afraid, often because of something that has just happened or that you think may happen.

words.tr: phrase. 鸟儿的歌唱；鸟鸣声
words.ex: The birds' singing wakes me up every morning.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿的鸣叫每天早上把我叫醒。
words.en: The vocal sounds made by birds, often melodious and used for communication or attracting mates.

words.tr: phrase. 境况好得多；富裕得多；处境改善很多
words.ex_cn: 他没有那份工作后好多了。
words.en: To be in a more favorable or prosperous condition.

words.tr: adj. 紧张不安的；神经系统的；
words.ex: He felt nervous before the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到紧张不安。
words.en: If someone is nervous, they are frightened or worried about something that is happening or might happen, and show this in their behavior.

words.ex: The children saw a big rainforest on their trip.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在旅行中看到了一片热带雨林。
words.en: A dense, tropical forest that receives a high amount of rainfall, typically located near the equator.

words.ex: Beware of the dog.
words.ex_cn: 当心那只狗。
words.en: to be cautious and alert to the dangers of.

words.ex: The sailors slept in the cabin during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 水手们在风暴期间睡在船舱里。
words.en: A cabin is a small room or compartment, especially one on a ship or an aircraft.

words.ex: I catch a glimpse of the bird in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 我瞥见了树上的鸟。
words.en: To see someone or something for a very short time.

words.tr: phrase. 鳄鱼巡游（指乘坐船只在有鳄鱼出没的水域中游览的活动）
words.ex: We took a crocodile cruise on the river.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘坐了鳄鱼游船在河上。
words.en: A crocodile cruise is a boat tour designed to observe crocodiles in their natural environment, often in rivers or wetlands.

words.ex: He will depart tomorrow morning.
words.ex_cn: 他明天早上离开。
words.en: If you depart from a place, you leave it and start a journey to another place.

words.tr: phrase. 晚餐时间；吃晚饭的时间
words.ex: It is dinner time, so we eat now.
words.ex_cn: 该吃晚饭了，所以我们现在吃饭。
words.en: The time at which dinner is eaten.

words.ex: He discovered a new planet last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年发现了一颗新行星。
words.en: If you discover something that you did not know about before, you become aware of it or find it.

words.tr: phrase. 探险旅行；探险之旅
words.ex: The explorer trip took them through the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 这次探险之旅带他们穿过了丛林。
words.en: An expedition or journey of exploration.

words.tr: phrase. 四轮驱动车旅行；越野车观光之旅
words.ex: We went on a four-wheel-drive tour in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 我们去沙漠进行了一次四轮驱动旅行。
words.en: A tour that is conducted using a four-wheel-drive vehicle, typically offering an adventurous experience over rough terrain.

words.tr: 短语动词. 远离一切烦恼；彻底放松；摆脱日常琐事
words.ex: He went to the mountains to get away from it all.
words.ex_cn: 他去山里远离一切烦恼。
words.en: To escape from one's usual environment or daily routine, often for relaxation or to avoid stress.

words.tr: 短语. 有不同的关注点；关注的重心不同
words.ex: They have a different focus in their new project.
words.ex_cn: 他们在新项目中有不同的重点。
words.en: To have a different primary aim or area of attention.

words.tr: phrase. 雨林小屋；位于雨林中的度假小屋或旅馆
words.ex: We stayed at a rainforest lodge near the Amazon River.
words.ex_cn: 我们住在亚马逊河附近的一家雨林小屋。
words.en: A rainforest lodge is a type of accommodation located within a rainforest, offering guests the opportunity to experience the natural environment up close.

words.ex: The park protects many kinds of wildlife.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园保护许多种类的野生生物。
words.en: Wildlife refers to animals and plants that live and grow in natural conditions.

words.ex: They went on a spotlight tour of the city last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末他们进行了城市观光游。
words.en: A spotlight tour refers to a tour or visit that focuses on highlighting specific aspects or features, often used in the context of music tours or guided visits to places of interest.

words.ex: We watched the sundown from the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我们在海滩上观看了日落。
words.en: The time in the evening when the sun disappears or daylight fades.

words.tr: phrase. 确保；确定；核实；查明
words.ex: Make sure you lock the door before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前确保锁好门。
words.en: To make certain that something is done or happens.

words.ex: The phone call caused an interruption in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 电话打断了会议。
words.en: An interruption is something that temporarily stops an activity or a situation.

words.ex: The loud music was a distraction while I tried to study.
words.ex_cn: 当我试图学习时，大声的音乐让我分心。
words.en: Something that makes it difficult for you to concentrate on what you are doing.

words.tr: v. 提供；供应；“provide”的过去式和过去分词； conj. 如果；假如；在…条件下；
words.ex: The school provides free lunch to students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。
words.en: If a particular condition is true or if a particular event happens, then another condition will be true or another event will happen.

words.ex: He used common sense to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用常识解决了这个问题。
words.en: Common sense is the natural ability to make good judgments and to behave in a practical and sensible way.

words.tr: adj. 分泌毒液的；有毒的；恶毒的
words.ex: The snake is venomous.
words.ex_cn: 这条蛇是有毒的。
words.en: If you describe a person or their behavior as venomous, you mean that they show great bitterness and anger toward someone.

words.ex: The irritation on his arm hurt when he touched it.
words.ex_cn: 他手臂上的疼痛处一碰就疼。
words.en: Irritation is the feeling of annoyance, especially when something keeps happening that you do not like.

chapters.name: 真题解析2 T4 S3 学习技巧咨询与指导

words.ex: The teacher gave us a math assignment.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一份数学作业。
words.en: An assignment is a task or piece of work that you are given to do, especially as part of your job or studies.

words.tr: phrase. 普遍兴趣；一般关注
words.ex: He reads magazines for general interest.
words.ex_cn: 他阅读那些出于普遍兴趣的杂志。
words.en: A subject or activity that attracts the attention of the majority of people.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet is compulsory for cyclists.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车时戴头盔是必须的。
words.en: If something is compulsory, you must do it because of a rule or law.

words.tr: phrase. 咨询会话；辅导会谈
words.ex: He attended a counseling session last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周参加了一次心理咨询。
words.en: A counseling session is a meeting in which someone receives guidance or advice from a professional counselor, often to help them deal with personal or psychological issues.

words.tr: phrase. 课程要求；修读某课程所需满足的条件
words.ex: The course requirement is to pass the final exam.
words.ex_cn: 这门课的要求是通过期末考试。
words.en: A course requirement is a condition or set of conditions that must be met in order to complete a course successfully.

words.ex: The students go to the resource centre to find books.
words.ex_cn: 学生们去资源中心找书。
words.en: A resource centre is a place where a variety of information and resources are made available to the public, often focusing on a specific subject or area of interest.

words.ex: He revised his answer to make it correct.
words.ex_cn: 他修正了他的答案，使其正确。
words.en: To revise something means to alter or amend it, especially in order to correct or improve it.

words.tr: phrase. 科学课程；理科课程
words.ex: He takes a science course every semester.
words.ex_cn: 他每学期都上一门科学课程。
words.en: A science course is a series of classes or a program of study in the field of science, designed to teach students about scientific principles, methods, and discoveries.

words.tr: 短语：掌控时间；管理时间
words.ex: He tries to take control of time by planning his day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过规划一天来试图掌控时间。
words.en: To manage one's time effectively to increase productivity or achieve goals.

words.tr: phrase. 休闲活动；业余活动；闲暇时进行的娱乐或放松活动
words.ex: He enjoys reading as a leisure activity.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢把阅读当作一种休闲活动。
words.en: An activity done for enjoyment when one is not working.

words.ex: He follows a systematic approach to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种系统的方法来解决数学问题。
words.en: A systematic approach or method is one that is done according to a fixed plan, in a thorough and efficient way.

words.tr: phrase. 磁带录音机；盒式录音机
words.ex: He listens to music on a cassette recorder.
words.ex_cn: 他用磁带录音机听音乐。
words.en: A cassette recorder is a device that records and plays back sound using cassette tapes.

words.tr: phrase. 呼吁；有吸引力；使感兴趣
words.ex: The teacher appealed to the students to be quiet.
words.ex_cn: 老师呼吁学生们保持安静。
words.en: To make a serious or urgent request to the public for help or money; to attract or interest someone.

words.ex: The teacher underlined the key point.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调了这个关键点。
words.en: To draw a line under a word or phrase, especially in order to emphasize it.

words.tr:
v. 突出；强调；高光；
n. 最突出的部分；
words.ex: The teacher highlighted the key words in the text.
words.ex_cn: 老师把文中的关键词突出了。
words.en: To highlight something means to make it stand out or to emphasize it, often because it is important or interesting.

chapters.name: 真题解析2 T4 S4 关于用车安全的调查报告

words.tr: phrase. 汽车安全；指车辆在行驶过程中保护驾乘人员免受伤害的能力或措施
words.ex: Car safety is important for every driver.
words.ex_cn: 汽车安全对每位司机都很重要。
words.en: Car safety refers to the measures and technologies designed to minimize the risk of accidents and injuries in automobiles.

words.tr: phrase. 项目的核心；项目的重点
words.ex: The focus of the project is improving student reading skills.
words.ex_cn: 项目的核心是提高学生的阅读能力。
words.en: The central aim or main subject of a project.

words.ex: Please pay in advance.
words.ex_cn: 请提前付款。
words.en: Before a particular time, or before doing a particular thing.

words.ex: The train's destination is Beijing.
words.ex_cn: 这列火车的目的地是北京。
words.en: The place to which someone or something is going or being sent.

words.ex: In the majority, students like pizza.
words.ex_cn: 大多数学生喜欢披萨。
words.en: If a group is in the majority, they form more than half of a larger group.

words.ex: He will overtake the car ahead soon.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就会超过前面的车。
words.en: If you overtake someone, you go past them because you are moving faster than they are.

words.ex: The project background explains why we started this work.
words.ex_cn: 项目背景解释了我们为什么开始这项工作。
words.en: The project background refers to the context and circumstances that led to the initiation of a project, including the problem it aims to solve, the objectives it seeks to achieve, and the environment in which it operates.

words.ex: He is working on a research project about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他正在做一个关于气候变化的研究项目。
words.en: A research project is a detailed and careful study of a specific topic or problem, often carried out over a period of time and involving the collection and analysis of information.

words.ex: The court issued an injunction to stop the construction.
words.ex_cn: 法院下达了命令，停止施工。
words.en: An injunction is a court order, usually one telling someone not to do something.

words.tr:
v. 见证；
n. 证人；目击者；
words.ex: He witnessed the accident yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天目睹了那起事故。
words.en: A witness is someone who sees an event happen, especially a crime or an accident. Witnesses are often called upon to give evidence in court.

words.tr:
n. 面试；访谈；
v. 面试；接见；
words.ex: He has an interview tomorrow for a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他明天有一场新工作的面试。
words.en: An interview is a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out if they are suitable for a job or a course of study.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a questionnaire about our habits.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们一份关于我们习惯的问卷。
words.en: A questionnaire is a written list of questions which are answered by a lot of people in order to provide information for a report or a survey.

words.tr: n. 观察；观测；注意；监视；(观察后的）意见；
words.ex: The scientist made an observation about the bird's behavior.
words.ex_cn: 科学家对这只鸟的行为进行了观察。
words.en: The act of noticing or watching something carefully in order to gain information.

words.ex: The proportion of students who passed the test was high.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试的学生比例很高。
words.en: A proportion is a part of a whole, or the relationship of one part to another in terms of size, amount, or degree.

words.tr: n. 调查发现； v. 找到；发现；“find”的现在分词；
words.ex: The finding of the study surprised many scientists.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究的调查发现让许多科学家感到惊讶。
words.en: A finding is a discovery or conclusion reached as a result of an investigation or research.

words.ex: The instructions were straightforward and easy to follow.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明很简单，容易遵循。
words.en: If you describe something as straightforward, you approve of it because it is easy to do or understand.

words.tr: phrase. 路怒症；驾车时的愤怒攻击行为
words.ex: He shouted at another driver because of road rage.
words.ex_cn: 他因为路怒症对另一名司机大喊大叫。
words.en: Road rage refers to aggressive or angry behavior exhibited by a driver of a road vehicle, which can include rude gestures, verbal insults, deliberately driving in an unsafe or threatening manner, or making threats.

words.ex: He parked his car in the garage.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在了车库里。
words.en: A garage is a building where you keep a car. It can also refer to a place where cars are repaired.

words.ex: He drives on the motorway every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在高速公路上开车。
words.en: A motorway is a wide road specially built for fast travel over long distances, with a limited number of places at which drivers can enter and leave it.

words.ex: The team made a smart strategy to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队制定了一项聪明的策略来赢得比赛。
words.en: A strategy is a plan that you use in order to achieve something.

words.ex: There was a big improvement in his English skills.
words.ex_cn: 他的英语水平有了很大改进。
words.en: The act of making something better or the state of being made better; an example or instance of this.

chapters.name: 真题解析3 T1 S1 电话咨询租房事宜

words.ex: He lost all his property in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他在火灾中失去了所有财产。
words.en: Something owned; a possession.

words.ex: They live in a quiet suburb outside the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在城市外一个安静的市郊。
words.en: A suburb is a residential district located on the outskirts of a city.

words.tr:
n. 一系列；（变化）范围；山脉；
v. （在某范围内）变化；包括（各种不同的人或物）；
words.ex: The store offers a range of colors.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供一系列颜色。
words.en: A range of things is a number of different things of the same general kind.

words.ex: He depends on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠他哥哥帮忙。
words.en: To rely on someone or something for support, help, or supply; to be determined or influenced by something.

words.tr:
n. 因素；要素；倍数；
v. 把…因素包括进去；
words.ex: Weather is a factor in the game's outcome.
words.ex_cn: 天气是比赛结果的一个因素。
words.en: A factor is one of the things that affects an event, decision, or situation.

words.ex: He parked his car in the garage.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在了车库里。
words.en: A garage is a building where you keep a car. It can also refer to a place where cars are repaired.

words.ex: He stored the documents in a metal file.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件存放在一个金属档案盒里。
words.en: A file is a box or folded piece of heavy paper or plastic in which letters or documents are kept. As a verb, to file means to put documents in a file or to officially record something.

words.tr:
v. 适合；相配；
n. 套装；西装；诉讼；
words.ex: This color suits her well.
words.ex_cn: 这个颜色很适合她。
words.en: A suit is a set of clothes made from the same fabric, usually consisting of a jacket and trousers or a skirt. As a verb, to suit means to be appropriate or acceptable for someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 水费账单；用水费用单据
words.ex: He paid the water bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天交了水费。
words.en: A water bill is a statement of charges for water usage that is sent to a customer by a water utility company.

words.tr: adj. 可获得的；有空的；可用的；
words.ex: The books are available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在图书馆里可以借到。
words.en: If something is available, it is able to be used or obtained.

words.ex: The availability of free Wi-Fi is important for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 免费Wi-Fi的可用性对旅行者很重要。
words.en: The quality of being able to be used or obtained.

words.ex: He asked his teacher for a reference letter.
words.ex_cn: 他请老师给他写一封推荐信。
words.en: A reference letter is a document in which the writer assesses the qualities, characteristics, and capabilities of the person being recommended in terms of that individual's ability to perform a particular task or function.

words.tr: phrase. 雇主出具的推荐信；由雇主提供的证明信
words.ex: He sent a reference letter from his employer to the new company.
words.ex_cn: 他把雇主写的推荐信寄给了新公司。
words.en: A document written by an employer that provides a testimonial of an employee's skills, achievements, and work ethic, often used in job applications.

words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.tr:
n. 数量；数额；
v. 总计；等于；
words.ex: The amount of water in the bottle is small.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里的水量很少。
words.en: An amount of something is how much there is of it, or how much you have, need, or get.

words.tr: phrase. 支付合同费用；为合同付款
words.ex: He will pay for contract before the work starts.
words.ex_cn: 他将在工作开始前支付合同费用。
words.en: To pay money for a formal agreement.

words.tr: 短语动词. 通知即将搬入；告知搬入意向
words.ex: They gave notice of moving in next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们通知了下周要搬进来。
words.en: To officially inform about the date of moving into a new home.

words.tr: phrase. 房屋中介；房产代理机构
words.ex: We hired a house agency to find our new home.
words.ex_cn: 我们聘请了一家房屋中介来为我们找新家。
words.en: A house agency is a business that acts as an intermediary between sellers and buyers of real estate properties, offering services such as property listing, viewing arrangements, and negotiation assistance.

words.ex: The location of the store is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店的位置在公园附近。
words.en: A location is the place where something happens or is situated.

words.tr: phrase. 询问：向某人或某机构提出问题或请求信息。
words.ex: He makes an enquiry about the train schedule.
words.ex_cn: 他询问火车时刻表。
words.en: To ask for information about something.

words.ex: He paid for telephone rental last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月支付了电话租赁费。
words.en: The service of renting telephones to users, typically for a short period of time.

chapters.name: 真题解析3 T1 S2 家庭主妇谈论英国医疗体制

words.tr: phrase. 安顿下来；适应新环境（如新家、新工作或新国家）
words.ex: They settled in a small town after moving.
words.ex_cn: 搬家后，他们在一个小镇安顿下来。
words.en: To begin to feel comfortable in a new place or situation.

words.ex: The removal of the old tree made the yard bigger.
words.ex_cn: 移除那棵老树让院子变大了。
words.en: The act of removing something or someone from a place or position.

words.ex: He drives a red van to work.
words.ex_cn: 他开一辆红色的货车去上班。
words.en: A van is a road vehicle used for transporting goods or people, usually larger than a car but smaller than a truck.

words.ex: Don't bother to clean the room, I'll do it later.
words.ex_cn: 别麻烦去打扫房间了，我稍后会做。
words.en: To bother someone means to cause them trouble or to annoy them.

words.tr: phrase. 抓住；掌握；得到；找到某人
words.ex: He tried to get hold of the rope.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抓住那根绳子。
words.en: To obtain something or to contact someone.

words.tr:
adv. 好；对；满意地；
int. （用于表示惊讶，疑虑，接受等）好；
n. 井；
adj. 健康的；
words.ex: She sings well.
words.ex_cn: 她唱得很好。
words.en: In a good or satisfactory manner; in a thorough manner; in a manner that is appropriate or suitable.

words.tr:
v. 注册；登记；
n. 登记簿；
words.ex: He will register for the course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会注册这门课程。
words.en: If you register something, you officially record it or list it.

words.tr:
n. 练习；实践；惯常做法；
v. 从事；练习；
words.ex: Daily practice helps you improve your skills.
words.ex_cn: 每天的练习帮助你提高技能。
words.en: Practice is the act of rehearsing a behavior over and over, or engaging in an activity again and again, for the purpose of improving or mastering it, as in the phrase 'practice makes perfect'.

words.ex: He visits his general practitioner for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 他去看全科医生做体检。
words.en: A general practitioner is a doctor who does not specialize in one particular area of medicine, but who has a medical practice in which he or she treats all types of illness.

words.tr: phrase. 富裕的；境况良好的
words.ex: They are well off because they own a big house and a car.
words.ex_cn: 他们很富裕，因为他们有一栋大房子和一辆车。
words.en: Having a lot of money or owning a lot of things.

words.ex: The comparison of the two phones helped me decide.
words.ex_cn: 对这两部手机的比较帮助我做出了决定。
words.en: When you make a comparison, you consider two or more things and discover the differences or similarities between them.

words.ex: He runs fast, in comparison with his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，与他哥哥相比。
words.en: Used to say that something is being considered in relation to something else, especially to show how they are different or similar.

words.tr: adj. 老式的；老派的；守旧的
words.ex: He wears an old-fashioned hat.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着一顶过时的帽子。
words.en: If you describe something as old-fashioned, you mean that it is no longer modern, current, or fashionable.

words.tr: adj. 正确的；合适的；正当的；
words.ex: This is the proper way to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是解决这个问题的正确方法。
words.en: If something is proper, it is suitable or correct for a particular purpose, situation, or person.

words.ex: I have an appointment with my doctor at 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我下午三点有个医生的约会。
words.en: An appointment is a formal arrangement to meet or visit someone at a particular time, especially for a purpose connected with their work or official position.

words.tr: phrase. 预约系统；预约制度
words.ex: The hospital uses an appointment system to help patients.
words.ex_cn: 医院使用预约系统来帮助病人。
words.en: A method or process for scheduling and managing appointments, especially in a professional or medical setting.

words.ex: I will make an appointment with the doctor tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天要预约医生。
words.en: To arrange a meeting or consultation at a specific time.

words.ex: The receptionist greeted the visitors with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 接待员微笑着迎接了访客。
words.en: A receptionist is a person whose job is to deal with people arriving at or telephoning a hotel, office building, doctor's surgery, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 填（写）； 填满；替代
words.ex: Please fill in the blanks with the correct words.
words.ex_cn: 请用正确的单词填空。
words.en: If you fill in a form or other document requesting information, you write information in the spaces on it.

words.tr: adj. 卓越的；极好的；明亮的；灿烂的；
words.ex: He gave a brilliant answer to the math question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这道数学题给出了卓越的回答。
words.en: A brilliant person, idea, or performance is extremely clever or skilful.

words.ex: He used to play soccer every day.
words.ex_cn: 他过去每天踢足球。
words.en: If something used to be done or used to be the case, it was done regularly in the past or was the case in the past.

words.ex: Children tend to be more active in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 孩子往往在早上更活跃。
words.en: If someone tends to do something, they usually do it or they often do it.

words.tr: phrase. 接诊病人；为患者看病
words.ex: The doctor will see patients in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 医生将在早上接诊病人。
words.en: To treat or provide medical care to patients.

words.ex: He is impatient when he waits for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他等公交车时很不耐烦。
words.en: If you are impatient, you are easily annoyed by delays or by people making mistakes.
