words.en: A ceremonial dress is a formal outfit worn on special occasions or ceremonies.

words.tr: phrase. 良好的利润率；指企业销售收入减去成本后所得利润占收入的比例较高，反映盈利能力强
words.ex: The company has a good profit margin due to its efficient operations.
words.ex_cn: 由于运营高效，该公司拥有良好的利润率。
words.en: A satisfactory level of financial return on sales or investment.

words.tr: phrase. 过时的；不再流行的；落伍的
words.ex: Those shoes are out of fashion now.
words.ex_cn: 那些鞋子现在不流行了。
words.en: No longer fashionable or popular.

words.tr:
v. 隐藏；躲藏；
n. 兽皮；
words.ex: He hides the key under the mat.
words.ex_cn: 他把钥匙藏在垫子下面。
words.en: To conceal something or someone from view or discovery.

words.tr: phrase. 平方米：一个标准的面积单位，等于一边长为一米的正方形的面积（即一个面积为一平方米的正方形）。
words.ex: The room is 20 square metres in size.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的面积是20平方米。
words.en: A square metre is a unit of area measurement equal to a square measuring one metre on each side.

words.ex: He bought a leather jacket for winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天买了一件皮夹克。
words.en: Leather is a material made from the skin of an animal by tanning or a similar process.

words.tr: adj. 精致的；微妙的；易碎的；脆弱的；
words.ex: She wore a delicate lace dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条精致的蕾丝连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is delicate is small and beautifully shaped. It can also be easily broken or damaged.

words.ex: The bag is made of good quality leather.
words.ex_cn: 这个包是由优质皮革制成的。
words.en: Leather of high standard or superior condition.

words.tr:
n. 东西；原料；
v. 塞；填充；
words.ex: I need to clean up all this stuff.
words.ex_cn: 我需要清理这些东西。
words.en: If you stuff something somewhere, you push it there quickly and roughly. If you stuff a container or space with something, you fill it completely with that thing.

words.ex: He packed some biltong for the long journey.
words.ex_cn: 他为长途旅行打包了一些干肉条。
words.en: Biltong is a form of dried, cured meat that originated in Southern African countries. It is typically made from beef or game meats, and is similar to beef jerky.

words.ex: I recognize her face from school.
words.ex_cn: 我从学校认出了她的脸。
words.en: If you recognize someone or something, you know who or what they are because you have seen or heard them before.

words.ex: He eats eggs for protein.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋来获取蛋白质。
words.en: Proteins are large, complex molecules that play many critical roles in the body. They are necessary for the structure, function, and regulation of the body's tissues and organs.

words.tr: phrase. 脂肪和胆固醇含量低的
words.ex: This diet is low in fats and cholesterol, making it heart-healthy.
words.ex_cn: 这种饮食低脂肪和低胆固醇，使其对心脏健康有益。
words.en: Containing minimal amounts of fats and cholesterol, often used to describe foods or diets that are beneficial for heart health.

words.ex: The butcher expertly carved the hindquarter of the lamb.
words.ex_cn: 屠夫熟练地切开了羊的后腿及臀部。
words.en: The rear part of a side of beef, lamb, etc., including the leg and loin.

words.ex: This food is high in protein and low in fat.
words.ex_cn: 这种食物蛋白质含量高，脂肪含量低。
words.en: Containing a large amount of protein.

words.ex: He will embark on a new journey next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将开始一段新的旅程。
words.en: To start or begin something, especially something new, challenging, or exciting.

words.tr:
adj. 成熟的；
v. 成熟；
words.ex: He is a mature student who works full-time.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位成熟的学生，全职工作。
words.en: When something or someone matures, they become fully grown or developed. In finance, a mature investment is one that has reached the end of its term and is ready to be paid out.

words.tr: adj. 已受精的；使肥沃（fertilize 的过去式与过去分词）；
words.ex: The fertilized egg will grow into a baby.
words.ex_cn: 已受精的卵子会发育成婴儿。
words.en: Something that is fertilized has had a substance added to it to help plants or crops grow, or has had sperm introduced to an egg to start the process of reproduction.

words.tr:
n. 首都；财富；大写字母；
adj. 大写的；
words.ex: Beijing is the capital of China.
words.ex_cn: 北京是中国的首都。
words.en: The city or town that functions as the seat of government and administrative center of a country or region.

words.tr: n. 孵卵器；育婴箱；培养的器具
words.ex: The eggs are kept in an incubator to hatch.
words.ex_cn: 鸡蛋放在孵卵器里孵化。
words.en: An incubator is a piece of hospital equipment which helps weak or small babies to survive. It consists of a transparent container in which the oxygen supply, temperature, and humidity can be controlled.

words.tr:
adj. 依靠的；依赖的；
n. 受赡养者；
words.ex: The child is dependent on his parents for food.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子依靠父母提供食物。
words.en: A dependent person or thing is one that needs the support of another person or thing in order to exist or be successful.

words.ex: She hired a minder to look after her children while she was at work.
words.ex_cn: 她在工作时雇了一个照顾者来照看她的孩子。
words.en: A minder is a person whose job is to look after someone or something.

words.ex: He studied the problem intensively.
words.ex_cn: 他集中地研究了这个问题。
words.en: In a way that involves a lot of effort or activity in a short period of time.

words.ex: The farmer feeds the calf every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂小牛。
words.en: A calf is a young cow or bull. It can also refer to the fleshy part of the back of the human leg below the knee.

words.ex: The bird hatched her eggs after three weeks.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟在三周后孵出了她的蛋。
words.en: To hatch means to cause an egg to break open so that a young animal can come out, or to plan secretly with other people to do something bad or illegal.

words.ex: Mother's milk nourishes the baby.
words.ex_cn: 母乳滋养婴儿。
words.en: To nourish someone or something means to provide them with the food and other substances they need in order to live, grow, and be healthy.

words.tr: adj. 滋养的；养育( nourish的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The nourished plants grew tall and strong.
words.ex_cn: 这些得到滋养的植物长得又高又壮。
words.en: If someone is nourished, they are provided with the food and other substances that are necessary for life, growth, and good health.

words.tr:
adj. 最初的；开始的；
n. 首字母；
words.ex: This is the initial plan for the project.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个项目的最初计划。
words.en: The first letter of a name or word, used to represent the whole name or word.

words.ex: The outlay for the new computer was high.
words.ex_cn: 这台新电脑的花费很高。
words.en: An outlay is an amount of money that you have to spend in order to buy something or to start a project.

words.tr:
n. 输出；出口；
v. 输出；出口；
words.ex: This country is a big export of wheat.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家是小麦的大输出国。
words.en: To send goods to another country for sale.

words.ex: She looks after her little brother every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天照顾她的弟弟。
words.en: To take care of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 在农业上很有意义；符合良好的农耕常识；对耕作而言是明智之举
words.ex: It makes good farming sense to plant crops in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天种庄稼是符合农耕道理的。
words.en: To be a sensible or logical approach in the context of farming or agriculture.

chapters.name: 真题解析3 T4 S1 礼物选择——庆祝婴儿诞生

words.ex: He noticed every detail of the painting.
words.ex_cn: 他注意到了这幅画的每一个细节。
words.en: A detail is a small individual feature or element of something.

words.ex: The doctor will weigh the baby at the clinic.
words.ex_cn: 医生将在诊所称量婴儿的体重。
words.en: To weigh something means to measure how heavy it is, usually by using scales. It can also mean to consider something carefully before making a decision.

words.ex: He bought two kilos of apples.
words.ex_cn: 他买了两公斤苹果。
words.en: A kilo is a unit of measurement equal to 1,000 grams or approximately 2.2 pounds. It is commonly used to measure weight.

words.ex: The pencil is 15 centimetres long.
words.ex_cn: 这支铅笔长15厘米。
words.en: A centimetre is a unit of length in the metric system equal to one hundredth of a metre.

words.tr:
adj. 大规模的；大量的；
n. 大量；质量；块；群；团；
words.ex: The company launched a mass production line to meet demand.
words.ex_cn: 该公司启动了大规模生产线以满足需求。
words.en: A mass is a large amount of something that has no particular shape or arrangement.

words.ex: She had curly black hair that cascaded down her back.
words.ex_cn: 她有一头卷曲的黑发，垂落在背后。
words.en: Curly black hair refers to hair that is both curly in texture and black in color.

words.tr: phrase. 捡起；获得；接人；恢复精神；偶然学到；加速；逮住
words.ex: He picked up the pen from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起了钢笔。
words.en: If you pick something up, you lift it up from a surface. If you pick someone up, you go to the place where they are and take them away, often in a car. If you pick up a skill or an idea, you acquire it without formal teaching or training. If something picks up, it improves or increases after a period of inactivity or decline.

words.tr: v. 使恢复精力；使复原；使变新
words.ex: A short nap can refresh you.
words.ex_cn: 小睡一会儿能让你恢复精力。
words.en: To refresh someone means to make them feel less tired or less hot.

words.ex: He parked his car in the garage.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在了车库里。
words.en: A garage is a building where you keep a car. It can also refer to a place where cars are repaired.

words.tr:
adj. 最后的；最近的；
v. 持续；
adv. 最后；最近一次；
words.ex: This is the last chance to pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 这是通过考试的最后机会。
words.en: Coming after all others in time or order; final.

words.tr: phrase. 盆栽植物；花盆里种植的植物
words.ex: She has a beautiful collection of pot plants in her living room.
words.ex_cn: 她在客厅里收藏了许多美丽的室内植物。
words.en: A pot plant is a plant that is grown in a pot rather than in the ground.

words.tr:
n. 水；
v. 给…浇水；给（某地）供水；
words.ex: She drinks water every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喝水。
words.en: Water is a clear thin liquid that has no colour or taste when it is pure. It falls from clouds as rain and enters rivers and seas. All animals and plants need water in order to live.

words.ex: She always uses baby shampoo because it's gentler on her hair.
words.ex_cn: 她总是使用婴儿洗发水，因为它对头发更温和。
words.en: A type of shampoo specially formulated for babies, which is gentle on their skin and eyes.

words.tr: phrase. 滑石粉；爽身粉；扑粉
words.ex: She uses talcum powder to keep her skin dry.
words.ex_cn: 她使用滑石粉保持皮肤干燥。
words.en: A powder made from talc, used especially for making the skin feel dry or for reducing friction.

words.tr: phrase. 出生统计数据；有关出生率、出生人数、婴儿性别比等的统计资料
words.ex: The birth statistics show a steady increase in the number of births.
words.ex_cn: 出生统计数据显示出生人数稳步增加。
words.en: Birth statistics refer to the data and analysis related to the number of births in a particular population over a specific period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 泰迪熊（一种毛绒玩具熊）
words.ex: The child hugs a teddy bear every night.
words.ex_cn: 孩子每天晚上都抱着一个泰迪熊。
words.en: A teddy bear is a soft toy bear, usually made of fabric and stuffed with cotton or similar material, often given to children as a comforting object.

words.ex: The child hugs a soft toy every night.
words.ex_cn: 孩子每天晚上都抱着一个毛绒玩具。
words.en: A soft toy is a children's toy made of fabric stuffed with a soft material, often resembling an animal or a character.

chapters.name: 真题解析3 T4 S2 电视导购——家用器具

words.ex: The museum held an exhibition of ancient art.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆举办了一场古代艺术展览。
words.en: An exhibition is a public display of works of art or items of interest, often held in a museum or art gallery.

words.tr: phrase. 家用小器具；家庭常用的小型设备
words.ex: A new household gadget that helps with cleaning the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 一种有助于清洁厨房的新型家用小器具。
words.en: A household gadget is a small tool or device that is used in the home to perform a specific task, often related to cooking, cleaning, or maintenance.

words.tr: phrase. 常驻专家；长期驻留的权威人士
words.ex: The company hired a resident expert to guide their new product development.
words.ex_cn: 公司聘请了一位常驻专家来指导新产品开发。
words.en: A resident expert is someone who has a deep knowledge or skill in a particular area and is often available to provide advice or information on that subject.

words.ex: The police will investigate the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方将调查这起事故。
words.en: If someone, especially an official, investigates an event, situation, or claim, they try to find out what happened or what is the truth.

words.tr:
n. 家庭；
adj. 家庭的；
words.ex: This household has three children.
words.ex_cn: 这个家庭有三个孩子。
words.en: A household is all the people in a family or group who live together in a house.

words.tr: adj. 现实的；现实主义的；
words.ex: He made a realistic plan to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个现实的存钱计划。
words.en: If you are realistic about a situation, you recognize and accept its true nature and try to deal with it in a practical way.

words.tr: phrase. 不含玻璃；不包含玻璃成分
words.ex: The packaging is designed to contain no glass, ensuring safety during transportation.
words.ex_cn: 这种包装设计为不包含玻璃，确保运输过程中的安全。
words.en: To not include any glass as an ingredient or component.

words.ex: It rained all day, therefore the game was canceled.
words.ex_cn: 下了一整天的雨，因此比赛被取消了。
words.en: You use therefore to introduce a logical result or conclusion.

words.ex: This glass is unbreakable.
words.ex_cn: 这种玻璃不易破损。
words.en: If something is unbreakable, it cannot be broken or damaged.

words.tr:
n. 意图；目的；
adj. 专注的；
words.ex: His intent was to help, not to hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他的意图是帮助，而不是伤害。
words.en: If you are intent on doing something, you are determined to get it done. If you have an intent to do something, you have a plan or purpose in mind.

words.ex: His purpose is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的目的是帮助别人。
words.en: The reason for which something is done or created or for which something exists.

words.ex: He bought a spoon made of stainless steel.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个不锈钢勺子。
words.en: A type of steel that contains a large proportion of chromium, making it resistant to rust and corrosion.

words.ex: Unfortunately, he missed the bus.
words.ex_cn: 不幸的是，他错过了公交车。
words.en: Used to say that something is sad, disappointing, or has a bad effect.

words.ex: The teacher gave me a recommendation for the scholarship.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我写了一封奖学金推荐信。
words.en: A suggestion or proposal as to the best course of action, especially one put forward by an authoritative body.

words.tr: adj. 整洁时髦的；设计精妙的
words.ex: He wears a natty suit to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿一件时髦的西装去上班。
words.en: If you describe someone as natty, you mean that their clothes are smart and fashionable.

words.ex: He bought a new device to take photos.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个新设备来拍照。
words.en: A device is an object or machine that has been invented for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He blew a whistle to get our attention.
words.ex_cn: 他吹了一声口哨来引起我们的注意。
words.en: A whistle is a small metal tube which you blow in order to produce a loud sound and attract someone's attention. A whistle is also the sound that you make when you blow a whistle or when you whistle.

words.tr: n. 持有者；拥有者；支架
words.ex: The holder of the ticket won a prize.
words.ex_cn: 票的持有者中了奖。
words.en: A holder is a person or thing that holds something.

words.ex: He basically just wants to be left alone.
words.ex_cn: 他基本上只是想一个人待着。
words.en: You use basically to indicate that you are stating a fact or opinion in a simple, clear, or definite way.

words.tr:
n. 音高；球场；程度（最高点）；宣传论点；
v. 扎营；
words.ex: The singer changed the pitch of her voice.
words.ex_cn: 歌手改变了她声音的音高。
words.en: Pitch can refer to the highness or lowness of a sound, the act of throwing something, or a thick, black, sticky substance used for paving roads or waterproofing.

words.tr:
n. 闪光；一刹那；
v. 闪光；闪现；
words.ex: The camera captured a sudden flash of light.
words.ex_cn: 相机捕捉到了一道突然的闪光。
words.en: A flash is a sudden bright light that quickly disappears. As a verb, it means to shine brightly for a short time or to appear or pass suddenly.

words.tr:
n. 新闻界；出版社；
v. 按；压；
words.ex: The press reported the news quickly.
words.ex_cn: 新闻界迅速报道了这则新闻。
words.en: To press something is to push it firmly, often with your fingers or hand, in order to operate a device or machine, or to make something flat or smooth. It can also mean to urge someone to do something or to make a strong demand for something.

words.ex: She sewed a button on her coat.
words.ex_cn: 她把一颗纽扣缝在了外套上。
words.en: A button is a small, usually round object that you press to operate a device or a machine, or a small, round object that you fasten to clothing to keep it closed.

words.ex: He looked through the keyhole to see who was outside.
words.ex_cn: 他通过锁孔往外看，想知道谁在外面。
words.en: A keyhole is the hole in a lock that you put a key in to lock or unlock it.

words.ex: The smell was unpleasant.
words.ex_cn: 这气味令人不快。
words.en: If something is unpleasant, it gives you bad feelings, for example, by making you feel upset or uncomfortable.

words.ex: He found a piece of metal in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园里发现了一块金属。
words.en: Metal is a hard, shiny substance such as iron, gold, or steel.

words.ex: She put a cushion on the chair to make it comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 她在椅子上放了一个靠垫，让它更舒服。
words.en: A cushion is a soft bag of some ornamental material, stuffed with wool, hair, feathers, polyester staple fiber, non-woven material, or even paper torn into fragments. It may be used for sitting or kneeling upon, or to soften the hardness or angularity of a chair or couch.

words.ex: The painting is considered a masterpiece by art critics.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画被艺术评论家视为杰作。
words.en: A masterpiece is a work of art such as a painting, film, or book that is made with great skill and is considered to be the best work of a particular artist or writer.

words.ex: He bought a new gizmo to fix his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个新小装置来修他的手机。
words.en: A gizmo is a small device or tool, especially one whose name you do not know or cannot remember.

words.ex: He squeezed into the small seat.
words.ex_cn: 他挤进了小座位里。
words.en: To squeeze something means to press it firmly, usually with your fingers or hands, often to get liquid out of it or to make it smaller.

words.tr:
v. 处理；操纵；
n. 把手；柄；
words.ex: He can handle difficult problems easily.
words.ex_cn: 他能轻松处理难题。
words.en: To deal with or control a situation or problem.

words.ex: The wind generates electricity.
words.ex_cn: 风产生电力。
words.en: To generate something means to cause it to begin and develop.

words.tr:
adj. 客观的；
n. 目标；目的；
words.ex: He gave an objective opinion about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他对这部电影给出了一个客观的看法。
words.en: An objective is something that you plan to do or achieve.

words.tr:
n. 诱饵；（诱捕鸟兽的）动物
v. 引诱
words.ex: The hunter used a decoy to attract ducks.
words.ex_cn: 猎人用假鸭子来吸引鸭子。
words.en: A decoy is a person, thing, or action that is used to trick someone into doing something or going somewhere, especially by making them think they are going to get something they want.

words.tr:
v. 伪造；假装；冒充；
adj. 假的；冒充的；伪造的；
words.ex: He faked a signature to get the money.
words.ex_cn: 他伪造了一个签名来拿到钱。
words.en: If something is fake, it is not real, genuine, or true, but is made to appear so.

words.ex: The loud noise scared the child.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音吓到了孩子。
words.en: If something scares you, it frightens or worries you.

words.ex: The burglar broke into the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 窃贼在夜里闯入了房子。
words.en: A burglar is a person who illegally enters buildings and steals things.

words.ex: The police caught the man after the burglary.
words.ex_cn: 警察在盗窃后抓住了那个男人。
words.en: Burglary is the crime of illegally entering a building and stealing things.

words.ex: He drinks hot water from a vacuum flask.
words.ex_cn: 他从保温瓶里喝热水。
words.en: A vacuum flask is a container which is used to keep hot drinks hot and cold drinks cold. It has double walls with a vacuum between them, which prevents heat from passing through.

words.tr: 短语动词. 发出微弱的光；散发出暗淡的光线
words.ex: The star gives off a weak light.
words.ex_cn: 这颗星星发出微弱的光。
words.en: To emit a low-intensity glow.

words.tr:
v. 保证；确保；
n. 保证；保证书；
words.ex: The store guarantees a refund if you are not happy.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不满意，商店保证退款。
words.en: A guarantee is a formal promise that certain conditions will be fulfilled, especially that a product will be repaired or replaced if it is not of a specified quality.

words.tr: phrase. 维持热量；保持温度
words.ex: The insulation helps to maintain heat in the house during winter.
words.ex_cn: 隔热材料有助于在冬季保持房屋内的热量。
words.en: To preserve or keep a certain level of warmth.

words.tr:
n. 制造；
v. （用机器大量）制造；虚构；捏造；
words.ex: The manufacture of cars needs many workers.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的制造需要很多工人。
words.en: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory, usually in large quantities.

words.tr: phrase. 在不利的一面；缺点在于
words.ex: On the downside, the project requires a lot of initial investment.
words.ex_cn: 缺点是，这个项目需要大量的初期投资。
words.en: Used to introduce a negative aspect or disadvantage of something.

words.tr: phrase. 不好的方面；不利的地位
words.ex: His math skills are on the weaker side.
words.ex_cn: 他的数学能力是不好的方面。
words.en: Phrase. Indicating that something is leaning towards being weaker or less strong in comparison.

words.ex: Children enjoy outdoor activities like running and climbing.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢户外活动，比如跑步和攀爬。
words.en: Activities that take place in the open air, outside of buildings.

words.tr: phrase. 大众科学；科普；面向大众的科学传播
words.ex: The magazine is a popular science publication that simplifies complex scientific concepts for the general public.
words.ex_cn: 这本杂志是一本科普出版物，它简化了复杂的科学概念，以便普通大众理解。
words.en: Popular science is a genre of broadcasting or writing which aims to make scientific knowledge accessible and interesting to the general public.

words.ex: He will sort out his books tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会整理好他的书。
words.en: To sort something out means to organize or arrange it, or to solve a problem or difficulty.

words.tr:
adv. 在水下；
adj. 水下的；
words.ex: The divers swam underwater to explore the coral reef.
words.ex_cn: 潜水员在水下游泳以探索珊瑚礁。
words.en: Located, occurring, or used beneath the surface of the water.

chapters.name: 真题解析3 T4 S3 课外研讨——论文撰写与修改

words.ex: The faculty of engineering has many labs.
words.ex_cn: 工程学院有许多实验室。
words.en: A faculty is a group of departments in a university or college that specialize in a particular subject or group of subjects, or the teachers in such a group.

words.tr: adj. 焦虑的；渴望的；担忧的；
words.ex: He feels anxious before every test.
words.ex_cn: 他每次考试前都感到焦虑。
words.en: If you are anxious to do something or anxious that something should happen, you very much want to do it or very much want it to happen.

words.ex: He read the first chapter of the book.
words.ex_cn: 他读了这本书的第一章。
words.en: A chapter is one of the parts that a book is divided into. Each chapter has a number, and sometimes a title.

words.tr: phrase. 引人注目；突出；出色
words.ex: Her red hat makes her stand out in the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 她的红帽子让她在人群中很显眼。
words.en: To be very noticeable or obvious, especially in comparison to others.

words.tr: adj. 令人惊异的；令人惊叹的； v. “amaze”的现在分词；
words.ex: The view from the mountain is amazing.
words.ex_cn: 从山上看到的景色令人惊异。
words.en: If something is amazing, it is very surprising and makes you feel pleasure or admiration.

words.ex: Add a dash of salt to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 给汤里加一点盐。
words.en: If you dash somewhere, you run or go there quickly and suddenly. A dash is a straight, horizontal line used in writing, for example to separate two main clauses whose meanings are closely connected.

words.tr:
n. 一双；一对；
v. （使）配对；
words.ex: He bought a pair of shoes for his son.
words.ex_cn: 他为儿子买了一双鞋。
words.en: A pair of things are two things of the same size and shape that are intended to be used together, or that are regarded as a unit.

words.ex: The division of the cake was fair.
words.ex_cn: 蛋糕的划分是公平的。
words.en: The act or process of dividing something into parts or the state of being divided.

words.tr: v. 朝向；前进；“head”的现在分词； n. 标题；
words.ex: The ship is heading north.
words.ex_cn: 船正朝北航行。
words.en: A heading is a word, phrase, or sentence at the beginning of a written passage that explains what it's about.

words.tr: n. 差额；边缘；净利润；余地；
words.ex: The profit margin is five dollars.
words.ex_cn: 利润差额是五美元。
words.en: The margin is the edge or border of something, or the difference between two amounts, especially the difference between the cost of producing something and the price it is sold for.

words.ex: This information is relevant to our project.
words.ex_cn: 这些信息与我们的项目相关。
words.en: Something that is relevant to a situation or person is important or significant in that situation or to that person.

words.ex: This topic is relevant to our project.
words.ex_cn: 这个话题与我们的项目相关。
words.en: To be connected with what is happening or being discussed.

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.tr: adj. 有价值的；贵重的；值钱的；
words.ex: This old book is valuable to historians.
words.ex_cn: 这本旧书对历史学家来说很有价值。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as valuable, you mean that they are very useful and helpful.

words.tr:
adj. 复杂的；
n. 综合楼（群）；
words.ex: The instructions are too complex for children.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明对孩子来说太复杂了。
words.en: Something that is complex has many different parts, and is therefore often difficult to understand.

words.tr: n. 年代学；年表；按年代次序的排列
words.ex: He wrote the chronology of ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他写了古罗马的年代顺序。
words.en: Chronology is the arrangement of events or dates in the order of their occurrence.

words.ex: His answer was too simplistic.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答太简单化了。
words.en: If you describe something as simplistic, you disapprove of it because it is so simple that it ignores important details or difficulties.

words.tr: v. 代表；表现；体现；相当于；
words.ex: He represents his country in the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中代表他的国家。
words.en: If someone represents a person or group of people, they act on behalf of that person or group.

words.ex: He is doing proofreading for his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为他的文章做校对。
words.en: Proofreading is the activity of finding and correcting mistakes in text before it is printed or put online.

words.ex: The document was laser-printed with high precision.
words.ex_cn: 这份文件是用激光打印机以高精度打印的。
words.en: Printed using a laser printer.

words.tr: phrase. 教职员工办公室；教师办公室
words.ex: She went to the faculty office to ask for help.
words.ex_cn: 她去教员办公室寻求帮助。
words.en: A room or set of rooms in a school or college where teachers work and meet students.

words.ex: He wrote a draft of the letter before sending it.
words.ex_cn: 他在发送之前写了这封信的草稿。
words.en: A draft is a preliminary version of a piece of writing, or a current of air in a room or other confined space. It can also refer to the act of selecting someone for a particular purpose or task, especially in sports or the military.

words.ex: Choosing to study abroad was a better choice for his career development.
words.ex_cn: 选择出国留学对他的职业发展是一个更好的选择。
words.en: A better choice refers to an option that is superior to others in terms of quality, suitability, or effectiveness.

words.tr: phrase. 广泛的划分；大致的分类
words.ex: The data was organized into broad divisions based on geographical regions.
words.ex_cn: 数据根据地理区域被划分为广泛的类别。
words.en: The term 'broad divisions' refers to the major or general categories or sections into which something is divided.

words.tr: phrase. 注销；勾销；认为…无用或失败；撞毁（车辆等）
words.ex: The company decided to write off the old debt.
words.ex_cn: 公司决定核销这笔旧债务。
words.en: To write off something, especially a debt or an asset, means to remove it from your financial records because you no longer expect to receive payment for it or because it is no longer valuable.

words.tr: 短语动词. 进行一般性研究；开展广泛的调查或研究工作
words.ex: Before starting the project, it's important to do general research to understand the market.
words.ex_cn: 在开始项目之前，进行一般性研究以了解市场是很重要的。
words.en: To conduct research on a broad or unspecified topic.

words.tr: phrase. 在页边空白处；在边缘；在空白边缘做批注
words.ex: He wrote a note in the margin.
words.ex_cn: 他在页边写了一个注释。
words.en: In the narrow space beside the main text on a page, often used for notes or comments.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 在边缘；在页边空白处；处于社会边缘；以微弱优势
words.ex: He lives on the margin of the city.
words.ex_cn: 他住在城市的边缘。
words.en: At the edge or border of something; barely.

words.tr: n. 住房供给； v. 收容；“house”的现在分词；
words.ex: The city needs more housing for low-income families.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市需要为低收入家庭提供更多的住房供给。
words.en: Housing refers to buildings or other shelters in which people live; a place to live.

words.tr:
n. 面试；访谈；
v. 面试；接见；
words.ex: He has an interview tomorrow for a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他明天有一场新工作的面试。
words.en: An interview is a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out if they are suitable for a job or a course of study.

words.tr: phrase. 保持不变；维持原状
words.ex: The temperature must keep unchanged during the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 在实验过程中，温度必须保持不变。
words.en: To remain in the same state or condition without alteration.

words.tr: phrase. 本地住房；地方住宅供应
words.ex: The government has introduced new policies to improve local housing conditions.
words.ex_cn: 政府已经引入了新政策来改善当地住房条件。
words.en: Local housing refers to residential buildings and accommodations within a specific area or community.

words.tr: phrase. 做出改变；进行变更；带来变化
words.ex: He wants to make a change in his life.
words.ex_cn: 他想在生活中做出改变。
words.en: To alter or modify something, often to improve it or adapt to new circumstances.

words.tr: phrase. 提出一些建议；给些建议
words.ex: You should make some suggestions if you have any ideas.
words.ex_cn: 如果你有任何想法，你应该提出一些建议。
words.en: To offer ideas or proposals for consideration, typically in a constructive manner.

words.tr: phrase. 使数据清晰；把数据整理清楚；让数据易于理解
words.ex: He used charts to make the data clear.
words.ex_cn: 他使用图表使数据清晰。
words.en: To present information or facts in a way that is easy to understand and interpret.

words.ex: The villagers rely on the open well for their daily water supply.
words.ex_cn: 村民们依靠开口井获取日常用水。
words.en: To function or perform effectively from the start, without issues or difficulties.

words.ex: He revised his answer to make it correct.
words.ex_cn: 他修正了他的答案，使其正确。
words.en: To revise something means to alter or amend it, especially in order to correct or improve it.

words.ex: He had to rewrite his essay after the teacher gave feedback.
words.ex_cn: 他在老师给出反馈后不得不重写他的作文。
words.en: If someone rewrites a piece of writing such as a book, an article, or a law, they write it in a different way in order to improve it or because circumstances have changed.

words.ex: He starts with math problems every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上从数学题开始。
words.en: To begin with or include something as a preliminary part or element.

words.tr: phrase. 辅导支持教师；提供学业或心理支持的导师
words.ex: My support tutor helps me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的辅导老师帮我做作业。
words.en: A person who provides academic assistance and guidance to students, often in a specialized subject.

words.ex: They are equals in skill; there is no par between them.
words.ex_cn: 他们在技能上是平等的；他们之间没有高低之分。
words.en: Par refers to the standard or average condition or degree, or the face value of a stock or bond.

chapters.name: 真题解析3 T4 S4 学术讲座——关于噪音污染

words.tr: adj. 环境的；有关环境的；
words.ex: The government is protecting the environmental balance.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在保护环境平衡。
words.en: Relating to the natural world and the impact of human activity on its condition.

words.tr: n. 影响；作用；效果；效应；
words.ex: The new law had a big effect on traffic.
words.ex_cn: 新法律对交通产生了很大影响。
words.en: A change that is a result or consequence of an action or other cause.

words.ex: The old estate has large gardens and a beautiful mansion.
words.ex_cn: 这个古老的庄园有大片花园和一座美丽的豪宅。
words.en: An estate is all the money and property that someone owns, especially everything that is left when they die.

words.ex: I like fruits, particularly apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: Used to single out a subject to which a statement is especially applicable.

words.ex: The car drove fast on the highway.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在高速公路上开得很快。
words.en: A highway is a main road, especially one that connects towns or cities.

words.ex: I am somewhat tired after work.
words.ex_cn: 下班后我有点累。
words.en: You use somewhat to indicate that something is the case to a limited extent or degree.

words.ex: The wind began to abate after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴过后，风开始减弱。
words.en: If something bad or undesirable abates, it becomes much less strong or severe.

words.ex: The extent of his knowledge surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的知识广度让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The area or length to which something extends.

words.ex: The modification improved the design.
words.ex_cn: 这个修改改进了设计。
words.en: A modification is a change or alteration made to something to improve it or to make it suitable for a different purpose.

words.tr: adj. 重大的；重要的；影响明显的；
words.ex: This discovery is a significant step forward.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现是一个重大的进步。
words.en: Something that is significant is important or large enough to be noticed or to have an effect.

words.ex: The developer built a new apartment complex.
words.ex_cn: 这家开发商建造了一座新的公寓楼。
words.en: A developer is a person or a company that develops software, websites, or applications, or that builds houses or other structures on land.

words.tr: 表示即将做某事，用于描述马上要发生的动作，后接动词原形
words.ex: He is about to leave the house.
words.ex_cn: 他正要离开家。
words.en: If you are about to do something, you are going to do it very soon.

words.tr:
n. 轮廓；纲要；
v. 描画轮廓；概述；
words.ex: The artist drew the outline of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家画出了山的轮廓。
words.en: An outline is a line that shows or forms the outer edge of something, or a general description or plan showing the essential features of something but not the detail.

words.tr: adj. 值得拥有的；令人渴望的；称心如意的；
words.ex: A quiet neighborhood is desirable for families.
words.ex_cn: 安静的社区对家庭来说是值得拥有的。
words.en: Something that is desirable is worth having or doing because it is useful, necessary, or popular.

words.ex: He changed his job because of his background.
words.ex_cn: 他因为自己的背景换了工作。
words.en: The background is the situation that exists at a particular time, or the situation in which something happens, which helps to explain it.

words.ex: He propose to go to the park after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提议午饭后去公园。
words.en: If you propose something, you suggest it as a plan or course of action.

words.ex: The fence marks the perimeter of the garden.
words.ex_cn: 围栏标出了花园的边界。
words.en: The perimeter of an area or object is the total length of its sides or outer boundary.

words.tr: phrase. 噪声阈值；噪音门槛；系统或人耳所能容忍的最低噪声水平
words.ex: The device automatically adjusts its noise threshold based on the ambient sound level.
words.ex_cn: 该设备根据环境声音水平自动调整其噪声阈值。
words.en: The level of noise that must be exceeded for a signal to be detected.

words.ex: The noise was 80 decibels.
words.ex_cn: 噪音是80分贝。
words.en: A decibel is a unit used to measure the intensity of a sound or the power level of an electrical signal by comparing it with a given level on a logarithmic scale.

words.ex: The construction of the new bridge took two years.
words.ex_cn: 新桥的建筑花了两年时间。
words.en: The process or method of building or making something, especially buildings, bridges, etc.

words.ex: He will modify the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会更改计划。
words.en: To change something slightly, especially in order to make it more suitable for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 专业双层玻璃窗；特制双层玻璃
words.ex: The building was fitted with specialized double glazing to improve energy efficiency.
words.ex_cn: 该建筑安装了专业双层玻璃窗以提高能源效率。
words.en: Windows or doors with two panes of glass separated by a sealed space, designed for superior insulation and noise reduction.

words.ex: He works in glazing, installing windows in buildings.
words.ex_cn: 他从事玻璃装配业，负责安装建筑物的窗户。
words.en: The process of fitting windows or doors with glass, or the material used in this process.

words.ex: The room has good acoustic properties.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有良好的声音效果。
words.en: Relating to sound or the sense of hearing.

words.ex: He sealed the envelope with glue.
words.ex_cn: 他用胶水把信封封上了。
words.en: A seal is a device or substance that is used to close off or fasten an opening or container, making it airtight or watertight. It can also refer to a marine mammal with flippers for swimming.

words.tr: phrase. 外墙；建筑物的外部墙体
words.ex: The exterior wall is painted white.
words.ex_cn: 外墙是白色的。
words.en: The outer wall of a building or structure.

words.ex: The door opens on a metal hinge.
words.ex_cn: 这扇门装在一个金属枢纽上。
words.en: A hinge is a piece of metal, wood, or plastic that is used to join two things together so that one of them can swing or move freely.

words.ex: The two houses are adjacent to each other.
words.ex_cn: 这两栋房子彼此相邻。
words.en: If one thing is adjacent to another, it is next to it or adjoining it.

words.ex: The density of water is 1 gram per cubic centimeter.
words.ex_cn: 水的密度是每立方厘米1克。
words.en: Density is a measure of how much mass is contained in a given unit volume of a substance.

words.tr: n. 交叉；相交；十字路口；交叉路口；
words.ex: The intersection of two roads is busy.
words.ex_cn: 两条路的交叉口很繁忙。
words.en: An intersection is a place where roads or other lines meet or cross.

words.ex: The ceiling is white and low.
words.ex_cn: 天花板是白色的，而且很低。
words.en: The ceiling is the upper interior surface of a room or other similar compartment.

words.tr:
n. 灰泥；
v. 涂以灰泥；敷以膏药；
words.ex: The wall was covered with white plaster.
words.ex_cn: 墙壁上覆盖着白色灰泥。
words.en: A substance applied to walls or ceilings to smooth or decorate them, or a medical dressing used to cover wounds.

words.tr: 石膏板：一种由石膏和软矿物等成分压缩在厚纸板之间制成的建筑材料，用于建筑物的墙壁和天花板。
words.ex: The walls were made of plaster board.
words.ex_cn: 这墙是用石膏板做的。
words.en: A type of board made from plaster, used in the construction of interior walls and ceilings.

words.ex: The mechanical toy moves with batteries.
words.ex_cn: 这个机械玩具用电池驱动。
words.en: Relating to machines or machinery; operated by or involving a machine or machines.

words.ex: The room has good ventilation through the windows.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间通过窗户有良好的通风。
words.en: The provision of fresh air to a room, building, etc., or the system that does this.

words.ex: He will install the new software on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他将在他的电脑上安装新软件。
words.en: To set up or fix in position for use or service.

words.ex: The car has a special absorber to reduce shock.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有一个特殊的吸收体来减少震动。
words.en: An absorber is a device or material that takes in and reduces the intensity of something, such as energy, sound, or shock.

words.ex: The room has air conditioning to keep it cool.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有空调来保持凉爽。
words.en: Air conditioning is a system or process that controls the temperature, humidity, and sometimes the purity of the air in a building or vehicle.

words.ex: The new policy substantially improved the results.
words.ex_cn: 新政策实质上改善了结果。
words.en: To a great extent or degree; considerably.

words.ex: The bug is five millimeters long.
words.ex_cn: 这只虫子五毫米长。
words.en: A unit of length equal to one thousandth of a meter.

words.ex: The window has a broken pane.
words.ex_cn: 这扇窗户有一块碎了的玻璃。
words.en: A pane is a piece of glass that is fitted into a window or door.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；基本的；本质的；
words.ex: Water is essential for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必需的。
words.en: Something that is essential is extremely important or absolutely necessary to a particular subject, situation, or activity.

words.tr:
n. 最小值；
adj. 最小量的；
words.ex: The minimum of the function is 5.
words.ex_cn: 这个函数的最小值是5。
words.en: The minimum is the smallest or least amount possible or allowed.

words.ex: We must take the weather into account when planning the picnic.
words.ex_cn: 计划野餐时，我们必须把天气考虑进去。
words.en: If you take something into account, you consider it when you are thinking about a situation or deciding what to do.

words.tr: phrase. 房屋的布局；住宅的平面布置
words.ex: The layout of the house is very spacious and open.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的布局非常宽敞和开放。
words.en: The arrangement or organization of rooms and spaces within a residential building.

words.tr:
n. 大楼；大厦；块；街区；障碍物；
v. 阻塞；阻碍；
words.ex: The new block is next to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这栋新大楼就在公园旁边。
words.en: A block is a large solid piece of material with flat surfaces on each side. As a verb, to block means to prevent movement or progress.

words.ex: The house has good insulation to keep warm in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有良好的绝缘层以在冬天保暖。
words.en: Insulation is a material or substance that is used to stop heat, electricity, or sound from going from one place to another.

words.tr: phrase. 空气间隙；物理隔离（尤指在网络安全中通过物理断开连接来防止数据泄露）
words.ex: The air gap between the poles and the armature is crucial for the motor's efficiency.
words.ex_cn: 磁极和电枢之间的空气间隙对电机的效率至关重要。
words.en: An air gap is a physical space that separates two systems to prevent the transfer of data or contaminants between them.

words.ex: He fixed the car at a significant cost.
words.ex_cn: 他修车花了一大笔钱。
words.en: When something is achieved at a significant cost, it means that it is accomplished but at a great expense or sacrifice.

words.tr: phrase. 消除噪音；屏蔽噪声
words.ex: He cut out noise to focus on his work.
words.ex_cn: 他屏蔽了噪音，以便专注于工作。
words.en: To reduce or eliminate unwanted sound, typically through physical barriers or design features.

words.tr: phrase. 双层砖砌的；由两层砖砌成的（常用于墙体结构）
words.ex: They built a double brick house to keep it warm in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他们建了一座双层砖砌的房子，以便冬天保暖。
words.en: A construction method using two layers of bricks for walls, providing enhanced strength and insulation.

words.tr: phrase. 双层厚度的石膏板，一种用于墙体或天花板的建筑材料，具有更好的隔音、防火和强度性能
words.ex: He used double thickness plasterboard to make the wall stronger.
words.ex_cn: 他使用双层厚度的石膏板来让墙更坚固。
words.en: A type of plasterboard that is made with two layers to provide enhanced properties such as increased sound insulation or fire resistance.

words.tr: phrase. 走入歧途；堕落；丢失；被盗
words.ex: He went astray after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后走上了歧途。
words.en: If someone goes astray, they no longer follow the right course of action or the right way of life.

words.ex: The home buyer signed the contract last week.
words.ex_cn: 这位购房者上周签了合同。
words.en: A home buyer is a person who is in the process of buying a house.

words.tr: phrase. 内层玻璃；内侧玻璃（通常指双层或三层玻璃中的最内层）
words.ex: The inner glass broke when the cup fell.
words.ex_cn: 当杯子掉下来时，内层玻璃碎了。
words.en: The inner pane of glass in a double-glazed unit, facing the interior of a building.

words.tr: phrase. 最少的交通量；最低的车流量
words.ex: This road has the least traffic at night.
words.ex_cn: 这条道路在晚上交通量最少。
words.en: The area or period with the lowest volume of movement or activity, often used for planning or scheduling.

words.tr: phrase. 较安静的区域；噪音较少的区域
words.ex: He moved to a less noisy area to sleep better.
words.ex_cn: 他搬到了一个更安静的地方，以便睡得更好。
words.en: A quieter, more peaceful location.

words.tr: phrase. 轻型道路交通；道路车辆稀少的情况
words.ex: The city has light road traffic on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市在周末有轻型道路交通。
words.en: Light road traffic refers to a condition where the volume of vehicles on the road is low, leading to less congestion and smoother travel.

words.tr: phrase. 生活区；起居空间；居住区域
words.ex: The living area is bright and cozy.
words.ex_cn: 起居区明亮而舒适。
words.en: The part of a house or apartment that is used for everyday living activities.

words.tr: phrase. 噪声系数；噪声因子（电子学中表示系统引入额外噪声的度量）
words.ex: The noise factor of the amplifier is too high.
words.ex_cn: 这个放大器的噪声系数太高了。
words.en: A measure of the degradation of the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), caused by components in a signal chain.

words.tr: phrase. 噪声水平；噪音等级；音量大小
words.ex: The noise level in the room is too high.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的噪音水平太高了。
words.en: The level of sound, especially when it is unwanted, unpleasant, or loud.

words.tr: phrase. 外层玻璃；外部玻璃罩
words.ex: The outer glass broke when the cup fell.
words.ex_cn: 杯子掉下来时，外层玻璃碎了。
words.en: The transparent covering on the outside of a window or structure.

words.tr:
adj. 在头顶上的；
adv. 在空中；
words.ex: The overhead light is too bright.
words.ex_cn: 头顶上的灯太亮了。
words.en: You use overhead to indicate that something is above you or above the place that you are talking about.

words.tr: phrase. 规划住宅区；经过统一规划设计的住宅社区
words.ex: The city built a planned housing estate near the river.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市在河边建了一个规划好的住宅区。
words.en: A planned housing estate is a residential area designed and developed according to a specific plan, often including houses, apartments, and communal facilities.

words.tr: phrase. 私人住房；民营住宅；非政府提供的住房
words.ex: He lives in private housing near the city center.
words.ex_cn: 他住在市中心附近的私人住宅。
words.en: Housing that is owned by individuals or private companies rather than by the government.

words.tr: phrase. 密封窗；指无法打开、具有气密或隔音功能的窗户
words.ex: The sealed window keeps the cold air out.
words.ex_cn: 密封的窗户阻止冷空气进入。
words.en: A window that is designed to prevent air from entering or escaping, typically used to improve insulation in buildings.

chapters.name: 真题解析4 T1 S1 有关学校组织的旅游活动的咨询

words.tr: phrase. 密封窗；指无法打开、具有气密或隔音功能的窗户
words.ex: The sealed window keeps the cold air out.
words.ex_cn: 密封的窗户阻止冷空气进入。
words.en: A window that is designed to prevent air from entering or escaping, typically used to improve insulation in buildings.

words.ex: He got a full refund for the broken phone.
words.ex_cn: 他因为坏了的手机得到了全额退款。
words.en: A full refund is the return of the entire amount of money paid for a product or service, typically due to dissatisfaction or defect.

words.ex: I checked the class schedule for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我查看了明天的课程时间表。
words.en: A schedule is a plan that gives a list of events or tasks and the times at which each one should happen or be done.

words.ex: The weather varies from day to day.
words.ex_cn: 天气每天都在变化。
words.en: If things vary, they are different from each other in size, amount, or degree.

words.tr: phrase. 导览；有导游带领的参观旅行
words.ex: They took guided tours of the museum.
words.ex_cn: 他们参加了博物馆的导览。
words.en: A guided tour is a visit to a place of interest with a guide who provides information about the place.

words.ex: Please pay in advance.
words.ex_cn: 请提前付款。
words.en: Before a particular time, or before doing a particular thing.

words.ex: The notice board has a new message.
words.ex_cn: 公告板上有一条新消息。
words.en: A board on which notices are posted; a bulletin board.

words.ex: Many tourists visit places of historical interest in Rome.
words.ex_cn: 许多游客参观罗马的历史名胜。
words.en: Locations recognized for their historical significance and appeal to tourists.

words.tr: phrase. 可容纳十六人的小型巴士
words.ex: The school uses a sixteen-seater minibus to take students on field trips.
words.ex_cn: 学校用一辆十六座的小巴送学生去郊游。
words.en: A small bus designed to carry sixteen passengers.

chapters.name: 真题解析4 T1 S2 导游介绍古代村落遗址

words.tr: phrase. 简要的叙述；简短的报告
words.ex: He gave a brief account of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他简要地描述了会议的内容。
words.en: A brief account is a short description or summary of an event or situation.

words.ex: The cat likes to roam around the garden.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫喜欢在花园里游荡。
words.en: To roam means to move about or travel without any definite purpose or destination.

words.tr:
n. 制造；
v. （用机器大量）制造；虚构；捏造；
words.ex: The manufacture of cars needs many workers.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的制造需要很多工人。
words.en: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory, usually in large quantities.

words.ex: The availability of free Wi-Fi is important for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 免费Wi-Fi的可用性对旅行者很重要。
words.en: The quality of being able to be used or obtained.

words.ex: The factory uses raw materials to make products.
words.ex_cn: 工厂用原材料制造产品。
words.en: Raw materials are basic substances that are used to make products or to create energy. They are often natural resources such as oil, wood, or metal.

words.ex: Rock contains many minerals.
words.ex_cn: 岩石中含有许多矿物。
words.en: A mineral is a solid substance that occurs naturally and has a specific chemical composition and structure.

words.ex: The factory buys iron ore to make steel.
words.ex_cn: 工厂购买铁矿石来制造钢铁。
words.en: Iron ore is a type of rock from which metallic iron can be extracted, which is then used in the production of steel.

words.ex: There is an abundance of food at the party.
words.ex_cn: 聚会上食物非常丰富。
words.en: A very large quantity of something.

words.tr:
n. 燃料；燃油；
v. 加剧；
words.ex: The rocket uses fuel 627 for propulsion.
words.ex_cn: 火箭使用627号燃料推进。
words.en: Fuel is a substance such as coal, gas, or oil that is burned to provide heat or power.

words.ex: He burns coal to keep his house warm.
words.ex_cn: 他烧煤来让房子暖和。
words.en: Coal is a hard black substance that is extracted from the ground and burned as fuel.

words.ex: The craftsman made a wooden chair by hand.
words.ex_cn: 这位工匠手工制作了一把木椅。
words.en: A craftsman is a skilled worker who makes things by hand.

words.ex: The old iron forge produced tools for the village.
words.ex_cn: 旧的炼铁厂为村庄生产工具。
words.en: An iron forge is a workshop where metal is heated and hammered into shape by a blacksmith.

words.tr: phrase. 河流的弯曲处；河湾
words.ex: The bend in the river is where we swim.
words.ex_cn: 河流的拐弯处是我们游泳的地方。
words.en: The curve or turn in the course of a river.

words.tr:
n. 计划；打算；
v. 计划；打算；
words.ex: He made a plan to visit his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个去看望祖父母的计划。
words.en: A plan is a detailed proposal for doing or achieving something.

words.ex: The entrance to the building is on the left.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的入口在左边。
words.en: An entrance is a way into a place, such as a door or gate. It can also refer to the act of entering a place or the right to enter.

words.ex: He bought a train ticket at the ticket office.
words.ex_cn: 他在售票处买了一张火车票。
words.en: A ticket office is a place where tickets are sold to the public for admission to a theater, for travel on public transportation, etc.

words.ex: She bought a souvenir at the gift shop.
words.ex_cn: 她在礼品店买了一件纪念品。
words.en: A gift shop is a retail store that sells items that are suitable for giving as presents, such as souvenirs, knickknacks, and other small items.

words.tr: n. 样品陈列室；展销厅；
words.ex: The car showroom has many new models on display.
words.ex_cn: 汽车样品陈列室里有许多新款车型展出。
words.en: A showroom is a large room used for displaying goods, especially cars, furniture, or electrical appliances, for sale.

words.ex: The paintings are on display in the museum.
words.ex_cn: 这些画在博物馆里展出。
words.en: If something is on display, it is arranged for people to look at in a public place.

words.ex: He grinds the coffee beans into powder.
words.ex_cn: 他把咖啡豆碾成粉末。
words.en: To reduce something to small particles or powder by crushing it.

words.ex: The blacksmith heated the metal in the furnace.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠在熔炉里加热金属。
words.en: A furnace is a device that produces heat for warmth or to melt materials.

words.tr:
v. 熔炼；冶炼
v. 嗅；闻；散发气味；察觉；“smell”的过去式和过去分词
n. 胡瓜鱼
words.ex: They smelt iron ore to make steel.
words.ex_cn: 他们熔炼铁矿石来制造钢铁。
words.en: To smelt means to extract metal from ore by a process involving heating and melting.

words.tr:
n. 全体演员；
v. 投掷；扔；投射；
words.ex: The cast of the play performed very well.
words.ex_cn: 这部剧的全体演员表演得非常好。
words.en: To cast something means to throw it forcefully in a particular direction.

words.tr:
adj. 古老的；
n. 古董；
words.ex: He bought an antique chair from the old market.
words.ex_cn: 他从旧市场买了一把古老的椅子。
words.en: Something that is antique is old and often valuable because it is rare or well made.

words.ex: They live in a small cottage near the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在森林附近的一座小村舍里。
words.en: A cottage is a small house, usually in the countryside.

chapters.name: 真题解析4 T1 S3 师生间就作业展开的讨论

words.ex: The teacher gave us a math assignment.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一份数学作业。
words.en: An assignment is a task or piece of work that you are given to do, especially as part of your job or studies.

words.tr: adj. 应给的；预期的；到期的；
words.ex: The payment is due tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 这笔款项明天应给。
words.en: If something is due at a particular time, it is expected to happen or be done at that time.

words.tr: n. 扩展；延长期；延伸；电话分机；
words.ex: The company added an extension to its office building.
words.ex_cn: 公司为办公楼加了一个扩建部分。
words.en: An extension is a part that is added to something to make it longer or larger, or the act of adding this part.

words.tr: phrase. 医疗或人道理由；因健康或同情因素
words.ex: He left work for medical or compassionate reasons.
words.ex_cn: 他因为健康或人道原因离开了工作。
words.en: Reasons related to health or empathy.

words.tr: n. 参考；提及；介绍信；引用；
words.ex: Please use this book for reference.
words.ex_cn: 请使用这本书作为参考。
words.en: A reference is a mention of something or someone, or a letter or statement about someone's character or abilities.

words.ex: He will submit his homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会提交他的作业。
words.en: To yield or surrender (oneself) to the will or authority of another.

words.ex: He learned research methodology in his master's program.
words.ex_cn: 他在硕士课程中学习了研究方法。
words.en: Research methodology refers to the systematic, theoretical analysis of the methods applied to a field of study.

words.ex: He reads a science journal every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周读一本科学期刊。
words.en: A journal is a newspaper or magazine that deals with a particular subject or professional activity.

words.ex: This information is relevant to our project.
words.ex_cn: 这些信息与我们的项目相关。
words.en: Something that is relevant to a situation or person is important or significant in that situation or to that person.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；基本的；本质的；
words.ex: Water is essential for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必需的。
words.en: Something that is essential is extremely important or absolutely necessary to a particular subject, situation, or activity.

words.ex: The bar graph shows the number of students in each class.
words.ex_cn: 这个矩形图显示了每个班级的学生人数。
words.en: A bar graph is a chart that uses bars to show comparisons among categories. The bars can be either horizontal or vertical.

words.ex: I need a photocopy of my passport.
words.ex_cn: 我需要一份护照的影印本。
words.en: A photocopy is a copy of a document made by a photocopier.

words.ex: The dark clouds indicate rain.
words.ex_cn: 乌云表明要下雨了。
words.en: If one thing indicates another, the first thing shows that the second is true or exists.

words.ex: The proximity of the school to the park makes it nice for kids.
words.ex_cn: 学校靠近公园，对孩子们来说很好。
words.en: Proximity refers to the state of being near in space or time.

words.ex: The tenant pays rent every month.
words.ex_cn: 房客每个月支付租金。
words.en: A tenant is a person who rents land or property from a landlord.

chapters.name: 真题解析4 T1 S4 关于树木对城市地貌影响的讲座

words.ex: The urban area has many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市地区有许多高楼。
words.en: relating to a city or town

words.ex: The landscape after the rain is very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 雨后的景色非常美丽。
words.en: A landscape is all the visible features of an area of land, often considered in terms of their aesthetic appeal.

words.ex: The desert has little vegetation.
words.ex_cn: 这个沙漠植被很少。
words.en: Vegetation refers to plants in general, or the plants that are found in a particular area. It can also refer to a life that is dull or inactive, often due to illness or lack of exercise.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 重大的影响；显著的冲击
words.ex: The new rule had a significant impact on the students.
words.ex_cn: 这个新规定对学生产生了重大影响。
words.en: A significant impact refers to a major or important effect or influence that something has on a situation, process, or person.

words.ex: The class, as a whole, did well on the test.
words.ex_cn: 整个班级在考试中表现不错。
words.en: Considering all parts or elements together; as a single unit.

words.ex: The air feels humid after it rains.
words.ex_cn: 雨后空气感觉湿润。
words.en: You use humid to describe an atmosphere or climate that is very damp, and usually very hot.

words.ex: The inland city has no sea nearby.
words.ex_cn: 这个内陆城市没有海。
words.en: An inland city is a city located away from the coast or any major body of water, typically characterized by its geographical position within a country's interior.

words.tr: 短语. 在局部尺度上；在本地范围内
words.ex: The rain affected the garden on the local scale.
words.ex_cn: 这场雨在本地范围内影响了花园。
words.en: Refers to considering or analyzing something within a limited or specific area or community, as opposed to a global or broader scale.

words.ex: The shady spot under the tree is cool.
words.ex_cn: 树下的背阴处很凉爽。
words.en: If you describe a person or activity as shady, you mean that they seem dishonest or illegal.

words.ex: The internal parts of the machine need repair.
words.ex_cn: 机器的内部零件需要修理。
words.en: Internal is used to describe things that exist or happen inside a particular person, object, or place.

words.ex: The body has a mechanism to fight viruses.
words.ex_cn: 人体有一种对抗病毒的机制。
words.en: A mechanism is a part of a machine that does a particular task, or a system that is intended to achieve something or deal with a problem.

words.ex: The temperature today is very high.
words.ex_cn: 今天的温度很高。
words.en: The degree or intensity of heat present in a substance or object, especially as expressed according to a comparative scale and shown by a thermometer or perceived by touch.

words.ex: The thermostat helps regulate the room temperature.
words.ex_cn: 恒温器有助于调节室温。
words.en: To regulate something means to control or manage it, especially by means of rules or laws.

words.ex: The sun makes the puddle evaporate quickly.
words.ex_cn: 太阳使水坑很快蒸发。
words.en: If a liquid evaporates, or if something evaporates it, it changes from a liquid state to a gas, because its temperature has increased.

words.ex: The humidifier helps to humidify the dry air.
words.ex_cn: 加湿器有助于使干燥的空气变得湿润。
words.en: To humidify means to add moisture or water vapor to the air or to a gas, making it more humid.

words.ex: He lost all his property in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他在火灾中失去了所有财产。
words.en: Something owned; a possession.

words.ex: He exploited the situation to get more money.
words.ex_cn: 他利用这个情况赚了更多钱。
words.en: To exploit someone or something means to use them in a way that benefits you, often unfairly or without considering their rights or feelings. It can also refer to the act of making full use of and deriving benefit from a resource.

words.tr:
v. 过滤；
n. 过滤器；
words.ex: She filters the water before drinking it.
words.ex_cn: 她在喝水之前过滤水。
words.en: A filter is a device or a method that removes unwanted substances from something such as water, air, or light, by passing it through a special material or system.

words.tr: adv. 大幅度地；相当地；很大地；
words.ex: The price has increased considerably.
words.ex_cn: 价格大幅上涨了。
words.en: To a notably large or significant extent.

words.tr:
n. 一阵狂风；突然的一阵
v. （风）猛刮
words.ex: A sudden gust blew the hat off his head.
words.ex_cn: 一阵突然的风把他的帽子吹掉了。
words.en: A gust is a sudden, strong rush of wind.

words.tr: phrase. 建筑密集区；城市化地区；人口稠密的城区
words.ex: The city expanded into built-up areas near the river.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市向河边的建成区扩展了。
words.en: Built-up areas refer to parts of a city or town where there are many buildings and little open space.

words.ex: The storm will intensify tonight.
words.ex_cn: 风暴今晚会加强。
words.en: To make or become more intense or intensive.

words.tr: phrase. 一片带状树林；一长条树木
words.ex: They planted a belt of trees around the farm.
words.ex_cn: 他们在农场周围种了一排树。
words.en: A group of trees forming a line or a circle, often around a particular area.

words.tr: n. 车辆；交通工具；媒介；
words.ex: The vehicle stopped at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车在红灯前停了下来。
words.en: A vehicle is a machine such as a car, bus, or truck which has an engine and is used to carry people or goods from place to place.

words.tr: adj. 周围的； v. “surround”的现在分词；
words.ex: The surrounding trees block the wind.
words.ex_cn: 周围的树木挡住了风。
words.en: The area or environment around something or someone.

words.ex: The frequency of the radio station is 101.5 MHz.
words.ex_cn: 这个电台的频率是101.5兆赫。
words.en: The rate at which something happens or is repeated over a particular period of time.

words.ex: The river flows through a deep canyon.
words.ex_cn: 河流流经一个深峡谷。
words.en: A canyon is a large valley with very steep sides and usually a river flowing along the bottom.

words.tr:
adj. 高层的（建筑）
n. 高楼；大厦；多层建筑物
words.ex: He lives in a high-rise building near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一栋高楼里。
words.en: A high-rise building is a tall building with many floors.

words.ex: They enclose the garden with a wooden fence.
words.ex_cn: 他们用木栅栏把花园围起来。
words.en: If you enclose something with a letter, you put it in the same envelope as the letter.

chapters.name: 真题解析4 T2 S1 讨论旅游行程

words.ex: He bought a guidebook for his trip to Paris.
words.ex_cn: 他为去巴黎旅行买了一本旅游指南。
words.en: A guidebook is a book that gives tourists information about a town, area, or country.

words.tr: adj. 已冷的； v. “chill”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The chilled water tasted refreshing.
words.ex_cn: 冰凉的水喝起来很清爽。
words.en: If something is chilled, it has been made cold, often in order to make it more pleasant or refreshing.

words.ex: He drinks mineral water every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天喝矿泉水。
words.en: Water that contains dissolved mineral salts, especially carbonates, sulfates, and phosphates of calcium, magnesium, sodium, and iron, and is often effervescent.

words.ex: He paid with cash for the bread.
words.ex_cn: 他用现金买了面包。
words.en: Money in the form of coins or banknotes, especially that which is immediately available.

words.ex: He used a traveller's cheque to pay for his hotel.
words.ex_cn: 他用旅行支票支付了酒店费用。
words.en: A traveller's cheque is a cheque for a fixed amount that can be used as a safe way of carrying money when you are travelling.

words.ex: The exchange rate is high today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的汇率很高。
words.en: The exchange rate is the rate at which one currency will be exchanged for another. It is also regarded as the value of one country's currency in relation to another currency.

words.tr: n. 讲述者；（银行）出纳员；
words.ex: The old man is the teller of fairy tales.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人是童话故事的讲述者。
words.en: A teller is a person who works in a bank and whose job includes receiving and paying out money.

words.ex: The store is temporarily closed.
words.ex_cn: 这家店暂时关闭了。
words.en: For a limited time; not permanently.

words.ex: The bank recorded the transaction quickly.
words.ex_cn: 银行迅速记录了这笔交易。
words.en: A transaction is an instance of buying or selling something; a business deal.

words.ex: He is an architect who designs houses.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位设计房屋的建筑师。
words.en: An architect is a person who designs buildings and advises in their construction.

words.ex: I ate an apple as a snack after school.
words.ex_cn: 我放学后吃了一个苹果当小吃。
words.en: A snack is a small amount of food that is eaten between meals.

words.ex: We went sightseeing in Paris last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去巴黎观光了。
words.en: The activity of visiting places of interest in a particular location.

words.ex: The cathedral has tall towers and stained glass windows.
words.ex_cn: 这座大教堂有高高的塔楼和彩绘玻璃窗。
words.en: A cathedral is a very large and important church which has a bishop in charge of it.

words.ex: The king lives in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A castle is a large building or group of buildings fortified against attack with thick walls, battlements, towers, and in many cases a moat.

words.tr: phrase. 不挂断；稍等 ；紧紧抓住
words.ex: Hang on, I will be there soon.
words.ex_cn: 等一下，我马上就到。
words.en: To hold onto something tightly; to wait for a short time.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日参观了一个美术馆。
words.en: A place where works of art are displayed for public viewing.

words.tr: phrase. 植物园；专门用于种植和展示各种植物的园区
words.ex: We walked in the botanical garden and saw many flowers.
words.ex_cn: 我们在植物园里散步，看到了许多花。
words.en: A botanical garden is a place where plants are grown for scientific study and display to the public.

words.tr: phrase. 教堂礼拜；宗教仪式
words.ex: They go to church services every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每个星期天都去参加教堂礼拜。
words.en: A church service is a formalized period of communal worship in Christianity, often including prayers, hymns, a sermon, and other elements.

words.tr:
n. 收费；负责；指控；
v. 收费；充电；
words.ex: The hotel charge is $50 per night.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的收费是每晚50美元。
words.en: If you charge someone, you ask them to pay an amount of money for something that you have sold to them or done for them.

words.ex: The sunset was spectacular.
words.ex_cn: 日落非常壮观。
words.en: Something that is spectacular is very impressive or dramatic.

words.tr:
n. 野餐；
v. 去野餐；
words.ex: We had a picnic in the park on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日去公园野餐了。
words.en: A picnic is a meal eaten outdoors, especially in the countryside, usually as part of a trip or outing.

words.ex: A white swan swam quietly on the lake.
words.ex_cn: 一只白天鹅静静地在湖上游泳。
words.en: A swan is a large, white bird with a long neck that lives on rivers and lakes.

chapters.name: 真题解析4 T2 S2 介绍学校咨询服务的讲座

words.ex: He went to the counselling service for help.
words.ex_cn: 他去咨询服务中心寻求帮助。
words.en: A counselling service is a professional service that provides advice and support to people dealing with personal issues or psychological problems.

words.ex: A problem arose during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议中出现了一个问题。
words.en: If a situation or problem arises, it begins to exist or people start to become aware of it.

words.ex: I need to chase up the delivery driver.
words.ex_cn: 我需要追上送货司机。
words.en: To chase someone up means to remind or urge them to do something they have promised or are supposed to do.

words.ex: My tutor helps me with math homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮我做数学作业。
words.en: A tutor is someone who gives private lessons to one pupil or a very small group of pupils.

words.ex: The teacher gave me feedback on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我关于我作文的反馈。
words.en: Feedback is comments in the form of opinions about and reactions to something, intended to provide useful information for future decisions and development.

words.tr:
n. 压力；强调；
v. 着重；强调；
words.ex: He feels stress from too much work.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作太多而感到压力。
words.en: Stress is a state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances.

words.tr: v. 调整；使适合；使适应；
words.ex: He adjusted the chair to sit comfortably.
words.ex_cn: 他调整了椅子以便坐得舒服。
words.en: To adjust something means to change it so that it is more effective or appropriate, or so that it fits better.

words.tr: phrase. 日益增加的压力；不断加剧的压力
words.ex: He feels mounting pressure to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他感到完成这个项目压力越来越大。
words.en: Increasing pressure or stress that becomes more intense over time.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 悄悄接近某人；不知不觉地影响某人
words.ex: The cat creeps up on the bird quietly.
words.ex_cn: 猫悄悄地靠近那只鸟。
words.en: To approach someone or something quietly and stealthily, or to affect someone gradually without being noticed.

words.ex: He tries to cope with stress by walking every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天散步来应对压力。
words.en: To deal effectively with something difficult.

words.ex: He uses a social network to talk with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他使用社交网络和朋友聊天。
words.en: A social network is a website or application that enables users to communicate with each other by posting information, comments, messages, images, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 社交联系；社会关系；人际交往
words.ex: He has many social contacts in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他在城里有很多社交关系。
words.en: The people one knows and with whom one associates, especially in a professional context.

words.ex: He felt anxiety before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到忧虑。
words.en: Anxiety is a feeling of worry, nervousness, or unease about something with an uncertain outcome.

words.tr:
v. 触发；引起；发动；
n. 诱因；触发；
words.ex: The loud noise triggered the alarm.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音触发了警报。
words.en: A trigger is a device that activates a mechanism when it is pulled or pressed. It can also refer to something that causes a particular reaction or development.

words.tr: phrase. 被打断的人际关系
words.ex: They stopped talking after their interrupted personal relationships.
words.ex_cn: 他们之间的关系被打断后，就不再说话了。
words.en: Personal relationships that have been disrupted or broken off.

words.tr: phrase. 中断；突然停止；断绝（关系）；休息一会
words.ex: He broke off the conversation when the phone rang.
words.ex_cn: 电话响时，他中断了对话。
words.en: To suddenly stop doing something, especially speaking.

words.ex: He felt unmotivated to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得缺乏动力去完成作业。
words.en: If you are unmotivated, you lack enthusiasm and are not willing to work hard or do something.

words.ex: You must concentrate on your homework.
words.ex_cn: 你必须集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you concentrate on something, you give it your full attention and think about it carefully.

words.tr:
adj. 居住的；常驻的；
n. 常住居民；
words.ex: The resident population grew last year.
words.ex_cn: 居住人口去年增加了。
words.en: A resident is someone who lives in a particular place or a person who has their home in a place.

words.tr: n. （学校、医院、军队、监狱中的）牧师；
words.ex: The chaplain prayed with the soldiers before the mission.
words.ex_cn: 牧师在任务前为士兵们祈祷。
words.en: A chaplain is a member of the clergy attached to a private chapel, institution, ship, regiment, etc.

words.ex: He decided to drop out of the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他决定不参加比赛。
words.en: If someone drops out of a school or a course, they leave it before they have finished it.

words.ex: He has high self-esteem after passing the test.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试后，他自尊心很强。
words.en: Self-esteem is the opinion you have of yourself and your abilities.

words.ex: He will resit the math exam next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将重考数学考试。
words.en: If someone resits an examination, they take it again, usually because they failed it the first time.

words.ex: He is studying anthropology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学里学习人类学。
words.en: Anthropology is the study of human societies and cultures and their development.

words.ex: She was sympathetic to his problems.
words.ex_cn: 她对他的问题很同情。
words.en: If you are sympathetic to someone who is in a bad situation, you are kind to them and show that you understand their feelings.

words.ex: He has dietary problems because he eats too much sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他因为吃太多糖而有饮食方面的问题。
words.en: Issues related to the intake of food and nutrients, often causing health problems.

words.tr: 短语. 合某人胃口的；符合某人喜好的
words.ex: The food is cooked to my liking.
words.ex_cn: 这食物按照我的喜好做的。
words.en: In a way that someone likes or prefers.

words.tr:
adj. 难过的；沮丧的；
v. 打乱；使心烦；
words.ex: He felt upset when his dog ran away.
words.ex_cn: 当他的狗跑掉时，他感到很难过。
words.en: If you are upset, you are unhappy or disappointed because something unpleasant has happened to you.

words.tr: n. 饮食学家；营养学家
words.ex: The dietitian gave her healthy meal plans.
words.ex_cn: 营养师给了她健康的饮食计划。
words.en: A dietitian is a person who is qualified to advise people on what to eat in order to be healthy.

words.tr: phrase. 低息贷款；利率较低的贷款
words.ex: He got a low-interest loan to buy a car.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了一笔低息贷款来买一辆车。
words.en: A loan offered at a rate of interest that is below the average market rate.

words.ex: He plays a musical instrument every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都演奏一件乐器。
words.en: A musical instrument is a device created or adapted to make musical sounds. In principle, any object that produces sound can be considered a musical instrument—it is through purpose that the object becomes a musical instrument.

words.tr: phrase. 福利服务；社会福利机构提供的援助与支持服务
words.ex: The government provides welfare service for poor families.
words.ex_cn: 政府为贫困家庭提供福利服务。
words.en: A service provided by the government or other organizations to improve the well-being of individuals or groups, especially those in need.

words.ex: The company made staff cuts to save money.
words.ex_cn: 公司裁员以节省开支。
words.en: Reduction in the number of employees in a company or organization, typically to reduce costs or increase efficiency.

words.tr:
n. 吸引力；上诉；
v. 吸引；诉请；呼吁；
words.ex: The appeal of the beach drew many tourists.
words.ex_cn: 海滩的吸引力吸引了许多游客。
words.en: If you appeal to someone to do something, you make a serious and urgent request to them. If you appeal against a decision or sentence, you formally ask a court or other authority to change it. If something appeals to you, you like it or it interests you.

words.tr:
v. 发射；发起；启动；
n. 发射；投掷；启动；
words.ex: They will launch a rocket tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将发射一枚火箭。
words.en: To launch something means to send it into the air, space, or water, especially with a lot of force or effort, or to start an activity, event, or project.

words.ex: He spoke on behalf of his sister.
words.ex_cn: 他代表他的妹妹发言。
words.en: If you do something on behalf of someone, you do it as their representative or in their interest.

words.ex: The hospital is understaffed and needs more nurses.
words.ex_cn: 这家医院人手不足，需要更多的护士。
words.en: If an organization is understaffed, it does not have enough employees to function properly.

chapters.name: 真题解析4 T2 S3 课外研讨场景

words.ex: The teacher gave us a math assignment.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一份数学作业。
words.en: An assignment is a task or piece of work that you are given to do, especially as part of your job or studies.

words.ex: He finished his homework task before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭前完成了他的作业任务。
words.en: A task is a piece of work to be done or undertaken.

words.ex: The teacher collected data from the students' tests.
words.ex_cn: 老师收集了学生测试的数据。
words.en: Data is information, especially facts or numbers, collected to be examined and considered and used to help decision-making, or information in an electronic form that can be stored and used by a computer.

words.ex: The teacher will assess your homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天会评估你的作业。
words.en: to judge or decide the amount, value, quality, or importance of something

words.tr: phrase. 社会科学；社会科学学科
words.ex: He studies social science at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学学习社会科学。
words.en: Social science is the study of society and the relationships among individuals within a society.

words.ex: They will carry out the experiment tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将进行这个实验。
words.en: To perform or complete a task, duty, or project.

words.tr:
n. 主题；学科；对象；
v. 使臣服；
adj. 易遭受…的；受…支配的；
words.ex: The subject of the book is ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的主题是古代历史。
words.en: A subject is something that is discussed, studied, or written about. It can also refer to a person or thing that is the focus of attention or action. In grammar, a subject is the part of a sentence that performs the action of the verb.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a questionnaire about our habits.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们一份关于我们习惯的问卷。
words.en: A questionnaire is a written list of questions which are answered by a lot of people in order to provide information for a report or a survey.

words.tr:
n. 面试；访谈；
v. 面试；接见；
words.ex: He has an interview tomorrow for a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他明天有一场新工作的面试。
words.en: An interview is a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out if they are suitable for a job or a course of study.

words.ex: Doing homework by hand is time-consuming.
words.ex_cn: 手写作业很耗时。
words.en: If you describe an activity as time-consuming, you mean that it takes a lot of time to do.

words.ex: I reckon it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我认为明天会下雨。
words.en: If you reckon that something is true, you think that it is true.

words.tr: n. 措辞；用词； v. “word”的现在分词；
words.ex: The wording of the notice was clear.
words.ex_cn: 通知的措辞很清晰。
words.en: The way in which words are used to express something, especially in a document or speech.

words.tr: adj. 角的；有角的；尖角的；
words.ex: The angular shape of the triangle is clear.
words.ex_cn: 三角形的角形很清晰。
words.en: having angles or sharp corners; lean and bony

words.ex: He is a reliable friend who always helps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮忙。
words.en: Able to be trusted to do or provide what is needed or right.

words.ex: The drawback of this phone is its short battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的缺点是电池续航时间短。
words.en: A drawback is a feature of something that makes it less useful or desirable than it could be.

words.ex: The response rate was low in the survey.
words.ex_cn: 调查的回复率很低。
words.en: The proportion of people who respond to a survey, advertisement, or other form of communication.

words.ex: The letter revealed his secret.
words.ex_cn: 这封信揭露了他的秘密。
words.en: To reveal something means to make known something that was previously secret or unknown.

words.tr:
n. 样品；样本；
v. 抽样；
words.ex: The scientist tested the sample from the river.
words.ex_cn: 科学家测试了来自河流的样品。
words.en: A sample is a small quantity of a product, especially food, given to customers so that they can try it before buying it.

words.tr:
n. 调查；勘测；
v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did a survey about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了一项关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: A survey is a detailed study or inspection, especially as a means of collecting information about people's opinions or behavior.

words.ex: He went to a tutorial to understand math better.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加辅导以更好地理解数学。
words.en: A tutorial is a period of teaching and discussion with a tutor, especially in a British university or college.

words.tr: phrase. 阅读书目；书单（尤指课程指定的必读书目）
words.ex: He made a reading list for summer.
words.ex_cn: 他为夏天列了一份阅读清单。
words.en: A list of books, articles, or other materials recommended or required for reading, especially in an academic context.

chapters.name: 真题解析4 T2 S4 关于企业犯罪的讲座

words.tr: adj. 现代的；当代的；同时代的；
words.ex: This museum displays contemporary art.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆展示现代艺术。
words.en: Belonging to or occurring in the present; or a person or thing living or existing at the same time as another.

words.ex: His preoccupation with video games made him ignore his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他对电子游戏的全神贯注让他忽略了作业。
words.en: If you have a preoccupation with something or someone, you think or worry about them very often and they are the main focus of your attention.

words.ex: This painting is unique because no other like it exists.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是独特的，因为没有其他类似的。
words.en: Something that is unique is the only one of its kind.

words.tr: adj. 大规模的；大而重的；
words.ex: The company launched a massive advertising campaign.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司发起了一场大规模的广告活动。
words.en: Something that is massive is extremely large in size, amount, or extent.

words.ex: The corporate office is in New York.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的总部在纽约。
words.en: Corporate relates to large companies or to a particular large company.

words.ex: It is illegal to drive without a license.
words.ex_cn: 无证驾驶是非法的。
words.en: If something is illegal, the law says that it is not allowed.

words.ex: He acted in accordance with the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他按照规则行事。
words.en: If something is done in accordance with a particular rule or system, it is done in the way that the rule or system says that it should be done.

words.tr: phrase. 引号开始……引号结束；用于口语中表示引用的起止，常带讽刺或强调意味
words.ex: He said he was 'busy' — quote unquote — but I saw him playing games online.
words.ex_cn: 他说他‘很忙’——引号开始，引号结束——但我看到他在网上玩游戏。
words.en: Used to indicate that a word or phrase is being used ironically or to express doubt.

words.ex: He committed a crime last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚犯下一桩罪行。
words.en: To do something illegal or wrong.

words.ex: The theft of the bike was reported to the police.
words.ex_cn: 这起自行车被盗事件已向警方报告。
words.en: Theft is the act of stealing.

words.ex: He was jailed for embezzlement from his company.
words.ex_cn: 他因盗用公司公款而入狱。
words.en: Embezzlement is the act of dishonestly taking or using money that belongs to someone else, especially when it is in your care or belongs to the organization you work for.

words.ex: The man was punished for fraud.
words.ex_cn: 这个人因欺骗而受到惩罚。
words.en: Fraud is the crime of gaining money or financial benefits by a trick or by lying.

words.ex: The rule excludes children under 12.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则排除了12岁以下的孩子。
words.en: To exclude someone or something means to prevent them from entering a place or taking part in an activity.

words.tr: adj. 可原谅的；情有可原的；
words.ex: His excuse was excusable because he was sick.
words.ex_cn: 他的借口是可以原谅的，因为他生病了。
words.en: If something is excusable, it can be forgiven or understood because there is a good reason for it.

words.ex: He wears conventional clothes to work.
words.ex_cn: 他穿传统服装去上班。
words.en: Conventional ideas, methods, or systems are the ones that are generally accepted and used, and that have been used for a long time.

words.ex: He ignored the warning sign.
words.ex_cn: 他忽视了警告标志。
words.en: If you ignore someone or something, you pay no attention to them.

words.ex: The mass media shows news every day.
words.ex_cn: 大众媒体每天播放新闻。
words.en: The mass media refers to the various means by which information is communicated to large numbers of people, including newspapers, magazines, television, and the internet.

words.tr: adj．被低估报道的，报道不足的：指某一事件、问题或现象在媒体报道中被低估或未得到足够关注。
words.ex: The problem is under-reported in the media.
