words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在课堂上做了一个科学实验。
words.en: An experiment is a scientific procedure undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact.

words.tr:
v. 集中；聚焦；
n. 中心点；焦点；
words.ex: He needs to focus on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you focus on a particular topic or if your attention is focused on it, you concentrate on it and think about it, discuss it, or deal with it, rather than dealing with other topics.

words.tr: phrase. 反馈会议；意见交流环节
words.ex: We have scheduled a feedback session to discuss the project's progress.
words.ex_cn: 我们安排了一个反馈会议来讨论项目的进展。
words.en: A meeting or discussion where feedback is given and received, typically to improve a project, performance, or process.

words.tr:
n. 电影；底片；薄薄的一层；
v. 拍摄电影；
words.ex: I watched a funny film last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚看了一部有趣的电影。
words.en: A film is a series of moving pictures, usually shown in a cinema or on television and often telling a story.

words.ex: He uses a lot of slang when talking with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友聊天时用很多俚语。
words.en: Slang refers to a type of language that consists of words and phrases that are regarded as very informal, are more common in speech than writing, and are typically restricted to a particular context or group of people.

words.tr:
n. 妥协；
v. 危及；
words.ex: They reached a compromise after hours of talk.
words.ex_cn: 经过数小时的讨论，他们达成了妥协。
words.en: A compromise is an agreement between two people or groups in which each side gives up some of the things they want so that both sides are happy at the end.

words.ex: The angle of the roof helps rain run off.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶的角度有助于雨水流下。
words.en: An angle is the space between two lines or surfaces that meet, measured in degrees.

words.ex: He starts his new class in the fall semester.
words.ex_cn: 他在秋季学期开始他的新课程。
words.en: A semester is one of the two periods that the school or college year is divided into, especially in the United States and Canada.

chapters.name: 真题解析5 T2 S4 讲座

words.tr: adj. 不同寻常的；非凡的；显著的；值得注意的；
words.ex: She made a remarkable improvement in just one month.
words.ex_cn: 她在短短一个月内取得了不同寻常的进步。
words.en: Unusual or striking in a way that attracts attention.

words.ex: Penguins live in Antarctica.
words.ex_cn: 企鹅生活在南极洲。
words.en: Antarctica is the Earth's southernmost continent, containing the geographic South Pole. It is situated in the Antarctic region of the Southern Hemisphere, almost entirely south of the Antarctic Circle, and is surrounded by the Southern Ocean.

words.ex: The hostile neighbor shouted at us every morning.
words.ex_cn: 那个敌意的邻居每天早上都对我们大喊大叫。
words.en: If you are hostile to another person or an idea, you disagree with them or disapprove of them, often showing this in your behavior.

words.ex: He made a permanent change to his lifestyle.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的生活方式做出了永久的改变。
words.en: Something that is permanent exists or happens all the time, or exists for a long time without changing.

words.ex: The survival of the animals depends on the weather.
words.ex_cn: 这些动物的生存取决于天气。
words.en: The state or fact of continuing to live or exist, typically in spite of an accident, ordeal, or difficult circumstances.

words.tr:
adj. 极度的；
n. 极端；极端的事物；
words.ex: He felt extreme pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后感到极度疼痛。
words.en: If you describe something as extreme, you mean that it is very great in degree or intensity.

words.ex: He drinks fresh water every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝淡水。
words.en: Water that is not salty, especially water found in rivers and lakes, which is suitable for drinking and irrigation.

words.ex: The iceberg is floating in the cold sea.
words.ex_cn: 冰山在寒冷的海面上漂浮。
words.en: An iceberg is a large piece of ice that has broken off from a glacier and is floating in the sea.

words.tr: adj. 有成本效益的；划算的
words.ex: This bike is cost-effective and saves money.
words.ex_cn: 这辆自行车物有所值，能省钱。
words.en: Something that is cost-effective gives the best possible profit or benefits in comparison with the money that is spent.

words.tr: adj. 全年无休的；一年到头的
words.ex: The amusement park is open all-year-round.
words.ex_cn: 这个游乐园全年无休。
words.en: Something that is all-year-round is available or happens throughout the year.

words.ex: The lab is well-equipped with modern tools.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验室配备了现代化的工具。
words.en: Having all the necessary equipment or features for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He runs every morning to keep fit.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑步以保持健康。
words.en: To maintain one's health and physical condition through regular exercise and a healthy diet.

words.tr: phrase. 冰架；陆缘冰（陆地冰川延伸至海洋并漂浮在海面上的厚冰层）
words.ex: The ice shelf is melting because of global warming.
words.ex_cn: 冰架因全球变暖而融化。
words.en: An ice shelf is a thick, floating platform of ice that forms where a glacier or ice sheet flows down to a coastline and onto the ocean surface.

words.ex: There was a buildup of snow on the roof.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶上积聚了大量雪。
words.en: The gradual accumulation or increase of something, especially when leading to a more significant state or event.

words.tr: adj. 可展开的；可延伸的；可延展的；
words.ex: This table is extendable, so it can fit more people.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是可展开的，因此可以容纳更多人。
words.en: Capable of being extended or stretched out.

words.ex: Bread and rice are rich in carbohydrate.
words.ex_cn: 面包和米饭富含碳水化合物。
words.en: A carbohydrate is a substance found in foods such as bread, potatoes, and rice which provides your body with heat and energy and which consists of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen.

words.ex: The book has a compact design.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的设计很紧凑。
words.en: A compact object or substance is small and dense, with all its parts closely packed together.

words.ex: The water supply is insufficient for the whole village.
words.ex_cn: 供水对整个村庄来说是不充分的。
words.en: If something is insufficient, it is not enough for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He has the capacity to solve hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: The capacity of a place or container is the amount of things or people that it can hold.

words.tr: adj. 至关重要的；决定性的；
words.ex: It is crucial to drink water every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天喝水至关重要。
words.en: If you describe something as crucial, you mean it is extremely important.

words.ex: The teacher monitors the students' progress each week.
words.ex_cn: 老师每周监控学生的进步。
words.en: A monitor is a machine that is used to check or record things, for example in a factory or hospital. In a school, a monitor is a student who helps the teacher with various duties.

words.ex: The unemployment rate is an economic indicator.
words.ex_cn: 失业率是一个经济指标。
words.en: An indicator is a measurement or value which gives you an idea of what something is like.

words.ex: The index of 2 in 2^3 is 3.
words.ex_cn: 2^3 中 2 的指数是 3。
words.en: An index is a system by which changes in the value of something and the rate at which it changes can be recorded, measured, or interpreted.

words.ex: There is a vacancy in the sales department.
words.ex_cn: 销售部门有一个空缺职位。
words.en: A vacancy is a position or job that is available for someone to fill.

words.ex: Asia is the largest continent.
words.ex_cn: 亚洲是最大的洲。
words.en: A continent is a very large area of land, such as Africa or Asia, that consists of several countries.

words.tr:
adj. 偏远的；久远的；
n. 遥控器；
words.ex: The village is in a remote area far from the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄位于远离城市的偏远地区。
words.en: Remote areas are far away from cities and places where most people live, and are therefore difficult to get to.

words.ex: The island is uninhabited.
words.ex_cn: 这个岛没有人居住。
words.en: If a place is uninhabited, no people live there.

words.tr: adj. 最终的；最后的；极端的；
words.ex: This is the ultimate solution to the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个问题的最终解决方案。
words.en: You use ultimate to describe the final result or aim of a long series of events.

words.ex: The hikers got lost in the wilderness.
words.ex_cn: 徒步旅行者在荒野中迷路了。
words.en: A wilderness is a wild and uncultivated region, as of forest or desert, uninhabited or inhabited only by wild animals.

words.ex: The ice cap is melting because of global warming.
words.ex_cn: 冰盖因全球变暖而融化。
words.en: An ice cap is a large, thick layer of ice that covers less than 50,000 square kilometers of land area. It is smaller than an ice sheet.

words.ex: This book belongs to the science category.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于科学类别。
words.en: A category is a class or group of things that have similar characteristics.

words.ex: He tried to integrate into the new school community.
words.ex_cn: 他试图融入新的学校群体。
words.en: If someone integrates into a social group, or is integrated into it, they behave in such a way that they become part of the group or are accepted into it.

words.ex: This is a summer-only resort, so it closes during the winter.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个仅限夏季的度假胜地，所以它在冬季关闭。
words.en: Something that is summer-only is available, happens, or is used only in the summer.

words.tr: adj. 完备的；设施独立的；独立自足的；沉默寡言的
words.ex: The cabin is self-contained with its own water and electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这个小屋是自给自足的，有自己独立的水和电。
words.en: A self-contained place or thing is complete and does not need other things to function or exist.

words.ex: He goes to the gym every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身房。
words.en: A gym is a place equipped for physical exercise and training, especially for athletes or for people who want to keep fit.

words.ex: The satellite sends pictures from space.
words.ex_cn: 卫星从太空发送图片。
words.en: A satellite is an object which has been sent into space in order to collect information or to be part of a communications system. Satellites move continually round the earth or around another planet.

words.tr:
n. 雪橇；大锤
v. 乘雪橇；用大锤敲打
words.ex: The children rode on a sledge down the snowy hill.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们坐在雪橇上滑下雪坡。
words.en: A sledge is a vehicle that is used for traveling over snow and ice. It is typically pulled by animals or a motor.

words.ex: He ran fast to come up with the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: If you come up with a plan, idea, or solution, you think of it and suggest it.

words.ex: One apple has about 95 kilocalories.
words.ex_cn: 一个苹果大约有95千卡。
words.en: A unit of energy of 1,000 calories, especially as a measure of the energy value of foods.

words.tr:
n. 定量；配给量
v. 配给；定量供应
words.ex: He gets a small ration of food each day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天得到少量的食物配给。
words.en: A ration is a fixed amount of something such as food or fuel that is officially allowed to each person, especially when there is not enough of it available.

words.tr: v. 使……冻干，通过冷冻干燥来保存（物质）（freeze-dry 的现在分词）; n. 冷冻干燥法
words.ex: They use freeze-drying to keep food fresh for a long time.
words.ex_cn: 他们使用冷冻干燥来长期保鲜食物。
words.en: Freeze-drying is a dehydration process typically used to preserve a perishable material or make the material more convenient for transport. It works by freezing the material, then reducing the surrounding pressure and adding enough heat to allow the frozen water in the material to sublime directly from the solid phase to the gas phase.

words.tr: phrase. 刀刃；尖端；最前沿；优势
words.ex: The knife has a sharp cutting edge.
words.ex_cn: 这把刀有一个锋利的刀刃。
words.en: The most advanced stage in the development of something; the forefront.

words.ex: He works as a marine biologist near the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 他在海边成为一名海洋生物学家。
words.en: A marine biologist is a scientist who studies marine organisms, their behaviors, and interactions with the environment.

words.ex: His words had a profound effect on her life.
words.ex_cn: 他的话对她的生活产生了深远的影响。
words.en: If you describe something as profound, you mean that it is very great or intense.

words.ex: The ozone layer protects us from the sun's harmful rays.
words.ex_cn: 臭氧层保护我们免受太阳有害射线的伤害。
words.en: The ozone layer is a layer in the Earth's stratosphere that contains a high concentration of ozone (O3) molecules, which absorb most of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet radiation.

words.ex: The sun gives out ultraviolet radiation.
words.ex_cn: 太阳发出紫外线辐射。
words.en: Ultraviolet radiation is a type of energy produced by the sun and some artificial sources, which can cause damage to the skin and eyes.

words.ex: The administrative office handles school records.
words.ex_cn: 行政办公室负责管理学校档案。
words.en: Relating to the management of a company, organization, or institution.

words.ex: His insight helped the team solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他的洞察力帮助团队解决了问题。
words.en: If you gain insight or an insight into a complex situation or problem, you gain an accurate and deep understanding of it.

chapters.name: 真题解析5 T3 S1 买车

words.ex: The rain made the road wet.
words.ex_cn: 雨使得道路变湿了。
words.en: To create, produce, or prepare something, especially by putting parts together or by combining materials.

words.tr:
n. 力量；电源；权力；强国；
v. 给…提供能量；供以动力；
words.ex: The power of the storm broke the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风暴的力量折断了树木。
words.en: The ability or capacity to do something or act in a particular way; control or influence over others; electrical energy supplied to a device or building.

words.ex: He shifted the gear to slow down the car.
words.ex_cn: 他换挡以减慢车速。
words.en: Gear refers to a toothed wheel that works with others to alter the relation between the speed of a driving mechanism (such as the engine of a vehicle) and the speed of the driven parts (the wheels). It can also mean equipment that is used for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
adj. 手工的；体力的；
n. 说明书；
words.ex: He made a manual copy of the letter.
words.ex_cn: 他手工抄写了一封信。
words.en: A manual is a book which tells you how to do something or how a piece of machinery works.

words.tr:
n. 荫；阴影；
v. 遮蔽；
words.ex: The tree provides shade on a hot day.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在炎热的日子提供荫凉。
words.en: Shade is an area where there is no direct sunlight, or something that provides protection from the sun. It can also refer to a slight difference in color, or to gradually change from one color or tone to another.

words.tr: n. 术语；条款；期间；学期；“term”的复数；
words.ex: The book explains the terms of computer science.
words.ex_cn: 这本书解释了计算机科学的术语。
words.en: Terms refer to the conditions that are set for an agreement or the words used to describe specific things in a particular field.

words.ex: The teacher gave an evaluation of the student's work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作业进行了评估。
words.en: An evaluation is a judgment about how good, useful, or successful something is.

words.ex: He wrote his postcode on the envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他把邮编写在了信封上。
words.en: A postcode is a sequence of letters and numbers which is part of an address and shows exactly where a place is.

words.ex: The car has high mileage.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车行驶的英里数很高。
words.en: Mileage refers to the distance traveled, measured in miles, or the benefits or advantages gained from a particular situation or activity.

words.ex: The car is painted metallic grey.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车涂成了金属灰色。
words.en: A color that resembles the reflective and shiny qualities of metal, typically a shade of grey.

words.ex: The car has a strong engine.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有一个强劲的发动机。
words.en: An engine is a machine that converts energy into mechanical force and motion.

words.ex: I do my homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上做作业。
words.en: To perform or accomplish something

words.ex: I presume he will arrive tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我假设他明天会到。
words.en: If you presume that something is the case, you think that it is the case, although you are not certain.

words.ex: The door opens automatically when you get close.
words.ex_cn: 当你靠近时，门会自动打开。
words.en: If something happens automatically, it happens as a part of the normal process or system, without needing to be started by someone.

words.tr: phrase. 选择；追求；努力争取
words.ex: I want to go for the blue shirt.
words.ex_cn: 我对那件蓝色的衬衫感兴趣。
words.en: If you go for something, you choose it or try to achieve it.

words.ex: We made an arrangement to meet at 6 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我们安排好晚上六点见面。
words.en: An arrangement is a plan or preparation which you make so that something can happen.

words.ex: Please write your full name on the form.
words.ex_cn: 请在表格上写下你的全名。
words.en: The complete name of a person, including their first name and surname, and sometimes any middle names.

words.tr: phrase. 抓住；掌握；得到；找到某人
words.ex: He tried to get hold of the rope.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抓住那根绳子。
words.en: To obtain something or to contact someone.

words.ex: There are roughly 100 students in the class.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级大约有100名学生。
words.en: In a manner that is not exact or detailed; approximately.

words.tr: phrase. 叫（某人）进来；召来；来访
words.ex: He called in a doctor for his sick son.
words.ex_cn: 他为生病的儿子请了一位医生。
words.en: To request someone's presence or participation, especially by telephone.

chapters.name: 真题解析5 T3 S2 介绍学校

words.tr: adj. 身体的；物质的；物理的；外观的；
words.ex: He has a physical injury from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在这次事故中受了身体上的伤。
words.en: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind; relating to things that can be seen or touched, as opposed to things that are abstract or imaginary.

words.ex: He showed great capability in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题上展现了很强的能力。
words.en: The ability or qualities necessary to do something.

words.ex: He wants to study engineering at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习工程。
words.en: Engineering is the work involved in designing and constructing engines and machinery, or structures such as roads and bridges. Engineering is also the subject studied by people who want to do this work.

words.ex: He loves geography and learns about countries and rivers.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢地理学，学习各国和河流的知识。
words.en: The study of the physical features of the earth and its atmosphere, and of human activity as it affects and is affected by these, including the distribution of populations and resources, land use, and industries.

words.tr:
n. 一小口；
v. 呷；啜；小口喝；
words.ex: He took a sip of water.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了一小口水。
words.en: To drink something slowly by taking small amounts into your mouth.

words.tr: n. 参考；提及；介绍信；引用；
words.ex: Please use this book for reference.
words.ex_cn: 请使用这本书作为参考。
words.en: A reference is a mention of something or someone, or a letter or statement about someone's character or abilities.

words.ex: Please move along the hallway to the door.
words.ex_cn: 请沿着走廊向门移动。
words.en: To continue to move forward or to proceed.

words.tr:
n. 电话；
v. 打电话；
words.ex: I lost my phone yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天丢了电话。
words.en: A phone is a piece of equipment that you use to talk to someone who is in another place.

words.tr:
n. 担忧；关注；
v. 涉及；
words.ex: His main concern is his child's safety.
words.ex_cn: 他主要的担忧是孩子的安全。
words.en: If something concerns you, it worries you or causes you to feel anxious.

words.ex: The norm in this school is to arrive on time.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校的准则就是准时到校。
words.en: A norm is an official standard or level that organizations are expected to reach.

words.tr: v. 调整；使适合；使适应；
words.ex: He adjusted the chair to sit comfortably.
words.ex_cn: 他调整了椅子以便坐得舒服。
words.en: To adjust something means to change it so that it is more effective or appropriate, or so that it fits better.

words.tr: n. 需优先考虑的事；优先权；
words.ex: Homework is my top priority.
words.ex_cn: 作业是我最需要优先考虑的事。
words.en: If something is a priority, it is the most important thing you have to do or deal with, or must be done or dealt with before everything else you have to do.

words.ex: This book belongs to the science category.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于科学类别。
words.en: A category is a class or group of things that have similar characteristics.

words.ex: He will sort out his books tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会整理好他的书。
words.en: To sort something out means to organize or arrange it, or to solve a problem or difficulty.

words.ex: Please pay in advance.
words.ex_cn: 请提前付款。
words.en: Before a particular time, or before doing a particular thing.

words.tr: phrase. 及时地；提早；在适当的时候
words.ex: We arrived in good time for the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 我们及时到达，赶上了会议。
words.en: If something is done in good time, it is done early or with enough time to spare, often so that there is no need to hurry.

words.tr: phrase. 考虑到；体谅；为…留有余地
words.ex: The teacher makes allowance for students who are late because of traffic.
words.ex_cn: 老师会考虑到因交通堵塞而迟到的学生。
words.en: To take into consideration when making a judgment or decision.

words.ex: The map shows geographical features like mountains and rivers.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图显示了山脉和河流等地貌特征。
words.en: Relating to the study of the physical features of the earth and its atmosphere, and of human activity as it affects and is affected by these, including the distribution of populations and resources, land use, and industries.

words.ex: The teacher gave an assessment of the students' work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作品进行了评估。
words.en: An assessment is a judgment about something, especially about how good or bad it is, or an amount that is calculated for something, especially for tax purposes.

words.ex: He loves science and reads books about it.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢科学，经常读关于它的书。
words.en: Science is the study of the nature and behaviour of natural things and the knowledge that we obtain about them.

words.tr: phrase. 推销说辞；游说；推销话术
words.ex: The salesperson used persuasive sales talk to close the deal.
words.ex_cn: 销售人员使用有说服力的销售说辞达成了交易。
words.en: A sales talk is a persuasive speech or conversation aimed at convincing someone to buy a product or service.

words.ex: The hold-up at the bank lasted only five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 银行的抢劫只持续了五分钟。
words.en: A hold-up is a situation in which someone is threatened with a weapon in order to make them hand over money or valuables, or a delay in something happening.

words.ex: We should keep in touch even after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 我们毕业后也应该保持联系。
words.en: To maintain communication or contact with someone, especially after not seeing them for a period of time.

words.ex: He devised a new way to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他设计了一种解决这个问题的新方法。
words.en: To devise something means to plan or invent a new way of doing something.

words.tr: v. 保持联络；做联系人；
words.ex: The manager liaises with the suppliers every week.
words.ex_cn: 经理每周与供应商保持联络。
words.en: To liaise means to act as a link to assist communication and cooperation between people or groups, especially in a professional context.

words.tr:
adj. 糟糕的；可怕的；
adv. 非常；极其；
words.ex: The weather today is awful.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气很糟糕。
words.en: If you say that something is awful, you mean that it is extremely unpleasant, shocking, or bad.

words.tr: phrase. 需要一段时间；花费一些时间
words.ex: It will take a while to finish this homework.
words.ex_cn: 完成这份作业需要一些时间。
words.en: If something takes a while, it takes a long time.

words.ex: He hurt his body while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤到了身体。
words.en: The physical structure of a person or an animal, including the bones, flesh, and organs.

words.ex: The allocation of funds is decided by the committee.
words.ex_cn: 资金的分配由委员会决定。
words.en: An allocation is an amount of something, especially money, that is given to a particular person or used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The car exceeded the speed limit.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车超过了限速。
words.en: To be greater in quantity, degree, or intensity than something else.

words.tr: phrase. 抢购； 匆匆吃下； 抢先弄到手
words.ex: People snapped up the discounted shoes quickly.
words.ex_cn: 人们迅速抢购了打折的鞋子。
words.en: To buy something quickly and eagerly, often because it is cheap or in limited supply.

words.ex: The agency helps people find jobs.
words.ex_cn: 这个机构帮助人们找工作。
words.en: An agency is a business which provides a service on behalf of other businesses.

words.ex: He spoke at the meeting on my behalf.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上代表我发言。
words.en: If you do something on someone's behalf, you do it for that person as their representative.

words.ex: The audience clapped loudly after the show.
words.ex_cn: 演出结束后，观众热烈鼓掌。
words.en: The group of spectators at a public event; listeners or viewers collectively, especially those attending a performance or reading a particular work.

chapters.name: 真题解析5 T3 S3 课程评价

words.ex: The teacher gave me feedback on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我关于我作文的反馈。
words.en: Feedback is comments in the form of opinions about and reactions to something, intended to provide useful information for future decisions and development.

words.ex: Good communication helps people understand each other.
words.ex_cn: 良好的交流有助于人们相互理解。
words.en: The imparting or exchanging of information by speaking, writing, or using some other medium.

words.tr:
n. 轮廓；纲要；
v. 描画轮廓；概述；
words.ex: The artist drew the outline of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家画出了山的轮廓。
words.en: An outline is a line that shows or forms the outer edge of something, or a general description or plan showing the essential features of something but not the detail.

words.tr:
adj. 死的；
n. 死人；
adv. 完全地；
words.ex: The dead bird lay on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 那只死鸟躺在地上。
words.en: No longer alive; deprived of life.

words.tr: 短语. 大量的；一大堆（用于强调数量之多）
words.ex: He has a whole load of homework to finish.
words.ex_cn: 他有一大堆作业要完成。
words.en: A large amount or number of something.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 沿着航线；按既定路线；朝着某个方向
words.ex: The ship is on a course toward the island.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船正沿着航线驶向岛屿。
words.en: In the process of following a planned series of educational or training activities, or moving in a particular direction.

words.tr: phrase. 关键文本；核心文本；主要文本
words.ex: The key text in this article is the part that discusses the main argument.
words.ex_cn: 这篇文章的关键文本是讨论主要论点的部分。
words.en: The main or most important part of a written text, often highlighted or summarized.

words.ex: The course code is MATH101.
words.ex_cn: 这门课的课程代码是MATH101。
words.en: A unique identifier for a specific educational course, often used in registration systems.

words.ex: Gosh, I forgot my keys again!
words.ex_cn: 天哪，我又忘了带钥匙！
words.en: used to express surprise or emphasis

words.tr: n. 一段时间；会议；会期；开庭；学年；
words.ex: We had a long session of studying together.
words.ex_cn: 我们一起学习了一段时间。
words.en: A session is a meeting of a court, parliament, or other official group, or a period of time used for a particular activity, especially by a group of people.

words.ex: All of a sudden, the dog started barking.
words.ex_cn: 突然间，狗开始叫了。
words.en: If something happens all of a sudden, it happens quickly and unexpectedly.

words.tr: phrase. 课程传递；教学方式；课程交付方式
words.ex: The course delivery was clear and easy to follow.
words.ex_cn: 课程传递清晰且易于理解。
words.en: The manner in which educational content is provided to students.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a handout about photosynthesis.
words.ex_cn: 老师发给我们一份关于光合作用的讲义。
words.en: A handout is a document which contains news or information about something and which is given, for example, to journalists or to people attending a talk or lecture.

words.tr:
n. 保护区；储备；保留；
v. 预订；
words.ex: The wildlife reserve is home to many endangered animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个自然保护区是许多濒危动物的家园。
words.en: If you reserve something such as a table, ticket, or magazine, you arrange for it to be kept for you and not given to anyone else.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a math assignment.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一份数学作业。
words.en: An assignment is a task or piece of work that you are given to do, especially as part of your job or studies.

words.tr: n. 标准；尺度；准则；“criterion”的复数；
words.ex: The main criteria for selection are skill and experience.
words.ex_cn: 选择的主要标准是技能和经验。
words.en: A criterion is a standard or principle by which something is judged or decided.

words.ex: The exam was stressful for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这次考试对所有学生来说压力很大。
words.en: If a situation or experience is stressful, it makes you feel worried and tense because of difficulties or problems.

chapters.name: 真题解析5 T3 S4 废物回收

words.tr:
n. 计划；方案；项目；课题；
v. 投射；预计；
words.ex: He presented his school project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的学校计划。
words.en: A project is a piece of work that is planned or intended, or a large piece of work that is done by a group of people.

words.ex: We recycle plastic bottles every week.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周回收塑料瓶。
words.en: To recycle means to process used materials so that they can be used again.

words.tr:
n. 目标；对象；
v. 以…为目标；
words.ex: His target is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: A target is something at which someone is aiming a weapon or other object.

words.ex: The factory reduces emission to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 工厂减少排放以保护环境。
words.en: An emission is the production and discharge of something, especially gas or radiation.

words.ex: Farmers grow tomatoes in a greenhouse.
words.ex_cn: 农民在温室里种植番茄。
words.en: A greenhouse is a building with glass walls and roof; for the cultivation and exhibition of plants under controlled conditions.

words.ex: The incineration plant burns trash to make energy.
words.ex_cn: 焚烧车间焚烧垃圾以产生能源。
words.en: A facility designed for the combustion of waste materials to reduce their volume and produce energy.

words.ex: The sales had a sudden drop-off last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月销售额急剧下降。
words.en: A drop-off is a decrease in the amount, level, or number of something, or a place where something or someone is left.

words.ex: Please remove the trash from the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 请把厨房的垃圾去掉。
words.en: To take something or someone away from a place or off a surface.

words.tr: adv. 古怪地；怪异地；反常地；
words.ex: He dressed oddly for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着古怪地去参加派对。
words.en: In a manner that is strange or unusual.

words.ex: The boat is made of fiberglass.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船是用玻璃纤维制成的。
words.en: A material consisting of extremely fine filaments of glass that are combined in yarn and woven into fabrics, used in textiles and for insulation and reinforcement of plastics.

words.ex: The water goes through filtration to remove dirt.
words.ex_cn: 水经过过滤以去除杂质。
words.en: The process of passing a liquid through a filter to remove solid particles or other impurities.

words.ex: The air conditioner keeps the room cool.
words.ex_cn: 空调使房间保持凉爽。
words.en: A conditioner is a substance that you put on your hair after you have washed it to make it softer.

words.tr: n. 替代选择；替代选择（alternative 的复数）；
words.ex: We need to find better alternatives to plastic.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要找到比塑料更好的替代选择。
words.en: An alternative is something that you can choose to do or use instead of something else.

words.ex: They had a bumper harvest this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年他们获得了异常大的收成。
words.en: A bumper is a bar at the front and back of a vehicle that reduces damage if the vehicle hits something.

words.ex: The police discovered a scheme to steal money.
words.ex_cn: 警方发现了一个偷钱的阴谋。
words.en: A scheme is a plan or arrangement, especially one produced by a government or other organization, or a secret plan to do something, especially something illegal or dishonest.

words.ex: The cup is made of polystyrene.
words.ex_cn: 这个杯子是用聚苯乙烯制成的。
words.en: Polystyrene is a synthetic aromatic hydrocarbon polymer made from the monomer styrene. Polystyrene can be solid or foamed. General-purpose polystyrene is clear, hard, and brittle. It is a very inexpensive resin per unit weight.

words.ex: Can you sum up the total cost?
words.ex_cn: 你能合计一下总费用吗？
words.en: If you sum something up, you briefly describe the main features or ideas of it.

words.tr:
n. 家庭；
adj. 家庭的；
words.ex: This household has three children.
words.ex_cn: 这个家庭有三个孩子。
words.en: A household is all the people in a family or group who live together in a house.

words.tr:
n. 震惊；冲击；电击；震动；
v. 使震惊；使震动；
words.ex: The news of his death was a shock to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他去世的消息让所有人都感到震惊。
words.en: A shock is a sudden, unexpected event or piece of news that causes a strong emotional reaction.

words.ex: Plants take in carbon dioxide from the air.
words.ex_cn: 植物从空气中吸收二氧化碳。
words.en: Carbon dioxide is a gas that is produced when people and animals breathe out, or when carbon is burned in the air. It is used by plants in photosynthesis.

words.tr: phrase. 原生材料；未经使用或加工的原材料
words.ex: The factory uses virgin material to make new plastic bottles.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂使用原始材料来制造新的塑料瓶。
words.en: Virgin material refers to raw materials that have not been previously used or processed, often implying purity and high quality.

words.ex: The city closed the old landfill site last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这座城市关闭了旧的垃圾填埋场。
words.en: A landfill site is a place where waste materials are buried in the ground.

words.ex: A problem came up during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议期间发生了一个问题。
words.en: To arise or occur, especially unexpectedly or as a subject of discussion.

words.tr:
n. 包；捆
v. 捆成大包
words.ex: He tied the hay into a bale.
words.ex_cn: 他把干草捆成一捆。
words.en: A bale is a large quantity of something such as hay, paper, wool, or cloth that has been tied tightly into a rectangular shape.

words.tr: v. 变坚韧；变顽强；变强硬；变困难
words.ex: The leather will toughen as it dries.
words.ex_cn: 皮革干燥后会变得坚韧。
words.en: To toughen someone or something means to make them stronger or more able to deal with difficult conditions or situations.

words.tr:
n. 进口；重要性；
v. 进口；
words.ex: The country increased its import of oil last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这个国家增加了石油的进口。
words.en: To bring in (goods or services) from a foreign country for sale or use.

words.tr:
n. 制造；
v. （用机器大量）制造；虚构；捏造；
words.ex: The manufacture of cars needs many workers.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的制造需要很多工人。
words.en: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory, usually in large quantities.

words.ex: He bought new stationery for school.
words.ex_cn: 他为学校买了新的文具。
words.en: Stationery refers to the materials used for writing, such as paper, pens, and envelopes.

words.tr:
v. 禁止；
n. 禁止；
words.ex: The school bans phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: If there is a ban on something, it is not allowed. If something is banned, it is not allowed to be done, shown, or used.

words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能处理困难的问题。
words.en: To deal with something means to take action in order to achieve something or in order to solve a problem.

words.ex: She put the apples in a plastic container.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果放进了一个塑料容器里。
words.en: A container is something such as a box or bottle that is used to hold or store things in.

words.ex: He vends fresh fruit on the street corner.
words.ex_cn: 他在街角叫卖新鲜水果。
words.en: To sell or offer for sale to the public.

words.ex: He bought a polycup for his children to share drinks.
words.ex_cn: 他为孩子们买了一个多杯来分享饮料。
words.en: A disposable cup made from polystyrene or similar plastic material.

chapters.name: 真题解析5 T4 S1 寄宿家庭咨询与申请

words.tr: phrasal verb. 为某人安排（约会、工作等）；给某人提供（某物）
words.ex: She fixed me up with a job interview at her company.
words.ex_cn: 她为我安排了在她公司的工作面试。
words.en: To arrange or provide something for someone, especially something that they need or want.

words.tr:
n. 地址；演讲；
v. 解决；向…讲话；
words.ex: Please write your address on the form.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的地址写在表格上。
words.en: The particulars of the place where someone lives or an organization is situated; a formal speech delivered to an audience.

words.tr: n. 扩展；延长期；延伸；电话分机；
words.ex: The company added an extension to its office building.
words.ex_cn: 公司为办公楼加了一个扩建部分。
words.en: An extension is a part that is added to something to make it longer or larger, or the act of adding this part.

words.tr:
n. 许可证；
v. 允许；准许；
words.ex: He showed his fishing permit to the officer.
words.ex_cn: 他向官员出示了他的钓鱼许可证。
words.en: If someone permits something, they allow it to happen. If they permit you to do something, they allow you to do it.

words.ex: The occupation of the city by foreign troops lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 外国军队对这座城市的占领持续了多年。
words.en: An occupation is a job or profession, or a way of spending your time.

words.tr: adj. 先进的；高级的； v. 提前；前进；“advance”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: This school uses advanced technology in classrooms.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校在教室里使用先进的技术。
words.en: An advanced system, method, or design is modern and has been developed from an earlier version of the same thing.

words.ex: He is an intermediate student in English.
words.ex_cn: 他是英语的中级学生。
words.en: An intermediate stage, level, or position is one that occurs between two other stages, levels, or positions.

words.tr:
adj. 特指的；特殊的；挑剔的；
n. 细节；详情；
words.ex: He wants a particular book, not any other.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一本特指的书，不是别的。
words.en: You use particular to emphasize that you are talking about one thing or one kind of thing rather than other similar ones.

words.tr:
n. 素食者；食草动物；
adj. 素食者的；素菜的；
words.ex: He is a vegetarian and doesn't eat meat.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名素食者，不吃肉。
words.en: A vegetarian is someone who does not eat meat or fish, and sometimes other animal products, especially for moral, religious, or health reasons.

words.tr: n. 设施；特色功能；特定场所；资质；
words.ex: The school has a new sports facility.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有一个新的体育设施。
words.en: A facility is a place, building, or service that is designed for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 套房的；连带浴室的（通常指卧室配有独立浴室）
words.ex: The room has an en suite bathroom.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有一个内设浴室。
words.en: An en suite bathroom is a bathroom that is directly connected to a bedroom.

words.ex: They will move in next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们下周搬进来。
words.en: To begin living in a new home or place.

words.ex: The trip takes approximately 30 minutes.
words.ex_cn: 这段旅程大约需要30分钟。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is close to the actual, but not completely accurate or exact.

chapters.name: 真题解析5 T4 S2 足球俱乐部会议上的发言

words.ex: He plays soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末踢足球。
words.en: Soccer is a game played between two teams of eleven players who try to score by kicking or heading a ball into the opposing team's goal.

words.ex: Spring is a beautiful season.
words.ex_cn: 春天是一个美丽的季节。
words.en: A season is one of the four periods of the year: spring, summer, autumn, or winter. It can also refer to a period of the year characterized by particular conditions of weather, temperature, etc., or a period of the year when a particular sport is played.

words.ex: There is strong competition between the two companies.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司之间竞争激烈。
words.en: Competition is a situation in which two or more people or groups are trying to get something which not everyone can have.

words.tr:
n. 野餐；
v. 去野餐；
words.ex: We had a picnic in the park on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日去公园野餐了。
words.en: A picnic is a meal eaten outdoors, especially in the countryside, usually as part of a trip or outing.

words.tr: phrase. 颁奖；奖品颁发仪式
words.ex: The school held a grand presentation of prizes to honor the outstanding students.
words.ex_cn: 学校举行了一场盛大的颁奖仪式，以表彰优秀学生。
words.en: The act of formally giving awards or prizes to the winners in a ceremony.

words.tr: phrase. 训练课程；培训场次
words.ex: The team has training sessions every Monday and Wednesday.
words.ex_cn: 球队每周一和周三有训练课。
words.en: Training sessions are periods of instruction or practice in a particular skill or field of knowledge, typically provided by an expert to a group of people.

words.ex: The committee meets every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 委员会每周一开会。
words.en: A committee is a group of people who are chosen to do a particular job or make decisions on behalf of a larger group.

words.ex: The president signed the new contract.
words.ex_cn: 总裁签署了新合同。
words.en: The president is the elected head of a republic or the head of a company or organization.

words.ex: The treasurer keeps the club's money safe.
words.ex_cn: 司库保管俱乐部的钱。
words.en: A treasurer is an official who is responsible for the money and accounts of an organization.

words.ex: He paid the fee to join the club.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了加入俱乐部的费用。
words.en: A fee is a sum of money that you pay to be allowed to do something such as join an organization, or to be given advice or a service.

words.ex: The gym has new exercise equipment.
words.ex_cn: 健身房有新的健身设备。
words.en: The necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
n. 志愿者；
v. 自愿做；
words.ex: He is a volunteer at the local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他是当地医院的一名志愿者。
words.en: A volunteer is someone who does work without being paid for it, especially work that involves helping people.

words.tr: n. 时事通讯；业务通讯；简报
words.ex: He reads the weekly newsletter every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一都读这份周刊。
words.en: A newsletter is a regularly distributed publication that is generally about one main topic of interest to its subscribers.

words.tr: adv. 定期地；经常地；有规律地；
words.ex: He visits his grandparents regularly.
words.ex_cn: 他定期去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: At consistent intervals or in a consistent manner.

words.ex: The head coach leads the team every day.
words.ex_cn: 主教练每天带领球队。
words.en: The head coach is the main coach of a sports team, responsible for making strategic decisions, training players, and leading the team during games.

words.ex: We served refreshments after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议后我们提供了茶点。
words.en: Light snacks and drinks served to guests or participants at an event.

chapters.name: 真题解析5 T4 S3 师生讨论商业案例

words.tr: phrase. 个案研究；案例分析；调查研究
words.ex: He did a case study on a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于小企业的案例研究。
words.en: A case study is a detailed examination of a particular case or situation, especially in order to understand its complexities or to test a theory.

words.tr: phrase. 考试评估；对考试表现的评定
words.ex: The exam assessment showed that the majority of students had performed well.
words.ex_cn: 考试评估显示，大多数学生表现良好。
words.en: A formal evaluation of knowledge or skills, typically through written or practical tests.

words.ex: Can you summarise the story in one sentence?
words.ex_cn: 你能用一句话总结这个故事吗？
words.en: If you summarise something, you give a summary of it.

words.tr: phrase. 接受（意见、建议等）；让（某人）上船/飞机/车；考虑并采纳
words.ex: He did not take the advice on board.
words.ex_cn: 他没有采纳这个建议。
words.en: To accept or consider a suggestion, idea, or piece of advice.

words.ex: The company launched a new advertising campaign last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司上个月推出了一项新的广告活动。
words.en: A planned series of advertisements intended to achieve a particular aim.

words.tr: phrase. 在...之上；加之；紧接着
words.ex: The book is on top of the table.
words.ex_cn: 书在桌子上面。
words.en: In addition to; in control of or fully informed about something.

words.tr: adj. 即刻的；立即的；紧接的；最近的；
words.ex: He needs immediate help.
words.ex_cn: 他需要即刻的帮助。
words.en: An immediate action, event, or situation happens or exists without any delay.

words.ex: There is strong competition between the two companies.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司之间竞争激烈。
words.en: Competition is a situation in which two or more people or groups are trying to get something which not everyone can have.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 开始认真处理（问题或困难情况）；着手解决
words.ex: It's time to get to grips with the problem.
words.ex_cn: 是时候决定性地处理这个问题了。
words.en: to begin to deal with or understand something seriously

words.ex: The project was stalled by unexpected technical difficulties.
words.ex_cn: 项目因意外的技术困难而停滞。
words.en: To be delayed or hindered by something.

words.ex: The bank raised interest rates last month.
words.ex_cn: 银行上个月提高了利率。
words.en: The cost of borrowing money or the return for lending money, typically expressed as an annual percentage of the principal.

words.ex: The invention is credited to Thomas Edison.
words.ex_cn: 这项发明归功于托马斯·爱迪生。
words.en: If something is credited to someone, it is believed that they have achieved it or are responsible for it.

words.tr: phrase. 有利的条件；优惠的条款
words.ex: He got favourable terms on his loan.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了有利的贷款条件。
words.en: Conditions or terms that are advantageous or beneficial to one party in a negotiation or agreement.

words.ex: He was cautious when crossing the busy street.
words.ex_cn: 他过繁忙的街道时很小心。
words.en: If you are cautious, you are careful and avoid taking risks.

words.ex: I assume it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我假定明天会下雨。
words.en: If you assume that something is true, you accept that it is true without proof.

words.tr: adj. 急剧的；引人注目的；戏剧（性）的；
words.ex: There was a dramatic increase in temperature yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天温度急剧上升。
words.en: If something is dramatic, it happens or changes suddenly and noticeably.

words.tr: phrase. 一个简单的解决方法
words.ex: It turned out to be a simple fix for the problem.
words.ex_cn: 结果证明这是解决问题的简单修复方法。
words.en: A straightforward solution or repair that requires minimal effort or resources.

words.tr: phrase. 沉没；死；屈服；失败；破产
words.ex: The boat went under after hitting the rock.
words.ex_cn: 船撞上岩石后沉没了。
words.en: To fail, collapse, or be defeated; to sink or submerge.

words.tr: adj. 固有的；内在的；本身的；
words.ex: Honesty is an intrinsic part of her character.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是她性格中固有的部分。
words.en: belonging to a thing by its very nature

words.tr: adj. 革新的；富有革新精神的；
words.ex: The company made an innovative phone.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司推出了一款革新的手机。
words.en: Something that is innovative is new and original, especially in the way that it is done.

words.tr: phrase. 必然的结果；早已注定的结局
words.ex: The outcome of the game was a foregone conclusion.
words.ex_cn: 比赛的结果是预料之中的。
words.en: A foregone conclusion is a result that is obvious to everyone even before it happens.

words.ex: He watches the stock market every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天观看股市。
words.en: The stock market is a place where shares in companies are bought and sold.

words.tr: phrase. 现实的期望；切合实际的期待
words.ex: He has realistic expectations about his job.
words.ex_cn: 他对工作有现实的期望。
words.en: Realistic expectations refer to the anticipation of outcomes that are achievable and practical, considering the actual circumstances and limitations.

words.tr:
v. 启动；开始
n. 启动；开始
words.ex: The company decided to kick-start the project with additional funding.
words.ex_cn: 公司决定用额外的资金来启动这个项目。
words.en: To start something quickly or forcefully, especially a process or project.

words.ex: He ran fast to come up with the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: If you come up with a plan, idea, or solution, you think of it and suggest it.

chapters.name: 真题解析5 T4 S4 对大学图书馆的介绍

words.ex: The teacher gave me guidance on how to write the essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我写论文的指导。
words.en: Guidance is help and advice that is given to someone about their work, education, or personal life.

words.tr: phrase. 有导游的观光旅游
words.ex: We took a guided tour of the museum.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了博物馆的导览。
words.en: A guided tour is a tour of a place that is led by a guide who provides information about the place.

words.tr:
v. 使混乱；使糊涂；胡乱应付
n. 混乱；糊涂
words.ex: He muddled the instructions and got confused.
words.ex_cn: 他把说明搞混了，感到困惑。
words.en: If you muddle things or people, you get them mixed up, so that you do not know which is which.

words.tr: phrase. 懂电脑；电脑操作技术
words.ex: He is computer literate and can use Excel well.
words.ex_cn: 他懂电脑，能很好地使用Excel。
words.en: Having sufficient knowledge and skill to be able to use computers and related technology efficiently.

words.tr:
n. 轮廓；纲要；
v. 描画轮廓；概述；
words.ex: The artist drew the outline of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家画出了山的轮廓。
words.en: An outline is a line that shows or forms the outer edge of something, or a general description or plan showing the essential features of something but not the detail.

words.tr: adj. 可获得的；有空的；可用的；
words.ex: The books are available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在图书馆里可以借到。
words.en: If something is available, it is able to be used or obtained.

words.ex: He permanently moved to Canada last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年永久搬到了加拿大。
words.en: In a way that continues or lasts forever without changing.

words.ex: It is debatable whether he is the best player.
words.ex_cn: 他是不是最好的球员是有争议的。
words.en: If you say that something is debatable, you mean that it is not certain whether it is true or right.

words.tr: adj. 至关重要的；批判性的；关键的；危急的；临界的；
words.ex: Water is critical for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you are critical of someone or something, you show that you disapprove of them. In a critical situation, things are very serious and dangerous. A critical time or event is extremely important because it will affect future events.

words.tr: abbr. Modern Language Association (美国)现代语言协会；
words.ex: The paper follows MLA style for citations.
words.ex_cn: 这篇论文遵循现代语言协会的引用格式。
words.en: A style guide for academic writing, especially in the humanities, specifying formatting for citations and papers.

words.tr: phrase. 现代语言协会（美国主要学术组织，制定学术写作与引用格式标准）
words.ex: The Modern Language Association holds an annual conference for scholars in the fields of literature and language.
words.ex_cn: 现代语言协会为文学和语言领域的学者举办年度会议。
words.en: An organization dedicated to the study and teaching of language and literature.

words.tr: adj. 易接近的；可使用的；简单易懂的；可进入的；
words.ex: The park is accessible by bus.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园乘公交车可达。
words.en: If a place or building is accessible to people, it is easy for them to reach it or get into it. If an object is accessible, it is easy to reach.

words.tr: phrase. 使逐步淘汰；逐渐停止
words.ex: The company will phase out old machines next year.
words.ex_cn: 公司明年将逐步淘汰旧机器。
words.en: To gradually stop using or providing something, especially over a period of time.

words.ex: He waited for hours, and eventually got his turn.
words.ex_cn: 他等了几个小时，终于轮到他了。
words.en: At an unspecified later time; in the end.

words.tr: adj. 受限制的；有限的； v. 限制；约束；“restrict”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The children have restricted screen time.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们的屏幕使用时间是受限制的。
words.en: If something is restricted, it is limited or controlled, especially by rules or laws.

words.ex: The supervisor checked the workers' progress.
words.ex_cn: 主管检查了工人们的进展。
words.en: A supervisor is a person who oversees and directs the work of others.

words.ex: The manager oversees the team's daily work.
words.ex_cn: 经理监督团队的日常工作。
words.en: To oversee means to watch and direct a piece of work, the people doing it, or the way it is done in order to ensure that it is done correctly.

words.ex: The induction of the new mayor will be held next Monday.
words.ex_cn: 新市长的就职典礼将在下周一举行。
words.en: Induction is the process or action of inducting someone to a position or organization, or the process of reasoning from specific cases to general rules.

words.tr:
adj. 最初的；开始的；
n. 首字母；
words.ex: This is the initial plan for the project.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个项目的最初计划。
words.en: The first letter of a name or word, used to represent the whole name or word.

words.ex: He wrote his dissertation on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的学位论文。
words.en: A dissertation is a long piece of writing on a particular subject, especially one written for a university degree.

words.ex: This information is relevant to our project.
words.ex_cn: 这些信息与我们的项目相关。
words.en: Something that is relevant to a situation or person is important or significant in that situation or to that person.

words.tr: phrase. 在开头时；从一开始
words.ex: At the outset, he said he would help.
words.ex_cn: 一开始，他说他会帮忙。
words.en: At the beginning of something.

words.ex: He added the bibliography at the end of his report.
words.ex_cn: 他在报告末尾添加了参考书目。
words.en: A bibliography is a list of the books and articles that have been used by someone when writing a particular book or article.

words.tr:
v. 注册；登记；
n. 登记簿；
words.ex: He will register for the course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会注册这门课程。
words.en: If you register something, you officially record it or list it.

chapters.name: 真题解析6 T1 S1 健身中心入会咨询

words.tr: n. 会员资格；全体会员；
words.ex: He paid $50 to get membership of the gym.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了50美元以获得健身房的会员资格。
words.en: Membership is the state of being a member of a group or organization.

words.tr: n. 设施；特色功能；特定场所；资质；
words.ex: The school has a new sports facility.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有一个新的体育设施。
words.en: A facility is a place, building, or service that is designed for a particular purpose.

words.ex: They play tennis on the tennis court every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每星期天在网球场打网球。
words.en: A tennis court is the place where the game of tennis is played.

words.ex: He primarily works as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他主要是一名老师。
words.en: You use primarily to say what is mainly true in a particular situation.

words.tr: n. 羽毛球运动；羽毛球；
words.ex: He plays badminton every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打羽毛球。
words.en: A game played with rackets and a shuttlecock, which is hit back and forth across a high net.

words.ex: I like her, and vice versa.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢她，她也喜欢我。
words.en: Used to indicate that the reverse of what you have said is also true.

words.tr: adj. 保持健康的；健身的
words.ex: She does yoga every morning to keep-fit.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上做瑜伽来保持健康。
words.en: Keep-fit refers to activities or exercises aimed at maintaining or improving physical fitness and health.

words.ex: He practices judo every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午练习柔道。
words.en: A sport of unarmed combat derived from jujitsu and intended to train the body and mind. It involves using holds and leverage to unbalance the opponent.

words.ex: He does yoga every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上做瑜伽。
words.en: Yoga is a Hindu spiritual and ascetic discipline, a part of which, including breath control, simple meditation, and the adoption of specific bodily postures, is widely practiced for health and relaxation.

words.ex: He is a fully-licensed doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名完全持证的医生。
words.en: Having all necessary permissions or licenses to operate legally.

words.ex: You have three options to choose from.
words.ex_cn: 你有三个选项可以选择。
words.en: An option is something that you can choose to do in preference to one or more alternatives.

words.ex: The police discovered a scheme to steal money.
words.ex_cn: 警方发现了一个偷钱的阴谋。
words.en: A scheme is a plan or arrangement, especially one produced by a government or other organization, or a secret plan to do something, especially something illegal or dishonest.

words.tr: adj. 一年一次的；每年的；
words.ex: The school holds an annual sports day.
words.ex_cn: 学校每年举行一次运动会。
words.en: An annual event happens once every year.

words.ex: He pays a monthly subscription for the magazine.
words.ex_cn: 他每月支付杂志的订阅费。
words.en: A subscription is an amount of money that you pay regularly to receive a service or magazine, or to belong to or support an organization.

words.ex: The teacher gave an assessment of the students' work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作品进行了评估。
words.en: An assessment is a judgment about something, especially about how good or bad it is, or an amount that is calculated for something, especially for tax purposes.

words.ex: The instructor explained the math problem clearly.
words.ex_cn: 教员清楚地讲解了这道数学题。
words.en: An instructor is someone who teaches a skill or subject, especially in a college or university, or in a specialized field such as driving or skiing.

words.ex: The doctor ran a trial to test the new medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生进行了试验来测试这种新药。
words.en: A trial is a formal meeting in a law court, at which a judge and jury listen to evidence and decide whether a person is guilty of a crime.

chapters.name: 真题解析6 T1 S2 剧场重开营业的采访

words.tr: n. 重建；再发展；重建发展；
words.ex: The city plans redevelopment of the old downtown.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市计划对旧市中心进行重建。
words.en: The process of improving an area by building new houses, shops, or factories, or by repairing old ones.

words.ex: He waited in the foyer before the show started.
words.ex_cn: 演出开始前，他在门厅里等候。
words.en: A foyer is an area at the front of a building, especially a hotel or theater, where people can wait or meet others.

words.ex: He repainted the old house last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周重新粉刷了那栋老房子。
words.en: To paint something again, especially to give it a new appearance or to cover old paint.

words.ex: The box office closed at 8 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 售票处在晚上8点关闭。
words.en: The box office refers to the office in a theatre, cinema, or concert hall where tickets are sold, or to the amount of money that a film, play, or actor has earned by selling tickets.

words.ex: He reoriented his career toward teaching.
words.ex_cn: 他将职业方向重新确定为教学。
words.en: To change the focus or direction of something.

words.tr:
n. 接触（的机会或权利）；进入；通道；
v. 获取；使用；接近；
words.ex: Students need access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要有接触图书馆的机会。
words.en: If you have access to a building or other place, you are able to enter it or use it.

words.tr: n. （企业或机构使用的）房屋及土地；“premise”的复数；
words.ex: The company owns its premises in the city center.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司拥有位于市中心的房产和土地。
words.en: The buildings and land that a business or organization uses.

words.ex: This shirt is suitable for the party.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫适合这场派对。
words.en: Something that is suitable for a particular person or thing is right or acceptable for them.

words.ex: The audience clapped loudly after the show.
words.ex_cn: 演出结束后，观众热烈鼓掌。
words.en: The group of spectators at a public event; listeners or viewers collectively, especially those attending a performance or reading a particular work.

words.ex: The school concert was held in the auditorium.
words.ex_cn: 学校的音乐会是在礼堂举行的。
words.en: An auditorium is the part of a theatre, concert hall, or other public building in which the audience sits.

words.tr: phrase. （尤指汽车或其他交通工具座位前）伸腿的空间
words.ex: The airplane has little leg room.
words.ex_cn: 这架飞机的腿部空间很少。
words.en: Leg room refers to the amount of space available for a person to stretch their legs, especially in a vehicle or aircraft.

words.ex: The room was stuffy and hard to breathe in.
words.ex_cn: 房间闷热得让人难以呼吸。
words.en: If you describe a place as stuffy, you mean that it is unpleasantly warm and has no fresh air.

words.ex: He uses a wheelchair to move around.
words.ex_cn: 他使用轮椅来移动。
words.en: A wheelchair is a chair with wheels, used by people who cannot walk because of illness, injury, or disability.

words.tr:
v. 举起；提起；抬起；
n. 电梯；搭便车；
words.ex: He lift the box with both hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用双手举起箱子。
words.en: To lift something means to move it to a higher position. A lift is a device that carries people or goods up and down inside buildings.

words.ex: The performer danced on stage with great energy.
words.ex_cn: 这位表演者在舞台上充满活力地跳舞。
words.en: A performer is a person who entertains an audience by acting, singing, dancing, or playing music.

words.tr:
n. 后台；
adv. 在后台；
words.ex: The actors waited backstage before the show.
words.ex_cn: 演员们在演出前在后台等候。
words.en: Behind the scenes in a theater or relating to the private lives of people in the entertainment industry.

words.ex: He converts old paper into new notebooks.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧纸张转换成新笔记本。
words.en: To change something into a different form or to change someone's beliefs, especially their religious beliefs.

words.ex: The room is airy with windows on all sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间四面都有窗户，通风很好。
words.en: If a place or room is airy, it has a lot of fresh air because it is large or has a lot of windows.

words.ex: He uses an electronic book to read.
words.ex_cn: 他用电子书来阅读。
words.en: Electronic means relating to devices or systems that operate by controlling the flow of electrons, especially in a vacuum, gas, or semiconductor.

words.tr: n. 照明；灯光； v. “light”的现在分词；
words.ex: The room has good lighting.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间照明很好。
words.en: The arrangement or type of light in a place.

words.ex: He will install the new software on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他将在他的电脑上安装新软件。
words.en: To set up or fix in position for use or service.

words.tr:
n. 实验；试验；
v. 做试验；进行实验；
words.ex: The boy did a science experiment in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在课堂上做了一个科学实验。
words.en: An experiment is a scientific procedure undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact.

words.ex: She pulled the curtain to block the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 她拉上帷幕以挡住阳光。
words.en: A curtain is a piece of material that hangs down, often used to cover a window or to divide a room.

chapters.name: 真题解析6 T1 S3 课程咨询

words.ex: My tutor helps me with math homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮我做数学作业。
words.en: A tutor is someone who gives private lessons to one pupil or a very small group of pupils.

words.ex: He will enroll in the English course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将注册英语课程。
words.en: To officially register or enlist oneself or someone else in a course, institution, or organization.

words.tr: adj. 兼职的；部分时间的
words.ex: He works part-time at a coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家咖啡店做兼职。
words.en: If someone is a part-time worker or has a part-time job, they work for only part of each day or week.

words.ex: I recommend this book to you.
words.ex_cn: 我向你推荐这本书。
words.en: If someone recommends a person or thing to you, they suggest that you would find them good or useful.

words.ex: He tried to integrate into the new school community.
words.ex_cn: 他试图融入新的学校群体。
words.en: If someone integrates into a social group, or is integrated into it, they behave in such a way that they become part of the group or are accepted into it.

words.tr:
adj. 特指的；特殊的；挑剔的；
n. 细节；详情；
words.ex: He wants a particular book, not any other.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一本特指的书，不是别的。
words.en: You use particular to emphasize that you are talking about one thing or one kind of thing rather than other similar ones.

words.ex: He is presumably at home now.
words.ex_cn: 推测起来，他现在在家。
words.en: If you say that something is presumably the case, you mean that you think it is very likely to be the case, although you are not certain.

words.ex: The students eat lunch in the refectory.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在食堂吃午饭。
words.en: A refectory is a dining hall, especially in a monastery, college, or other institution.

words.ex: He has an allergy to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: An allergy is a condition in which your immune system reacts abnormally to a foreign substance.

words.ex: Please pay in advance.
words.ex_cn: 请提前付款。
words.en: Before a particular time, or before doing a particular thing.

words.tr: adj. 有资格的；合格的；合意的；
words.ex: He is eligible to vote because he is 18 years old.
words.ex_cn: 他年满18岁，有资格投票。
words.en: Someone who is eligible for something is qualified or allowed to do it.

words.ex: The children play at Nursery 796.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在796号托儿所玩耍。
words.en: A nursery is a place where young children are cared for during the day while their parents are at work.

words.ex: The teacher supervises the students during the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 老师在实验期间指导学生。
words.en: If you supervise an activity or a person, you make sure that the activity is done correctly or that the person is doing a task or behaving correctly.

words.tr: adj. 有资格的；合格的； v. 取得资格；“qualify”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is a qualified teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有资格的老师。
words.en: Having the necessary qualifications for a particular job or task.

words.tr:
n. 库存；股票；家畜；
v. 备有；贮存；
words.ex: The store has low stock of winter coats.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店的冬衣库存很少。
words.en: The supply of goods available for sale in a store; the capital raised by a company through the issue of shares.

words.ex: He reads a science journal every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周读一本科学期刊。
words.en: A journal is a newspaper or magazine that deals with a particular subject or professional activity.

words.tr: adj. 视听的；视听教学的
words.ex: The school uses audio-visual tools to teach students.
words.ex_cn: 学校使用视听工具来教学。
words.en: Relating to both hearing and sight, or to equipment and materials used to provide such experiences, especially in education or entertainment.

words.ex: He played his favorite song on a cassette player.
words.ex_cn: 他用盒式磁带播放器播放了他最喜欢的歌。
words.en: A cassette is a small flat case containing a very long strip of magnetic material that is used to record sound or pictures.

words.tr:
adj. 手工的；体力的；
n. 说明书；
words.ex: He made a manual copy of the letter.
words.ex_cn: 他手工抄写了一封信。
words.en: A manual is a book which tells you how to do something or how a piece of machinery works.

words.ex: The company will hire a new manager next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司下周将雇用一位新经理。
words.en: If you hire someone, you employ them or pay them to do a particular job for you.

words.tr: n. 便携式电脑；笔记本电脑；
words.ex: He uses a laptop to work from home.
words.ex_cn: 他用笔记本电脑在家工作。
words.en: A laptop is a computer which is small enough to be carried around easily and is designed for use outside an office.

words.ex: People queue up to buy bread every morning.
words.ex_cn: 人们每天早上排队买面包。
words.en: To form or join a line of people or vehicles waiting for something.

chapters.name: 真题解析6 T1 S4 伦敦东部历史的讲座

words.tr: phrase. 东部地区；（尤指英国伦敦的）东区
words.ex: The East End is known for its vibrant cultural scene.
words.ex_cn: 东区以其充满活力的文化场景而闻名。
words.en: The East End is a district of London, England, east of the City of London and north of the River Thames.

words.tr:
n. 头；脑袋；上端；首脑；
v. 朝…行进；居首位；领导；
adj. 头的；主要的；
words.ex: He hurt his head when he fell.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒时伤到了头。
words.en: The upper part of the human body, or the front or upper part of the body of an animal, typically separated from the rest of the body by a neck, and containing the brain, mouth, and sense organs.

words.ex: The farmer feeds his livestock every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂他的家畜。
words.en: Livestock are animals such as cattle and sheep which are kept on a farm.

words.tr:
v. 喂；吃；
n. 饲养；喂养；
words.ex: She feeds the cat every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喂猫。
words.en: To give food to a person or an animal; to supply something to a machine or a system.

words.ex: The invasion of privacy is a serious problem.
words.ex_cn: 侵犯隐私是一个严重的问题。
words.en: An invasion is an instance of invading a country or region with an armed force.

words.ex: The tribe lives in the forest and follows old traditions.
words.ex_cn: 这个部落住在森林里，遵循古老的传统。
words.en: A tribe is a social division in a traditional society consisting of families or communities linked by social, economic, religious, or blood ties, with a common culture and dialect, typically having a recognized leader.

words.ex: He bought a leather jacket for winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天买了一件皮夹克。
words.en: Leather is a material made from the skin of an animal by tanning or a similar process.

words.ex: The army conquered the small city after a long battle.
words.ex_cn: 军队经过长期战斗征服了这座小城。
words.en: To conquer means to take control of a country or city and its people by force, or to successfully deal with or control something.

words.ex: The city became prosperous after the new factory opened.
words.ex_cn: 新工厂开业后，这座城市变得繁荣了。
words.en: A prosperous person, place, or economy is rich and successful.

words.ex: There is a restriction on smoking in this building.
words.ex_cn: 这栋楼里禁止吸烟。
words.en: A restriction is an official rule that limits what you can do or that limits the amount or size of something.

words.ex: The newcomer joined our class last week.
words.ex_cn: 这个新来的人上周加入了我们的班级。
words.en: A newcomer is a person who has recently arrived in a place or started an activity.

words.ex: The merchant sells fresh fruit every morning.
words.ex_cn: 商人每天早上卖新鲜水果。
words.en: A merchant is a person who buys and sells goods, especially one who owns a shop.

words.ex: The money-lender gave him cash for high interest.
words.ex_cn: 放贷者以高利率借给他现金。
words.en: A money-lender is a person who lends money to others, often at high interest rates.

words.ex: The ship arrived at the dock at sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 船在日出时到达了码头。
words.en: A dock is an enclosed area of water in a port where ships go to be loaded, unloaded, and repaired.

words.tr:
v. 建造；构造；
n. 概念；
words.ex: They construct houses with bricks.
words.ex_cn: 他们用砖块建造房屋。
words.en: To construct something means to build or create it, usually something large such as a building, road, or machine.

words.ex: He waited for hours, and eventually got his turn.
words.ex_cn: 他等了几个小时，终于轮到他了。
words.en: At an unspecified later time; in the end.

words.tr: adv. 跟经济有关地；经济地；
words.ex: The country is developing economically.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在经济上发展。
words.en: In a way that relates to economics or finance; in a way that uses no more of something than is necessary.

words.tr: n. 替代选择；替代选择（alternative 的复数）；
words.ex: We need to find better alternatives to plastic.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要找到比塑料更好的替代选择。
words.en: An alternative is something that you can choose to do or use instead of something else.

words.ex: The birds live in the marshland near the river.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟住在河边的沼泽地里。
words.en: Marshland refers to an area of low-lying land which is flooded in wet seasons or at high tide, and typically remains waterlogged at all times.

words.tr: v. 排水；“drain”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The boys drained the water from the pool.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们把池子里的水排干了。
words.en: If someone is drained, they are extremely tired and have no energy left.

words.ex: The ship arrived at the port at noon.
words.ex_cn: 船在中午到达了港口。
words.en: A port is a place where ships load and unload goods or passengers.

words.ex: Many children suffer from poverty in poor countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多孩子在贫穷国家遭受贫困。
words.en: Poverty is the state of being extremely poor.

words.ex: He suffered from a bad cold last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周患了重感冒。
words.en: To experience something unpleasant, such as injury, pain, or loss.

words.tr: adj. 骇人的； v. “appall”的现在分词；
words.ex: The accident caused an appalling sight.
words.ex_cn: 这场事故造成了一幅骇人的景象。
words.en: If you describe something as appalling, you are emphasizing that it is very bad or unpleasant, and that you find it extremely unacceptable.

words.ex: The kitchen must be sanitary to prevent illness.
words.ex_cn: 厨房必须保持清洁以防止疾病。
words.en: relating to the conditions that affect hygiene and health, especially the supply of sewage facilities and clean drinking water

words.ex: The tenant pays rent every month.
words.ex_cn: 房客每个月支付租金。
words.en: A tenant is a person who rents land or property from a landlord.

words.ex: The landlord fixed the broken window.
words.ex_cn: 房东修好了破掉的窗户。
words.en: A landlord is a person who owns land or property and rents it out to others.

words.ex: The town lost electricity during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴期间，这个城镇停电了。
words.en: A form of energy resulting from the existence of charged particles (such as electrons or protons), either statically as an accumulation of charge or dynamically as a current.

words.tr: n. 含意；可能的影响（或后果）；暗示；
words.ex: The implication of his words was that he was sorry.
words.ex_cn: 他话中的含意是他很抱歉。
words.en: An implication is a possible future effect or result of an action or decision, often one that is not immediately obvious.

words.ex: Eating vegetables gives you good nutrition.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜能提供良好的营养。
words.en: The process of providing or obtaining the food necessary for health and growth.

chapters.name: 真题解析6 T2 S1 关于博物馆营业时间及服务范围的电话咨询

words.tr: n. 工艺；手艺；行业；航空器；
words.ex: The craft of pottery takes years to learn.
words.ex_cn: 陶艺工艺需要多年才能掌握。
words.en: Skill in making things by hand; the skilled practice of a practical occupation; the skilled production of decorative or functional objects.

words.ex: The music accompanies the dance.
words.ex_cn: 音乐伴随舞蹈。
words.en: To go somewhere with someone as a companion or escort; to play a musical accompaniment for.

words.tr:
n. 成人；
adj. 成年的；
words.ex: An adult must pay taxes.
words.ex_cn: 成人必须缴税。
words.en: An adult is a mature, fully developed person. An adult has reached the age when they are legally responsible for their actions.

words.ex: The children explored a dark cavern.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们探索了一个黑暗的洞穴。
words.en: A cavern is a large cave or a large chamber in a cave.

words.tr:
n. 标签；
v. 用标签标明；
words.ex: The bottle has a label with the name of the drink.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子上有一个写着饮料名称的标签。
words.en: A label is a piece of paper, polymer, cloth, metal, or other material affixed to a container or article, on which is written or printed information or symbols about the product or item.

words.tr:
n. 胶；胶水；
v. 粘合；
words.ex: He used glue to stick the paper together.
words.ex_cn: 他用胶把纸粘在一起。
words.en: A sticky substance used for joining things together.

words.ex: She bought new decoration for her living room.
words.ex_cn: 她为客厅买了新的装饰品。
words.en: Decoration is the process or art of decorating something, or the objects used to decorate something.

words.tr: n. 引人注目的人或物；溅污的斑点；
words.ex: The new singer became a splash on the music scene.
words.ex_cn: 这位新歌手成为了音乐界引人注目的人物。
words.en: To cause (a liquid) to scatter in drops or small quantities, especially by striking or moving suddenly; to move or strike so as to cause a liquid to scatter in this way.

chapters.name: 真题解析6 T2 S2 电话咨询火车运营时间

words.ex: He handed out a leaflet about the event.
words.ex_cn: 他分发了一份关于该活动的传单。
words.en: A leaflet is a small sheet of printed paper that gives you information or advertises something.

words.ex: The commuter line was packed with people heading to work.
words.ex_cn: 通勤线路挤满了去上班的人。
words.en: A commuter line is a train or bus service that operates regularly between a city and its suburbs, primarily used by people traveling to and from work.

words.tr: phrase. 餐车（列车上提供简餐和饮料的车厢）
words.ex: The train has a buffet car where you can buy snacks.
words.ex_cn: 这列火车有一个餐车，你可以在那里买零食。
words.en: A buffet car is a carriage on a train where passengers can buy and eat meals and snacks.

words.ex: We served refreshments after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议后我们提供了茶点。
words.en: Light snacks and drinks served to guests or participants at an event.

words.ex: He bought an open ticket to visit his family whenever he can.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张不定期机票，以便随时去看望家人。
words.en: An issue or matter that has not been resolved or closed.

words.tr:
n. 折扣；
v. 不全信；不重视；
words.ex: The store gave a 20% discount on all shoes.
words.ex_cn: 商店对所有鞋子提供了20%的折扣。
words.en: A reduction in the usual price of something, or the act of reducing the price.

words.ex: The movie is fascinating because it shows strange aliens.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极有吸引力，因为它展示了奇怪的外星人。
words.en: If you describe something as fascinating, you find it very interesting and attractive, and your thoughts tend to concentrate on it.

words.ex: We went on an excursion to the mountains last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去山区进行了短途旅行。
words.en: An excursion is a short journey or trip, especially one taken as a leisure activity.

words.ex: The trees surround the house.
words.ex_cn: 树木环绕着房子。
words.en: If something or someone is surrounded by something, that thing is situated all around them.

words.ex: The actor received acclaim for his performance.
words.ex_cn: 这位演员因他的表演而受到赞扬。
words.en: If someone or something is acclaimed, they are praised enthusiastically and publicly.

words.tr: phrase. 攀岩墙；用于攀岩运动的人造墙壁
words.ex: The kids are climbing the wall at the gym.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在健身房爬墙。
words.en: A climbing wall is an artificially constructed wall with grips for hands and feet, used for indoor climbing.

words.tr: n. 水族馆；水族箱；养鱼缸；
words.ex: We visited the aquarium to see the fish.
words.ex_cn: 我们去水族馆看鱼。
words.en: A tank or building in which fish and other water creatures and plants are kept.

words.ex: I anticipate rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我预料明天会下雨。
words.en: If you anticipate an event, you realize in advance that it may happen and you are prepared for it.

chapters.name: 真题解析6 T2 S3 论文

words.ex: He wrote his dissertation on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的学位论文。
words.en: A dissertation is a long piece of writing on a particular subject, especially one written for a university degree.

words.ex: He went to a tutorial to understand math better.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加辅导以更好地理解数学。
words.en: A tutorial is a period of teaching and discussion with a tutor, especially in a British university or college.

words.tr:
n. 目标；对象；
v. 以…为目标；
words.ex: His target is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: A target is something at which someone is aiming a weapon or other object.

words.ex: He did an analysis of the data.
words.ex_cn: 他对数据进行了分析。
words.en: Analysis is the process of considering something carefully or using statistical methods in order to understand it or explain it.

words.tr: phrase. 卡片目录（用于图书馆中按卡片索引图书的系统）
words.ex: He found the book using the card catalogue.
words.ex_cn: 他通过卡片目录找到了这本书。
words.en: A card catalogue is a system for organizing information about the books and other materials in a library, consisting of cards with information on them that are arranged in a particular order.

words.tr:
n. 调查；勘测；
v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did a survey about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了一项关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: A survey is a detailed study or inspection, especially as a means of collecting information about people's opinions or behavior.

words.tr:
n. 纪律；学科；科目；训练；惩戒；
v. 约束自己；
words.ex: The teacher enforced discipline in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师在教室里维持纪律。
words.en: Discipline is the practice of making people obey rules or standards of behaviour, and punishing them when they do not.

words.ex: The bank gave a loan to the student.
words.ex_cn: 银行向学生提供了一笔贷款。
words.en: A loan is a sum of money that you borrow.

words.ex: The statistics show a rise in sales last year.
words.ex_cn: 这些统计数字显示去年销售额有所上升。
words.en: Statistics is a branch of mathematics dealing with the collection, analysis, interpretation, presentation, and organization of data.

words.ex: He wrote a draft of the letter before sending it.
words.ex_cn: 他在发送之前写了这封信的草稿。
words.en: A draft is a preliminary version of a piece of writing, or a current of air in a room or other confined space. It can also refer to the act of selecting someone for a particular purpose or task, especially in sports or the military.

words.ex: He decided to embark on a new career.
words.ex_cn: 他决定从事一份新职业。
words.en: To embark on something means to start it, especially something new, difficult, or exciting.

chapters.name: 真题解析6 T2 S4 关于电影发展史的讲座

words.tr:
n. （马等动物的）蹄
v.  走；步行；以蹄踢（踏）
words.ex: The horse stepped on the rock with its hoof.
words.ex_cn: 马用蹄子踩在石头上。
words.en: The horny part of the foot of an ungulate animal, especially a horse.

words.ex: The horse walked quietly on its hooves.
words.ex_cn: 马用它的蹄子安静地走路。
words.en: The plural of hoof, the hard part of the foot of some animals, such as horses, cows, etc.

words.tr:
v. 奔驰；飞奔
n. 奔驰；飞奔
words.ex: The horse gallops across the field.
words.ex_cn: 马在田野上疾驰。
words.en: If a horse gallops, it runs very fast so that all four legs are off the ground at the same time in each stride.

words.ex: The succession of rain made the ground wet.
words.ex_cn: 连续的雨水使地面变湿了。
words.en: A succession of things of the same kind is a number of them that exist or happen one after the other.

words.tr:
n. 同事；（组织的）会员；家伙；同胞；
adj. 同类的；同事的；
words.ex: He works as a fellow with Dr. Smith in the lab.
words.ex_cn: 他在实验室里与史密斯博士一起工作，是他的同事。
words.en: A fellow is a man or boy. In British English, a fellow is also a member of certain academic societies.

words.ex: The tribe lives in a primitive hut.
words.ex_cn: 这个部落住在原始的小屋里。
words.en: Belonging to a very early period in the history of the world, or to a time before modern things existed.

words.ex: The motion of the ball is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 球的运动非常快。
words.en: The action or process of moving or being moved.

words.tr: phrase. 投影设备；投射装置
words.ex: The teacher uses a projection device to show videos.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用投影仪来播放视频。
words.en: A device used to project images, videos, or other content onto a surface, typically a screen or wall, for viewing by an audience.

words.ex: The children line up to enter the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们排队进入教室。
words.en: To arrange people or things in a row or to arrange for an event or activity to happen.

words.tr:
n. 竞争者；敌手；
v. 竞争；相匹敌；
words.ex: He is my main rival in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他是我在比赛中主要的竞争者。
words.en: A rival is a person, group, or organization that you are competing with in the same activity or the same area.

words.ex: There is a tendency for people to use phones before bed.
words.ex_cn: 人们在睡觉前使用手机是一种趋势。
words.en: A tendency is a likelihood of behaving in a particular way or going in a particular direction, which is often bad or undesirable.

words.tr: n. 紧张；紧张局势；紧张关系；
words.ex: There was tension between the two friends after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 两人争吵后，彼此之间出现了紧张。
words.en: Tension is a feeling of worry and anxiety which makes it difficult for you to relax. It can also refer to the state of being stretched tight or the degree of tightness of a stretched string, wire, etc.

words.ex: He drew a loop with the pencil.
words.ex_cn: 他用铅笔画了一个圈。
words.en: A loop is a shape produced by a curve that bends round and crosses itself, or a piece of wire, string, etc. that has this shape. It can also refer to a repeated sequence of operations or events in a computer program or in a process.

words.ex: The cold water gave her a sudden sensation.
words.ex_cn: 冷水给了她一种突然的感觉。
words.en: A sensation is a physical feeling or a reaction of interest or excitement that something causes in a person or in a group of people.
