words.en: The process by which organic matter decomposes into humus, a dark, nutrient-rich material in soil.

words.tr: phrase. 海洋性气候；受海洋影响显著的气候类型，全年温和湿润，温差较小
words.ex: The island has a marine climate with mild winters.
words.ex_cn: 这个岛屿拥有温和冬季的海洋性气候。
words.en: A marine climate is a climate type that is influenced by the ocean, characterized by small temperature differences between seasons and high humidity.

words.tr: phrase. 山地气候；山区气候（指高海拔地区气温低、气压低、昼夜温差大、降水随地形变化显著的气候类型）
words.ex: The mountain climate is cold and snowy.
words.ex_cn: 山地气候寒冷多雪。
words.en: The climate conditions typical of high altitude areas, characterized by cooler temperatures and often higher precipitation compared to lower elevations.

words.ex: The mountain range is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 这个山脉被雪覆盖着。
words.en: A mountain range is a series of mountains or hills ranged in a line and connected by high ground.

chapters.name: 真题解析7 T2 S1 关于购买汽车保险的问询

words.ex: He bought insurance for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车买了保险。
words.en: Insurance is an arrangement in which you pay money to a company, and they pay money to you if something unpleasant happens to you, for example if your property is stolen or damaged, or if you get a serious illness.

words.ex: We work during the daytime and rest at night.
words.ex_cn: 我们在白天工作，晚上休息。
words.en: The period of the day when there is natural light, from sunrise to sunset.

words.ex: He visits the dentist every six months.
words.ex_cn: 他每六个月去看一次牙医。
words.en: A dentist is a person who is qualified to treat diseases and conditions that affect the teeth and gums, especially the repair and extraction of teeth and the insertion of artificial ones.

words.tr:
n. 模型；模特；模范；型号；
v. 将…做成模型；当模特；
words.ex: The architect built a model of the new building.
words.ex_cn: 建筑师制作了新大楼的模型。
words.en: A model is a person whose job is to wear and show new styles of clothes and other products, or a representation of something, often on a smaller scale, or a particular design or type of product.

words.ex: They have a good relationship with their neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他们和邻居关系很好。
words.en: A relationship is the way in which two or more people or things are connected, or the state of being connected.

words.tr: n. 夫或妻的兄弟；姐夫；妹夫；连襟；姻兄弟
words.ex: My brother-in-law works at a hospital.
words.ex_cn: 我的姐夫/妹夫在医院工作。
words.en: The brother of your husband or wife, or the man who is married to your sister.

words.tr:
v. 引用；报价；
n. 引用；引文；报价；
words.ex: He quoted Shakespeare in his speech.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中引用了莎士比亚的话。
words.en: To repeat or copy out (a group of words from a text or speech), typically with an indication that one is not the original author or speaker.

chapters.name: 真题解析7 T2 S1 词汇拓展

words.ex: He works for an insurance company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家保险公司工作。
words.en: A company that provides insurance policies to individuals or businesses to protect against financial loss.

words.tr: phrase. 保险金额；投保金额
words.ex: The sum insured is $50,000.
words.ex_cn: 保险金额是5万美元。
words.en: The maximum amount that an insurance company will pay under an insurance policy in the event of a loss.

words.ex: The policy-holder paid the insurance fee on time.
words.ex_cn: 保单持有人按时支付了保险费。
words.en: A policy-holder is a person who owns an insurance policy.

words.tr: phrase. 保险的一个分支；保险的某一领域
words.ex: Life insurance is a major branch of insurance.
words.ex_cn: 人寿保险是保险的一个主要类别。
words.en: A specific area or category within the insurance industry that deals with a particular type of risk or coverage.

words.tr: phrase. 风险终止；风险的结束
words.ex: The policy will reach its termination of risk at the end of this month.
words.ex_cn: 这份保单将在本月底达到保险期满。
words.en: The point at which the risk associated with a particular activity or project is considered to be effectively managed or eliminated.

words.tr: phrase. 覆盖范围的文字说明；用于描述某项服务或产品覆盖区域的标注文字
words.ex: The map includes a coverage lettering that explains the service areas.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图包含了一段文字说明，解释了服务范围。
words.en: Text or lettering used to describe or provide information about an insurance policy's coverage.

words.tr: adj. 被保险的； v. 确保；“insure”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The insured car was repaired after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 这辆被保险的车在事故后得到了维修。
words.en: Covered by insurance; a person or entity whose life or property is covered by an insurance policy.

words.tr: adj. 确定的； v. 向…保证；“assure”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was assured that the package would arrive tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他确定包裹明天会到。
words.en: If you are assured of something, you are certain to get it or achieve it.

words.tr:
n. 调查；勘测；
v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did a survey about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了一项关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: A survey is a detailed study or inspection, especially as a means of collecting information about people's opinions or behavior.

words.tr: phrase. 损失通知；向保险公司或相关方提交的正式书面声明，说明已发生损失或损害
words.ex: The policyholder filed a notice of loss after the fire destroyed their home.
words.ex_cn: 在火灾摧毁了他们的房子后，投保人提交了损失通知。
words.en: A formal communication to an insurer informing them of a loss that may be covered under an insurance policy.

words.tr: phrase. 更新；续借；重申；使恢复
words.ex: He will renew his passport next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会更新他的护照。
words.en: To extend the validity period of something, such as a subscription, license, or agreement.

words.ex: The contract was declared null and void after the fraud was discovered.
words.ex_cn: 欺诈行为被发现后，合同被宣布无效。
words.en: If something is null and void, it is considered to have no legal force or effect.

words.tr: phrase. 存款溢价；定金附加费
words.ex: The bank offers a deposit premium for new savings accounts.
words.ex_cn: 银行为新的储蓄账户提供存款溢价。
words.en: A deposit premium is a sum of money paid in advance as a security for the fulfillment of a contract or as a part of the payment for insurance.

words.tr: n. 再保险；再保险金额
words.ex: The company purchased reinsurance to protect against potential losses.
words.ex_cn: 公司购买了再保险以防止潜在的损失。
words.en: Reinsurance is the practice whereby insurers transfer portions of their risk portfolios to other parties by some form of agreement to reduce the likelihood of paying a large obligation resulting from an insurance claim.

words.tr: phrase. 自然损耗；正常损耗
words.ex: The company allowed for a certain amount of natural loss during the transportation of fresh produce.
words.ex_cn: 公司在运输新鲜农产品时允许有一定程度的自然损耗。
words.en: The gradual reduction or depletion of something over time due to natural processes, such as erosion or decay.

words.ex: Natural calamities often cause significant damage to the environment and human lives.
words.ex_cn: 自然灾害通常会对环境和人类生命造成重大破坏。
words.en: Natural calamities refer to catastrophic events caused by natural forces, such as earthquakes, floods, and hurricanes, which can cause significant damage to the environment and human societies.

chapters.name: 真题解析7 T2 S2 景点介绍

words.tr: phrase. 停靠点；停顿处；中止点
words.ex: The bus makes stopping points every five miles.
words.ex_cn: 公交车每五英里设一个停靠点。
words.en: Stopping points refer to specific locations or moments where a pause or halt occurs, often used in the context of travel or processes to indicate places or times for rest, observation, or assessment.

words.ex: The king lives in a big palace.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座巨大的宫殿里。
words.en: A palace is a very large impressive house, especially one which is the official home of a king, queen, or president.

words.ex: His residence is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他的住所靠近公园。
words.en: A residence is a house or place where someone lives.

words.ex: We had a snack and some drinks as refreshment after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议结束后，我们吃了点心和喝了一些饮料作为茶点。
words.en: Refreshment refers to the act of refreshing or the state of being refreshed, especially by food or drink. It can also mean a light meal or drinks served in a social setting.

words.tr:
adj. 贸易的；商业的；
n. 广告；
words.ex: The commercial ship sailed to another country.
words.ex_cn: 这艘贸易船只驶向了另一个国家。
words.en: Commercial relates to the business of buying and selling goods and services.

words.ex: The pond is shallow, so you can see the bottom.
words.ex_cn: 这个池塘很浅，所以你能看到底部。
words.en: If something is shallow, it does not extend far down from the top surface.

words.tr: n. 拱廊；有拱廊的街道；游乐中心
words.ex: The old arcade has stone pillars and a tiled roof.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的拱廊有石柱和瓦片屋顶。
words.en: A covered passage with arches along one or both sides.

words.tr: n. 解说词；评论；实况报道；
words.ex: The commentator gave live commentary during the soccer match.
words.ex_cn: 解说员在足球比赛期间进行了现场解说。
words.en: A commentary is a spoken or written description of an event or situation that is broadcast or published as it occurs.

words.ex: The departure of the train was at 8 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 火车的出发时间是晚上8点。
words.en: The act of leaving a place, especially at the start of a journey.

words.ex: We took a hop-on hop-off bus to see the city.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘坐了一辆可随时上下车的巴士游览城市。
words.en: A hop-on hop-off service is a type of transport service, especially for tourists, that allows passengers to get on and off at various points along a route.

chapters.name: 真题解析7 T2 S2 词汇拓展

words.tr: phrase. 美术馆；艺术博物馆
words.ex: We visited an art museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了一家艺术博物馆。
words.en: An art museum is a building where works of art are displayed to the public.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日参观了一个美术馆。
words.en: A place where works of art are displayed for public viewing.

words.tr: phrase. 植物园；专门用于种植和展示各种植物的园区
words.ex: We walked in the botanical garden and saw many flowers.
words.ex_cn: 我们在植物园里散步，看到了许多花。
words.en: A botanical garden is a place where plants are grown for scientific study and display to the public.

words.tr: n. 历史遗迹；纪念碑；不朽作品；
words.ex: The ancient monument attracts many tourists each year.
words.ex_cn: 这座古代历史遗迹每年吸引许多游客。
words.en: A monument is a large structure, usually made of stone, which is built to remind people of an important person or event.

words.tr: phrase. 公用电话；公共电话亭
words.ex: He found a public telephone to make an urgent call.
words.ex_cn: 他找到一个公共电话来打一个紧急电话。
words.en: A public telephone is a telephone that is available for use by the general public, often located in public places and operated by inserting coins or using a telephone card.

words.tr: phrase. 公共厕所：供公众使用的厕所，通常位于公共场所如公园、商场、车站等地方。
words.ex: The public lavatory was located near the entrance of the park.
words.ex_cn: 公共厕所位于公园入口附近。
words.en: A public lavatory is a toilet that is available for use by the general public, typically located in a public place such as a park, station, or street.

words.ex: The national highway system is crucial for the country's transportation network.
words.ex_cn: 国道系统对国家的交通网络至关重要。
words.en: A main road in a country that is maintained by the national government and connects major cities or regions.

words.ex: The car stopped at the traffic light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红绿灯前停了下来。
words.en: A traffic light is a set of automatically operated coloured lights, typically red, amber, and green, for controlling traffic at road junctions, pedestrian crossings, and roundabouts.

words.tr: n. 营房；兵营；（一片）简陋的大房子
words.ex: The soldiers live in the barracks near the base.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们住在基地附近的兵营里。
words.en: A barracks is a building or group of buildings where soldiers live.

words.ex: He lives in a big metropolis with many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个有很多高楼的大都市里。
words.en: A metropolis is a very large city, often the most important city in a country or area.

words.tr: phrase. 购物中心；商业中心
words.ex: They went to the shopping centre to buy clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他们去购物中心买衣服。
words.en: A shopping centre is a group of shops and other commercial establishments built together on one site, often under one roof.

words.ex: The municipality cleaned the streets last week.
words.ex_cn: 这个自治市上周清理了街道。
words.en: A municipality is a city or town that has its own government to manage local affairs.

words.ex: The municipal library is open every day.
words.ex_cn: 这座市政图书馆每天都开放。
words.en: Relating to a city or town or its governing body.

words.ex: This district has many parks and schools.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有许多公园和学校。
words.en: A district is a part of a city, country, or other area that has been officially designated for a particular purpose, such as administration or business.

words.ex: The new park is in a quiet residential area.
words.ex_cn: 这个新公园位于一个安静的住宅区。
words.en: A residential area is a land use in which housing predominates, as opposed to industrial and commercial areas.

words.ex: The urban area has many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市地区有许多高楼。
words.en: relating to a city or town

words.ex: They live in a quiet suburb outside the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在城市外一个安静的市郊。
words.en: A suburb is a residential district located on the outskirts of a city.

words.ex: They live on the outskirts of the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在城市的郊区。
words.en: The outskirts of a city or town are the parts of it that are farthest away from its center.

words.ex: Many families live in the slum near the city center.
words.ex_cn: 许多家庭住在城市中心附近的贫民窟里。
words.en: A slum is a heavily populated urban area characterized by substandard housing and squalor.

words.tr: n. 以临时搭盖的陋屋为主的地区
words.ex: The shantytown was a stark reminder of the city's poverty.
words.ex_cn: 这个棚户区是城市贫困的鲜明提醒。
words.en: A shantytown is a deprived area on the outskirts of a town consisting of large numbers of shanties.

chapters.name: 真题解析7 T2 S3 关于南极科考的采访

words.tr:
adj. 南极的；
n. 南极地区；
words.ex: The antarctic ice is melting fast.
words.ex_cn: 南极的冰正在迅速融化。
words.en: The Antarctic is the area around the South Pole, characterized by its cold climate and ice-covered landscapes.

words.ex: Penguins live in Antarctica.
words.ex_cn: 企鹅生活在南极洲。
words.en: Antarctica is the Earth's southernmost continent, containing the geographic South Pole. It is situated in the Antarctic region of the Southern Hemisphere, almost entirely south of the Antarctic Circle, and is surrounded by the Southern Ocean.

words.ex: The hotel gave us complimentary breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 酒店免费赠送了我们早餐。
words.en: If something is complimentary, it is given or done free of charge. It can also mean expressing a compliment; praising or approving.

words.ex: He read a historical book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于古罗马的历史书。
words.en: Historical means relating to the study of history or connected with the past.

words.ex: The team went on an expedition to the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这支队伍去山上探险了。
words.en: An expedition is an organized journey that is made for a particular purpose such as exploration.

words.tr: phrase. 科学基地；科学研究基地
words.ex: The research center is a scientific base for space exploration.
words.ex_cn: 这个研究中心是太空探索的科学基地。
words.en: A foundation or basis in science; the fundamental principles or facts on which scientific knowledge is built.

words.tr:
n. 供应；供给；
v. 供给；
words.ex: The city needs a steady supply of water.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市需要稳定的供水。
words.en: If you supply someone with something that they want or need, you give them a quantity of it.

words.ex: The boxes are stored in the warehouse.
words.ex_cn: 这些箱子存放在仓库里。
words.en: A warehouse is a large building where raw materials or manufactured goods may be stored before their export or distribution for sale.

words.ex: He is a specialist in heart surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他是心脏手术方面的专家。
words.en: A specialist is a person who is highly skilled or knowledgeable in a particular field.

words.ex: He joined the air force last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年加入了空军。
words.en: The branch of a nation's armed services that conducts military operations in the air.

words.ex: The movie recreates the battle of Waterloo.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影再现了滑铁卢战役。
words.en: To recreate something means to make it exist or happen again, or to make a copy of something that existed in the past.

words.ex: The atmosphere keeps the Earth warm.
words.ex_cn: 大气使地球保持温暖。
words.en: The atmosphere is the layer of gases surrounding a planet or other material body, held in place by the gravity of the body.

words.tr:
n. 展示优点的场合（或机会）；
v. 展示…的优点；
words.ex: The competition was a showcase for her talent.
words.ex_cn: 这次比赛是她展示才华的机会。
words.en: A showcase is a setting in which someone or something is displayed to its best advantage, or a glass case used for displaying articles in a shop or museum.

words.ex: The two companies showed good cooperation on the project.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司在这个项目上表现出良好的合作。
words.en: Cooperation is the process of working or acting together, which can be seen in many aspects of life, including business, science, and social interactions.

words.tr: adj. 棒极了；令人敬畏的；令人畏惧的；
words.ex: The concert was awesome!
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会棒极了！
words.en: If you describe someone or something as awesome, you are emphasizing that you think that they are very impressive or extraordinary.

words.ex: The sunset over the mountains was magnificent.
words.ex_cn: 山上的日落壮丽极了。
words.en: If you say that something or someone is magnificent, you mean that you think they are extremely good, beautiful, or impressive.

words.ex: Asia is the largest continent.
words.ex_cn: 亚洲是最大的洲。
words.en: A continent is a very large area of land, such as Africa or Asia, that consists of several countries.

words.ex: Two countries signed a treaty to stop the war.
words.ex_cn: 两个国家签署了一项条约以停止战争。
words.en: A treaty is a formal agreement between two or more countries or groups, especially one that is written down and signed by their leaders.

words.ex: He propose to go to the park after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提议午饭后去公园。
words.en: If you propose something, you suggest it as a plan or course of action.

words.ex: The country expanded its territory after the war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在战争后扩大了它的领土。
words.en: An area of land that is controlled by a particular country, ruler, or military force.

words.ex: The school prohibits students from using phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: If a law or someone in authority prohibits something, they forbid it or make it illegal.

words.tr: n. 爆炸；（感情）爆发；激增；
words.ex: The explosion broke all the windows.
words.ex_cn: 爆炸震碎了所有的窗户。
words.en: An explosion is a sudden, violent burst of energy, for example one caused by a bomb.

chapters.name: 真题解析7 T2 S3 词汇拓展

words.ex: The Earth is divided into two hemispheres: north and south.
words.ex_cn: 地球被分为两个半球：北半球和南半球。
words.en: A hemisphere is one half of the earth, especially the northern or southern half above or below the equator, or the eastern or western half.

words.ex: The air feels humid after it rains.
words.ex_cn: 雨后空气感觉湿润。
words.en: You use humid to describe an atmosphere or climate that is very damp, and usually very hot.

words.ex: The hurricane destroyed many houses.
words.ex_cn: 飓风摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A hurricane is an extremely violent wind or storm.

words.tr: phrase. 水文循环；水循环（指水在地球表面、大气和地下之间的连续循环过程）
words.ex: The hydrological cycle is a continuous process that involves the movement of water between the Earth's surface and the atmosphere.
words.ex_cn: 水文循环是一个持续的过程，涉及水在地球表面和大气之间的运动。
words.en: The hydrological cycle, also known as the water cycle, is the continuous process by which water is circulated throughout the Earth and its atmosphere by evaporation, condensation, precipitation, and transpiration.

words.ex: The icecap on the mountain is melting slowly.
words.ex_cn: 山上的冰帽正在缓慢融化。
words.en: An icecap is a large area of ice covering less than 50,000 square kilometers of land area, larger than an ice field but smaller than an ice sheet.

words.tr: adj. 不注意的；疏忽的；非故意的
words.ex: He made an inadvertent mistake while typing.
words.ex_cn: 他在打字时不小心犯了个错误。
words.en: If something bad is inadvertent, it is done without realizing that it is wrong or that it could have bad consequences.

words.tr: phrase. 工业生产；工业产量
words.ex: The factory increased its industrial production last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂上个月提高了工业产量。
words.en: Industrial production refers to the output of industrial establishments, covering sectors such as manufacturing, mining, and utilities.

words.ex: The industrial revolution changed how people made things.
words.ex_cn: 工业革命改变了人们制造东西的方式。
words.en: The Industrial Revolution was the transition to new manufacturing processes in the period from about 1760 to sometime between 1820 and 1840.

words.ex: The country's industrialization began in the 1950s.
words.ex_cn: 该国的工业化始于20世纪50年代。
words.en: The process by which an economy is transformed from primarily agricultural to one based on the manufacturing of goods. Individual manual labor is often replaced by mechanized mass production, and craftsmen are replaced by assembly lines.

words.tr: adj. 工业化的； v. “industrialize”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The country became industrialized in the 20th century.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在20世纪实现了工业化。
words.en: An industrialized country or area has a lot of industries and factories.

words.ex: The atmosphere keeps the Earth warm.
words.ex_cn: 大气使地球保持温暖。
words.en: The atmosphere is the layer of gases surrounding a planet or other material body, held in place by the gravity of the body.

words.ex: The atmospheric pressure dropped before the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来临前，大气压下降了。
words.en: Relating to the atmosphere of the Earth or another planet; creating a distinctive mood, typically of romance or nostalgia.

words.tr: phrase. 大气温度；指地球大气层中不同高度的气温
words.ex: Atmospheric temperatures have risen significantly in the past century due to global warming.
words.ex_cn: 由于全球变暖，过去一个世纪大气温度显著上升。
words.en: Atmospheric temperatures refer to the temperature of the Earth's atmosphere at various altitudes.

chapters.name: 真题解析7 T2 S4 用手习惯对人在音乐和体育方面的影响

words.tr: n. 用右手或左手的习惯
words.ex: His handedness makes him write with his left hand.
words.ex_cn: 他的惯用手使他用左手写字。
words.en: The tendency to use one hand rather than the other, especially the right hand for most tasks.

words.ex: The relevance of this topic is clear.
words.ex_cn: 这个主题的相关性是明显的。
words.en: The quality or state of being closely connected or appropriate.

words.tr: n. 心理学家；心理学研究者；
words.ex: The psychologist helped the child feel less afraid.
words.ex_cn: 心理学家帮助孩子感觉不那么害怕。
words.en: A psychologist is a person who studies the human mind and human emotions and behaviour, and who uses this knowledge to help people with mental health problems.

words.ex: It was sheer luck that he won the game.
words.ex_cn: 他赢了比赛完全是运气。
words.en: Sheer is used to emphasize that a state or situation is complete and does not involve or is not mixed with anything else.

words.tr: n. 观察；观测；注意；监视；(观察后的）意见；
words.ex: The scientist made an observation about the bird's behavior.
words.ex_cn: 科学家对这只鸟的行为进行了观察。
words.en: The act of noticing or watching something carefully in order to gain information.

words.ex: His insight helped the team solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他的洞察力帮助团队解决了问题。
words.en: If you gain insight or an insight into a complex situation or problem, you gain an accurate and deep understanding of it.

words.ex: He has the capacity to solve hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: The capacity of a place or container is the amount of things or people that it can hold.

words.ex: He is a musician who plays the guitar.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位弹吉他的音乐家。
words.en: A musician is a person who plays a musical instrument, especially as a profession, or is musically talented.

words.ex: A hammer is a useful instrument for building.
words.ex_cn: 锤子是建造时有用的工具。
words.en: An instrument is a tool or device used for a particular task, especially for scientific, medical, or technical work. It can also refer to a musical instrument.

words.ex: The regularity of his daily routine helps him stay focused.
words.ex_cn: 他日常作息的规律性帮助他保持专注。
words.en: The quality or state of being regular; the condition of being governed by or according to rules, principles, or established customs.

words.ex: He will undertake a new project next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将从事一个新项目。
words.en: To undertake a task or job means to start doing it and accept responsibility for it.

words.ex: He types fast on the keyboard.
words.ex_cn: 他打字很快，用的是键盘。
words.en: A keyboard is a panel of keys that operate a computer or typewriter.

words.ex: The proportion of students who passed the test was high.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试的学生比例很高。
words.en: A proportion is a part of a whole, or the relationship of one part to another in terms of size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: He consistently arrives at school on time.
words.ex_cn: 他一贯准时到校。
words.en: In a way that does not vary; in the same way over time.

words.tr: phrase. 查阅；提到；涉及；指的是
words.ex: Please refer to the dictionary for the meaning.
words.ex_cn: 请查阅字典以了解这个词的意思。
words.en: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them.

words.ex: The dominant color in the room is blue.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间占优势的颜色是蓝色。
words.en: Someone or something that is dominant is more powerful, successful, influential, or noticeable than other people or things.

words.ex: The child shows right laterality in writing.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子在写字时表现出右利性。
words.en: Laterality refers to the preference or dominance of one side of the body over the other, especially in the context of brain function and the use of limbs.

words.tr:
n. 反面；对立面；
adj. 对面的；
prep. 与…相对；
words.ex: The opposite of black is white.
words.ex_cn: 黑色的反面是白色。
words.en: If one thing is opposite another, it is on the other side of a space from it.

words.ex: He picked up his hockey stick and prepared to take a shot.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起曲棍球棍，准备射门。
words.en: A hockey stick is a piece of sports equipment used by the players in hockey to move the ball or puck.

words.ex: The ghost is invisible to the human eye.
words.ex_cn: 这个鬼魂肉眼看不见。
words.en: If something is invisible, you cannot see it because it is hidden or because it is very difficult to see.

words.ex: He practices gymnastics every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上练习体操。
words.en: Gymnastics is a sport that involves exercises and movements that require physical strength, flexibility, balance, and control.

words.ex: The predominant color in the room is blue.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的主导颜色是蓝色。
words.en: If something is predominant, it is more important, noticeable, or powerful than the other things in a situation.

chapters.name: 真题解析7 T2 S4 词汇拓展

words.ex: The growth of the plant is slow in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这植物在冬天生长缓慢。
words.en: The process of increasing in physical size, number, value, or strength.

words.ex: The maturation of the fruit takes several weeks.
words.ex_cn: 水果的成熟需要几周时间。
words.en: The process of becoming mature or the state of being mature.

words.ex: The adaptation of animals to cold weather is amazing.
words.ex_cn: 动物对寒冷天气的适应令人惊叹。
words.en: An adaptation is a film, television drama, or stage play that is based on a written work.

words.ex: He made an adjustment to live in the new city.
words.ex_cn: 他做出了适应以适应新城市的生活。
words.en: An adjustment is a small change that is made to something such as a machine or a way of doing something.

words.tr: adj. 先天的；天生的；生性的
words.ex: He was born with a congenital heart problem.
words.ex_cn: 他出生时就有先天性心脏病。
words.en: A congenital disease or condition exists at or from birth.

words.ex: The transition from school to work was hard for him.
words.ex_cn: 从学校到工作的转变对他来说很难。
words.en: The process or a period of changing from one state or condition to another.

words.ex: The necklace is an imitation made of plastic.
words.ex_cn: 这条项链是用塑料做的仿制品。
words.en: An imitation of something is a copy of it.

words.tr: phrase. 本能行为；与生俱来的、不经学习而产生的自然行为
words.ex: Birds exhibit instinctive behavior when they build nests.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在筑巢时表现出本能行为。
words.en: Instinctive behavior refers to actions that are performed without conscious thought, as a result of innate biological factors.

words.ex: He showed habituation to the loud noise after a few days.
words.ex_cn: 几天后，他对巨响产生了习惯。
words.en: Habituation is the process of becoming accustomed to a stimulus or environment through repeated exposure, leading to a decreased response.

words.ex: The two kids stayed in equilibrium on the seesaw.
words.ex_cn: 两个孩子在跷跷板上保持了平衡。
words.en: A state in which opposing forces or influences are balanced.

words.ex: She fondly recalled her babyhood days.
words.ex_cn: 她深情地回忆起她的婴儿时代。
words.en: The period of time when someone is a baby.

words.ex: He remembers his childhood as a happy time.
words.ex_cn: 他记得自己的童年是一段快乐的时光。
words.en: Childhood is the period of a person's life when they are a child.

words.tr: phrase. 学龄前期；幼儿园时期（通常指3至5岁儿童尚未上小学的阶段）
words.ex: The preschool period is crucial for a child's development.
words.ex_cn: 学龄前期对儿童的发展至关重要。
words.en: The preschool period refers to the time in a child's life before they start attending school, typically between the ages of three and five.

words.tr: phrase. 幼年期；青少年时期；未成年阶段
words.ex: The juvenile period is a crucial stage in personal development.
words.ex_cn: 少年期是个人发展中的一个关键阶段。
words.en: The stage in an organism's life cycle that is characterized by growth and development before reaching adulthood.

words.ex: He was shy during his adolescence.
words.ex_cn: 他在青春期时很害羞。
words.en: Adolescence is the period in a person's life when they develop from a child into an adult.

words.ex: He is a genius in math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面是个天才。
words.en: Someone who is a genius is a person who is exceptionally intelligent or talented, especially in a particular field.

words.tr: phrase. 有天赋的儿童；天才儿童
words.ex: The school has a special program for gifted children.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校为天才儿童开设了专门的课程。
words.en: A gifted child is a child who has been born with natural abilities or talents that are significantly above average for their age.

chapters.name: 真题解析7 T3 S1 找兼职工作

words.tr: adj. 可获得的；有空的；可用的；
words.ex: The books are available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在图书馆里可以借到。
words.en: If something is available, it is able to be used or obtained.

words.tr:
v. 注册；登记；
n. 登记簿；
words.ex: He will register for the course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会注册这门课程。
words.en: If you register something, you officially record it or list it.

words.ex: The temperature is 30 degrees today.
words.ex_cn: 今天气温是30度。
words.en: A degree is a unit of measurement for angles, or a qualification given to a student by a college or university after they have completed a course of study.

words.ex: He shows his student card to get a discount.
words.ex_cn: 他出示学生证来获得折扣。
words.en: A card issued by an educational institution to a student, which is used to identify the student and may provide access to certain facilities or services.

words.tr: phrase. 拿掉；离开；起飞；脱下；突然成功
words.ex: Please take off your hat before entering.
words.ex_cn: 进入前请把帽子拿掉。
words.en: If an aircraft, bird, or insect takes off, it leaves the ground and begins to fly.

words.tr: n. 位置；职位；地位；姿势；
words.ex: The book is on the table in a good position.
words.ex_cn: 书放在桌子上的一个好位置。
words.en: A position refers to the place or type of role someone has in a situation, organization, or society, or the way in which someone or something is placed or arranged.

words.tr:
n. 吸引力；上诉；
v. 吸引；诉请；呼吁；
words.ex: The appeal of the beach drew many tourists.
words.ex_cn: 海滩的吸引力吸引了许多游客。
words.en: If you appeal to someone to do something, you make a serious and urgent request to them. If you appeal against a decision or sentence, you formally ask a court or other authority to change it. If something appeals to you, you like it or it interests you.

words.ex: He works in a clerical job at the office.
words.ex_cn: 他在办公室做文书工作。
words.en: Clerical means relating to work that is done in an office, especially work that involves keeping records or accounts. It can also refer to the clergy or the religious leaders of a church.

words.ex: The project involves simple math and writing.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目包括简单的数学和写作。
words.en: If a situation or activity involves something, that thing is a necessary part or consequence of it.

words.tr: phrase. 不挂断；稍等 ；紧紧抓住
words.ex: Hang on, I will be there soon.
words.ex_cn: 等一下，我马上就到。
words.en: To hold onto something tightly; to wait for a short time.

words.ex: I managed to finish my homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我设法在晚饭前完成了作业。
words.en: To manage means to be in charge of or control something, especially a business or a group of people.

words.ex: A problem came up during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议期间发生了一个问题。
words.en: To arise or occur, especially unexpectedly or as a subject of discussion.

words.tr: phrase. 学生宿舍；大学宿舍
words.ex: He lives in the hall of residence near the library.
words.ex_cn: 他住在图书馆附近的宿舍楼里。
words.en: A hall of residence is a building where students live at a university or college.

words.ex: The administrative office handles school records.
words.ex_cn: 行政办公室负责管理学校档案。
words.en: Relating to the management of a company, organization, or institution.

words.ex: The police opened an enquiry into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方对这起事故展开了调查。
words.en: An enquiry is a question you ask in order to get some information.

chapters.name: 真题解析7 T3 S1 词汇拓展

words.ex: He is job hunting after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 他毕业后正在找工作。
words.en: The process of trying to find a job by applying for many different jobs.

words.ex: The waiter brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A waiter is a man who works in a restaurant, serving people with food and drink.

words.ex: The waitress brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 女服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A waitress is a woman who works in a restaurant, serving food and drink to customers.

words.ex: The supervisor checked the workers' progress.
words.ex_cn: 主管检查了工人们的进展。
words.en: A supervisor is a person who oversees and directs the work of others.

words.ex: The boxes are stored in the warehouse.
words.ex_cn: 这些箱子存放在仓库里。
words.en: A warehouse is a large building where raw materials or manufactured goods may be stored before their export or distribution for sale.

words.ex: The hairdresser cut my hair nicely.
words.ex_cn: 理发师给我剪了一头漂亮的头发。
words.en: A hairdresser is a person who cuts, colours, and arranges people's hair, especially women's, as their job.

words.ex: The barber cuts hair every day.
words.ex_cn: 理发师每天剪头发。
words.en: A barber is a person whose job is cutting men's hair and sometimes shaving their beards.

words.tr: n. 要洗的衣物；洗衣店；
words.ex: I put the dirty laundry in the washing machine.
words.ex_cn: 我把脏衣服放进洗衣机里。
words.en: Laundry refers to the clothes and linens that need to be washed or that have just been washed. It can also refer to the place or business where clothes and linens are washed and ironed.

words.ex: He buys milk and bread at the grocery.
words.ex_cn: 他在杂货店买牛奶和面包。
words.en: A grocery is a store where food and small items for the house are sold.

words.ex: The nosh bar near the office is always crowded during lunchtime.
words.ex_cn: 办公室附近的小吃店在午餐时间总是人满为患。
words.en: A place where snacks and light meals are served.

words.tr: phrase. 小卖部：一家出售糖果等小吃的商店，尤其是在或靠近学校的商店。
words.ex: The kids buy sweets from the tuck shop at lunchtime.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在午餐时间从杂货店买糖果。
words.en: A tuck shop is a small store, often found in or near schools, that sells snacks and drinks.

chapters.name: 真题解析7 T3 S2 关于徒步募捐的介绍

words.ex: The charity helps poor children get food and education.
words.ex_cn: 这个慈善团体帮助贫困儿童获得食物和教育。
words.en: An organization that helps people in need, or the act of giving money, food, or help to those who need it.

words.tr:
n. 赞助商；
v. 赞助；
words.ex: The company is a sponsor of the football match.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司是这场足球赛的赞助商。
words.en: A sponsor is a person or organization that pays for or contributes to the costs involved in staging a sporting or artistic event in return for advertising. A sponsor can also be someone who introduces and supports a proposal for a new law.

words.ex: He donate money to the poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他向贫困儿童捐赠钱。
words.en: To donate means to give something, especially money, to a person or organization that needs help.

words.tr:
v. 保证；确保；
n. 保证；保证书；
words.ex: The store guarantees a refund if you are not happy.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不满意，商店保证退款。
words.en: A guarantee is a formal promise that certain conditions will be fulfilled, especially that a product will be repaired or replaced if it is not of a specified quality.

words.tr: adj. 残疾的； v. “disable”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The disabled man uses a wheelchair to move around.
words.ex_cn: 这位残疾人使用轮椅行动。
words.en: If someone is disabled, they are unable to use part of their body or mind properly, for example, because of injury or illness.

words.ex: The disabled need better access to public places.
words.ex_cn: 残疾人需要更好的公共设施访问权。
words.en: People who are physically or mentally impaired, especially those who are unable to perform certain tasks or activities because of their impairment.

words.ex: He received a certificate for completing the course.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了课程后获得了证书。
words.en: A certificate is an official document attesting a fact, in particular.

words.tr: v. 使气馁；使胆怯；吓倒
words.ex: The loud noise did not daunt her.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音并没有吓倒她。
words.en: If something daunts you, it makes you feel slightly afraid or worried about dealing with it.

words.ex: The sunset was spectacular.
words.ex_cn: 日落非常壮观。
words.en: Something that is spectacular is very impressive or dramatic.

words.tr: n. 床上用品；寝具； v. “bed”的现在分词；
words.ex: She bought new bedding for her bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 她为卧室买了新的床上用品。
words.en: Bedding refers to the materials that are used on a bed for sleeping on, such as sheets and blankets.

words.ex: He carries his books in a rucksack.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在帆布背包里。
words.en: A rucksack is a bag with shoulder straps that allow it to be carried on someone's back, typically used by hikers or travelers.

words.ex: The view from the mountain is marvelous.
words.ex_cn: 从山上看到的景色极好。
words.en: If you describe something as marvelous, you are emphasizing that it is extremely good.

words.tr: adj. 有历史意义的；历史性的；
words.ex: This is a historic moment for our country.
words.ex_cn: 这是对我们国家有历史意义的时刻。
words.en: Something that is historic is important in history, or potentially so.

words.ex: She weaves a basket from reeds.
words.ex_cn: 她用芦苇编织一个篮子。
words.en: If you weave cloth or a carpet, you make it by crossing threads over and under each other using a machine or a frame called a loom.

words.ex: He deliberately broke the rule.
words.ex_cn: 他有意地违反了规则。
words.en: If you do something deliberately, you do it intentionally or after thinking about it carefully.

words.ex: He handed out a leaflet about the event.
words.ex_cn: 他分发了一份关于该活动的传单。
words.en: A leaflet is a small sheet of printed paper that gives you information or advertises something.

words.ex: We planned our itinerary before the trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们在旅行前规划了路线。
words.en: An itinerary is a plan of a journey, including the route and the places that you will visit.

words.tr: v. 使适应（新气候或环境）
words.ex: He needs to acclimatize to the hot weather.
words.ex_cn: 他需要适应炎热的天气。
words.en: To acclimatize means to adjust to a new climate, environment, or situation.

words.tr: v. 到达…的顶点；达到高潮；告终
words.ex: The concert culminated with a loud fireworks show.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会以一场响亮的烟花表演结束。
words.en: If an event or series of events culminates in something, it ends with it, having developed until it reaches this point.

words.ex: She wore a gorgeous dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件华丽的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: If you say that something is gorgeous, you mean that it gives you a lot of pleasure or is very attractive.

chapters.name: 真题解析7 T3 S2 词汇拓展

words.tr:
n. 侦察兵；
v. 搜寻；
words.ex: The scout watched the enemy's movement quietly.
words.ex_cn: 侦察兵悄悄观察敌人的动向。
words.en: A scout is someone who is sent to an area of countryside to find out the position of an enemy or to search for a suitable place for a military camp.

words.tr: phrase. 募捐；凑份子；向众人筹钱
words.ex: They decided to pass the hat around to raise money for the charity event.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定传递帽子来为慈善活动筹集资金。
words.en: To collect money from a group of people, typically for a charitable cause or to help someone in need.

words.tr: phrase. 慈善机构；慈善组织
words.ex: The charitable institution provides food and shelter for homeless people.
words.ex_cn: 这家慈善机构为无家可归的人提供食物和住所。
words.en: A charitable institution is an organization that helps people in need, often by providing money, food, or other types of support.

words.ex: He is a philanthropist who gives money to poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位向贫困儿童捐款的慈善家。
words.en: A philanthropist is someone who helps others, especially by giving money to people who need it.

words.tr: phrase. 慈善舞会；为慈善筹款而举办的正式舞会
words.ex: The charity ball raised over a million dollars for the children's hospital.
words.ex_cn: 慈善舞会为儿童医院筹集了超过一百万美元。
words.en: A charity ball is a formal dance event held to raise funds for a charitable cause.

words.tr: phrase. 善行；慈善行为；功德
words.ex: She is known for her many good works in the community.
words.ex_cn: 她因在社区中的许多善举而闻名。
words.en: Good works refer to acts of kindness or charity that are done to help others, often motivated by moral or religious beliefs.

words.ex: He went to the hospital because he felt sick.
words.ex_cn: 他因为感觉不舒服去了医院。
words.en: A hospital is a place where people who are ill or injured are treated and taken care of by doctors and nurses.

words.tr: phrase. 慈善学校；由慈善机构资助的学校
words.ex: The charity school provided education to underprivileged children.
words.ex_cn: 这所慈善学校为贫困儿童提供教育。
words.en: A charity school is a school that provides free education to children from poor families, often funded by charitable donations.

chapters.name: 真题解析7 T3 S3 关于海洋研究的讨论

words.ex: The robotic arm helps doctors during surgery.
words.ex_cn: 机械臂帮助医生进行手术。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of robots or robotics.

words.tr: n. 受公众注意的程度；简介；轮廓；
words.ex: The celebrity's profile rose after the TV interview.
words.ex_cn: 这位名人经过电视采访后，受公众注意的程度提高了。
words.en: A profile is a side view of something, especially a person's face, or a brief description of someone or something.

words.tr:
v. 发射；发起；启动；
n. 发射；投掷；启动；
words.ex: They will launch a rocket tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将发射一枚火箭。
words.en: To launch something means to send it into the air, space, or water, especially with a lot of force or effort, or to start an activity, event, or project.

words.ex: She lives in Indonesia.
words.ex_cn: 她住在印度尼西亚。
words.en: A country in Southeast Asia, consisting of an archipelago between the Indian Ocean and the Pacific Ocean, known for its diverse cultures, languages, and biodiversity.

words.ex: His speech was very impressive.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲非常令人印象深刻。
words.en: Something that is impressive makes you admire it because it is very good, large, important, etc.

words.tr: v. 激活；使活动；使活化；
words.ex: Press the button to activate the device.
words.ex_cn: 按下按钮来激活设备。
words.en: If a device or process is activated, it starts working or becomes operational.

words.ex: The satellite sends pictures from space.
words.ex_cn: 卫星从太空发送图片。
words.en: A satellite is an object which has been sent into space in order to collect information or to be part of a communications system. Satellites move continually round the earth or around another planet.

words.ex: The weather shows a lot of variation in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天天气变化很大。
words.en: A variation is a difference or change in the usual or expected amount, level, or form of something.

words.ex: The salinity of the sea water is too high for most fish.
words.ex_cn: 海水的盐分对大多数鱼来说太高了。
words.en: The concentration of salt in a solution, especially in water.

words.ex: The meteorological report says it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 气象报告说明天会下雨。
words.en: Relating to the branch of science concerned with the processes and phenomena of the atmosphere, especially as a means of forecasting the weather.

words.tr: phrase. 厄尔尼诺现象（太平洋赤道地区海水异常变暖的现象）
words.ex: El Nino causes heavy rain in South America.
words.ex_cn: 厄尔尼诺现象导致南美洲暴雨频发。
words.en: A climate pattern characterized by unusually warm ocean temperatures in the Equatorial Pacific, affecting global weather.

words.ex: The ozone layer protects us from the sun's harmful rays.
words.ex_cn: 臭氧层保护我们免受太阳有害射线的伤害。
words.en: Ozone is a form of oxygen that has three atoms in each molecule, and it is a pale blue gas with a pungent smell. It is found in the Earth's atmosphere and absorbs ultraviolet radiation, which is harmful to living organisms.

words.ex: The depletion of natural resources is a serious problem.
words.ex_cn: 自然资源的损耗是一个严重的问题。
words.en: The act of reducing something by a large amount so that there is not enough left.

words.ex: She tried to prevail on him to change his mind.
words.ex_cn: 她试图劝服他改变主意。
words.en: If a proposal, principle, or opinion prevails, it gains influence or is accepted, often after a struggle or argument.

words.tr:
n. 救援；营救；
v. 救援；营救；
words.ex: The rescue came just in time to save the hikers.
words.ex_cn: 救援及时赶到，救出了徒步者。
words.en: To rescue someone or something means to save them from a dangerous or unpleasant situation.

words.tr: n. 含意；可能的影响（或后果）；暗示；
words.ex: The implication of his words was that he was sorry.
words.ex_cn: 他话中的含意是他很抱歉。
words.en: An implication is a possible future effect or result of an action or decision, often one that is not immediately obvious.

words.tr:
v. 保存；保护；保持；
n. （某群体）专有的活动；
words.ex: She preserves fresh fruit by making jam.
words.ex_cn: 她通过做果酱来保存新鲜水果。
words.en: To preserve something means to maintain it in its original or existing state.

words.ex: We need sustainable energy to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要可持续的能源来保护环境。
words.en: If something is sustainable, it can be maintained or continued at a certain rate or level without causing damage or depletion of resources.

chapters.name: 真题解析7 T3 S3 词汇拓展

words.ex: The arctic ocean is very cold.
words.ex_cn: 北冰洋非常寒冷。
words.en: The Arctic Ocean is the ocean around the North Pole, the smallest and shallowest of the world's five major oceans.

words.ex: The fisherman sails on the Indian Ocean.
words.ex_cn: 渔夫在印度洋上航行。
words.en: The Indian Ocean is the third largest of the world's oceanic divisions, covering approximately 20% of the water on the Earth's surface. It is bounded by Asia to the north, Africa to the west, Australia to the east, and the Southern Ocean to the south.

words.ex: The ship crossed the Atlantic Ocean.
words.ex_cn: 船穿越了大西洋。
words.en: The Atlantic Ocean is the second largest of the world's oceans, separating the continents of Europe and Africa to the east from those of North and South America to the west.

words.ex: The fish swim in the Pacific Ocean.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在太平洋里游动。
words.en: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest of the world's ocean divisions, extending from the Arctic Ocean in the north to the Southern Ocean in the south, and bounded by Asia and Australia on the west and the Americas on the east.

words.ex: He traveled to Oceania last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了大洋洲。
words.en: A region centered on the islands of the tropical Pacific Ocean.

words.ex: The Amazon River is in America.
words.ex_cn: 亚马逊河位于美洲。
words.en: The term 'America' can refer to the United States of America or the continents of North America and South America collectively.

words.ex: He wants to visit Africa next year.
words.ex_cn: 他想明年去非洲旅行。
words.en: Africa is the continent south of Europe, between the Atlantic Ocean and the Indian Ocean.

words.ex: He travels to Asia every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他每年夏天都去亚洲旅行。
words.en: Asia is the largest of the world's continents, covering approximately 30 percent of the Earth's land area. It is also the world's most populous continent, with roughly 60 percent of the total population.

words.ex: He traveled to Europe last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了欧洲。
words.en: Europe is one of the world's seven continents, comprising the westernmost peninsula of Eurasia. It's known for its rich history, diverse cultures, and significant contributions to art, science, and politics.

chapters.name: 真题解析7 T3 S4 有关旅馆设施和服务的发言

words.ex: The host showed great hospitality to the guests.
words.ex_cn: 主人对客人表现出极大的款待。
words.en: Hospitality is friendly and generous behaviour towards guests, especially by giving them food, drink, or a place to stay.

words.tr: v. 使迷失方向；使迷惘
words.ex: The storm disoriented the hikers.
words.ex_cn: 风暴使徒步者迷失了方向。
words.en: To cause someone to lose their sense of direction or to become confused.

words.ex: The bad news dispirited the whole team.
words.ex_cn: 这个坏消息让整个团队士气低落。
words.en: If something dispirits you, it makes you lose your enthusiasm and excitement.

words.ex: The palace had opulent carpets and golden chandeliers.
words.ex_cn: 宫殿里有华丽的地毯和金色的吊灯。
words.en: Having or displaying great wealth or richness.

words.tr: adj. 现代的；当代的；同时代的；
words.ex: This museum displays contemporary art.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆展示现代艺术。
words.en: Belonging to or occurring in the present; or a person or thing living or existing at the same time as another.

words.ex: The external wall of the house is painted blue.
words.ex_cn: 房子的外墙被刷成了蓝色。
words.en: External is used to indicate that something is on the outside of a surface or body, or that it exists, happens, or comes from outside.

words.ex: The police will investigate the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方将调查这起事故。
words.en: If someone, especially an official, investigates an event, situation, or claim, they try to find out what happened or what is the truth.

words.ex: She wore a chic dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条别致的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as chic, you mean that they are stylish and fashionable.

words.ex: She bought a dress from a small boutique downtown.
words.ex_cn: 她在市中心的一家小型时装精品屋买了一条裙子。
words.en: A boutique is a small shop that sells stylish clothes, shoes, or jewelry.

words.ex: He lives in a big mansion near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他住在湖边的一座大宅子里。
words.en: A mansion is a very large, impressive house, especially one that is the home of a wealthy or important person.

words.tr: n. 奢华；奢侈品；难得的享受；
words.ex: She bought a luxury dress for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一件奢华的裙子。
words.en: Luxury is very great comfort, especially among beautiful and expensive surroundings.

words.tr: phrase. 免除；省掉；没有也行
words.ex: He decided to dispense with the formal dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他决定取消正式的晚宴。
words.en: If you dispense with something, you stop using it or get rid of it, usually because you no longer need it.

words.tr: v. 使增加至最大限度；最大化；
words.ex: He tries to maximize his profit by selling more.
words.ex_cn: 他通过多卖东西来使利润达到最大。
words.en: To maximize something means to make it as great in amount, size, or importance as possible.

words.ex: The car has a sleek design.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有着流畅的外形。
words.en: Sleek describes something that is smooth, glossy, and streamlined, often implying a sense of elegance and efficiency.

words.ex: Strong foundations underpin the building.
words.ex_cn: 坚固的地基支撑着这栋建筑。
words.en: To support, strengthen, or provide a foundation for something.

words.tr: n. 旅馆经理；旅馆老板；
words.ex: The hotelier welcomed guests with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 旅馆经理微笑着欢迎客人。
words.en: A person who owns or manages a hotel.

words.ex: The predictability of the weather helps farmers plan their work.
words.ex_cn: 天气的可预测性帮助农民规划他们的工作。
words.en: The ability to be predicted; the quality of being predictable.

words.ex: Parents shouldn't indulge their children's bad habits.
words.ex_cn: 父母不应该放任孩子的坏习惯。
words.en: To indulge means to allow yourself or someone else to have something enjoyable, especially more than is good for you.

words.ex: She pampered her baby with warm baths and soft blankets.
words.ex_cn: 她用温水浴和柔软的毯子细心照顾她的婴儿。
words.en: To treat someone very kindly, often too kindly, by letting them have or do whatever they want.

words.ex: Parents often spoil their children with too many toys.
words.ex_cn: 父母经常用太多玩具宠坏孩子。
words.en: To spoil something means to reduce its quality or value, often by damaging it in some way. It can also mean to treat someone, especially a child, with too much kindness or indulgence, leading to their detriment.

words.tr:
v. 治疗；对待；
n. 款待；
words.ex: The doctor will treat his fever with medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生会用药物治疗他的发烧。
words.en: If you treat someone or something in a particular way, you behave towards them or deal with them in that way.

words.ex: The minuscule dot was hard to see with the naked eye.
words.ex_cn: 那个极小的点用肉眼很难看到。
words.en: If you describe something as minuscule, you mean that it is very small.

chapters.name: 真题解析7 T3 S4 词汇拓展

words.ex: The minuscule dot was hard to see with the naked eye.
words.ex_cn: 那个极小的点用肉眼很难看到。
words.en: If you describe something as minuscule, you mean that it is very small.

words.ex: He put the milk in the fridge.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶放进冰箱里。
words.en: A fridge is a large container which is kept cool inside, usually by electricity, so that the food and drink in it stays fresh.

words.ex: The radiator is hot in the winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天时，散热器是热的。
words.en: A radiator is a device for heating a room or building, consisting of a series of pipes through which hot water or steam is circulated. It can also refer to a device for cooling an engine or other mechanism, typically consisting of a bank of thin tubes with fins attached, through which coolant flows.

words.ex: He heats food in a microwave oven.
words.ex_cn: 他用微波炉加热食物。
words.en: A microwave oven is an oven that uses microwaves to cook or heat food.

words.ex: She makes a quilt for her baby.
words.ex_cn: 她为宝宝做了一床被子。
words.en: A quilt is a bed cover made by sewing layers of fabric together, often with a layer of padding in between, to provide warmth.

words.ex: He put his head on the pillow and fell asleep.
words.ex_cn: 他把头放在枕头上，睡着了。
words.en: A pillow is a cushion that you rest your head on when you are in bed.

words.ex: He wrote his name on a sheet of paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在一张纸上写了名字。
words.en: A sheet is a large piece of thin cloth used on a bed to lie on or under. It can also refer to a flat, thin piece of material, such as paper, metal, or glass.

words.ex: He dried his hands with a towel.
words.ex_cn: 他用毛巾擦干手。
words.en: A towel is a piece of thick soft cloth that you use to dry yourself with.

words.ex: She washed the bed-linen every week.
words.ex_cn: 她每周都洗床单被套。
words.en: Bed-linen refers to the sheets, pillowcases, and other items used on a bed.

words.tr:
n. 衣柜；壁橱；贮藏室
adj. 隐藏的
words.ex: He keeps his shirts in the closet.
words.ex_cn: 他把衬衫放在壁橱里。
words.en: A closet is a small room or space in a house or apartment where clothes, shoes, and other items are stored.

chapters.name: 真题解析7 T4 S1 租房

words.ex: I live with a local family during my homestay.
words.ex_cn: 我在寄宿家庭期间和一个当地家庭住在一起。
words.en: A homestay is a form of tourism and/or study abroad program that allows the visitor to rent a room from a local family to better learn the local lifestyle as well as improve their language ability.

words.ex: He will enroll in the English course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将注册英语课程。
words.en: To officially register or enlist oneself or someone else in a course, institution, or organization.

words.tr: phrase. 高级的英语；指较高水平的英语学习或使用能力
words.ex: He is taking an advanced English course this semester.
words.ex_cn: 他这学期正在上一门高级英语课程。
words.en: English language instruction or study materials designed for learners at a high level of proficiency.

words.ex: He has a preference for tea over coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: A preference is a greater liking for one alternative over another or others.

words.ex: The veterinarian helps sick animals.
words.ex_cn: 兽医帮助生病的动物。
words.en: A veterinarian is a person who is qualified to treat sick or injured animals.

words.tr:
n. 素食者；食草动物；
adj. 素食者的；素菜的；
words.ex: He is a vegetarian and doesn't eat meat.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名素食者，不吃肉。
words.en: A vegetarian is someone who does not eat meat or fish, and sometimes other animal products, especially for moral, religious, or health reasons.

words.ex: He plays handball after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后打手球。
words.en: Handball is a team sport in which two teams of seven players each pass a ball using their hands with the aim of throwing it into the goal of the other team.

chapters.name: 真题解析7 T4 S1 词汇拓展

words.ex: He plays cricket every weekend with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都和朋友们打板球。
words.en: Cricket is a sport played between two teams of eleven players each, using a bat and ball, on a field with a wicket at each end.

words.ex: He plays rugby every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期六打橄榄球。
words.en: Rugby is a sport played by two teams of 15 players each, using an oval ball that players kick, pass, or carry in order to score points by grounding the ball behind the opponent's goal line or kicking it between the goalposts.

words.ex: He plays football with his friends every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末和朋友踢足球。
words.en: A game played by two teams of eleven players with a round ball that may not be touched with the hands or arms during play except by the goalkeepers. The object of the game is to score goals by kicking or heading the ball into the opponents' goal.

words.ex: He plays soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末踢足球。
words.en: Soccer is a game played between two teams of eleven players who try to score by kicking or heading a ball into the opposing team's goal.

words.ex: He plays hockey every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末打冰球。
words.en: Hockey is a sport played on ice or on a field, in which two teams try to hit a small hard object called a puck or a ball into the other team's goal using long curved sticks.

words.tr:
n. 球类运动（squash）；
v. 压碎；
words.ex: He plays squash every weekend with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末和朋友打壁球。
words.en: To squash something means to press or squeeze it so that it becomes flat, soft, or out of shape. It can also refer to the sport of squash or a type of vegetable.

words.ex: He plays baseball every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末打棒球。
words.en: a game played especially in North America by two teams of nine players, in which a player hits a ball with a bat and tries to run around four bases on a large field before the other team returns the ball

words.ex: She plays softball every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 她每个周末都打垒球。
words.en: A game similar to baseball but played on a smaller field and with a larger, softer ball.

words.ex: He plays ice hockey every weekend with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都和朋友打冰球。
words.en: A game played on ice between two teams of six players each, who wear skates and compete to score goals by hitting a puck into the opponent's goal with a hockey stick.

chapters.name: 真题解析7 T4 S2 公园介绍

words.tr: adj. 每二百年发生一次的；
words.ex: The bicentennial celebration marked 200 years since the country's founding.
words.ex_cn: 二百年庆典纪念了该国建国200周年。
words.en: A bicentennial is the two-hundredth anniversary of a significant event.

words.tr: n. 摧毁；拆毁；拆除；大败；
words.ex: The demolition of the old building started last week.
words.ex_cn: 那座旧楼的拆除上周开始了。
words.en: The act of demolishing something, especially a building.

words.ex: The old factory is now a derelict building.
words.ex_cn: 那座旧工厂现在是一座破败的建筑。
words.en: If a building or a piece of land is derelict, it is not cared for and is in bad condition. A derelict person or thing is one that has been abandoned or neglected.

words.ex: The boxes are stored in the warehouse.
words.ex_cn: 这些箱子存放在仓库里。
words.en: A warehouse is a large building where raw materials or manufactured goods may be stored before their export or distribution for sale.

words.ex: The farm has a big storehouse for grain.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场有一个存放谷物的大仓库。
words.en: A storehouse is a building where things are stored.

words.tr: n. 住房供给； v. 收容；“house”的现在分词；
words.ex: The city needs more housing for low-income families.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市需要为低收入家庭提供更多的住房供给。
words.en: Housing refers to buildings or other shelters in which people live; a place to live.

words.tr:
adj. 复杂的；
n. 综合楼（群）；
words.ex: The instructions are too complex for children.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明对孩子来说太复杂了。
words.en: Something that is complex has many different parts, and is therefore often difficult to understand.

words.tr: phrase. 正规公园；规整布局的公园，通常指设计对称、植被修剪整齐、具有几何布局的公共园林
words.ex: They walked in the formal park near the palace.
words.ex_cn: 他们在宫殿附近的正规公园里散步。
words.en: A formal park is a park that is designed and maintained in a formal manner, often featuring symmetrical layouts, manicured lawns, and structured gardens. It is usually subject to specific rules and regulations to maintain its appearance and atmosphere.

words.tr:
n. 特征；报刊特写；
v. 以…为特色；是…的重要组成；
words.ex: The main feature of this phone is its long battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的主要特征是续航时间长。
words.en: A feature of something is an interesting or important part or characteristic of it.

words.ex: The movie was fantastic!
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极好！
words.en: If you describe something as fantastic, you are emphasizing that you think it is very good or that you like it a lot.

words.ex: The boxing match took place in an arena.
words.ex_cn: 拳击比赛在竞技场举行。
words.en: An arena is a place or scene of activity, debate, or conflict, especially one where a competition or performance is held.

words.ex: He practices gymnastics every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上练习体操。
words.en: Gymnastics is a sport that involves exercises and movements that require physical strength, flexibility, balance, and control.

words.tr: phrase. 花样游泳：一种游泳运动，其中一个或多个游泳者的动作与音乐伴奏同步进行，以形成不断变化的图案。
words.ex: She participated in the synchronized swimming competition.
words.ex_cn: 她参加了花样游泳比赛。
words.en: Synchronized swimming is a sport in which swimmers perform a synchronized routine of elaborate moves in the water, accompanied by music.

words.tr: n. 潜水；跳水； v. 潜水；跳水；“dive”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves diving in the clear sea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在清澈的海里潜水。
words.en: The sport or activity of swimming or exploring underwater.

words.ex: The garden has ornamental flowers.
words.ex_cn: 这个花园里有装饰性的花卉。
words.en: Something that is ornamental is intended to be attractive and is not necessary or useful.

words.tr:
v. 使脱落；去除；
n. 棚屋；
words.ex: The tree sheds its leaves in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在秋天落叶。
words.en: A shed is a small building, usually made of wood, used for storing things such as garden tools. When something sheds, it loses its covering, such as leaves or hair, or it gets rid of something it no longer needs.

words.ex: The birds live in the mangrove near the sea.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿生活在海边的红树林里。
words.en: A mangrove is a tropical maritime tree or shrub of the genus Rhizophora, characterized by its tangled roots that grow above ground and form dense thickets.

words.tr: adj. 易接近的；可使用的；简单易懂的；可进入的；
words.ex: The park is accessible by bus.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园乘公交车可达。
words.en: If a place or building is accessible to people, it is easy for them to reach it or get into it. If an object is accessible, it is easy to reach.

words.tr: n. 海滨的木板人行道
words.ex: We walked on the boardwalk by the sea.
words.ex_cn: 我们在海边的木板路上散步。
words.en: A boardwalk is a path made of wooden boards, especially one built along a beach or waterfront for walking.

words.tr: phrase. 远端；远处的那一端
words.ex: The ball rolled to the far end of the field.
words.ex_cn: 球滚到了场地的远端。
words.en: The most distant point or extreme limit of something, often used in contexts like communication or physical space.

words.ex: The animals found refuge in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这些动物在森林中找到了避难所。
words.en: A place or state of safety or shelter from danger, trouble, or difficulty.

words.tr:
n. 避难所；庇护所；
v. 庇护；遮蔽；
words.ex: The refugees found shelter in a small building.
words.ex_cn: 难民们在一个小建筑里找到了避难所。
words.en: A shelter is a small building or covered place which is made to protect people from bad weather or danger.

words.ex: He uses binoculars to watch birds in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他用望远镜在公园里看鸟。
words.en: Binoculars are an instrument that you hold up to your eyes to look at objects that are far away. It consists of two small telescopes joined together.

chapters.name: 真题解析7 T4 S2 词汇拓展

words.ex: The village is located in a quiet valley.
words.ex_cn: 村庄坐落在一个宁静的山谷中。
words.en: A valley is a low area of land between hills or mountains, typically with a river or stream flowing through it.

words.ex: The sheep graze in the green dale.
words.ex_cn: 羊群在绿色的山谷中吃草。
words.en: A dale is a valley, especially in northern England.

words.ex: The rocky path made hiking difficult.
words.ex_cn: 多岩石的小路让徒步变得困难。
words.en: A rocky area is covered with rocks or consists of large areas of rock and has nothing growing on it.

words.ex: The boy found a dark cave near the hill.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在山附近发现了一个黑暗的洞穴。
words.en: A cave is a large hole in the side of a cliff or hill, or one that is under the ground.

words.tr:
n. 远足；
v. 远足；
words.ex: We went on a long hike in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 我们去山里进行了一次长途远足。
words.en: A hike is a long walk in the country, especially one that you go on for pleasure. It can also refer to an increase in the cost or amount of something.

words.tr: phrase. v. 徒步离开；从某地徒步出去（尤指从偏远地区或露营地）
words.ex: We decided to hike out of the forest before dark.
words.ex_cn: 我们决定在天黑前徒步离开森林。
words.en: To walk a long distance, especially in a remote or rugged area.

words.ex: They live in a big villa near the sea.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在海边的一座大别墅里。
words.en: A villa is a fairly large house, especially one that is used for holidays in Mediterranean countries.

words.ex: The old manor stood beside a large lake.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的庄园坐落在一个大湖旁边。
words.en: A large country house with lands; the principal house of a landed estate.

words.ex: The kiwi is a flightless bird from New Zealand.
words.ex_cn: 几维鸟是一种来自新西兰的不会飞的鸟。
words.en: A kiwi is a flightless bird native to New Zealand, or the fruit of a Chinese gooseberry vine, which is also known as kiwifruit.

words.ex: The ostrich runs very fast on the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 鸵鸟在草原上跑得很快。
words.en: An ostrich is a large African bird that cannot fly and has long legs and a long neck.

words.ex: The cobra hissed at the man.
words.ex_cn: 眼镜蛇向那个人嘶嘶作响。
words.en: A cobra is a highly venomous snake known for its hood and its ability to spit venom.

words.ex: The poisonous spider bit the boy.
words.ex_cn: 那只毒蜘蛛咬了那个男孩。
words.en: A spider that is capable of injecting venom into its prey or predators, which can cause harm or death.

words.ex: The crocodile is swimming in the river.
words.ex_cn: 鳄鱼正在河里游泳。
words.en: A crocodile is a large reptile that lives in rivers in the tropical regions of Africa, Asia, America, and Australia. It has a long body, a long tail, and very strong jaws.

words.tr: n. 变色龙；见风使舵的人
words.ex: The chameleon changes color to hide.
words.ex_cn: 变色龙改变颜色来隐藏自己。
words.en: A chameleon is a type of lizard that can change the color of its skin in order to blend in with its surroundings.

words.ex: He loves scuba diving in the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在海洋里潜水。
words.en: Scuba diving is an underwater swimming activity where divers use a self-contained underwater breathing apparatus (scuba) to breathe underwater.

words.ex: We had a barbecue in the park last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们在公园举行了户外烧烤。
words.en: A barbecue is a meal or gathering at which meat, fish, or other food is cooked out of doors on a rack over an open fire or on a special appliance.

words.tr: phrase. 洞穴开发；对洞穴资源的利用或开采
words.ex: The government stopped the cave exploiting to protect the natural environment.
words.ex_cn: 政府停止了洞穴开发，以保护自然环境。
words.en: The practice of exploring or exploiting caves, often for tourism or research.

words.ex: He loves mountain climbing on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末去登山。
words.en: The activity or sport of climbing mountains.

words.tr: n. 航海；帆船运动； v. 航行；“sail”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves sailing on the open sea.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱在公海上航海。
words.en: The activity or sport of moving across water in a boat that is propelled by the wind.

words.tr: v. 漂移；漂流；“drift”的现在分词；
words.ex: The boat is drifting away from the shore.
words.ex_cn: 船正在远离岸边漂移。
words.en: Drifting refers to the act of moving slowly, especially as a result of outside forces, with no control over direction.

words.tr: n. 玫瑰； v. 上升；提高；“rise”的过去式；
words.ex: She picked a red rose from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 她从花园里摘了一朵红玫瑰。
words.en: A rose is a flower, often with a pleasant smell, which grows on a bush with thorns on the stems.

words.ex: She planted a white lily in her garden.
words.ex_cn: 她在花园里种了一朵白色的百合。
words.en: A lily is a plant with large flowers that are often white, but can also be pink, yellow, or purple. Lilies are commonly used in gardens and as cut flowers.

words.ex: She gave her mom a red carnation on Mother's Day.
words.ex_cn: 她在母亲节送了妈妈一朵红色的康乃馨。
words.en: A carnation is a type of flower with a sweet smell, which is often worn on special occasions such as weddings or funerals.

words.ex: He ate a big pomelo for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个大柚子。
words.en: A pomelo is a large citrus fruit with a thick rind and a sweet, slightly tangy interior, similar to but larger than a grapefruit.

words.ex: He eats grapefruit for breakfast every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早餐吃葡萄柚。
words.en: A grapefruit is a large, round, yellow or orange fruit that has a sharp, slightly bitter taste.

chapters.name: 真题解析7 T4 S3 老师布置展示作业

words.ex: He gave a presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于气候变化的报告。
words.en: The act of showing or explaining something to an audience.

words.ex: The teacher will assess your homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天会评估你的作业。
words.en: to judge or decide the amount, value, quality, or importance of something

words.ex: He read a historical book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于古罗马的历史书。
words.en: Historical means relating to the study of history or connected with the past.

words.ex: The map shows geographical features like mountains and rivers.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图显示了山脉和河流等地貌特征。
words.en: Relating to the study of the physical features of the earth and its atmosphere, and of human activity as it affects and is affected by these, including the distribution of populations and resources, land use, and industries.

words.ex: The report gives an overview of the project.
words.ex_cn: 这份报告对项目进行了概述。
words.en: An overview is a general summary or review of a subject.

words.ex: Do you want to go out tonight? Nope.
words.ex_cn: 你今晚想出去吗？不。
words.en: Used to give a negative response or to refuse something.

words.ex: He attended a seminar on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个关于气候变化的研讨会。
words.en: A seminar is a meeting where a group of people discuss a problem or topic.

words.ex: He has a positive attitude toward life.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活持积极的态度。
words.en: If you are positive about things, you are hopeful and confident, and think of the good aspects of a situation rather than the bad ones.

words.ex: The teacher used an overhead projector to show the diagram.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用高射投影机展示图表。
words.en: An overhead projector is a device that projects images or text onto a screen or wall, typically used in classrooms or meetings for presentations.

words.tr:
n. 规模；等级；比例（尺）；刻度；秤；
v. 改变…大小；
words.ex: The scale of the project surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的规模让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: A scale is a set of levels or numbers which are used in a particular system of measuring things or are used when comparing things.

words.ex: The school needs more resources for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校需要为学生提供更多的资源。
words.en: A resource is a source or supply from which benefit is produced. Typically resources are materials, energy, services, staff, knowledge, or other assets that are transformed to produce benefit and in the process may be consumed or made unavailable.

words.ex: He picked up a brochure about the city.
words.ex_cn: 他拿了一本关于这座城市的宣传小册子。
words.en: A brochure is a type of small magazine or booklet containing pictures and information about something or advertising something.

words.ex: Children need literacy to read books and write letters.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们需要有读写能力才能读书和写信。
words.en: Literacy is the ability to read and write.

words.ex: He looked up the word in an encyclopaedia.
words.ex_cn: 他从百科全书中查找了这个词。
words.en: A book or set of books giving information on many subjects or on many aspects of one subject and typically arranged alphabetically.

words.tr: adj. 充满热情的；热心的；
words.ex: He is enthusiastic about playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他对打篮球充满热情。
words.en: If you are enthusiastic about something, you show how much you like or enjoy it by the way that you behave and talk.

words.ex: He went to a tutorial to understand math better.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加辅导以更好地理解数学。
words.en: A tutorial is a period of teaching and discussion with a tutor, especially in a British university or college.

chapters.name: 真题解析7 T4 S3 词汇拓展

words.ex: The teacher gave us a math assignment.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一份数学作业。
words.en: An assignment is a task or piece of work that you are given to do, especially as part of your job or studies.

words.ex: He finished his homework before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 他在截止日期前完成了作业。
words.en: A deadline is a time or date before which a particular task must be finished or a particular thing must be done.

words.tr: n. 扩展；延长期；延伸；电话分机；
words.ex: The company added an extension to its office building.
words.ex_cn: 公司为办公楼加了一个扩建部分。
words.en: An extension is a part that is added to something to make it longer or larger, or the act of adding this part.

words.tr:
n. 调查；勘测；
v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did a survey about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了一项关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: A survey is a detailed study or inspection, especially as a means of collecting information about people's opinions or behavior.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a questionnaire about our habits.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们一份关于我们习惯的问卷。
words.en: A questionnaire is a written list of questions which are answered by a lot of people in order to provide information for a report or a survey.

chapters.name: 真题解析7 T4 S4 关于味精的介绍

words.ex: He added monosodium glutamate to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 他往汤里加了谷氨酸钠。
words.en: A sodium salt of glutamic acid, used as a flavor enhancer in food.

words.ex: This chemical is an enhancer for plant growth.
words.ex_cn: 这种化学物质是植物生长的增强剂。
words.en: An enhancer is something that improves the quality, value, or extent of something else.

words.ex: Italian cuisine is famous for pasta and pizza.
words.ex_cn: 意大利烹调风格以意大利面和披萨闻名。
words.en: A style or method of cooking, especially as characteristic of a particular country, region, or establishment.

words.ex: The fish swim among the seaweed near the shore.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在岸边的海藻间游动。
words.en: Seaweed is a plant that grows in the sea, especially in the ocean. It is often used in food, medicine, and cosmetics.

words.ex: The extraction of coal harms the environment.
words.ex_cn: 煤炭的开采对环境有害。
words.en: The process of removing or obtaining something from something else.

words.ex: Proteins are made of amino acids.
words.ex_cn: 蛋白质由氨基酸组成。
words.en: An amino acid is a type of organic acid that contains both a carboxyl group and an amino group, and is a basic component of proteins.

words.ex: This product is commercially successful.
words.ex_cn: 这个产品在商业上很成功。
words.en: In a way that is related to the buying and selling of goods and services.

words.ex: She ate a crisp apple for snack.
words.ex_cn: 她吃了一个脆苹果当点心。
words.en: Something that is crisp is hard, and makes a pleasant sound when you break it or crush it.

words.ex: The storm will intensify tonight.
words.ex_cn: 风暴今晚会加强。
words.en: To make or become more intense or intensive.

words.ex: This is an evolutionary change in the species.
words.ex_cn: 这是该物种的一种进化的改变。
words.en: Relating to or denoting processes of development or growth, especially in a biological context.

words.ex: He is an associate professor at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学的副教授。
words.en: An associate professor is a mid-level academic rank in universities and colleges, above assistant professor and below full professor.

words.ex: He eats eggs for protein.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋来获取蛋白质。
words.en: Proteins are large, complex molecules that play many critical roles in the body. They are necessary for the structure, function, and regulation of the body's tissues and organs.

words.ex: Bread and rice are rich in carbohydrate.
words.ex_cn: 面包和米饭富含碳水化合物。
words.en: A carbohydrate is a substance found in foods such as bread, potatoes, and rice which provides your body with heat and energy and which consists of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen.

words.ex: The poison in the snake is a natural toxin.
words.ex_cn: 蛇的毒液是一种天然毒素。
words.en: A toxin is a poisonous substance, especially one produced by bacteria, which causes disease.

words.ex: The spoilage of milk happens when it is left out too long.
words.ex_cn: 牛奶放太久就会腐败。
words.en: The process of becoming spoiled, especially the decay or decomposition of food.

chapters.name: 真题解析7 T4 S4 词汇拓展

words.ex: He cooked soup with a leek.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根韭葱煮了汤。
words.en: A leek is a vegetable that is related to the onion, with flat leaves and a white base. It is used in cooking for its mild flavor.

words.ex: He adds ginger to his tea for flavor.
words.ex_cn: 他往茶里加姜来调味。
words.en: Ginger is a plant with a thick, knobby root that is used as a spice in cooking. It has a strong, spicy flavor and is also used in traditional medicine.

words.ex: He adds garlic to the soup for flavor.
words.ex_cn: 他往汤里加蒜来提味。
words.en: A strong-smelling pungent-tasting bulb, used as a flavoring in cooking and in herbal medicine.

words.ex: She added pepper to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她往汤里加了胡椒粉。
words.en: Pepper is a hot-tasting powder made from the crushed seeds of certain plants, used to flavor food.

words.ex: He added a hot pepper to the soup to give it a spicy kick.
words.ex_cn: 他在汤里加了一个辣椒，使汤变得辛辣。
words.en: A hot pepper is a type of chili pepper that is known for its spicy flavor. It is commonly used in cooking to add heat and flavor to dishes.

words.ex: She adds rosemary to the soup for flavor.
words.ex_cn: 她往汤里加迷迭香来提味。
words.en: Rosemary is a woody, perennial herb with fragrant, evergreen, needle-like leaves and white, pink, purple, or blue flowers, native to the Mediterranean region.

chapters.name: 阅读真题认知词汇 A

words.ex: A cluster of birds flew over the tree.
words.ex_cn: 一群鸟飞过树顶。
words.en: A group of similar things or people positioned or occurring closely together.

words.tr: phrase. 一个……的横截面；代表……的典型样本
words.ex: The book shows a cross-section of ancient Roman life.
words.ex_cn: 这本书展示了古罗马生活的横截面。
words.en: A cross-section of a group of people or things is a representative group of them.

words.tr: phrase. 虚假的希望；看似有希望但实际上令人失望的情况
words.ex: After a false dawn, the project finally took off.
words.ex_cn: 经过一个虚假的开始，这个项目终于起飞了。
words.en: A temporary or illusory improvement that is not sustained.

words.ex: He owns five acres of farmland.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有五英亩的农田。
words.en: A unit of area used in the US Customary and the British Imperial systems, equal to 4,840 square yards or 4,046.86 square meters.

words.ex: The activation of the new app took only a few seconds.
words.ex_cn: 新应用的激活只花了几秒钟。
words.en: The action or process of making something active or operative.

words.tr: n. 针灸医生；针疗医生；
words.ex: The acupuncturist helped me with my back pain.
words.ex_cn: 这位针灸医生帮我缓解了背痛。
words.en: An acupuncturist is a person who is trained to perform acupuncture, which is the practice of inserting thin needles into specific points on the body to relieve pain or treat various physical, mental, and emotional conditions.

words.ex: The old adage says, 'Slow and steady wins the race.'
words.ex_cn: 这句古老的格言说：'慢而稳者胜。'
words.en: An adage is a short, wise saying which has been used for a long time and is generally accepted as true.

words.tr:
n. 附属物；
adj. 附属的；
words.ex: The printer is an adjunct to the computer.
words.ex_cn: 打印机是电脑的附属物。
words.en: Something that is added or attached to something else but is not essential to it.

words.ex: The dress has gold adornment on the hem.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子的裙边有金色装饰。
words.en: An adornment is something that is used to make a person or thing more beautiful or attractive.

words.ex: It is advantageous to wake up early.
words.ex_cn: 早起是有利的。
words.en: If something is advantageous to you, it is likely to benefit you.

words.ex: The farmer uses aeration to help plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用通气来帮助植物生长。
words.en: The process of exposing to air, or of causing air to circulate through a substance.

words.tr: adj. 航空的；航空学的；飞机驾驶员的（等于 aeronautic）
words.ex: He designs aeronautical systems for airplanes.
words.ex_cn: 他为飞机设计航空系统。
