words.en: A roster is a list which gives details of the members of a team, organization, or group, and the times or order in which they are to perform a particular duty.

words.ex: He rubs his hands together to warm them.
words.ex_cn: 他搓手来暖和它们。
words.en: To move one's hand or a cloth repeatedly back and forth on the surface of something with firm pressure.

words.tr: adj. 未充分发展的；初步的；基本的；
words.ex: His knowledge of math is rudimentary.
words.ex_cn: 他对数学的了解是初步的。
words.en: Rudimentary means relating to the basic or simplest aspects of a subject, or being in the earliest stages of development.

words.tr:
n. 隆隆声；辘辘声
v. 隆隆作响；辘辘行驶
words.ex: The dog let out a low rumble.
words.ex_cn: 狗发出了一声低沉的咆哮。
words.en: To make a continuous deep, resonant sound; to speak in a low, deep voice.

words.ex: The soup is too runny; add more flour.
words.ex_cn: 这汤太稀了；加点面粉。
words.en: Something that is runny is more liquid than usual or than was intended.

words.ex: Heavy rain caused a large runoff into the river.
words.ex_cn: 大雨导致大量径流进入河流。
words.en: Runoff refers to water, from rain or melting snow, that flows over the surface of the ground and eventually into streams, rivers, and lakes. It can also refer to a final race, election, or contest to decide a winner after an earlier one has not produced a clear result.

chapters.name: 阅读真题认知词汇 S

words.tr:
n. 军刀；马刀
v. 用军刀斩
words.ex: He carries a saber to protect himself.
words.ex_cn: 他带着一把弯刀来保护自己。
words.en: A saber is a type of sword with a curved blade, used especially by soldiers in the past.

words.ex: He flies a sailplane over the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他驾驶滑翔机飞越群山。
words.en: A sailplane is a light aircraft that is designed to fly without an engine, using the currents of air to stay in the air.

words.ex: Dogs produce saliva when they smell food.
words.ex_cn: 狗闻到食物时会分泌唾液。
words.en: Saliva is the watery liquid that forms in your mouth and helps you to chew and digest food.

words.ex: Saltpeter is used to make gunpowder.
words.ex_cn: 硝石用于制造火药。
words.en: A white crystalline salt used especially in gunpowder, as a food preservative, and in medicine.

words.tr: phrase. 抽样理论；统计学中关于如何从总体中抽取样本并进行推断的理论
words.ex: He is learning sampling theory in his statistics class.
words.ex_cn: 他正在统计课上学习抽样理论。
words.en: Sampling theory is a branch of statistics that involves the selection, analysis, and interpretation of data obtained from a random subset of a population.

words.tr: n. 公共卫生；卫生设施；
words.ex: The city improved sanitation to keep people healthy.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改善了公共卫生以保障人民健康。
words.en: The conditions and processes that help maintain health and prevent disease, especially through cleanliness.

words.ex: The floor was covered with sawdust after the carpenter worked.
words.ex_cn: 木匠工作后，地板上铺满了锯屑。
words.en: Sawdust consists of tiny particles of wood that are produced when you saw wood.

words.ex: The mice scamper away when they see the cat.
words.ex_cn: 老鼠一看到猫就四处奔逃。
words.en: If people or small animals scamper somewhere, they move there quickly with small, light steps.

words.ex: He uses a scanner to copy documents.
words.ex_cn: 他使用扫描仪来复制文件。
words.en: A scanner is a device that captures images from photographic prints, posters, magazine pages, and similar sources for computer editing and display.

words.ex: His scepticism about the plan made him ask many questions.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个计划的怀疑态度让他提出了很多问题。
words.en: Scepticism is an attitude of doubting that particular claims or statements are true or that something will happen.

words.ex: He wrote a scholarly article about ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于古代历史的学术性文章。
words.en: A scholarly person or activity is serious and academic, and involves a lot of reading and studying.

words.ex: She scoured the pan until it was clean.
words.ex_cn: 她把锅擦得干干净净。
words.en: If you scour something, you clean it by rubbing it hard with something rough.

words.tr:
n. 灾难；祸患；鞭子
v. 鞭打；折磨；使受苦难
words.ex: Pollution is a scourge on the environment.
words.ex_cn: 污染是对环境的祸害。
words.en: A scourge is something that causes a lot of trouble or suffering, or a whip used as an instrument of punishment.

words.tr:
n. 侦察兵；
v. 搜寻；
words.ex: The scout watched the enemy's movement quietly.
words.ex_cn: 侦察兵悄悄观察敌人的动向。
words.en: A scout is someone who is sent to an area of countryside to find out the position of an enemy or to search for a suitable place for a military camp.

words.tr:
n. 小块；碎片；废金属；吵架
v. 废弃；取消
adj. 废弃的
words.ex: He picked up a scrap of paper from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起一张纸片。
words.en: A scrap is a small piece or amount of something, especially one that is left over after the greater part has been used. It can also mean to discard or get rid of something as being no longer useful or necessary.

words.ex: The deer walked through the scrub near the hill.
words.ex_cn: 鹿穿过了山边的灌木丛。
words.en: To scrub something means to rub it hard in order to clean it, especially using a stiff brush and water.

words.ex: He is scrupulous about checking his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他检查作业时一丝不苟。
words.en: If you are scrupulous, you are careful, thorough, and extremely attentive to details.

words.tr: v. 详细检查；仔细察看
words.ex: The teacher scrutinizes every student's homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师仔细检查每位学生的作业。
words.en: If you scrutinize something, you examine it very carefully, often to find out some information from it or about it.

words.tr:
v. 扭打；混战
n. 扭打；混战
words.ex: The two boys had a scuffle over the ball.
words.ex_cn: 两个男孩为了球打了一架。
words.en: A scuffle is a short, confused fight or struggle at close quarters.

words.ex: The fish swim above the seabed.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在海床上方游动。
words.en: The seabed is the bottom of the ocean, consisting of various sediments and rocks.

words.ex: Rivers carry sediment to the sea.
words.ex_cn: 河流把沉积物带到大海。
words.en: Material that settles to the bottom of a liquid; matter that has been deposited by some natural process.

words.tr:
n. 种子；籽；
v. 播种；
words.ex: The farmer planted the seed in the soil.
words.ex_cn: 农夫把种子种在土里。
words.en: A seed is the small, hard part of a plant from which a new plant grows.

words.tr: adj. 不证自明的；不言而喻的
words.ex: It is self-evident that water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
words.ex_cn: 水在100摄氏度沸腾是显而易见的。
words.en: Something that is self-evident is so obvious that there is no need for proof or explanation.

words.ex: He is a self-proclaimed expert on ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 他自称是古代历史专家。
words.en: Describes someone who claims to be a particular thing, especially without having the necessary qualifications or without being recognized as such by others.

words.ex: The word 'bank' has different semantic meanings.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'bank' 有不同的语义含义。
words.en: Semantic is used to describe something that relates to the meanings of words and sentences.

words.ex: The robot uses a sensor to detect walls.
words.ex_cn: 机器人使用传感器来检测墙壁。
words.en: A sensor is a device which reacts to certain physical conditions or impressions such as heat or light, and which is used to provide information.

words.ex: The sensory experience of eating chocolate is wonderful.
words.ex_cn: 吃巧克力的感觉体验很棒。
words.en: Sensory means relating to the physical senses of touch, smell, taste, hearing, and sight.

words.ex: Serotonin helps regulate mood and sleep.
words.ex_cn: 5-羟色胺有助于调节情绪和睡眠。
words.en: A compound present in blood platelets and serum that constricts the blood vessels and acts as a neurotransmitter.

words.tr: n. 计划；组织；机构；装配
words.ex: The set-up for the party was perfect.
words.ex_cn: 派对的计划很完美。
words.en: The way in which something, especially an organization or equipment, is organized, planned, or arranged.

words.ex: The severity of the storm caused many power outages.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴的严重性导致了许多停电。
words.en: The severity of something is the degree to which it is serious or severe.

words.ex: The city cleaned the sewage from the streets.
words.ex_cn: 城市清理了街道上的污水。
words.en: Sewage is waste matter such as faeces or dirty water from homes and factories, which flows away through sewers.

words.ex: The rod is a long shaft made of metal.
words.ex_cn: 这根杆是一根长金属杆。
words.en: A shaft is a long, narrow part or section forming the handle of a tool or club, the body of a spear or arrow, or a long, narrow, typically vertical hole that gives access to a mine, accommodates a lift, or provides ventilation.

words.tr: n. 切碎机；粉碎机；碎纸机
words.ex: He put the paper into the shredder.
words.ex_cn: 他把纸放进碎纸机里。
words.en: A shredder is a machine that cuts paper into very small pieces in order to destroy it.

words.tr: adj. 精明的；敏锐的；机灵的；
words.ex: He made a shrewd decision to buy the house low.
words.ex_cn: 他精明地决定低价买下这栋房子。
words.en: A shrewd person is able to understand and judge a situation quickly and to use this understanding to their own advantage.

words.ex: The farmer used a sickle to cut the wheat.
words.ex_cn: 农夫用镰刀割小麦。
words.en: A tool with a curved blade used for cutting crops such as wheat or grass.

words.ex: He takes a siesta after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后小睡一会儿。
words.en: A siesta is a short sleep or rest which you have in the early afternoon, especially in hot countries.

words.ex: The signification of this word is clear.
words.ex_cn: 这个词的含义是清楚的。
words.en: The meaning or importance of something.

words.ex: The river deposited silt on the banks.
words.ex_cn: 河流在河岸上沉积了淤泥。
words.en: Silt is fine sand, soil, or mud which is carried along by a river and then left on the land.

words.tr:
n. 肌腱；力量的来源
v. 给…以力量
words.ex: The sinew held the muscle to the bone.
words.ex_cn: 肌腱将肌肉连接到骨头。
words.en: A sinew is a tendon, the strong tissue that connects muscles to bones, or it can refer to the strength and energy that makes someone able to do something difficult.

words.ex: He likes to size up the situation before making a decision.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在做决定前先评估一下情况。
words.en: To size up means to assess or evaluate something or someone, often in terms of their potential, ability, or size.

words.ex: He earned a sizeable amount of money from his business.
words.ex_cn: 他从生意中赚了一笔可观的钱。
words.en: A sizeable amount or quantity of something is fairly large.

words.ex: He joined skills-training to get better at his job.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了技能培训以更好地胜任工作。
words.en: Skills-training refers to the process of teaching or learning specific skills, often in a professional or vocational context.

words.ex: He likes slapstick comedy because it makes him laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢滑稽喜剧，因为它让他大笑。
words.en: Slapstick is a type of physical comedy characterized by broad humor, absurd situations, and vigorous, usually violent action.

words.ex: The children rode a sled down the snowy hill.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们坐着雪橇从积雪的山坡滑下。
words.en: A sled is a vehicle used for traveling over snow and ice, typically consisting of a light frame mounted on runners and often used for recreation or transporting goods.

words.ex: The slit in the curtain let in a thin beam of light.
words.ex_cn: 窗帘上的裂缝透进了一束细光。
words.en: A long, narrow cut or opening.

words.ex: The children played on the slope behind the house.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在房子后面的斜坡上玩耍。
words.en: A slope is a surface that is at an angle, so that one end is higher than the other.

words.tr:
v. 出声地吃喝；啧啧地响
n. 啧啧吃的声音；咕嘟声
words.ex: He slurps his soup noisily.
words.ex_cn: 他吧嗒吧嗒地喝汤。
words.en: To drink or eat something noisily.

words.ex: He runs a small-scale bakery in his town.
words.ex_cn: 他在镇上经营一家小型面包店。
words.en: involving or relating to a small number of people or things, or to a small area

words.tr: v. 厚厚地覆盖；使…窒息；闷死
words.ex: He tried to smother the fire with a blanket.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用毯子把火闷灭。
words.en: To smother someone or something means to kill them by covering their face so that they cannot breathe, or to put out a fire by covering it.

words.ex: He took a snapshot of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他拍了一张日落的照片。
words.en: A snapshot is a photograph that is taken quickly and casually, or a brief summary or overview of something.

words.ex: He gave a sniff of the flower.
words.ex_cn: 他闻了闻那朵花。
words.en: To sniff is to breathe in air through your nose in a way that makes a noise, especially when you are trying to smell something or when you have a cold.

words.tr: n. 摩托雪橇；雪地机动车；
words.ex: He drives a snowmobile across the frozen lake.
words.ex_cn: 他开着摩托雪橇穿越结冰的湖面。
words.en: A snowmobile is a small vehicle, designed for travel on snow and ice, that is steered by skis at the front and propelled by a belt of tracks at the back.

words.tr: phrase. 社交环境；社会场合
words.ex: He feels nervous in a social setting.
words.ex_cn: 他在社交场合中感到紧张。
words.en: A social setting refers to the immediate physical and social environment in which people live or in which something happens or develops. It includes the culture that the individual was educated or lives in, and the people and institutions with whom they interact.

words.ex: The sociobiologist studies how animals behave in groups.
words.ex_cn: 这位社会生物学家研究动物群体的行为。
words.en: A sociobiologist is a scientist who studies the biological basis of social behavior in animals and humans.

words.ex: The policy helps low-income, socio-economic groups.
words.ex_cn: 这项政策帮助了低收入的社会经济群体。
words.en: Relating to the interaction of social and economic factors.

words.ex: He eats soft-boiled eggs for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃溏心蛋。
words.en: Cooked in boiling water for a short time so that the yolk is still soft.

words.ex: Salt is soluble in water.
words.ex_cn: 盐可以溶于水。
words.en: A substance that is soluble can be dissolved in a liquid.

words.ex: He lives in South Africa.
words.ex_cn: 他住在南非。
words.en: South Africa is a country located at the southern tip of the African continent, known for its diverse cultures, languages, and natural beauty.

words.ex: The scientist uses a spectrometer to analyze light.
words.ex_cn: 科学家使用光谱仪分析光。
words.en: An instrument used for measuring properties of light over a specific portion of the electromagnetic spectrum, typically used in spectroscopic analysis to identify materials.

words.ex: The sperm whale swims deep in the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 抹香鲸在海洋深处游动。
words.en: A large toothed whale with a massive head, typically found in deep waters and known for its spermaceti organ.

words.ex: He spoke to his friend yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天和他的朋友说了话。
words.en: A spoke is one of the rods or bars that connect the center of a wheel to its outer edge, helping to support the wheel's structure.

words.ex: The sponge lives in the ocean and filters water for food.
words.ex_cn: 这种海绵动物生活在海洋中，通过过滤水来获取食物。
words.en: A sponge is a piece of a soft, light, porous substance originally from the skeletons of marine creatures, used for washing, cleaning, or padding. As a verb, it means to wipe, rub, or clean with a sponge or to absorb something.

words.tr: adv. 间断发生地；零星地
words.ex: He visits his grandma sporadically.
words.ex_cn: 他偶尔去看望奶奶。
words.en: If something happens sporadically, it happens occasionally and not regularly or continuously.

words.ex: The city's sprawl has covered many farmlands.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的杂乱无序的拓展覆盖了许多农田。
words.en: If you sprawl somewhere, you sit or lie with your legs and arms spread out in a careless way.

words.ex: He ran a 100-meter sprint in under 11 seconds.
words.ex_cn: 他在100米冲刺中跑出了不到11秒的成绩。
words.en: If you sprint, you run or ride as fast as you can over a short distance.

words.tr:
n. 球类运动（squash）；
v. 压碎；
words.ex: He plays squash every weekend with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末和朋友打壁球。
words.en: To squash something means to press or squeeze it so that it becomes flat, soft, or out of shape. It can also refer to the sport of squash or a type of vegetable.

words.tr:
n. 吱吱声；尖叫声
v. 短促而尖厉地叫；吱吱叫
words.ex: The mouse makes a small squeak.
words.ex_cn: 老鼠发出一声小小的吱吱声。
words.en: If something or someone squeaks, they make a short, high-pitched sound.

words.ex: The squishy sponge soaked up all the water.
words.ex_cn: 湿软的海绵吸干了所有的水。
words.en: Something that is squishy is soft and easy to squash.

words.ex: The doctor tried to stabilize the patient's heart rate.
words.ex_cn: 医生试图稳定病人的脉搏。
words.en: To stabilize something means to make it stable or to prevent it from changing or declining.

words.ex: The water in the pond was stagnant.
words.ex_cn: 池塘里的水不流动。
words.en: If something such as a business or economy is stagnant, there is little activity or change.

words.tr:
n. 摊位；
v. 故意拖延；
words.ex: He sells fruits at a stall in the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场的一个摊位上卖水果。
words.en: A stall is a small open-fronted shop or a compartment for one animal in a stable or barn. As a verb, it means to stop or cause to stop making progress.

words.tr: v. “stand”的现在分词；站立； adj. 直立的；常设的； n. 地位；
words.ex: He is standing by the door.
words.ex_cn: 他正站在门边。
words.en: Your standing is your status or reputation.

words.tr: adj. 富含淀粉的；刻板的；拘谨的
words.ex: He eats starchy food like potatoes and rice.
words.ex_cn: 他吃土豆和米饭等淀粉类食物。
words.en: Starchy foods contain a lot of starch.

words.tr: adj. 完全的；荒凉的；光秃秃的；僵硬的；严厉的
words.ex: There was a stark difference between the two results.
words.ex_cn: 这两个结果之间有完全的差异。
words.en: Stark means complete, severe, or obvious in a way that is impossible to avoid noticing.

words.ex: The two rooms are starkly different.
words.ex_cn: 这两个房间完全不同。
words.en: In a way that is very clear and obvious, often in a way that is unpleasant or shocking.

words.ex: He uses stereoscopic glasses to see the 3D picture.
words.ex_cn: 他戴立体眼镜来看三维图片。
words.en: Relating to or denoting a process by which two photographs of the same object taken at slightly different angles are viewed together, creating an impression of depth and solidity.

words.tr: phrase. 立体视觉；双眼视觉，指通过双眼协同工作感知深度和三维空间的能力
words.ex: The owl has stereoscopic vision to catch mice at night.
words.ex_cn: 猫头鹰有立体视觉，以便在夜间捕捉老鼠。
words.en: The ability to perceive depth and distance using the visual information from both eyes.

words.ex: The glass bottles are sterilizable by boiling.
words.ex_cn: 这些玻璃瓶可以通过煮沸来灭菌。
words.en: Capable of being sterilized; able to be made free from bacteria or other living microorganisms.

words.ex: People often stigmatize those with mental illness.
words.ex_cn: 人们常常污名化患有精神疾病的人。
words.en: If someone or something is stigmatized, they are unfairly regarded by many people as being bad or having something to be ashamed of.

words.tr:
n. 大量贮备；囤积
v. 大量储备；囤积
words.ex: The government built a stockpile of food for emergencies.
words.ex_cn: 政府为紧急情况储备了大量食物。
words.en: A stockpile is a large supply of something that is kept to be used in the future.

words.ex: The old tree has a stout trunk.
words.ex_cn: 这棵老树有一个粗壮的树干。
words.en: Someone who is stout is rather fat or heavy.

words.tr: n. 平流层；同温层；最高层；
words.ex: Planes fly in the stratosphere to avoid bad weather.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在平流层飞行以避开恶劣天气。
words.en: The stratosphere is the second major layer of Earth's atmosphere, just above the troposphere, and below the mesosphere. It is characterized by a slight temperature increase with altitude and the presence of the ozone layer, which absorbs and scatters the solar ultraviolet radiation.

words.ex: The car has a streamlined shape to reduce wind resistance.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车具有流线型的外形以减少风阻。
words.en: Designed or arranged to offer the least resistance to fluid flow; made efficient by simplifying or eliminating unnecessary elements.

words.ex: The school has stringent rules about homework.
words.ex_cn: 学校对作业有严格的规定。
words.en: Stringent measures, rules, or conditions are very strict or severe.

words.ex: The tiger has black stripes on its orange fur.
words.ex_cn: 老虎的橙色皮毛上有黑色条纹。
words.en: A stripe is a long, narrow band or strip differing in color or texture from the surface on either side of it.

words.ex: He had a stumble on the rocky path.
words.ex_cn: 他在布满石头的小路上绊了一跤。
words.en: To stumble means to trip or momentarily lose one's balance while walking or running. It can also refer to speaking in a hesitant or faltering manner.

words.ex: Cats are a sub-category of pets.
words.ex_cn: 猫是宠物的一个子类别。
words.en: A sub-category is a category that is part of a larger category.

words.ex: The set of even numbers is a subgroup of the integers.
words.ex_cn: 偶数的集合是整数的一个子群。
words.en: A subgroup is a distinct and often subordinate group within a larger group.

words.tr: adj. 下意识的；潜意识的；
words.ex: The ad used subliminal messages to influence buyers.
words.ex_cn: 这则广告使用了下意识的信息来影响买家。
words.en: Subliminal refers to something that is below the threshold of sensation or consciousness; it is perceived by or affecting someone's mind without their being aware of it.

words.ex: The roots grow deep into the subsoil.
words.ex_cn: 根部深入到底土中。
words.en: The layer of soil lying immediately below the surface soil.

words.ex: The new policy substantially improved the results.
words.ex_cn: 新政策实质上改善了结果。
words.en: To a great extent or degree; considerably.

words.ex: The garden grows subtropical plants like citrus trees.
words.ex_cn: 这个花园种植了柑橘树等亚热带植物。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of the regions adjacent to or bordering on the tropics.

words.tr: phrase. 哺乳期阶段；指幼崽依赖母乳喂养的发育时期
words.ex: The puppy is in the suckling stage.
words.ex_cn: 这只小狗还在哺乳期。
words.en: The period during which mammals feed their young with milk.

words.ex: He is from Sudan.
words.ex_cn: 他来自苏丹。
words.en: Sudan is a country in northeastern Africa, known for its significant history and cultural diversity.

words.tr: 专有名词。苏丹海峡（注：地理上无此正式名称，可能为误称或虚构地名；'Sudan' 指苏丹国，'Straits' 指海峡）
words.ex: The ship sailed through the Sudan Straits at night.
words.ex_cn: 船在夜间驶过了苏丹海峡。
words.en: The Sudan Straits refers to a strait that is significant for its geographical location and maritime navigation, often associated with the country of Sudan.

words.tr: n. 患病者；受苦者；受难者
words.ex: The sufferer felt better after resting.
words.ex_cn: 这位患者休息后感觉好多了。
words.en: A sufferer is someone who is experiencing pain, illness, or distress.

words.tr: n. 投票；选举权；参政权
words.ex: Women won suffrage in 1920.
words.ex_cn: 女性在1920年获得了选举权。
words.en: Suffrage is the right to vote in political elections.

words.ex: The suffragette marched for women's right to vote.
words.ex_cn: 这位女权运动者游行争取女性投票权。
words.en: A suffragette was a woman who campaigned for the right to vote in public elections, especially in the early 20th century.

words.tr: adj. 适合的；合适的； v. 适合；“suit”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: This job is suited for someone who loves quiet work.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作适合喜欢安静工作的人。
words.en: If someone or something is suited to a particular purpose, they have the right qualities or characteristics for it.

words.ex: The volcano released sulfur into the air.
words.ex_cn: 火山向空气中释放了硫。
words.en: Sulfur is a pale yellow, odorless, brittle solid, which is insoluble in water but soluble in carbon disulfide.

words.ex: The factory releases sulphur dioxide into the air.
words.ex_cn: 工厂向空气中排放二氧化硫。
words.en: Sulphur dioxide is a chemical compound with the formula SO₂. It is a toxic gas with a pungent, irritating smell, released by volcanoes and in various industrial processes.

words.ex: He looked superficially at the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他只是表面地看了看这个问题。
words.en: In a way that appears to be true or real only until examined more closely.

words.ex: The new law will supersede the old one.
words.ex_cn: 新法律将取代旧法律。
words.en: If something is superseded by something newer, it is replaced because it has become old-fashioned or unacceptable.

words.ex: The supplier delivered the boxes on time.
words.ex_cn: 供应商按时送来了箱子。
words.en: A supplier is a person or company that provides goods or services to another person or company.

words.ex: There was a surge in sales during the holiday season.
words.ex_cn: 假期期间销量激增。
words.en: If something surges, it increases suddenly and greatly, after having been steady or only small in size or amount.

words.tr:
v. （使）旋转
n. 转环；旋轴
words.ex: The chair can swivel easily.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子可以轻松旋转。
words.en: A swivel is a device that allows something to turn around freely, or to turn something around freely.

words.ex: The synthesis of ideas helped solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这些想法的综合帮助解决了问题。
words.en: The act of combining different ideas, influences, or objects into a new and coherent whole.

words.ex: The shirt is made of synthetic fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫是合成纤维制成的。
words.en: Synthetic products are made from chemicals or artificial substances rather than from natural ones.

words.ex: He poured syrup on his pancakes.
words.ex_cn: 他把糖浆倒在煎饼上。
words.en: A thick, sweet liquid made by dissolving sugar in boiling water, often used as a topping for desserts or as a sweetener in drinks.

chapters.name: 阅读真题认知词汇 T

words.tr: n. 平板电脑；（刻有文字的）匾；
words.ex: He uses a tablet to read books.
words.ex_cn: 他用平板电脑读书。
words.en: A tablet is a small, flat computer that is controlled by touching the screen. It can also refer to a small, solid piece of medicine that you swallow.

words.ex: The dog showed its tail-wagging when it saw its owner.
words.ex_cn: 狗看到主人时摇了尾巴。
words.en: The action of a dog moving its tail from side to side as a sign of pleasure or excitement.

words.tr: adv. 可触摸地；可触知地；有形地
words.ex: She could tangibly feel the improvement.
words.ex_cn: 她能明显感觉到进步。
words.en: In a way that is perceptible by touch or clearly understandable.

words.tr: v. 逐渐变细；逐渐减少；
words.ex: The candle tapers toward the top.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛向顶部逐渐变细。
words.en: A taper is a long thin candle or a gradual decrease in width or thickness.

words.tr: n. 关税；税率；（旅馆、饭店等的）价目表
words.ex: The government raised the tariff on imported cars.
words.ex_cn: 政府提高了进口汽车的关税。
words.en: A tariff is a tax that a government collects on goods coming into a country.

words.ex: The taste bud detects sweet food.
words.ex_cn: 味蕾能尝出甜食。
words.en: A taste bud is a small organ on the tongue that allows you to recognize the flavors of food and drink.

words.ex: He taunted his brother for losing the game.
words.ex_cn: 他奚落弟弟比赛输了。
words.en: If someone taunts you, they say unkind or insulting things to you, especially about your weaknesses or failures.

words.ex: The tectonic plates move slowly over time.
words.ex_cn: 板块随着时间缓慢移动。
words.en: Relating to the structure of the earth's crust and the large-scale processes which take place within it.

words.tr: phrase. 颞叶（大脑中与听觉、语言和记忆相关的区域）
words.ex: The temporal lobes help us understand sounds and words.
words.ex_cn: 颞叶帮助我们理解声音和词语。
words.en: The temporal lobes are regions of the cerebral cortex that are located beneath the lateral fissure on both the left and right hemispheres of the brain. They are involved in processing sensory input into derived meanings for the appropriate retention of visual memory, language comprehension, and emotion association.

words.tr: adj. 说得过去的；站得住脚的；可防守的
words.ex: His excuse was a little weak, but still tenable.
words.ex_cn: 他的借口有点牵强，但还是说得过去的。
words.en: If an idea, argument, or plan is tenable, it is reasonable and could be successfully defended against criticism.

words.ex: The doctor used medical terminology to explain the illness.
words.ex_cn: 医生使用医学术语来解释这种疾病。
words.en: The set of terms and expressions used in a particular subject, field, or profession.

words.ex: The hikers struggled across the rough terrain.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者艰难地穿越了崎岖的地形。
words.en: Terrain is used to refer to an area of land or a type of land when you are considering its physical features.

words.ex: The terrestrial animals live on land.
words.ex_cn: 陆地动物生活在陆地上。
words.en: Of, on, or relating to the earth.

words.ex: The store sells many kinds of textile, like cotton and silk.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售多种纺织品，比如棉和丝绸。
words.en: Textiles are types of cloth or fabric, especially ones that have been woven.

words.ex: He has thalassaemia and needs regular blood checks.
words.ex_cn: 他患有地中海贫血，需要定期验血。
words.en: Thalassaemia is a genetic blood disorder characterized by the body making an abnormal form of hemoglobin, the protein in red blood cells that carries oxygen. The disorder results in excessive destruction of red blood cells, which leads to anemia.

words.tr:
v. 使融解；解冻；变缓和
n. 融雪
words.ex: The ice begins to thaw in spring.
words.ex_cn: 冰在春天开始融化。
words.en: If ice, snow, or something else that is frozen thaws, it melts. A thaw is a period of warmer weather when snow and ice melt, usually at the end of winter.

words.ex: The renaissance brought new art and ideas to Europe.
words.ex_cn: 文艺复兴为欧洲带来了新的艺术和思想。
words.en: The Renaissance was a period in European history marking the transition from the Middle Ages to modernity and covering the 15th and 16th centuries, characterized by an effort to revive and surpass ideas and achievements of classical antiquity.

words.ex: The lion is at the top of the food chain.
words.ex_cn: 狮子处于食物链的顶端。
words.en: A food chain is a series of organisms each dependent on the next as a source of food.

words.tr: phrase. 有学问的；博学的（特指学者或知识分子群体）
words.ex: The learned professor gave a lecture on ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这位有学问的教授就古代历史做了一场讲座。
words.en: Having or showing profound knowledge, especially in a particular subject.

words.ex: The Nile Delta is rich in farmland.
words.ex_cn: 尼罗河三角洲土地肥沃。
words.en: The Nile Delta is the delta formed in Northern Egypt where the Nile River spreads out and drains into the Mediterranean Sea. It is one of the world's largest river deltas and is extremely fertile, making it a key agricultural area in Egypt.

words.tr: phrase. 文人共和国；指启蒙时代欧洲知识分子通过书信与出版物形成的跨国思想交流网络
words.ex: In the 18th century, writers shared ideas across Europe through the republic of letters.
words.ex_cn: 在18世纪，作家们通过文人共和国在欧洲分享思想。
words.en: The Republic of Letters refers to the long-distance intellectual community in the late 17th and 18th centuries in Europe and the Americas. It fostered communication among the intellectuals of the time, such as philosophers, scientists, and writers, who were interested in the ideas of the Enlightenment.

words.tr: phrase. 英国皇家学会（英国最具声望的科学机构，成立于1660年，致力于推动自然科学的发展）
words.ex: The royal society supports scientific research.
words.ex_cn: 皇家学会支持科学研究。
words.en: The Royal Society is a learned society for science, and is possibly the oldest such society in existence. Founded in November 1660, it was granted a royal charter by King Charles II as 'The Royal Society'. The society fulfils a number of roles: promoting science and its benefits, recognising excellence in science, supporting outstanding science, providing scientific advice for policy, fostering international and global co-operation, education and public engagement.

words.ex: The therapist helped him feel better after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 治疗专家在事故后帮助他感觉好些了。
words.en: A therapist is a person who is skilled in a particular type of therapy and treats people using it.

words.tr: pref.pref. 表示“热、热电”之义（等于 therm-）
words.ex: The thermo- sensor shows the temperature change.
words.ex_cn: 热敏传感器显示温度变化。
words.en: A prefix used in the formation of compound words to denote heat or temperature.

words.tr: adj. （合成树脂）热固的，热变定的；
words.ex: The plastic is thermosetting, so it doesn't melt when heated.
words.ex_cn: 这种塑料是热固性的，因此加热时不会熔化。
words.en: Thermosetting refers to a material that becomes permanently hard when heated and cannot be remolded or softened by further heating.

words.tr: n. 图勒（传说中位于世界最北端的地方）
words.ex: Thule is a distant place in ancient maps.
words.ex_cn: 图勒是古地图上的一个遥远地方。
words.en: A remote or distant place, often used metaphorically to refer to somewhere very far away.

words.tr: phrase. 扎牢；妥善解决；密切联系；占用；合伙；停泊
words.ex: He will tie up the loose rope.
words.ex_cn: 他会把松开的绳子系好。
words.en: To tie up means to fasten or secure something with a cord, rope, or the like. It can also mean to occupy or engage someone or something completely, leaving no time or resources for other activities.

words.ex: The doctor examined the tissue under a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 医生在显微镜下检查了组织。
words.en: Tissue is a group of cells that have a similar structure and that work together to perform a specific function.

words.ex: The pendulum moves to and fro.
words.ex_cn: 钟摆来回摆动。
words.en: Moving repeatedly from one place to another and back again.

words.tr: phrase. 在手边；近在手边（尤指可供使用或参考）
words.ex: Keep the dictionary to hand while you write.
words.ex_cn: 写作时把字典放在手边。
words.en: If something is to hand, it is easily accessible or available for use.

words.ex: The lab technician transcribes the DNA sequence into RNA.
words.ex_cn: 实验室技术员将DNA序列转录成RNA。
words.en: To transcribe something means to write it down or to copy it from one form of recording to another.

words.ex: The joy was transient, like a brief smile.
words.ex_cn: 这种快乐是短暂的，像一个短暂的微笑。
words.en: If you describe something as transient, you mean that it lasts only for a short time.

words.tr: n. 服饰；马饰；装饰；外部标志
words.ex: He wore the trappings of a judge during the ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 他在仪式上穿上了法官的服饰。
words.en: The trappings of a particular role or job are the extra things, such as titles and ceremonies, that go with it but are not necessary to it.

words.ex: He poured treacle on his pancakes.
words.ex_cn: 他把糖蜜浇在煎饼上。
words.en: A thick, sticky, dark syrup made from partly refined sugar; molasses. Also, something that is excessively sweet or sentimental.

words.tr: n. 单调的工作；踏车；跑步机；
words.ex: His job as a data entry clerk feels like a treadmill.
words.ex_cn: 他做数据录入员的工作感觉像是一份单调的工作。
words.en: A treadmill is a device consisting of a wheel with steps around its edge or a continuous belt, used for exercise or as a power source.

words.ex: The trekker walked slowly up the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这位徒步者缓慢地走上山。
words.en: A trekker is someone who goes on a long, arduous journey, typically on foot.

words.tr: phrase. 对流层臭氧；指存在于地球大气对流层中的臭氧，通常为污染物，与平流层臭氧（有益臭氧层）不同
words.ex: Tropospheric ozone pollutes the air in big cities.
words.ex_cn: 对流层臭氧污染大城市的空气。
words.en: Tropospheric ozone is a secondary pollutant formed when sunlight triggers chemical reactions between nitrogen oxides (NOx) and volatile organic compounds (VOCs) in the atmosphere.

words.tr:
v. 把…塞进狭窄的空间；把…藏入
n. 褶皱；零食
words.ex: He tucked the letter into his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他把信塞进了口袋里。
words.en: If you tuck something somewhere, you put it there so that it is safe, comfortable, or neat.

words.tr: n. 钨（元素符号为 W）
words.ex: The light bulb uses tungsten filament.
words.ex_cn: 灯泡使用钨丝。
words.en: Tungsten is a hard, dense, steel-gray metal that is used in the manufacture of electric light filaments, X-ray targets, and in some alloys.

words.tr: adj. 浑浊的；污浊不清的；
words.ex: The river water looks turbid after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后河水看起来浑浊。
words.en: If you describe something as turbid, you mean that it is cloudy, dirty, or muddy.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；生产；结果是；关闭；朝外
words.ex: The weather turned out to be sunny.
words.ex_cn: 天气结果是晴朗的。
words.en: If something turns out a particular way, it happens in that way or has the result or degree of success indicated. If you turn out something, you produce or create it. If you turn out a light, you switch it off.

words.tr: n. 营业额；人员流动率；周转率；
words.ex: The store's turnover increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店上个月的营业额增加了。
words.en: The amount of money taken by a business in a particular period.

words.ex: He tweaked the volume to make it louder.
words.ex_cn: 他微调了音量，让它更大声。
words.en: To tweak something means to make a small change to it in order to improve it or make it work better.

words.tr: adj. 有两部分的；双重的；两倍的；
words.ex: The project has a twofold purpose: to teach and to help.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目有两个目的：教学和帮助。
words.en: If something is twofold, it has two parts or aspects.

words.ex: The typhoon destroyed many houses last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周的台风摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A typhoon is a very violent tropical storm that occurs in the western Pacific Ocean.

chapters.name: 阅读真题认知词汇 U

words.ex: The lab is ultraclean to prevent contamination.
words.ex_cn: 实验室非常洁净，以防止污染。
words.en: Extremely clean; free from dirt, impurities, or pollutants.

words.ex: The doctor used ultrasonic waves to check the baby.
words.ex_cn: 医生使用超声波来检查婴儿。
words.en: Ultrasonic refers to sound waves with frequencies higher than the upper limit of human hearing.

words.tr: n. 紫外线辐射；紫外光；
words.ex: The ultraviolet from the sun can hurt your skin.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的紫外线会伤害你的皮肤。
words.en: Ultraviolet light or radiation has a wavelength shorter than that of visible light but longer than X-rays.

words.ex: He ran unbelievably fast in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中跑得不可思议地快。
words.en: In a manner that is hard to believe; extremely.

words.tr: adj. 不让步的；不妥协的；强硬的
words.ex: He is uncompromising about honesty.
words.ex_cn: 他在诚实方面毫不妥协。
words.en: If you describe someone as uncompromising, you mean that they are determined not to change their opinions or aims in any way.

words.tr: adj. 不可战胜的；坚不可摧的
words.ex: He had an unconquerable spirit.
words.ex_cn: 他有一种不可战胜的精神。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as unconquerable, you mean that they cannot be defeated or overcome.

words.tr: adj. 未充分发挥潜力的；未达到预期目标的
words.ex: He is an under-achieving student who rarely does his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个不努力的学生，很少做作业。
words.en: Performing below the expected level, especially in academic or professional contexts.

words.ex: He forgot his homework, and understandably, the teacher was upset.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了作业，老师生气是可以理解的。
words.en: In a way that is easy to understand or that seems reasonable or expected.

words.tr: adj. 平凡的；混杂的；听不清的；看不清的
words.ex: He is an undistinguished student in his class.
words.ex_cn: 他是班上一个平凡的学生。
words.en: If you describe something as undistinguished, you mean that it is not very interesting, impressive, or good.

words.ex: He faced undue pressure from his boss.
words.ex_cn: 他受到了来自老板的过度压力。
words.en: If you describe something bad as undue, you mean that it is greater or more extreme than you think is reasonable or appropriate.

words.ex: The door handle was unobtrusive and blended with the wall.
words.ex_cn: 门把手不显眼，与墙壁融为一体。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as unobtrusive, you mean that they are not easily noticed or do not draw attention to themselves.

words.ex: He uses an unorthodox method to teach math.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种非传统的方法教数学。
words.en: If you describe someone's behaviour, beliefs, or customs as unorthodox, you mean that they are different from what is generally accepted.

words.ex: The weather is unpredictable today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气不可预测。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as unpredictable, you mean that you cannot tell what they are going to do or how they are going to behave.

words.tr: adj. 未说出口的；未用语言表达出来的；收回（unsay 的过去分词形式）；
words.ex: He felt the unsaid words between them.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到了他们之间未说出口的话。
words.en: If something is unsaid, it has not been expressed in words.

words.tr: adv. 不知不觉；无意地；糊里糊涂地；
words.ex: He unwittingly revealed the secret.
words.ex_cn: 他不知不觉地泄露了秘密。
words.en: Without being aware of what is happening or being done.

words.tr: adj. 未写下的；不成文的；
words.ex: The unwritten rule is to be kind to others.
words.ex_cn: 不成文的规则是善待他人。
words.en: An unwritten rule, law, or agreement is one that is understood and accepted by everyone, although it may not have been formally written down.

words.tr:
adj. 向上游的；
adv. 向上游；
words.ex: The fish swam upstream to lay eggs.
words.ex_cn: 鱼逆流而上产卵。
words.en: In the direction that is opposite to the flow of a stream or river.

words.ex: Uranus is the seventh planet from the Sun.
words.ex_cn: 天王星是离太阳第七远的行星。
words.en: Uranus is the seventh planet from the Sun in the Solar System. It has the third-largest planetary radius and fourth-largest planetary mass in the Solar System.

words.tr: adj. 实用的；功利主义的；
words.ex: The chair is utilitarian and comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子实用又舒适。
words.en: Utilitarian means relating to or adhering to the belief that the value of a thing or an action is determined by its utility.

words.ex: His utterance made everyone silent.
words.ex_cn: 他的话让所有人都沉默了。
words.en: An utterance is a word, statement, or sound that someone says.

chapters.name: 阅读真题认知词汇 V

words.tr: phrase. 言语能力；语言表达能力
words.ex: He has strong verbal ability and speaks clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他语言能力很强，说话清晰。
words.en: The capacity to use language effectively and to understand and produce spoken and written language.

words.ex: Fish and birds are vertebrates.
words.ex_cn: 鱼和鸟是脊椎动物。
words.en: A vertebrate is an animal that has a spine or backbone.

words.ex: The tree grows in a vertical line.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树垂直生长。
words.en: Something that is vertical stands or points straight up.

words.ex: The fishing vessel sailed out at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 那艘渔船在黎明时出海。
words.en: A vessel is a large boat or a container for holding liquids.

words.tr: phrase. 既得利益；因个人利益而支持某事的倾向
words.ex: He has a vested interest in the company's success.
words.ex_cn: 他有 vested interest 在公司的成功上。
words.en: A vested interest is a personal stake or involvement in an undertaking or state of affairs, especially one with an expectation of financial gain.

words.ex: The park is in the vicinity of my house.
words.ex_cn: 公园在我家附近。
words.en: The area or region near or about a place; the surrounding district.

words.ex: Life is full of vicissitude.
words.ex_cn: 生活充满起伏。
words.en: A change of circumstances or fortune, typically one that is unwelcome or unpleasant.

words.ex: The viral infection made him feverish for three days.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒引起的感染让他发烧了三天。
words.en: Relating to or caused by a virus; becoming very popular by circulating quickly from person to person, especially on the internet.

words.ex: Honey is a viscous liquid.
words.ex_cn: 蜂蜜是一种黏稠的液体。
words.en: A viscous liquid is thick and sticky and does not flow easily.

words.tr: adj. 发声的；嗓音的；直言不讳的；
words.ex: He made a vocal sound to get attention.
words.ex_cn: 他发出声音来引起注意。
words.en: If you are vocal about something, you express your opinions or feelings about it in a strong and public way.

words.tr: n. 发声；嗓音；说出的话
words.ex: The baby's vocalization made her mother smile.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿的发声让她的妈妈笑了。
words.en: The act or process of producing sounds with the voice, especially in speech or song.

words.ex: The system uses voiceprint to identify the user.
words.ex_cn: 该系统使用声纹来识别用户。
words.en: A voiceprint is a graphical representation of someone's voice, showing the characteristics that make it unique, used especially in identifying individuals.

words.ex: The alcohol is volatile and evaporates quickly.
words.ex_cn: 酒精是易挥发的，会迅速蒸发。
words.en: A volatile situation or person is one that is likely to change suddenly and unexpectedly, especially by getting worse.

words.ex: The volcanic eruption destroyed the village.
words.ex_cn: 火山喷发摧毁了村庄。
words.en: Volcanic is used to describe things that are connected with volcanoes or caused by volcanoes.

words.ex: The battery gives out 9 volts.
words.ex_cn: 这节电池输出9伏特。
words.en: A volt is a unit used to measure the force of an electric current.

words.tr: n. 火山活动，火山现象；火山作用
words.ex: Vulcanism causes volcanoes to erupt.
words.ex_cn: 火山作用导致火山喷发。
words.en: The phenomenon of volcanic activity, including the eruption of magma onto the surface of the Earth or a solid-surface planet or moon, where lava, pyroclastics, and volcanic gases erupt through a break in the surface called a vent.

words.tr: n. 火山学家（等于 volcanologist）
words.ex: He is a vulcanologist who studies active volcanoes.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位研究活火山的火山学家。
words.en: A vulcanologist is a scientist who studies volcanoes and volcanic phenomena.

chapters.name: 阅读真题认知词汇 W

words.tr: n. 火山学家（等于 volcanologist）
words.ex: He is a vulcanologist who studies active volcanoes.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位研究活火山的火山学家。
words.en: A vulcanologist is a scientist who studies volcanoes and volcanic phenomena.

words.tr: phrase. 磨损；逐渐减弱；逐渐消失
words.ex: The paint on the door is wearing off.
words.ex_cn: 门上的油漆正在磨损。
words.en: If a feeling or the effect of something wears off, it gradually disappears.

words.ex: He reads a book, whilst she listens to music.
words.ex_cn: 他读书，而她听音乐。
words.en: Whilst means the same as 'while'. It is used in British English.

words.tr:
conj. 当…的时候；尽管；然而；
n. 一段时间；一会儿；
words.ex: I read a book while I waited for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 我等公交车的时候读了一本书。
words.en: While is used to introduce a clause in which you mention something that happens at the same time as something else, or to introduce a clause that contrasts with something else that you have mentioned.

words.tr:
n. 假发
v. 痛骂；严责；给…装假发
words.ex: She wore a wig to cover her bald head.
words.ex_cn: 她戴了一顶假发来遮盖她光秃的头。
words.en: A wig is a covering of false hair which you wear on your head, for example because you are bald or because you want to cover up your own hair.

words.ex: He wittingly ignored the warning.
words.ex_cn: 他有意忽略了警告。
words.en: If you do something wittingly, you are fully aware of what you are doing and you intend to do it.

words.ex: The chair has a wobble on one leg.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子有一条腿在晃动。
words.en: If something wobbles or if you wobble it, it moves unsteadily from side to side.

words.tr: phrase. 木粉；木屑粉，通常用于复合材料或填充剂
words.ex: He mixes wood flour with glue to make a paste.
words.ex_cn: 他把木粉和胶水混合成糊状。
words.en: Fine particles of wood produced by sawing, sanding, or milling, used in various industrial applications.

words.ex: The deer live in the woodland near the river.
words.ex_cn: 鹿住在河边的林地中。
words.en: An area of land covered with trees, larger than a wood.

words.tr: n. 劳动力；工人总数；职工总数；
words.ex: The factory needs a larger workforce to meet demand.
words.ex_cn: 工厂需要更多的劳动力来满足需求。
words.en: The workforce is the total number of people who are employed by a particular company or who are available to work in a particular country or area.

words.ex: He wears workwear every day at his job.
words.ex_cn: 他每天上班都穿工作服。
words.en: Clothing worn for work, especially that which is durable and suitable for manual labor.

words.ex: This company makes world-beating smartphones.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司生产世界领先的智能手机。
words.en: If you describe something as world-beating, you mean that it is the best in the world.

words.tr:
v. 扭动；翻滚；苦恼
n. 扭动；翻滚
words.ex: The child writhe in pain after falling.
words.ex_cn: 孩子摔倒后痛苦地扭动。
words.en: If you writhe, your body twists and turns violently backwards and forwards, usually because you are in great pain or discomfort.

chapters.name: 阅读真题认知词汇 Y

words.ex: The yolk of the egg is yellow.
words.ex_cn: 鸡蛋的蛋黄是黄色的。
words.en: The yellow part in the middle of an egg.

chapters.name: 阅读真题认知词汇 Z

words.tr: n. 赞比亚（非洲中南部国家）
words.ex: He lives in Zambia.
words.ex_cn: 他住在赞比亚。
words.en: A country in southern Africa, known for its wildlife and the Victoria Falls.

words.ex: The bottle contains zinc to help your body stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子里含有锌，有助于你的身体健康。
words.en: Zinc is a bluish-white metal that is used in making other metals or for covering other metals to protect them.
